paras.zh: 如果您是那种在任何特定时刻都会打开 50 个标签的人，那么您将会欣赏《Exhumed》中无数离奇的事实。以下是我最喜欢的三个：

paras.en: - Leonardo da Vinci was a fan of corpse medicine, the practice of reusing body parts from dead people for medicinal purposes. Like many of his peers, da Vinci believed the human body contained “vital spirits.” When someone died, there’d be leftover spirits for the living to make use of.
paras.zh: - 列奥纳多·达·芬奇是尸体医学的爱好者，即重新利用死者的身体部位用于医疗目的。和许多同龄人一样，达·芬奇相信人体含有“生命力”。人死后，会有剩余的灵魂供生者使用。

paras.en: - In 17th century Europe, the tomato was known as the “poison apple.” Many people became sick after eating tomatoes and some even died. For two centuries, society wrongly blamed the fruit. The real killer turned out to be lead leached out of pewter dishes by tomatoes’ acidic juice.
paras.zh: - 在 17 世纪的欧洲，番茄被称为“毒苹果”。很多人吃了西红柿就生病了，有的甚至死亡。两个世纪以来，社会错误地指责这种水果。事实证明，真正的杀手是番茄酸性汁从锡盘中浸出的铅。

paras.en: - The spinning red, white and blue poles on barbershops were born out of the business’ former specialty, bloodletting. Red stripes stand for blood, blue for veins and white for the rags used for clean-up. The ball on top is said to represent the bowl that captured the blood. And the pole itself represents the wand patients squeezed during the procedure. Feeling sick in 1705? Head to the local barber with the spinning pole outside.
paras.zh: - 理发店里旋转的红、白、蓝柱子源于该行业以前的专业——放血。红色条纹代表血液，蓝色条纹代表静脉，白色条纹代表清洁用的抹布。据说顶部的球代表盛有血液的碗。杆子本身代表手术过程中患者被挤压的魔杖。 1705 年感觉不舒服吗？前往当地理发店，理发店外面有旋转杆。

paras.en: Buy Exhumed from Bookshop.org. Science News is a Bookshop.org affiliate and will earn a commission on purchases made from links in this article.
paras.zh: 从 Bookshop.org 购买《Exhumed》。 《科学新闻》是 Bookshop.org 的附属机构，通过本文中的链接进行购买将赚取佣金。

articles.title: This Halloween, amateur astronomers may be in for a dwarf planet treat
articles.author: Lisa Grossman

paras.en: The outer solar system is yielding its secrets to the Vera C. Rubin Observatory.
paras.zh: 外太阳系正在向维拉·C·鲁宾天文台透露其秘密。

paras.en: Less than five months into the observatory’s decade-long survey of the sky, a potential new dwarf planet has already popped up in its data, astronomers reported this week at a meeting of the American Astronomical Society’s Division of Planetary Sciences in Spokane, Wash.
paras.zh: 天文学家本周在华盛顿州斯波坎举行的美国天文学会行星科学部会议上报告说，天文台对天空进行了长达十年的调查不到五个月，一颗潜在的新矮行星已经出现在其数据中。

paras.en: Another team reported a handful of new Neptune Trojans, icy objects that share an orbit with Neptune, at the meeting and in the Astrophysical Journal Letters. The findings are filling in astronomers’ picture of the Kuiper Belt at the solar system’s frigid fringes.
paras.zh: 另一个团队在会议上和《天体物理学杂志快报》上报告了一些新的海王星特洛伊木马，它们是与海王星共享轨道的冰冷物体。这些发现填补了天文学家对太阳系寒冷边缘柯伊伯带的想象。

paras.en: “It feels a little bit like we’re replicating the 1800s and early 1900s, discovering what the solar system even looks like in general,” says Sam Deen, an amateur astronomer based in Simi Valley, Calif. “We’re finding out what there even is in the first place that makes up most of the Kuiper Belt.”
paras.zh: 加利福尼亚州西米谷的业余天文学家萨姆·迪恩 (Sam Deen) 表示：“感觉有点像我们正在复制 1800 年代和 1900 年代初期，探索太阳系的总体面貌。我们正在寻找构成柯伊伯带大部分区域的物质。”

paras.en: A possible dwarf planet hid in historical data
paras.zh: 历史数据中隐藏着一颗可能的矮行星

paras.en: Perched on a mountaintop in Chile, the Vera Rubin Observatory is on a mission to map the entire southern sky every couple of nights, searching for faint and fast-moving cosmic objects. The observatory took its first images in June 2025 and officially began a decade-long survey in June 2026.
paras.zh: 维拉鲁宾天文台坐落在智利的山顶上，其任务是每隔几个晚上绘制整个南部天空的地图，寻找微弱且快速移动的宇宙物体。该天文台于 2025 年 6 月拍摄了第一张图像，并于 2026 年 6 月正式开始为期十年的调查。

paras.en: Even before the official survey started, Rubin had detected the motion of an object orbiting billions of kilometers beyond Pluto. Rubin observed the object 30 times on 20 nights from March 4 to July 11. But no one knew it was there until October 13, when astrophysicist Matt Holman of the Smithsonian Astronomical Observatory in Cambridge, Mass., ran a search for moving dots of light in the data.
paras.zh: 甚至在官方调查开始之前，鲁宾就探测到了一个绕冥王星数十亿公里运行的物体的运动。从3月4日到7月11日，鲁宾在20个晚上观察了这个物体30次。但直到10月13日，马萨诸塞州剑桥史密森天文台的天体物理学家马特·霍尔曼在数据中寻找移动的光点时，才有人知道它在那里。

paras.en: The object, called 2026 ED138, appeared to be about 47 times as far from Earth as Earth is from the sun. Its brightness suggests it’s between 600 and 1,500 kilometers wide, potentially as large as other dwarf planets like Ceres and Makemake. That’s probably big enough to be spherical, making it a dwarf planet.
paras.zh: 这个被称为 2026 ED138 的天体距离地球的距离似乎是地球距离太阳距离的 47 倍。它的亮度表明它的宽度在 600 到 1,500 公里之间，可能与谷神星和鸟神星等其他矮行星一样大。它可能足够大，成为球形，使其成为一颗矮行星。

paras.en: “It’s really big. It’s damn huge,” Deen says. “No matter what you call it, it’s still the biggest thing we’ve found in the entire solar system in 19 years.”
paras.zh: “它真的很大。真是太大了，”迪恩说。 “不管你怎么称呼它，它仍然是 19 年来我们在整个太阳系中发现的最大的东西。”

paras.en: When Holman realized what he had found, he was thrilled but doubtful. “It’s quite an exciting thing,” Holman said in a news briefing at the meeting on October 27. “But one of the things that you need to do when you discover something potentially of this size is to try to verify that it’s true.”
paras.zh: 当霍尔曼意识到他的发现时，他很兴奋，但也很怀疑。 “这是一件非常令人兴奋的事情，”霍尔曼在 10 月 27 日的会议新闻发布会上说。“但是，当你发现这种规模的潜在东西时，你需要做的事情之一就是尝试验证它的真实性。”

paras.en: Holman and colleagues were able to find observations of the same object in archived data from the Dark Energy Camera, located on an adjacent mountaintop in Chile, taken in 2016.
paras.zh: 霍尔曼和同事能够在 2016 年拍摄的位于智利邻近山顶的暗能量相机的存档数据中找到对同一物体的观察结果。

paras.en: Deen was able to trace it back even farther, to photographic plates taken as part of a sky survey at Palomar Observatory in California in 1954. Other amateur astronomers independently found the same sightings.
paras.zh: 迪恩能够追溯到更远的地方，追溯到 1954 年在加利福尼亚州帕洛玛天文台进行天空调查时拍摄的照片底片。其他业余天文学家独立发现了相同的目击事件。

paras.en: “They took an image from Palomar in 1954, and another about half an hour after the first one, that both by pure chance happen to point at where ED138 is,” Deen says. “And it’s really obvious. If you know it’s supposed to be there, it’s not particularly faint.”
paras.zh: “他们于 1954 年在帕洛玛拍摄了一张照片，在第一张照片拍摄后大约半小时又拍摄了一张照片，这两张照片都纯属偶然地指向了 ED138 所在的位置，”迪恩说。 “而且它真的很明显。如果你知道它应该在那里，它就不会特别微弱。”

paras.en: So why didn’t anybody notice it until now? It’s partly because ED138 practically crawls across the sky, orbiting the sun once every 280 years. It was also moving against a dense background of Milky Way stars, where it blended in.
paras.zh: 那么为什么直到现在还没有人注意到它呢？部分原因是 ED138 几乎在天空中爬行，每 280 年绕太阳一周。它也在密集的银河系恒星背景下移动，并融入其中。

paras.en: By combining observations spanning decades, astronomers can calculate the object’s orbit with more precision.
paras.zh: 通过结合数十年的观测结果，天文学家可以更精确地计算该物体的轨道。

paras.en: Deen is hoping to observe the potential new dwarf planet pass in front of a distant star on Halloween. That sort of observation, called an occultation, can help reveal more details of the putative dwarf planet’s size and shape, and even whether it has moons or rings. Usually, it takes years to understand an object’s orbit well enough to predict an occultation, Deen says. “Getting to do it immediately is like being a kid in a candy shop, really.”
paras.zh: 迪恩希望在万圣节观察到潜在的新矮行星从一颗遥远的恒星前面经过。这种被称为掩星的观察可以帮助揭示假定的矮行星的大小和形状的更多细节，甚至它是否有卫星或环。迪恩说，通常需要数年时间才能充分了解物体的轨道以预测掩星。 “立即开始做这件事就像是一个在糖果店里的孩子，真的。”

paras.en: Icy objects could offer clues to solar system beginnings
paras.zh: 冰冷的物体可以为太阳系的起源提供线索

paras.en: A crop of newly spotted Neptune Trojans were masked by the Milky Way, too. These asteroids gather in the same orbit as Neptune, but offset from the planet at 60 degrees. Astronomers think they were some of the original building blocks of the solar system and contain an ancient record of planetary formation and evolution.
paras.zh: 一批新发现的海王星特洛伊人也被银河系掩盖了。这些小行星聚集在与海王星相同的轨道上，但与海王星的偏移角为 60 度。天文学家认为它们是太阳系的一些原始组成部分，并且包含行星形成和演化的古老记录。

paras.en: Other planets have Trojans, too. Jupiter has thousands. Astronomers think Neptune has many more, but so far they have seen only 30 in the cluster of space objects that orbit ahead of Neptune, and just two in the cluster behind it.
paras.zh: 其他行星也有特洛伊人。木星有数千个。天文学家认为海王星还有更多，但到目前为止，他们在海王星前面的空间物体星团中只看到了 30 个，而在海王星后面的星团中只看到了 2 个。

paras.en: “We would expect these [groups of Trojans] to be symmetric in numbers, so you have to get more than two,” planetary scientist Meg Schwamb said in a news conference at the meeting on October 28.
paras.zh: “我们预计这些[特洛伊木马群]在数量上是对称的，因此必须有两个以上，”行星科学家梅格·施万布 (Meg Schwamb) 在 10 月 28 日会议的新闻发布会上说道。

paras.en: The trailing cloud happened to have been moving in front of the Milky Way from the perspective of Earth for the last 15 years. Spotting individual Trojans against that crowded background was “like finding a needle in a sequined dress,” said Schwamb, of Queens University Belfast in Northern Ireland.
paras.zh: 在过去 15 年里，从地球的角度来看，尾随云恰好一直在银河系前面移动。北爱尔兰贝尔法斯特女王大学的施万布说，在拥挤的背景下发现单个特洛伊木马“就像在亮片连衣裙中找到一根针”。

paras.en: Schwamb and colleagues examined Vera Rubin data taken from the commissioning phase — the period when engineers were testing the telescope. In this early data haul, the team found two more trailing Trojans, plus one candidate. They seem to be similar in composition to the leading ones, which matches theories of how the solar system formed.
paras.zh: 施万布和同事检查了维拉·鲁宾在调试阶段（工程师测试望远镜的时期）获取的数据。在早期的数据采集中，团队发现了另外两个跟踪特洛伊木马，以及一个候选木马。它们的组成似乎与主要的类似，这与太阳系形成的理论相匹配。

paras.en: “It just kind of got lucky,” Schwamb said. “These objects photobombed the commissioning survey.”
paras.zh: “这只是运气好，”施万布说。 “这些物体对调试调查进行了照片轰炸。”

paras.en: “This is really the appetizer for what Rubin Observatory is going to do in its mission for the next ten years,” she added. “There’s hundreds more of these objects likely to be found.”
paras.zh: “这确实是鲁宾天文台未来十年使命的开胃菜，”她补充道。 “可能还会发现数百个这样的物体。”

paras.en: Some of the excitement about these discoveries is dampened by fears of losing observations to bright satellites crisscrossing the telescope’s field of view, says astronomer Sam Lawler of the University of Regina in Canada.
paras.zh: 加拿大里贾纳大学的天文学家萨姆·劳勒说，这些发现的一些兴奋感因担心观测结果被穿过望远镜视场的明亮卫星而减弱。

paras.en: “I have to put in the constant downer of how the increasing numbers of satellites will make these discoveries harder,” Lawler says. “There are one hundred new satellites launching every week, and they keep getting bigger and brighter. These discoveries will be hindered by that.”
paras.zh: “我必须不断地沮丧，因为卫星数量的增加将使这些发现变得更加困难，”劳勒说。 “每周都有一百颗新卫星发射，而且它们变得越来越大、越来越亮。这些发现将因此受到阻碍。”

paras.en: But even with the satellites, Lawler anticipates many more cool discoveries from Rubin.
paras.zh: 但即使有了卫星，劳勒预计鲁宾还会有更多酷的发现。

paras.en: “Just finding a dwarf planet so quickly, maybe we’ll find something even bigger,” she says. “There could be something the size of Mars out there. And then we’d have the whole planet debate all over again. It would be fun.”
paras.zh: “这么快就找到了一颗矮行星，也许我们会发现更大的东西，”她说。 “那里可能有火星那么大的东西。然后我们会再次进行整个星球的辩论。这会很有趣。”

articles.title: Two Crows Took a Classic Psychology Test. Their Decision-Making Skills Left Ours in The Dust.
articles.author: Jess Cockerill

paras.en: Two male crows have performed better than humans and monkeys in a classic psychology task designed to test how the brain makes decisions based on what it sees.
paras.zh: 在一项经典的心理学任务中，两只雄性乌鸦的表现比人类和猴子都要好，该任务旨在测试大脑如何根据所看到的内容做出决定。

paras.en: In prior experiments, corvids (a family of birds that includes crows, ravens, rooks, jackdaws, and jays) have shown a range of remarkable mental abilities once thought unique to primates.
paras.zh: 在之前的实验中，鸦科动物（包括乌鸦、乌鸦、白嘴鸦、寒鸦和松鸦）表现出了一系列曾经被认为是灵长类动物所独有的非凡智力。

paras.en: New Caledonian crows build compound tools and plan three steps ahead; western scrub jays have episodic-like memories; ravens are "smart enough to be paranoid".
paras.zh: 新喀里多尼亚乌鸦建造复合工具并提前计划三步；西部灌丛鸦具有情景式记忆；乌鸦“聪明得足以偏执”。

paras.en: Now, two neurobiologists from the University of Tübingen in Germany have tested the decision-making prowess of carrion crows (Corvus corone), and the results kind of leave our primate brains in the dust.
paras.zh: 现在，德国蒂宾根大学的两名神经生物学家测试了食腐乌鸦（Corvus corone）的决策能力，结果让我们的灵长类动物大脑相形见绌。

paras.en: The researchers Philipp Schmidbauer and Andreas Nieder are not only interested in demonstrating crows' intelligence. They want to understand how the birds manage such intellectual feats with such fundamentally different brains from ours.
paras.zh: 研究人员菲利普·施米德鲍尔和安德烈亚斯·尼德尔不仅对展示乌鸦的智力感兴趣。他们想了解鸟类如何利用与我们截然不同的大脑来实现如此智力上的成就。

paras.en: "Such behavioral flexibility might seem unexpected because a layered cerebral cortex, the highest integration center in the mammalian brain, is not existant in birds," Nieder wrote in a paper almost a decade ago.
paras.zh: “这种行为灵活性似乎出人意料，因为鸟类不存在分层的大脑皮层，哺乳动物大脑中最高的整合中心，”尼德在大约十年前的一篇论文中写道。

paras.en: Instead of layers, he explained, bird brains rely on circuits that originate from a different part of the pallium. Their brains are smaller than ours, but so are their neurons, which means less distance for information to travel, and more processing power per square inch.
paras.zh: 他解释说，鸟类的大脑依赖于源自大脑皮层不同部分的电路，而不是层次。他们的大脑比我们的小，但他们的神经元也比我们的小，这意味着信息传播的距离更短，每平方英寸的处理能力更强。

paras.en: "With this independently evolved endbrain design, the corvid brain affords twice as many neurons as a primate brain of equal mass, adding up to enormous processing powers in a small and densely packed 'birdbrain'," he added.
paras.zh: “通过这种独立进化的端脑设计，鸦科动物的大脑提供的神经元数量是同等质量的灵长类动物大脑的两倍，在一个小而密集的‘鸟脑’中增加了巨大的处理能力，”他补充道。

paras.en: The new experiments demonstrate just how powerful those 'birdbrains' can be.
paras.zh: 新的实验证明了这些“鸟脑”的力量有多么强大。

paras.en: Two male adult crows were put to the test. That's a very small sample size, which makes it impossible to know if the results can tell us much about crows in general. But it's a start.
paras.zh: 两只雄性成年乌鸦接受了测试。这是一个非常小的样本量，因此无法知道结果是否可以告诉我们很多有关乌鸦的总体信息。但这是一个开始。

paras.en: Each crow was placed in front of a touch-sensitive screen. In each session, the screen displays lots of dots, and then some of those dots move in one direction, left or right. The crow indicates which direction the dots are moving by pecking at a target on the corresponding side of the touch screen.
paras.zh: 每只乌鸦都被放置在触摸屏前。在每个会话中，屏幕都会显示许多点，然后其中一些点向一个方向（向左或向右）移动。乌鸦通过啄击触摸屏相应侧的目标来指示点移动的方向。

paras.en: A correct response is rewarded with a tasty mealworm.
paras.zh: 正确的反应会奖励美味的黄粉虫。

paras.en: The task is self-paced: the crows were given a wide window of time to choose their response, because the idea is that the animals express their decision once they are confident in their choice, not just for the sake of speed.
paras.zh: 这项任务是自定进度的：乌鸦有很长的时间来选择他们的反应，因为我们的想法是，一旦动物对自己的选择充满信心，他们就会表达自己的决定，而不仅仅是为了速度。

paras.en: Both crows were trained in this test across more than 100 sessions each before the real data were collected, to make sure they had it down.
paras.zh: 在收集真实数据之前，两只乌鸦都在这项测试中接受了 100 多次训练，以确保它们能把数据记录下来。

paras.en: Humans and monkeys have previously demonstrated their perceptual decision-making via this random-dot motion discrimination task, but this is the first time crows have been tested.
paras.zh: 人类和猴子之前已经通过这种随机点运动辨别任务展示了他们的感知决策，但这是第一次对乌鸦进行测试。

paras.en: The birds made deliberate decisions "with unprecedented speed, reporting choices in approximately 235 milliseconds on average, which is roughly twice as fast as has been observed in monkeys or humans," Schmidbauer and Nieder report.
paras.zh: Schmidbauer 和 Nieder 报告说，这些鸟类“以前所未有的速度做出深思熟虑的决定，平均在大约 235 毫秒内报告选择，这大约是在猴子或人类中观察到的速度的两倍”。

paras.en: And that speed came at no cost to accuracy.
paras.zh: 而且这种速度并不影响准确性。

paras.en: Next, the researchers implanted electrodes into the crows' brains. They were specifically placed to monitor the nidopallium caudolaterale (NCL), which contains neurons involved in perceiving motion direction (like the dots on the screen).
paras.zh: 接下来，研究人员将电极植入乌鸦的大脑中。它们被专门用来监测尾外侧巢穴（NCL），其中包含参与感知运动方向的神经元（如屏幕上的点）。

paras.en: On waking from surgery, the crows once again performed the random-dot task, this time with the activity of 248 individual neurons on record.
paras.zh: 从手术中醒来后，乌鸦再次执行随机点任务，这次记录了 248 个神经元的活动。

paras.en: These neurons fired signals related to the crow's imminent decision just 70 milliseconds after the dots started moving, and about 170 milliseconds before making the decisive peck.
paras.zh: 这些神经元在这些点开始移动后仅 70 毫秒、在做出决定性啄食前约 170 毫秒，就发出与乌鸦即将做出的决定相关的信号。

paras.en: These results suggest the crow brain has "primate-like computational dynamics within a distinct neural architecture, with markedly higher temporal efficiency," Schmidbauer and Nieder write, adding that crows' decision-making speed may be the result of specific pressures birds have faced in evolution.
paras.zh: 施米德鲍尔和尼德写道，这些结果表明，乌鸦的大脑“在独特的神经结构中具有类似灵长类动物的计算动力学，具有明显更高的时间效率”，并补充说，乌鸦的决策速度可能是鸟类在进化过程中面临的特定压力的结果。

paras.en: "Birds rely on their vision to carry out precise, rapid maneuvers during flight and to guide their beaks toward objects when foraging," Nieder says.
paras.zh: “鸟类依靠视觉在飞行过程中进行精确、快速的机动，并在觅食时引导喙朝向物体，”尼德说。

paras.en: 'Birdbrains' is starting to sound more like a compliment after all.
paras.zh: 毕竟，“Birdbrains”听起来更像是一种恭维。

paras.en: The research has been published in Science.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《科学》杂志上。

articles.title: Two Different Kinds of Gamma-Ray Bursts Erupted 4 Minutes Apart. Astronomers Have Never Seen This Before.
articles.author: Ivan Farkas

paras.en: Gamma-ray bursts (GRBs) are among the most energetic cosmic events since the Big Bang, releasing the most energetic type of radiation, gamma rays – the stuff that turned unassuming Bruce Banner into the rampaging Hulk, but on an astronomical, potentially planet-sterilizing level.
paras.zh: 伽马射线暴 (GRB) 是自大爆炸以来能量最高的宇宙事件之一，释放出能量最高的辐射类型——伽马射线——正是伽马射线将谦逊的布鲁斯·班纳变成了狂暴的绿巨人，但其程度却达到了天文数字，可能对行星造成毁灭性影响。

paras.en: GRBs are classed by transience, including short-duration ones that last less than two seconds and long-duration ones that last over two seconds (possibly much longer).
paras.zh: 伽马暴按瞬态性分类，包括持续时间少于两秒的短时暴和持续时间超过两秒（可能更长）的长时暴。

paras.en: The former are thought to originate from the various collisions and resultant mergers of compact celestial objects, such as neutron stars and black holes.
paras.zh: 前者被认为起源于中子星和黑洞等致密天体的各种碰撞和合并。

paras.en: The latter are typically associated with core-collapse supernovae, the outbursts of dying stars that may be tens of times more massive than the Sun.
paras.zh: 后者通常与核心塌缩超新星有关，即垂死恒星的爆发，其质量可能是太阳的数十倍。

paras.en: Now, astronomers have reported an event unlike any other yet observed or predicted: a short and a long-burst GRB, spaced only four minutes apart – a happening so unprecedentedly odd it may require a rethink of GRB classifications and origin scenarios.
paras.zh: 现在，天文学家报告了一个与迄今为止观察到或预测的任何其他事件不同的事件：一次短爆发和一次长爆发的伽玛暴，间隔仅四分钟——这一事件的发生如此前所未有的奇怪，可能需要重新思考伽玛暴的分类和起源场景。

paras.en: This singularly spectacular specimen, named GRB 160425A, is described in a paper published in Nature Astronomy.
paras.zh: 这个异常壮观的样本被命名为 GRB 160425A，在《自然天文学》上发表的一篇论文中对此进行了描述。

paras.en: "This is so far the only event with such a strange property," corresponding author Bing Zhang, an astrophysicist at the University of Hong Kong, told ScienceAlert.
paras.zh: “这是迄今为止唯一具有如此奇怪性质的事件，”通讯作者、香港大学天体物理学家张兵告诉 ScienceAlert。

paras.en: "I'd think that these are two independent GRBs, but the chance of having them happen together (in the same direction and around the same time) is so low [that] we have to admit that the pair has the same origin."
paras.zh: “我认为这是两个独立的伽玛暴，但它们同时发生（在同一方向和大约同一时间）的可能性非常低，因此我们不得不承认它们具有相同的起源。”

paras.en: The blasts were detected on April 25, 2016, by the Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory in space, a necessity since Earth's atmosphere is opaque to gamma rays, and ground-based telescopes then followed the fading afterglow.
paras.zh: 2016 年 4 月 25 日，尼尔·盖雷尔斯·斯威夫特天文台在太空中探测到了这次爆炸，这是必要的，因为地球大气层对伽马射线是不透明的，然后地面望远镜跟踪了逐渐消失的余辉。

paras.en: Its host galaxy, possibly a pair of merging galaxies, is so far away that the bursts' light took roughly 5.5 billion years to reach us.
paras.zh: 它的宿主星系，可能是一对正在合并的星系，距离如此遥远，以至于爆发的光花了大约 55 亿年才到达我们。

paras.en: So this event occurred nearly a billion years before our Solar System formed, and its high-energy light traveled across more than one-third of cosmic history to reach us.
paras.zh: 因此，这一事件发生在我们太阳系形成之前近十亿年，它的高能光穿越了超过三分之一的宇宙历史到达了我们这里。

paras.en: The first GRB, called G1, lasted a scant 1.7 seconds and is associated with a merger origin, while the second burst, called G2, lasted 51.2 seconds and is associated with a collapsing star origin.
paras.zh: 第一个GRB，称为G1，持续了不到1.7秒，与合并起源有关，而第二个爆发，称为G2，持续了51.2秒，与塌缩恒星起源有关。

paras.en: GRBs are thought to release their energy in focused beams. Momentarily ignoring this fact for relatability, the first burst released billions of years' worth of solar energy, and the second roughly three times more:
paras.zh: 人们认为伽玛暴以聚焦光束的形式释放能量。为了相关性暂时忽略这一事实，第一次爆发释放了数十亿年的太阳能，第二次释放了大约三倍的能量：

paras.en: "The total energy emitted by the Sun throughout the entire lifetime is not enough to account for the second component," Zhang explains, and notes that accounting for a beam-like release substantially changes the mathematics.
paras.zh: 张解释说：“太阳在整个生命周期中发出的总能量不足以解释第二部分。”并指出，考虑束状释放会大大改变数学。

paras.en: Altogether, this discovery is unlike any previous GRB because it combines three features: two separate bursts, the quiet gap between them, and the fact that they're different types of GRBs.
paras.zh: 总而言之，这一发现与之前的任何伽玛暴不同，因为它结合了三个特征：两次独立的爆发、它们之间的安静间隙以及它们是不同类型的伽玛暴。

paras.en: The researchers describe five possible explanations, each of which they note is "challenging," elucidating the previously mentioned astronomical odds.
paras.zh: 研究人员描述了五种可能的解释，他们指出每一种解释都是“具有挑战性的”，阐明了前面提到的天文可能性。

paras.en: The first is happenstance. Maybe the bursts came from separate host galaxies that are coincident in space and time, within about four minutes of each other and both pointing their jets toward Earth.
paras.zh: 第一个是偶然。也许这些爆发来自不同的主星系，这些星系在空间和时间上都是重合的，彼此的间隔大约在四分钟之内，并且都将它们的喷流指向地球。

paras.en: The odds of this happening in any one moment and patch of sky are about 2 in a trillion; even across all the years Swift has been watching, they're only around 1 in 100,000 to 1 in 10 million.
paras.zh: 这种情况在任何时刻、任何一片天空中发生的几率约为万亿分之二；即使斯威夫特观察了这么多年，这种比例也只有十万分之一到千万分之一左右。

paras.en: The second explanation is that the two bursts originated in the same galaxy but in different locations. The odds may be between about 8 in 10 trillion and 8 in a trillion, and once all of Swift's years of observations are factored in, it becomes even less likely than the first scenario.
paras.zh: 第二种解释是，这两次爆发起源于同一个星系，但地点不同。这种可能性可能在十万亿分之八到万亿分之八之间，一旦考虑到斯威夫特多年的观察结果，这种可能性就比第一种情况更小了。

paras.en: For perspective, 10 trillion days would be equivalent to more than 27 billion years, almost twice the age of the Universe.
paras.zh: 从长远来看，10 万亿天相当于超过 270 亿年，几乎是宇宙年龄的两倍。

paras.en: Imagine you and a friend each randomly picking a dinner date from a calendar of 10 trillion days, and the odds of you both landing on the same one. (Also pretend you're both very long-lived with very few outstanding engagements.)
paras.zh: 想象一下，您和一位朋友各自从 10 万亿天的日历中随机选择一个晚餐日期，以及你们俩落在同一个日期的几率。 （还要假装你们都很长寿，而且很少有出色的约会。）

paras.en: Explanation three is that we're seeing a rare version of a type I GRB (short duration), produced by colliding bodies like neutron stars, which give off a big bang (not the Big Bang) followed by a weaker tail-like emission.
paras.zh: 解释三是，我们看到了 I 型伽马暴（短持续时间）的罕见版本，它是由中子星等天体碰撞产生的，会发出大爆炸（不是大爆炸），随后会发出较弱的尾状发射。

paras.en: Yet the long quiet gap between them, and the fact that the second burst is far too energetic to be a mere tail, make this unlikely.
paras.zh: 然而，它们之间漫长的安静间隙，以及第二次爆发能量太大而不仅仅是尾巴的事实，使得这种情况不太可能发生。

paras.en: Enter interpretation four: could this event be a single type II GRB (long duration), from the collapse of a dying massive star, with the main explosion (G2) being prefaced by a smaller, death-bed emission (G1)?
paras.zh: 进入解释四：这个事件可能是一个单一的II型伽马射线暴（长持续时间） ，来自一颗垂死的大质量恒星的坍塌，主要爆炸（ G2 ）的前面有一个较小的死亡床发射（ G1 ） ？

paras.en: In other words, a stellar belch before the doomed star fatally upchucks its radioactive guts? Perhaps not, as such a process would likely produce a weaker initial emission.
paras.zh: 换句话说，在这颗注定失败的恒星致命地吐出其放射性内脏之前，恒星会打嗝吗？也许不会，因为这样的过程可能会产生较弱的初始排放。

paras.en: Finally, explanation five may be the most intriguing and non-standard. This double-GRB may originate within a single system that includes an undetermined type and number of celestial bodies, generating an intertwined blast that connects two of the Universe's most intensely energetic events via some mechanism that cannot yet be specified; a mystery for the ages.
paras.zh: 最后，解释五可能是最有趣且不标准的。这种双伽玛暴可能起源于一个单一系统，该系统包括未确定类型和数量的天体，产生相互交织的爆炸，通过某种尚无法确定的机制将宇宙中两个最强烈的能量事件连接起来；千古之谜。

paras.en: "That's the difficult part. We ran out the possibilities," Zhang said.
paras.zh: “这是困难的部分。我们已经没有了可能性，”张说。

paras.en: "All the scenarios have severe difficulties," he concluded. "As a theorist working on GRBs for more than two decades, this one really challenged me."
paras.zh: “所有的情况都有严重的困难，”他总结道。 “作为一名研究伽玛暴二十多年的理论家，这对我来说确实是一个挑战。”

paras.en: The research has been published in Nature Astronomy.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《自然天文学》上。

articles.title: The World's Largest Known Sponge Is The Size of a Minivan – And Its Species Is a Mystery
articles.author: Michelle Starr

paras.en: Deep beneath the blue, blue waves of the Pacific Ocean, a true benthic monster makes its home.
paras.zh: 在太平洋碧波荡漾的深处，真正的海底怪物安家落户。

paras.en: Not the giant squid with its grasping, clasping arms; nor the sperm whale with its cunning eye and raking teeth.
paras.zh: 不是那只手臂紧握、紧握的巨型乌贼；而是那只巨大的乌贼。也不是拥有狡猾的眼睛和耙齿的抹香鲸。

paras.en: Instead, this beast has the intricate folds of a forgotten pile of laundry, almost luminous against the inky darkness – the intestine-like configuration of the largest sponge humanity has ever seen.
paras.zh: 相反，这头野兽有着一堆被遗忘的衣物的复杂褶皱，在漆黑的黑暗中几乎闪闪发光——这是人类所见过的最大海绵的肠状结构。

paras.en: NOAA scientists exploring the Papahānaumokuākea Marine National Monument in 2015 found it at a depth of 2,130 meters (6,990 feet), and measured its size.
paras.zh: NOAA 科学家于 2015 年探索帕帕哈瑙莫夸基亚海洋国家纪念碑，发现其深度为 2,130 米（6,990 英尺），并测量了其大小。

paras.en: The extraordinary colony came in at 3.7 meters long, 2.1 meters wide, 1.5 meters high – "about the size of a minivan", according to NOAA.
paras.zh: 据 NOAA 称，这个非凡的菌落长 3.7 米，宽 2.1 米，高 1.5 米，“大约有一辆小型货车大小”。

paras.en: And it could have been growing down there for a very long time.
paras.zh: 它可能已经在那里生长了很长一段时间。

paras.en: The discovery was made during NOAA's 2015 Hohonu Moana: Exploring Deepwaters off Hawaiʻi expedition aboard the research vessel Okeanos Explorer.
paras.zh: 这一发现是在 NOAA 2015 年 Hohonu Moana：探索夏威夷深水区探险期间搭乘 Okeanos Explorer 号科考船进行的。

paras.en: Using a remotely operated vehicle called Deep Discoverer, the researchers spotted the enormous animal on a ridge deep beneath the ocean's surface.
paras.zh: 研究人员使用名为“深度发现者”的遥控飞行器，在海洋表面深处的山脊上发现了这种巨大的动物。

paras.en: Two parallel laser beams projected onto the sponge allowed the team to measure its height and width, while images captured from above by a second vehicle, Seirios, helped determine its length.
paras.zh: 投射到海绵上的两束平行激光束使团队能够测量其高度和宽度，而第二辆车 Seirios 从上方捕获的图像有助于确定其长度。

paras.en: Those dimensions eclipsed the previous record – a colony of the glass sponge Aphrocallistes vastus, found in shallow waters off western Canada, that measured 3.4 meters long, 0.5 meters wide, and 1.1 meters high.
paras.zh: 这些尺寸超越了之前的记录——在加拿大西部浅水区发现的玻璃海绵 Aphrocallistes badus 的群体，长 3.4 米，宽 0.5 米，高 1.1 米。

paras.en: But we don't really know who our mystery record-holder is. The researchers didn't collect a sample of the enormous sponge itself, but they did retrieve a smaller specimen from a nearby location that they believed belonged to the same species.
paras.zh: 但我们并不真正知道我们的神秘记录保持者是谁。研究人员没有收集巨大海绵本身的样本，但他们确实从附近的位置取回了一个较小的样本，他们认为该样本属于同一物种。

paras.en: Examining its microscopic skeletal structures, called spicules, revealed that it belonged to a family of glass sponges called Rossellidae. Its exact species, however, remains unidentified.
paras.zh: 通过检查其被称为骨针的微观骨骼结构，发现它属于一种名为罗丝丽科（Rossellidae）的玻璃海绵家族。然而，它的确切物种仍然未知。

paras.en: In fact, these were the only two apparent representatives of the species encountered during the expedition, despite the researchers conducting 18 dives.
paras.zh: 事实上，尽管研究人员进行了 18 次潜水，但它们是探险期间遇到的唯一两个明显代表该物种的物种。

paras.en: Glass sponges get their name from their delicate skeletons, made of silica – the same material that makes up glass. These intricate structures support the animals' bodies, while providing shelter for other marine organisms.
paras.zh: 玻璃海绵因其精致的骨架而得名，骨架由二氧化硅制成，与玻璃的材质相同。这些复杂的结构支撑着动物的身体，同时为其他海洋生物提供庇护所。

paras.en: Like other sponges, they are filter feeders, drawing seawater through their bodies to extract tiny particles of food. In doing so, they can filter enormous quantities of water, playing an important role in the ecosystems around them.
paras.zh: 和其他海绵一样，它们是滤食动物，通过身体吸入海水来提取微小的食物颗粒。通过这样做，它们可以过滤大量的水，在周围的生态系统中发挥重要作用。

paras.en: And that leaves one other burning question: Just how long does it take to grow a sponge the size of a minivan?
paras.zh: 这就留下了另一个紧迫的问题：培育出一辆小型货车大小的海绵到底需要多长时间？

paras.en: Actually, nobody knows – not for this sponge, anyway.
paras.zh: 事实上，没有人知道——至少对于这块海绵来说。

paras.en: But other massive sponges are thought to live for astonishing lengths of time. A 2008 study of giant barrel sponges (Xestospongia muta) suggested that some individuals could be more than 2,300 years old.
paras.zh: 但其他巨大的海绵被认为寿命惊人。 2008 年对巨型桶状海绵 (Xestospongia muta) 的一项研究表明，某些个体的年龄可能超过 2,300 岁。

paras.en: Whether the enormous glass sponge has a similarly Ahasuerian lifespan is unknown.
paras.zh: 巨大的玻璃海绵是否具有类似亚哈随王的寿命尚不清楚。

paras.en: Its species and age remain mysteries, more than a decade after it was discovered.
paras.zh: 它的种类和年龄在被发现十多年后仍然是个谜。

paras.en: And in the vast, largely unexplored depths of the ocean, there may be even bigger wonders waiting to be found.
paras.zh: 在广阔的、很大程度上未经探索的海洋深处，可能还有更大的奇迹等待被发现。

paras.en: "The largest portion of our planet lies in deep waters, the vast majority of which has never been explored," NOAA marine biologist Daniel Wagner said in 2016.
paras.zh: NOAA 海洋生物学家丹尼尔·瓦格纳 (Daniel Wagner) 在 2016 年表示：“我们星球的最大部分位于深水区，其中绝大多数从未被探索过。”

paras.en: "Finding such an enormous and presumably old sponge emphasizes how much can be learned from studying deep and pristine environments such as those found in the remote Papahānaumokuākea Marine National Monument."
paras.zh: “发现如此巨大且可能古老的海绵，强调了通过研究深层和原始环境（例如在偏远的帕帕哈瑙莫夸基亚海洋国家纪念碑中发现的环境）可以学到很多东西。”

paras.en: The researchers' account of the discovery was published in Marine Biodiversity in 2016.
paras.zh: 研究人员对这一发现的描述发表在 2016 年的《海洋生物多样性》杂志上。

articles.title: The asteroid killed the dinosaurs. Why did crocodiles survive?

paras.en: The asteroid killed the dinosaurs. Why did crocodiles survive?
paras.zh: 小行星杀死了恐龙。鳄鱼为何能幸存？

paras.en: - Scientists may have solved a 66-million-year-old mystery: how crocodiles survived the asteroid that wiped out the dinosaurs. A sweeping analysis of fossils and ancient climates suggests that their preference for warm environments placed them in tropical refuges that remained habitable even after the catastrophic impact.
paras.zh: - 科学家可能已经解开了一个 6600 万年前的谜团：鳄鱼如何在灭绝恐龙的小行星中幸存下来。对化石和古代气候的全面分析表明，它们对温暖环境的偏好使它们处于热带避难所，即使在灾难性影响之后，这些避难所仍然适合居住。

paras.en: Why did crocodiles survive the asteroid impact that wiped out the dinosaurs 66 million years ago? New research suggests that their preference for warm environments may have given them a crucial advantage during one of Earth's greatest mass extinctions.
paras.zh: 为什么鳄鱼在 6600 万年前恐龙灭绝的小行星撞击中幸存下来？新的研究表明，它们对温暖环境的偏好可能使它们在地球上最严重的大规模灭绝之一期间获得了至关重要的优势。

paras.en: Scientists led by UCL (University College London) found that crocodiles and their ancient relatives spent much of their 250 million years of evolutionary history following warm climates rather than adapting to dramatically different temperatures. When Earth grew hotter, they expanded into new regions, sometimes reaching as far as Antarctica. As temperatures fell, they moved back toward the tropics.
paras.zh: 由 UCL（伦敦大学学院）领导的科学家发现，鳄鱼及其远古亲戚在 2.5 亿年的进化史中，大部分时间都是在温暖的气候下度过的，而不是适应截然不同的温度。当地球变得越来越热时，它们扩展到新的区域，有时甚至到达南极洲。随着气温下降，他们又迁回热带地区。

paras.en: Published in Science Advances, the study analyzed more than 7,000 fossils and records from over 400 living and extinct species. Researchers combined this evidence with computer models that reconstructed Earth's climate and geography across 245 million years.
paras.zh: 该研究发表在《科学进展》上，分析了来自 400 多个现存和灭绝物种的 7,000 多块化石和记录。研究人员将这些证据与计算机模型相结合，重建了 2.45 亿年来地球的气候和地理。

paras.en: The results suggest that tropical and subtropical regions remained suitable for crocodile relatives after the asteroid struck, even as the environments available to many dinosaurs deteriorated. Only the most extreme climate simulations eliminated these potential refuges.
paras.zh: 结果表明，小行星撞击后，热带和亚热带地区仍然适合鳄鱼亲戚生存，尽管许多恐龙的生存环境已经恶化。只有最极端的气候模拟才能消除这些潜在的避难所。

paras.en: Why Crocodiles Survived the Dinosaur Extinction
paras.zh: 为什么鳄鱼在恐龙灭绝中幸存下来

paras.en: The researchers examined how conditions on Earth may have changed following the asteroid impact 66 million years ago. Their simulations indicated that areas near the equator could have remained warm enough to support crocodile relatives, providing places where surviving populations could persist and eventually recover.
paras.zh: 研究人员研究了 6600 万年前小行星撞击地球后地球状况可能发生的变化。他们的模拟表明，赤道附近的地区可能保持足够温暖以支持鳄鱼亲戚，为幸存的种群提供持续存在并最终恢复的地方。

paras.en: Previous modeling by members of the same research team found that suitable habitats for non-avian dinosaurs (i.e., the ones that went extinct) contracted much more severely after the impact.
paras.zh: 同一研究小组成员之前的模型发现，撞击后适合非鸟类恐龙（即灭绝的恐龙）的栖息地收缩得更严重。

paras.en: Lead author Dr. Alfio Alessandro Chiarenza, based at UCL Earth Sciences, said: "The asteroid did not make the whole planet equally hostile to every group.
paras.zh: 伦敦大学学院地球科学中心的主要作者阿尔菲奥·亚历山德罗·基亚伦扎博士说：“这颗小行星并没有让整个地球对每个群体都同样充满敌意。

paras.en: "Crocodiles' long-standing preference for warm environments may have placed survivors exactly where suitable climates held up best, like around the equator. These refuges could have sheltered populations that later recovered and radiated out."
paras.zh: “鳄鱼长期以来对温暖环境的偏爱可能将幸存者安置在气候最适宜的地方，比如赤道附近。这些避难所可能为后来恢复并辐射出去的种群提供了庇护。”

paras.en: The discovery offers a possible explanation for how a group of animals that appeared around the same time as dinosaurs managed to endure two of Earth's five major mass extinctions.
paras.zh: 这一发现为与恐龙大约同时出现的一群动物如何成功地经历了地球五次大规模灭绝中的两次提供了可能的解释。

paras.en: Ancient Crocodiles Were Far More Diverse
paras.zh: 古代鳄鱼更加多样化

paras.en: Modern crocodiles and their close relatives share many recognizable features, but their evolutionary history reveals a much wider variety of body shapes, sizes, and lifestyles.
paras.zh: 现代鳄鱼及其近亲具有许多可识别的特征，但它们的进化史揭示了更广泛的体型、大小和生活方式。

paras.en: The broader crocodile lineage, known as pseudosuchians, once included heavily armored plant eaters, predators that hunted entirely on land, and enormous animals weighing more than a metric ton.
paras.zh: 更广泛的鳄鱼谱系，被称为拟鳄类，曾经包括全副武装的植食者、完全在陆地上捕猎的掠食者，以及重量超过一吨的巨大动物。

paras.en: Among the most remarkable was Sarcosuchus, a giant predator nicknamed the "super croc" that could reach 12 meters in length. Another prehistoric relative, Postosuchus, was a land dwelling hunter capable of moving on either two legs or all four.
paras.zh: 其中最引人注目的是帝鳄，一种绰号为“超级鳄鱼”的巨型掠食者，身长可达 12 米。另一位史前亲戚波斯托鳄是一种陆地狩猎者，能够用两条腿或四条腿移动。

paras.en: Dr. Chiarenza said: "Crocodiles are often called living fossils, but their ancestors and relatives changed enormously throughout their history, ranging from giants the size of a bus that could have devoured a T. rex, to small, cute animals with the face of a pug.
paras.zh: 基亚伦扎博士说：“鳄鱼通常被称为活化石，但它们的祖先和亲戚在它们的历史中发生了巨大的变化，从可以吞掉霸王龙的巴士大小的巨人，到长着哈巴狗脸的可爱的小动物。

paras.en: "Our study shows that, despite all this diversity, what stayed surprisingly consistent was their relationship with climate."
paras.zh: “我们的研究表明，尽管存在如此多的多样性，但令人惊讶的是它们与气候的关系却保持着一致。”

paras.en: Fossils Reveal 245 Million Years of Climate History
paras.zh: 化石揭示了 2.45 亿年的气候历史

paras.en: To investigate that relationship, the scientists reconstructed the temperature and rainfall preferences of 400 crocodile species and their ancient relatives. They used fossil evidence, evolutionary family trees, and detailed maps of where living crocodile species are found today.
paras.zh: 为了研究这种关系，科学家们重建了 400 种鳄鱼及其远古亲戚对温度和降雨的偏好。他们使用了化石证据、进化谱系树以及当今发现现存鳄鱼物种的详细地图。

paras.en: The team then compared these preferences with reconstructions of ancient geography and climate to identify where suitable habitats existed at different points in Earth's history.
paras.zh: 然后，研究小组将这些偏好与古代地理和气候的重建进行比较，以确定地球历史上不同时期存在合适栖息地的地方。

paras.en: A clear pattern emerged. Crocodile relatives generally followed warmer conditions as the planet's climate changed, expanding their ranges during hot periods and retreating when temperatures cooled.
paras.zh: 一个清晰的模式出现了。随着地球气候的变化，鳄鱼的近亲通常会跟随温暖的环境，在炎热时期扩大它们的活动范围，并在气温变冷时撤退。

paras.en: About 50 million years ago, during the particularly warm early Eocene, global temperatures were approximately 10°C higher than today, and the polar regions had no permanent ice. Crocodile relatives lived at high latitudes across North America, Europe, and even Antarctica.
paras.zh: 大约5000万年前，在特别温暖的始新世早期，全球气温比今天高出约10°C，极地地区没有永久冰。鳄鱼的近亲生活在北美、欧洲甚至南极洲的高纬度地区。

paras.en: Over the following millions of years, global cooling gradually reduced the areas where they could thrive. Their geographic range contracted toward warmer tropical regions.
paras.zh: 在接下来的几百万年里，全球变冷逐渐减少了它们可以繁衍生息的地区。它们的地理范围向温暖的热带地区收缩。

paras.en: Although this preference for warm environments remained remarkably consistent, the researchers identified two important exceptions.
paras.zh: 尽管这种对温暖环境的偏好仍然非常一致，但研究人员发现了两个重要的例外。

paras.en: During the Cretaceous Thermal Maximum, approximately 94 million years ago, global temperatures climbed as much as 14°C above modern levels. One branch of the crocodile family tree evolved the ability to tolerate hotter conditions than the broader lineage could withstand at other times.
paras.zh: 在大约 9400 万年前的白垩纪最热时期，全球气温比现代水平高出 14°C。鳄鱼家谱的一个分支进化出了比其他更广泛的谱系在其他时候所能承受的更热环境的能力。

paras.en: A separate adaptation occurred around 34 million years ago in Australia. As a prolonged cooling period reduced rainfall and dried out the continent, an extinct group of crocodiles adapted to increasingly arid, desert-like environments.
paras.zh: 大约 3400 万年前，澳大利亚发生了一次单独的适应。由于长时间的冷却期减少了降雨量并使大陆变得干燥，一群灭绝的鳄鱼适应了日益干旱的沙漠环境。

paras.en: These exceptions show that some crocodile relatives could evolve to handle different climates, even though most continued to follow their preferred warm conditions.
paras.zh: 这些例外表明，一些鳄鱼亲戚可以进化来应对不同的气候，尽管大多数鳄鱼仍然遵循它们喜欢的温暖条件。

paras.en: What Happened After the Dinosaur-Killing Asteroid?
paras.zh: 恐龙灭绝小行星之后发生了什么？

paras.en: The researchers also used climate simulations to investigate the decades and centuries immediately following the Chicxulub asteroid impact, which triggered the extinction of most dinosaurs.
paras.zh: 研究人员还利用气候模拟来调查希克苏鲁伯小行星撞击后的几十年和几个世纪，这次撞击引发了大多数恐龙的灭绝。

paras.en: They explored several possible environmental consequences, including sunlight being blocked by dust and ash and rising carbon dioxide levels associated with volcanic eruptions.
paras.zh: 他们探讨了几种可能的环境后果，包括阳光被灰尘和火山灰遮挡以及与火山喷发相关的二氧化碳浓度上升。

paras.en: When the simulations reduced sunlight by 5% or 10%, warm regions near the equator remained suitable for crocodile relatives. These areas could have provided critical refuges during the environmental disruption.
paras.zh: 当模拟将阳光减少 5% 或 10% 时，赤道附近的温暖地区仍然适合鳄鱼亲戚。这些地区本可以在环境破坏期间提供重要的避难所。

paras.en: However, a more severe scenario involving a 15% reduction in sunlight left those regions unsuitable as well. The researchers noted that this extreme level of reduced sunlight is now considered unlikely.
paras.zh: 然而，更严重的情况是阳光减少 15%，这些地区也不适合。研究人员指出，这种极端的阳光减少现在被认为是不可能的。

paras.en: Other simulated changes, including increased atmospheric carbon dioxide, did not alter the availability of suitable climates for crocodiles.
paras.zh: 其他模拟的变化，包括大气中二氧化碳的增加，并没有改变适合鳄鱼生存的气候。

paras.en: Together, the results suggest that crocodiles may have benefited from living in regions where temperatures remained within their preferred range, even as conditions became much less favorable for many dinosaurs.
paras.zh: 总之，这些结果表明，鳄鱼可能受益于生活在温度保持在它们喜欢的范围内的地区，即使条件对许多恐龙来说变得不太有利。

paras.en: The Survival Strategy That Could Now Become a Weakness
paras.zh: 现在可能成为弱点的生存策略

paras.en: The researchers emphasized that favorable temperatures were probably only one reason crocodiles survived the mass extinction.
paras.zh: 研究人员强调，有利的温度可能只是鳄鱼在大规模灭绝中幸存下来的原因之一。

paras.en: Other characteristics likely improved their chances, including relatively small body sizes, the ability to live partly in water, flexible diets, and modest energy requirements. As ectothermic ("cold-blooded") animals, crocodiles need less food to maintain their bodies than many animals that generate their own body heat.
paras.zh: 其他特征可能提高了它们的机会，包括相对较小的体型、部分生活在水中的能力、灵活的饮食以及适度的能量需求。作为变温（“冷血”）动物，鳄鱼需要比许多自身产生热量的动物更少的食物来维持身体。

paras.en: The findings also raise important questions about how crocodiles will respond to modern climate change.
paras.zh: 这些发现还提出了有关鳄鱼将如何应对现代气候变化的重要问题。

paras.en: For millions of years, moving into regions with suitable temperatures appears to have been one of their main responses to a changing planet. Today, however, expanding cities, agricultural land, and roads increasingly limit where wildlife can move.
paras.zh: 数百万年来，迁入温度适宜的地区似乎是它们对不断变化的星球的主要反应之一。然而如今，不断扩张的城市、农田和道路日益限制了野生动物的活动范围。

paras.en: Professor Philip Mannion, based at UCL Earth Sciences, said: "These findings have implications for species today. If crocodiles mostly coped with past climate change by moving towards suitable habitats, today's species will need room to move as the planet warms, and the loss of suitable areas to roads, farms and cities is making that harder."
paras.zh: 伦敦大学学院地球科学教授菲利普·曼尼恩（Philip Mannion）表示：“这些发现对当今的物种具有重要意义。如果鳄鱼主要通过迁往合适的栖息地来应对过去的气候变化，那么随着地球变暖，今天的物种将需要空间来移动，而道路、农场和城市的合适区域的消失使这一过程变得更加困难。”

paras.en: The research was funded by The Royal Society, the Leverhulme Trust, and the National Environment Research Council (NERC).
paras.zh: 该研究由英国皇家学会、Leverhulme Trust 和国家环境研究委员会 (NERC) 资助。

paras.en: Materials provided by University College London. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由伦敦大学学院提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

paras.en: - Alfio Alessandro Chiarenza, Alexandra F. C. Howard, Grace L. Varnham, Alex Farnsworth, Paul J. Valdes, Philip D. Mannion. Climatic niche conservatism shapes the macroevolution, extinction, and survivorship of crocodile-line archosaurs. Science Advances, 2026; 12 (43) DOI: 10.1126/sciadv.aeg2217
paras.zh: - 阿尔菲奥·亚历山德罗·基亚伦扎、亚历山德拉·F·C·霍华德、格蕾丝·L·瓦纳姆、亚历克斯·法恩斯沃斯、保罗·J·瓦尔德斯、菲利普·D·曼尼恩。气候生态位保守主义塑造了鳄鱼系祖龙的宏观进化、灭绝和生存。科学进展，2026； 12（43）DOI：10.1126/sciadv.aeg2217

articles.title: Physicists created a tiny universe and watched time emerge without a clock

paras.en: Physicists created a tiny universe and watched time emerge without a clock
paras.zh: 物理学家创造了一个微小的宇宙，并在没有时钟的情况下观察时间的出现

paras.en: - Scientists have created a miniature universe in the laboratory that could help answer one of the biggest mysteries in physics: What is time, and where does it come from? Using 24,000 ultracold atoms, a University of Birmingham researcher built an isolated quantum system that repeatedly expands and contracts, mimicking the Big Bang and a possible Big Crunch. Remarkably, the experiment showed that time could emerge from changes happening inside the system, without relying on an external clock.
paras.zh: - 科学家在实验室中创造了一个微型宇宙，可以帮助解答物理学中最大的谜团之一：时间是什么，它从哪里来？伯明翰大学的一名研究人员使用 24,000 个超冷原子构建了一个孤立的量子系统，该系统会反复膨胀和收缩，模仿大爆炸和可能的大挤压。值得注意的是，实验表明时间可以从系统内部发生的变化中产生，而不需要依赖外部时钟。

paras.en: What if time is not a fundamental part of the universe, but something that emerges from the changes taking place inside it? A physicist at the University of Birmingham has created a miniature universe in the laboratory that offers a surprising new way to investigate this possibility.
paras.zh: 如果时间不是宇宙的基本组成部分，而是宇宙内部发生的变化而产生的东西呢？伯明翰大学的一位物理学家在实验室中创造了一个微型宇宙，为研究这种可能性提供了一种令人惊讶的新方法。

paras.en: Using thousands of atoms cooled to temperatures barely above absolute zero, Professor Giovanni Barontini demonstrated that the passage of time can be measured without relying on an external clock. Instead, a form of time emerges naturally from the behavior of particles within the experimental system.
paras.zh: 乔瓦尼·巴隆蒂尼教授利用数千个冷却至略高于绝对零温度的原子，证明了可以在不依赖外部时钟的情况下测量时间的流逝。相反，时间的一种形式是从实验系统内粒子的行为中自然产生的。

paras.en: The findings, published in Physical Review Research, provide experimental evidence for an intriguing idea in theoretical physics: Time may not be an essential ingredient of reality. It could arise from the relationships and changes occurring within the universe itself.
paras.zh: 发表在《物理评论研究》上的研究结果为理论物理学中一个有趣的想法提供了实验证据：时间可能不是现实的重要组成部分。它可能源于宇宙本身内部发生的关系和变化。

paras.en: Why Some Physicists Think Time May Not Be Fundamental
paras.zh: 为什么一些物理学家认为时间可能不是基础

paras.en: We usually think of time as something that continuously moves forward, regardless of what happens around us. Seconds pass, planets orbit stars, and the universe evolves. But some theories of physics suggest that time may work very differently at the most fundamental level.
paras.zh: 我们通常认为时间是一种不断前进的东西，无论我们周围发生什么。时间一分一秒过去，行星围绕恒星运行，宇宙也在演化。但一些物理学理论表明，时间在最基本的层面上的运作方式可能非常不同。

paras.en: One example is the Wheeler-DeWitt equation, which appears in attempts to combine quantum mechanics with gravity. In this framework, the universe can be described as a single, unchanging quantum state, with no external clock marking the passage of time. Quantum particles can exhibit both wave-like and particle-like properties, but the universe as a whole does not necessarily have a built-in time variable.
paras.zh: 惠勒-德威特方程就是一个例子，它出现在将量子力学与引力结合起来的尝试中。在这个框架中，宇宙可以被描述为一个单一的、不变的量子态，没有外部时钟标记时间的流逝。量子粒子可以表现出类波和类粒子的特性，但宇宙作为一个整体并不一定有一个内置的时间变量。

paras.en: This creates a major puzzle. If the universe has no external clock, how can anything happen in a particular order? What determines which events come first and which happen later?
paras.zh: 这造成了一个重大难题。如果宇宙没有外部时钟，任何事情怎么可能以特定的顺序发生呢？是什么决定了哪些事件先发生、哪些事件后发生？

paras.en: One possibility is that time emerges from the changing relationships between different parts of the universe. Barontini designed an experiment to investigate whether such a process could be observed in the laboratory.
paras.zh: 一种可能性是，时间是从宇宙不同部分之间不断变化的关系中产生的。巴隆蒂尼设计了一个实验来研究是否可以在实验室中观察到这样的过程。

paras.en: Creating a Miniature Universe With 24,000 Atoms
paras.zh: 创建一个包含 24,000 个原子的微型宇宙

paras.en: To build his miniature cosmos, Barontini used a cloud of approximately 24,000 atoms cooled to just a few billionths of a degree above absolute zero. At these extraordinarily low temperatures, quantum effects become especially important, allowing researchers to study behaviors that are normally difficult to observe.
paras.zh: 为了构建他的微型宇宙，Barontini 使用了由大约 24,000 个原子组成的云，其温度仅比绝对零高几亿分之一度。在这些极低的温度下，量子效应变得尤其重要，使研究人员能够研究通常难以观察到的行为。

paras.en: The atoms were confined inside a carefully controlled quantum system designed to remain isolated from its surroundings. Two laser beams operating at different frequencies created a thin barrier that divided the system into two regions: an observed ('bright') region and an unobserved ('dark') region.
paras.zh: 这些原子被限制在一个精心控制的量子系统内，该系统旨在与周围环境保持隔离。以不同频率工作的两束激光形成了一个薄屏障，将系统分为两个区域：可观察的（“亮”）区域和不可观察的（“暗”）区域。

paras.en: Although the overall system was isolated from the outside world, atoms could move between these two regions.
paras.zh: 尽管整个系统与外界隔离，但原子可以在这两个区域之间移动。

paras.en: The bright region underwent repeated cycles of expansion and contraction, resembling simplified versions of two dramatic cosmological events. The expansion was analogous to the Big Bang, while the contraction resembled a Big Crunch, a hypothetical fate of the universe in which cosmic expansion eventually reverses and everything collapses inward.
paras.zh: 明亮的区域经历了反复的膨胀和收缩循环，类似于两个戏剧性宇宙事件的简化版本。膨胀类似于大爆炸，而收缩类似于大挤压，这是一种假设的宇宙命运，其中宇宙膨胀最终逆转，一切都向内塌陷。

paras.en: The experiment did not recreate these actual cosmic events. Instead, it provided a simplified quantum model in which researchers could investigate how a sequence of events might be reconstructed without referring to a clock outside the system.
paras.zh: 该实验并没有重现这些实际的宇宙事件。相反，它提供了一个简化的量子模型，研究人员可以在其中研究如何在不参考系统外部时钟的情况下重建事件序列。

paras.en: The key to the experiment was entropy, a concept in physics associated with the spread or disorder (entropy) of particles and energy.
paras.zh: 该实验的关键是熵，这是一个与粒子和能量的扩散或无序（熵）相关的物理学概念。

paras.en: Rather than using seconds or minutes, Barontini developed a way to track time through changes in how atoms were distributed within the miniature universe.
paras.zh: 巴伦蒂尼没有使用秒或分钟，而是开发了一种通过原子在微型宇宙中分布方式的变化来跟踪时间的方法。

paras.en: As atoms moved between the bright and dark regions, the distribution of particles in the bright region changed. These changes provided a way to define the system's progression through time, even when the bright region alternated between expansion and contraction.
paras.zh: 当原子在亮区和暗区之间移动时，亮区中粒子的分布发生变化。这些变化提供了一种定义系统随时间进展的方法，即使明亮区域在膨胀和收缩之间交替也是如此。

paras.en: When the particle distribution increased or decreased in its spread, the system continued moving forward according to this internal measure of time. When the distribution remained unchanged, the progression of this particular form of time effectively stopped.
paras.zh: 当粒子分布的扩散增加或减少时，系统根据这种内部时间测量继续向前移动。当分布保持不变时，这种特殊形式的时间的进展实际上停止了。

paras.en: Importantly, this did not mean that time literally stopped in the laboratory. It meant that the internal measure of time ceased advancing when the relevant changes in the system disappeared.
paras.zh: 重要的是，这并不意味着时间在实验室里完全停止了。这意味着当系统中的相关变化消失时，时间的内部测量就停止前进。

paras.en: Barontini called this concept "entropic time." The experiment showed that this form of time has several important properties. It moves consistently in one direction, establishing what physicists call the "arrow of time," the distinction between past and future. It also places events in the correct sequence, even as the miniature universe expands and contracts.
paras.zh: 巴隆蒂尼将这个概念称为“熵时间”。实验表明，这种时间形式有几个重要的特性。它始终朝一个方向移动，建立了物理学家所说的“时间之箭”，即过去与未来的区别。即使微型宇宙膨胀和收缩，它也会将事件按正确的顺序排列。

paras.en: Perhaps most surprisingly, entropic time does not always advance at the same rate. Its progression can speed up or slow down depending on how entropy changes within the system.
paras.zh: 也许最令人惊讶的是，熵时间并不总是以相同的速度前进。它的进程可以加速或减慢，具体取决于系统内熵的变化。

paras.en: A New Clue to One of Physics' Biggest Mysteries
paras.zh: 物理学最大谜团之一的新线索

paras.en: Professor Barontini said: "In some theories of the universe, especially quantum gravity, time doesn't appear as a built-in feature. Yet in everyday life, time flows from past to future -- why is this so, when most basic laws of physics work the same way forwards and backwards?
paras.zh: 巴隆蒂尼教授说：“在一些宇宙理论中，尤其是量子引力理论中，时间并不是一个固有的特征。然而在日常生活中，时间从过去流向未来——当大多数基本物理定律向前和向后都以同样的方式起作用时，为什么会这样呢？

paras.en: "This study provides the first controlled experimental evidence that 'time' can be defined by changes within a system rather than as the external 'ticking clock' we think of as time. It offers new insight into the nature of time in quantum gravity that could be used to describe dynamics just as effectively as conventional time."
paras.zh: “这项研究提供了第一个受控实验证据，证明‘时间’可以通过系统内部的变化来定义，而不是我们所认为的外部‘滴答作响的时钟’。它为量子引力中时间的本质提供了新的见解，可以像传统时间一样有效地用来描述动力学。”

paras.en: The distinction between everyday time and the underlying laws of physics is especially important. Many fundamental physical equations work equally well whether time is mathematically reversed or allowed to move forward. Yet our experience of the world has a clear direction: We remember the past, not the future, and events unfold in a recognizable sequence.
paras.zh: 日常生活与基本物理定律之间的区别尤其重要。无论时间在数学上倒转还是向前推进，许多基本物理方程都同样有效。然而，我们对世界的体验有一个明确的方向：我们记住过去，而不是未来，事件以可识别的顺序展开。

paras.en: Entropy has long played a central role in explaining this difference. Barontini's experiment takes that connection further by demonstrating how changes in entropy can provide an operational measure of time inside a controlled quantum system.
paras.zh: 长期以来，熵在解释这种差异方面发挥着核心作用。巴伦蒂尼的实验通过演示熵的变化如何在受控量子系统内提供时间的可操作测量，进一步深化了这种联系。

paras.en: The findings also go beyond simply arranging events in the correct order.
paras.zh: 研究结果也不仅仅是简单地按照正确的顺序排列事件。

paras.en: Barontini demonstrated that a version of the Schrödinger equation, one of the foundational equations of quantum mechanics (Schrödinger), can be expressed using entropic time. This equation describes how the quantum state of a system evolves, including changes in the probability of finding particles in particular locations or states.
paras.zh: 巴伦蒂尼证明了薛定谔方程的一个版本，即量子力学（薛定谔）的基本方程之一，可以使用熵时间来表达。该方程描述了系统的量子态如何演化，包括在特定位置或状态中找到粒子的概率的变化。

paras.en: In other words, the internally generated measure of time could still be used to make predictions about the quantum system's behavior, much as conventional time is used in standard quantum mechanics.
paras.zh: 换句话说，内部生成的时间测量仍然可以用来预测量子系统的行为，就像标准量子力学中使用的传统时间一样。

paras.en: Could a Tiny Universe Help Explain the Big Bang?
paras.zh: 微小的宇宙可以帮助解释大爆炸吗？

paras.en: For decades, questions about the origin and fundamental nature of time have largely belonged to theoretical physics, particularly quantum cosmology and quantum gravity. These fields attempt to understand how the universe behaves when quantum effects and gravity must be considered together, including under the extreme conditions associated with the early cosmos.
paras.zh: 几十年来，关于时间的起源和基本性质的问题很大程度上属于理论物理学，特别是量子宇宙学和量子引力。这些领域试图了解当必须同时考虑量子效应和引力时宇宙的行为方式，包括在与早期宇宙相关的极端条件下。

paras.en: Barontini's experiment offers a way to investigate some of these ideas using physical systems that scientists can create, manipulate, and observe.
paras.zh: 巴伦蒂尼的实验提供了一种利用科学家可以创建、操纵和观察的物理系统来研究其中一些想法的方法。

paras.en: The miniature universe continued to obey the established equations of quantum physics while providing a different way to describe its evolution. That makes it a potentially valuable testing ground for theories in which time is not assumed to exist independently of the system being studied.
paras.zh: 微型宇宙继续遵循既定的量子物理方程，同时提供了一种不同的方式来描述其演化。这使得它成为具有潜在价值的理论测试场，在这些理论中，时间不被假设为独立于所研究的系统而存在。

paras.en: Future experiments could extend this approach to more complicated quantum systems, allowing researchers to explore models of the Big Bang and the Big Crunch in greater detail. Similar techniques might eventually help simulate aspects of black holes or distinguish between competing explanations of how time emerges.
paras.zh: 未来的实验可以将这种方法扩展到更复杂的量子系统，使研究人员能够更详细地探索大爆炸和大挤压的模型。类似的技术最终可能有助于模拟黑洞的各个方面，或区分时间如何出现的相互竞争的解释。

paras.en: The experiment does not establish that time is an illusion or prove that our universe lacks fundamental time. Instead, it demonstrates something that was previously difficult to test: A quantum system can possess a meaningful internal measure of time without depending on an external clock.
paras.zh: 该实验并没有证明时间是一种幻觉，也没有证明我们的宇宙缺乏基本时间。相反，它展示了以前难以测试的东西：量子系统可以在不依赖外部时钟的情况下拥有有意义的内部时间测量。

paras.en: By creating a miniature universe from just 24,000 atoms, researchers have gained a new experimental tool for investigating a question that has challenged physicists and philosophers for centuries: What makes time flow?
paras.zh: 通过仅用 24,000 个原子创建一个微型宇宙，研究人员获得了一种新的实验工具，用于研究几个世纪以来一直挑战物理学家和哲学家的问题：是什么让时间流动？

paras.en: Materials provided by University of Birmingham. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由伯明翰大学提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

paras.en: - Giovanni Barontini. Testing the problem of time with cold atoms. Physical Review Research, 2026; 8 (2) DOI: 10.1103/1h9j-df4k
paras.zh: ——乔瓦尼·巴隆蒂尼。用冷原子测试时间问题。物理评论研究，2026； 8 (2) DOI：10.1103/1h9j-df4k

articles.title: Type 2 diabetes breakthrough as 54% achieve remission in just 6 months

paras.en: Type 2 diabetes breakthrough as 54% achieve remission in just 6 months
paras.zh: 2 型糖尿病取得突破性进展，54% 的患者在短短 6 个月内获得缓解

paras.en: - European Association for the Study of Diabetes
paras.zh: - 欧洲糖尿病研究协会

paras.en: - A promising new study suggests that more than half of younger adults with type 2 diabetes could achieve remission in just six months through a combination of a low-calorie diet and structured exercise. Researchers found that 54% of participants under age 45 who followed an intensive diet and exercise program achieved remission, compared with just 4% receiving usual care.
paras.zh: - 一项有希望的新研究表明，通过低热量饮食和结构化锻炼相结合，超过一半的 2 型糖尿病年轻人可以在短短六个月内获得缓解。研究人员发现，54% 的 45 岁以下参与者在遵循强化饮食和锻炼计划后病情得到缓解，而接受常规治疗的人只有 4%。

paras.en: A carefully structured combination of diet and exercise may offer a powerful way to put type 2 diabetes into remission in younger adults. In a new clinical trial, more than half of participants who followed an intensive lifestyle program achieved remission within just six months, compared with only 4% of those receiving standard care.
paras.zh: 精心设计的饮食和运动相结合可能是缓解年轻人 2 型糖尿病的有效方法。在一项新的临床试验中，超过一半遵循强化生活方式计划的参与者在短短六个月内获得了缓解，而接受标准护理的参与者中只有 4% 的病情得到缓解。

paras.en: The findings, presented at the Annual Meeting of the European Association for the Study of Diabetes (EASD) and published in The Lancet Regional Health Americas, suggest that a low-calorie diet paired with regular exercise could significantly change the course of early-onset type 2 diabetes (EOT2D) (aged under 45 years).
paras.zh: 研究结果发表在欧洲糖尿病研究协会 (EASD) 年会上，并发表在《柳叶刀》美洲地区健康杂志上，研究结果表明，低热量饮食加上定期运动可以显着改变早发 2 型糖尿病 (EOT2D)（年龄在 45 岁以下）的病程。

paras.en: The research was conducted by Professor Kaberi Dasgupta, Director of the Division of General Internal Medicine at McGill University in Montreal, Canada, Professor Thomas Yates of the University of Leicester in the UK, and their colleagues.
paras.zh: 该研究由加拿大蒙特利尔麦吉尔大学普通内科主任 Kaberi Dasgupta 教授、英国莱斯特大学 Thomas Yates 教授及其同事进行。

paras.en: Why Early-Onset Type 2 Diabetes Is Especially Dangerous
paras.zh: 为什么早发 2 型糖尿病特别危险

paras.en: Type 2 diabetes diagnosed at a younger age can be particularly aggressive. People with early-onset type 2 diabetes (EOT2D) often experience a faster decline in blood sugar control, develop complications earlier in life, and face a shorter life expectancy than those diagnosed at older ages.
paras.zh: 在年轻时诊断出的 2 型糖尿病可能特别具有侵袭性。早发性 2 型糖尿病 (EOT2D) 患者的血糖控制通常会更快下降，较早出现并发症，并且预期寿命比老年诊断患者要短。

paras.en: Previous research has shown that very low-calorie diets (LEDs) can lower blood sugar enough for some people to achieve remission without diabetes medication (T2D remission). Remission means blood sugar has fallen below the threshold used to diagnose diabetes and remains there without glucose-lowering drugs. However, it does not necessarily mean the disease has been permanently cured.
paras.zh: 先前的研究表明，极低热量饮食 (LED) 可以将血糖降低到足以使某些人无需服用糖尿病药物即可达到缓解（T2D 缓解）。缓解意味着血糖已降至诊断糖尿病的阈值以下，并且在不使用降糖药物的情况下仍保持在该水平。然而，这并不一定意味着这种疾病已经得到永久治愈。

paras.en: Researchers wanted to find out whether adding structured exercise could make this approach even more effective. Beyond helping regulate blood sugar, physical activity could improve fitness, protect muscle during weight loss, strengthen heart function, and reduce insulin resistance.
paras.zh: 研究人员想知道增加结构化锻炼是否可以使这种方法更加有效。除了帮助调节血糖之外，体力活动还可以改善健康状况、在减肥过程中保护肌肉、增强心脏功能并降低胰岛素抵抗。

paras.en: To investigate, the team tested whether combining a low-calorie diet with supervised exercise could achieve remission after 24 weeks, compared with standard medical care.
paras.zh: 为了进行调查，研究小组测试了与标准医疗护理相比，低热量饮食与监督运动相结合是否可以在 24 周后实现缓解。

paras.en: The randomized clinical trial took place at three research centers in England and Canada (affiliated with the University of Leicester, UK, McGill University (Montreal), and the University of Alberta, Edmonton). It enrolled adults aged 18 to 45 who had early-onset type 2 diabetes and obesity but were not using insulin.
paras.zh: 该随机临床试验在英格兰和加拿大的三个研究中心（隶属于英国莱斯特大学、麦吉尔大学（蒙特利尔）和阿尔伯塔大学埃德蒙顿分校）进行。该研究招募了 18 至 45 岁患有早发 2 型糖尿病和肥胖症但未使用胰岛素的成年人。

paras.en: The trial was open-label, meaning participants and researchers knew which treatment each person received, although the assessment of the main outcome was blinded.
paras.zh: 该试验是开放标签的，这意味着参与者和研究人员知道每个人接受了哪种治疗，尽管对主要结果的评估是盲法的。

paras.en: One group continued receiving usual care. The other followed an intensive program that combined a daily intake of 800 to 900 calories with supervised aerobic and resistance exercise twice per week, plus one independent exercise session each week (weeks 1-12). Participants then transitioned to a diet designed to maintain their weight loss while continuing to exercise independently (weeks 13-24).
paras.zh: 一组继续接受常规护理。另一个则遵循强化计划，每天摄入 800 至 900 卡路里的热量，每周两次有监督的有氧运动和抗阻运动，再加上每周一次独立运动（第 1 至 12 周）。然后，参与者转向旨在维持体重减轻的饮食，同时继续独立锻炼（第 13-24 周）。

paras.en: The researchers measured how many participants achieved diabetes remission after 24 weeks. To qualify, participants needed an HbA1c level below 6.5%, equivalent to 48 mmol/mol, and must have taken no glucose-lowering medication for at least 12 weeks. HbA1c is a blood test that reflects average blood sugar levels over approximately three months.
paras.zh: 研究人员测量了 24 周后有多少参与者的糖尿病得到缓解。为了符合资格，参与者的 HbA1c 水平需要低于 6.5%（相当于 48 mmol/mol），并且必须至少 12 周没有服用降糖药物。 HbA1c 是一项血液测试，反映了大约三个月内的平均血糖水平。

paras.en: The analysis included everyone assigned to either group. When remission data were missing, researchers conservatively counted those participants as not having achieved remission. They also examined changes in cardiovascular fitness, body composition, and heart structure.
paras.zh: 分析包括分配到任一组的每个人。当缓解数据缺失时，研究人员保守地将这些参与者视为未实现缓解。他们还检查了心血管健康、身体成分和心脏结构的变化。

paras.en: At the beginning of the intensive program, participants discontinued medications used to lower blood sugar and blood pressure (in the absence of albuminuria), under the study's medical supervision. Albuminuria refers to the presence of a protein called albumin in urine and can indicate kidney damage.
paras.zh: 在强化计划开始时，参与者在研究的医疗监督下停止服用用于降低血糖和血压的药物（在没有蛋白尿的情况下）。白蛋白尿是指尿液中存在一种称为白蛋白的蛋白质，可能表明肾脏受损。

paras.en: Their restricted diet provided 800 to 900 calories daily (30% protein, 50% carbohydrate, 20% fat). Participants were encouraged to drink at least two liters of calorie-free fluids each day and were given access to a fiber-based laxative when needed.
paras.zh: 他们的限制饮食每天提供 800 至 900 卡路里的热量（30% 蛋白质、50% 碳水化合物、20% 脂肪）。鼓励参与者每天至少喝两升无热量液体，并在需要时使用纤维泻药。

paras.en: During the first two weeks, all meals were replaced with specially formulated nutritional products (Optifast). From weeks three through 12, participants maintained the same calorie limit but gained more flexibility in their food choices (Optifast in UK and ProtiDiet in Canada).
paras.zh: 在前两周，所有膳食均更换为特殊配方的营养产品（Optifast）。从第 3 周到第 12 周，参与者保持相同的卡路里限制，但在食物选择上获得了更大的灵活性（英国的 Optifast 和加拿大的 ProtiDiet）。

paras.en: This second phase allowed one conventional meal per day, with daily intake targets that included protein, fruit, and vegetables (60 to 90 g protein from all sources combined, one portion of fruit, two portions of non-starchy vegetables).
paras.zh: 第二阶段允许每天一顿常规膳食，每日摄入目标包括蛋白质、水果和蔬菜（所有来源的蛋白质合计 60 至 90 克，一份水果，两份非淀粉类蔬菜）。

paras.en: After the first 12 weeks, participants shifted toward maintaining their weight loss rather than continuing rapid weight reduction.
paras.zh: 最初 12 周后，参与者转向维持体重减轻，而不是继续快速减轻体重。

paras.en: More Than Half Achieved Type 2 Diabetes Remission
paras.zh: 超过一半的 2 型糖尿病得到缓解

paras.en: Between September 24, 2021, and June 6, 2025, the researchers enrolled and randomly assigned 96 participants (40 UK, 56 Canada). The group included 50 people assigned to the intensive intervention and 46 receiving standard care (24 female, 26 male intervention group; 21 female, 25 male control group; mean age 38 years, BMI 35·2 kg/m2).
paras.zh: 2021年9月24日至2025年6月6日期间，研究人员招募并随机分配了96名参与者（40名英国，56名加拿大）。该组包括 50 名接受强化干预的患者和 46 名接受标准护理的患者（干预组 24 名女性，26 名男性；对照组 21 名女性，25 名男性；平均年龄 38 岁，BMI 35·2 kg/m2）。

paras.en: Of those enrolled, 86 (90%) completed the final assessments.
paras.zh: 在注册的人中，86 人 (90%) 完成了最终评估。

paras.en: The results revealed a striking difference between the groups. After 24 weeks, 27 of the 50 participants following the diet and exercise program had achieved remission, representing 54% of the intervention group. In comparison, just two of the 46 participants receiving standard care reached remission, or approximately 4%.
paras.zh: 结果显示各组之间存在显着差异。 24 周后，遵循饮食和运动计划的 50 名参与者中有 27 名病情得到缓解，占干预组的 54%。相比之下，接受标准护理的 46 名参与者中只有两人达到缓解，即约 4%。

paras.en: After accounting for relevant statistical factors, the researchers calculated that participants in the intensive lifestyle program were 21 times more likely to achieve remission than those receiving usual care.
paras.zh: 在考虑了相关统计因素后，研究人员计算出，参加强化生活方式计划的参与者获得缓解的可能性是接受常规护理的参与者的 21 倍。

paras.en: Weight loss was also substantially greater among participants following the combined program.
paras.zh: 接受联合计划的参与者的体重减轻也显着增加。

paras.en: Among the 47 intervention participants with available weight data, average body weight fell from 100.7 kg to 92.3 kg, a reduction of 8.4 kg over 24 weeks. The 43 control participants with available weight data started at an average of 103.2 kg and lost just 1.2 kg, reaching 102.0 kg.
paras.zh: 在拥有体重数据的 47 名干预参与者中，平均体重从 100.7 公斤下降至 92.3 公斤，24 周内减少了 8.4 公斤。 43 名拥有可用体重数据的对照参与者开始时平均体重为 103.2 公斤，仅减重 1.2 公斤，达到 102.0 公斤。

paras.en: After statistical adjustment, the intervention group lost an average of 7.5 kg more weight than the control group. Importantly, this included an additional 6.6 kg of fat loss, indicating that much of the difference came from reduced body fat.
paras.zh: 经过统计调整后，干预组比对照组平均减重7.5公斤。重要的是，这还包括额外减少 6.6 公斤的脂肪，这表明大部分差异来自体内脂肪的减少。

paras.en: Promising Results With Manageable Side Effects
paras.zh: 效果良好且副作用可控

paras.en: No severe adverse events were reported during the trial. However, side effects were more common among participants following the intensive diet.
paras.zh: 试验期间没有报告严重不良事件。然而，在强化饮食的参与者中，副作用更为常见。

paras.en: At least one adverse event occurred in 43 of the 50 intervention participants, compared with six of the 46 participants receiving standard care. Most problems appeared during the early stages of the restrictive diet and included symptoms such as constipation, headaches, dizziness, and fatigue (e.g., constipation, headache, dizziness, fatigue). These effects generally resolved.
paras.zh: 50 名干预参与者中有 43 人至少发生了一项不良事件，而接受标准护理的 46 名参与者中有 6 人发生了不良事件。大多数问题出现在限制性饮食的早期阶段，包括便秘、头痛、头晕和疲劳等症状（例如便秘、头痛、头晕、疲劳）。这些影响通常会得到解决。

paras.en: The researchers believe the findings demonstrate that a combined diet and exercise intervention can produce meaningful improvements beyond blood sugar control alone.
paras.zh: 研究人员认为，研究结果表明，结合饮食和运动干预可以产生比单独控制血糖更有意义的改善。

paras.en: The authors say: "Our findings demonstrate the feasibility and efficacy of combining structured aerobic and resistance exercise with a low energy diet in early-onset type 2 diabetes, supporting its potential to deliver substantial and holistic health and well-being benefits alongside diabetes remission.
paras.zh: 作者说：“我们的研究结果证明了将结构化有氧运动和抗阻运动与低能量饮食相结合治疗早发性 2 型糖尿病的可行性和有效性，支持其在缓解糖尿病的同时带来实质性和整体健康和福祉的潜力。

paras.en: "Our remission rates are at the upper end of those previously reported in the literature for trials of similar duration, reinforcing the potential of structured lifestyle interventions to support clinically meaningful remission, while demonstrating for the first time that such effects can be achieved in a multi-ethnic population with early-onset type 2 diabetes through a combined low-energy diet and structured exercise intervention."
paras.zh: “我们的缓解率处于文献中先前报道的类似持续时间试验的上限，这增强了结构化生活方式干预支持临床上有意义的缓解的潜力，同时首次证明，通过低能量饮食和结构化运动干预相结合，可以在患有早发 2 型糖尿病的多种族人群中实现这种效果。”

paras.en: Why Preserving Muscle During Weight Loss Matters
paras.zh: 为什么在减肥过程中保留肌肉很重要

paras.en: One particularly important aspect of the study was its emphasis on protecting muscle mass during rapid weight loss.
paras.zh: 这项研究的一个特别重要的方面是它强调在快速减肥过程中保护肌肉质量。

paras.en: The researchers explain that most people who complete weight loss programs eventually regain some or all of the weight they lost. This is especially relevant when using very low-calorie diets to achieve diabetes remission.
paras.zh: 研究人员解释说，大多数完成减肥计划的人最终会恢复部分或全部减掉的体重。当使用极低热量饮食来缓解糖尿病时，这一点尤其重要。

paras.en: Losing weight through calorie restriction alone typically reduces both fat and fat-free mass, which includes muscle. Some evidence suggests that when weight returns, the body may regain proportionally more fat than lean tissue.
paras.zh: 仅通过限制热量来减肥通常会减少脂肪和去脂质量，其中包括肌肉。一些证据表明，当体重恢复时，身体恢复的脂肪比例可能会多于瘦肉组织。

paras.en: Over time, repeated weight loss and regain could therefore contribute to a gradual reduction in muscle mass and increase the risk of sarcopenia, a condition characterized by declining muscle mass and strength.
paras.zh: 随着时间的推移，反复的体重减轻和恢复可能会导致肌肉质量逐渐减少，并增加肌肉减少症的风险，肌肉减少症是一种以肌肉质量和力量下降为特征的疾病。

paras.en: To address this problem, the researchers incorporated resistance training into the most intensive phase of weight loss. Their results suggest that it is possible to achieve substantial fat loss while preserving muscle, potentially making the approach more beneficial for long-term metabolic health.
paras.zh: 为了解决这个问题，研究人员将阻力训练纳入减肥的最密集阶段。他们的结果表明，在保留肌肉的同时实现大量脂肪减少是可能的，这可能使该方法更有利于长期代谢健康。

paras.en: They say: "Our RESET for Remission study targeted muscle during the intensive weight loss phase through resistance training, and our findings indicate fat-free mass and muscle preservation is achievable with rapid weight loss. Preserving muscle during remission-oriented weight loss may have important implications for long-term metabolic health, physical function, and disease trajectory. This requires examination in a longer-term study."
paras.zh: 他们说：“我们的缓解期重置研究通过阻力训练在强化减肥阶段针对肌肉进行研究，我们的研究结果表明，通过快速减肥可以实现去脂体重和肌肉保留。在以缓解为导向的减肥过程中保留肌肉可能对长期代谢健康、身体功能和疾病轨迹产生重要影响。这需要进行长期研究来检验。”

paras.en: A Potential New Approach to Treating Type 2 Diabetes
paras.zh: 治疗 2 型糖尿病的潜在新方法

paras.en: The findings could be particularly important as type 2 diabetes becomes increasingly common among younger adults worldwide.
paras.zh: 随着 2 型糖尿病在全球年轻人中变得越来越普遍，这一发现可能尤为重要。

paras.en: People who develop the condition earlier in life face more years of exposure to elevated blood sugar, increasing their lifetime risk of cardiovascular disease and other complications. Finding effective ways to achieve remission early could therefore have substantial health benefits.
paras.zh: 早年患上这种疾病的人将面临更长的时间暴露在血糖升高的环境中，从而增加了他们一生中患心血管疾病和其他并发症的风险。因此，找到早期实现缓解的有效方法可能会带来巨大的健康益处。

paras.en: The researchers emphasize that their intervention did more than lower blood sugar. It also reduced body fat while protecting muscle, improved muscle quality and physical performance, supported cardiovascular health, and produced improvements in participants' reported well-being.
paras.zh: 研究人员强调，他们的干预措施不仅仅只是降低血糖。它还可以减少身体脂肪，同时保护肌肉，提高肌肉质量和身体表现，支持心血管健康，并改善参与者报告的幸福感。

paras.en: They also suggest that this strategy could be especially relevant for people planning a pregnancy or who may become pregnant.
paras.zh: 他们还建议，这种策略对于计划怀孕或可能怀孕的人尤其重要。

paras.en: However, the researchers caution that longer studies are needed to determine whether the benefits can be sustained. In particular, future research must establish how well participants maintain their weight loss, muscle mass, and diabetes remission after returning to everyday life outside a closely monitored clinical trial.
paras.zh: 然而，研究人员警告说，需要更长时间的研究来确定这些好处是否能够持续。特别是，未来的研究必须确定参与者在严密监测的临床试验之外恢复日常生活后如何保持体重减轻、肌肉质量和糖尿病缓解。

paras.en: The authors conclude: "By focusing specifically on early-onset type 2 diabetes, our trial addresses a growing clinical population, characterized by elevated cardiovascular disease risk, greater cumulative complication burden, and poor long-term outcomes…In summary, RESET for Remission demonstrated that in early-onset type 2 diabetes, combining structured aerobic and resistance exercise with a low-calorie diet produces high remission rates, induces fat loss while preserving muscle mass, improves muscle quality and function, enhances cardiovascular health, and leads to meaningful improvements in patient-reported outcomes. As the prevalence of early-onset type 2 diabetes rises globally, our findings highlight an opportunity to re-evaluate treatment paradigms and support scalable implementation of integrated dietary and exercise interventions for remission. Our approach may be particularly valuable in those seeking or with potential for pregnancy. It warrants further evaluation in longer term studies in real-world settings."
paras.zh: 作者总结道：“通过专门针对早发性 2 型糖尿病，我们的试验针对的是不断增长的临床人群，其特点是心血管疾病风险升高、累积并发症负担更大以及长期结果不佳……总而言之，缓解 RESET 表明，在早发性 2 型糖尿病中，将结构化有氧运动和抗阻运动与低热量饮食相结合可产生高缓解率，在保持肌肉质量的同时诱导脂肪减少，改善肌肉质量和功能，增强心血管健康，并导致有意义的改善随着早发性 2 型糖尿病在全球范围内的患病率上升，我们的研究结果强调了重新评估治疗模式并支持可扩展实施综合饮食和运动干预措施以缓解病情的机会。我们的方法对于那些寻求怀孕或有可能怀孕的人来说可能特别有价值，值得在现实世界中进行长期研究。”

paras.en: Materials provided by European Association for the Study of Diabetes. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由欧洲糖尿病研究协会提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

articles.title: 'Star Trek's' William Shatner and George Takei honor the death of Walter Koenig
articles.author: Jeff Spry

paras.en: This has been a pretty rough week for "Star Trek" royalty on this 60th anniversary year with the deaths of both Walter Koenig, "Star Trek's" Lt. Pavel Chekov on Sunday, Oct. 25 and Patrick Stewart, the storied sci-fi property's Captain Jean Luc-Picard on Wednesday, Oct. 28.
paras.zh: 对于《星际迷航》60周年纪念日来说，本周对《星际迷航》皇室成员来说是相当艰难的一周，沃尔特·科尼格、《星际迷航》中的帕维尔·契诃夫中尉于10月25日星期日去世，而这部传奇科幻作品的船长让·吕克-皮卡德于10月28日星期三帕特里克·斯图尔特去世。

paras.en: With the passing of Walter Koenig at the age of 90 this past week, franchise luminaries of all degrees are coming out with heartfelt condolences, kind words of remembrance, and tearful reflections.
paras.zh: 上周，90 岁高龄的沃尔特·科尼格 (Walter Koenig) 去世了，各个级别的球队名人都表达了衷心的哀悼、善意的悼念和含泪的反思。

paras.en: William Shatner, 95, and George Takei, 89, represent the final remaining members of the U.S.S. Enterprise's core crew from "Star Trek: The Original Series" and they both took to social media to express their deep sorrow over losing one of their fellow travelers in the final frontier.
paras.zh: 95 岁的威廉·沙特纳和 89 岁的乔治·竹井代表了美国最后剩下的成员。 《星际迷航：原初系列》中企业号的核心船员们都在社交媒体上表达了对在最后边境失去一位旅伴的深切哀悼。

paras.en: "I am deeply saddened to learn of Walter Koenig’s passing," Shatner posted on Instagram.
paras.zh: 沙特纳在 Instagram 上发帖称：“得知沃尔特·科尼格去世的消息，我深感悲痛。”

paras.en: "Although we did not know each other well away from the set, we shared the later seasons of the original 'Star Trek' series and the six films that followed. What I observed, and what so many fans have expressed over the years, was a man who genuinely loved the 'Star Trek' community.
paras.zh: “尽管我们在片场外并不十分了解，但我们分享了原版《星际迷航》系列的最后几季以及随后的六部电影。我所观察到的，以及多年来许多粉丝所表达的，是一个真正热爱《星际迷航》社区的人。

paras.en: "At conventions, Walter was rarely content to remain behind a signing table. He preferred to be among the people who had kept 'Star Trek' alive for so many decades. That kind of genuine connection is rare, and it will be remembered by everyone who came into contact with him.
paras.zh: “在大会上，沃尔特很少满足于留在签名桌后面。他更喜欢成为让《星际迷航》流传了几十年的人之一。这种真正的联系是罕见的，每个与他接触过的人都会记住它。

paras.en: "My condolences to his family, his friends, and the countless fans whose lives he touched."
paras.zh: “我向他的家人、他的朋友以及他所感动的无数粉丝表示哀悼。”

paras.en: George Takei, who portrayed Lt. Hikaru Sulu and co-starred with Koenig on two seasons of "The Original Series" from 1967-69, as well as six subsequent "Star Trek" feature films, offered similar thoughts in memoriam.
paras.zh: 乔治·竹井（George Takei）在悼念中表达了类似的想法，他在 1967-69 年的两季“原创系列”以及随后的六部“星际迷航”故事片中饰演了光苏鲁中尉，并与柯尼格共同主演。

paras.en: "My heart is heavy. Walter Koenig, our Ensign Pavel Chekov, passed away early today," Takei shared on his Instagram page.
paras.zh: “我的心情很沉重。沃尔特·柯尼希，我们的少尉帕维尔·契诃夫，今天早些时候去世了，”武井在他的 Instagram 页面上分享道。

paras.en: "Walter and I met on the bridge of the Enterprise in the 1960s, and we stayed friends for nearly six decades. When Brad and I married in 2008, Walter stood beside us as our best man. Just last month, on Sept. 14, he turned 90, on the same day Brad and I celebrated our 18th wedding anniversary. I will always treasure that he and I shared that date.
paras.zh: “沃尔特和我在 20 世纪 60 年代在企业号的桥上相识，我们成为了近 6 年的朋友。当布拉德和我在 2008 年结婚时，沃尔特作为我们的伴郎站在我们身边。就在上个月，9 月 14 日，他满了 90 岁，同一天布拉德和我庆祝了我们的 18 周年结婚纪念日。我将永远珍惜我和他共享的那个日子。

paras.en: "Walter was more than Chekov. He was a writer, a teacher, a thoughtful man, and a loyal friend. To the fans who loved him for so many years, thank you. He loved you too.
paras.zh: “沃尔特不仅仅是契诃夫。他是一位作家、一位老师、一个有思想的人和一位忠实的朋友。对于多年来爱他的粉丝们，谢谢你们。他也爱你们。

paras.en: "Rest well, my dear friend. Keep navigating a steady course."
paras.zh: “好好休息，我亲爱的朋友。继续保持稳定的航向。”

paras.en: Jeff Spry is an award-winning screenwriter and veteran freelance journalist covering TV, movies, video games, books, and comics. His work has appeared at SYFY Wire, Inverse, Collider, Bleeding Cool and elsewhere. Jeff lives in beautiful Bend, Oregon amid the ponderosa pines, classic muscle cars, a crypt of collector horror comics, and two loyal English Setters.
paras.zh: 杰夫·斯普里 (Jeff Spry) 是一位屡获殊荣的编剧和资深自由记者，报道电视、电影、视频游戏、书籍和漫画。他的作品曾出现在 SYFY Wire、Inverse、Collider、Bleeding Cool 等网站上。杰夫住在俄勒冈州美丽的本德，周围有黄松、经典肌肉车、收藏恐怖漫画的地窖和两只忠诚的英国塞特犬。
