articles.title: The Taurid meteor shower isn't much to look at. That's why I love it
articles.author: Jamie Carter

paras.en: I used to make a basic mistake with meteor showers — I treated the zenith hourly rate (ZHR) like a timetable. If a shower were advertised at 20 meteors per hour, I'd go outside expecting something roughly every three minutes. After 10 quiet minutes, I'd start wondering what I was doing wrong. After half an hour, I'd start to doubt the whole idea of meteor showers.
paras.zh: 我曾经在流星雨方面犯过一个基本错误——我把天顶每小时费率（ZHR）当作一个时间表。如果广告上说流星雨每小时有 20 颗流星，我大约每三分钟就会出去期待一下。安静十分钟后，我开始怀疑自己做错了什么。半小时后，我开始怀疑流星雨的整个想法。

paras.en: The Northern and Southern Taurids cured me of all that. Two linked meteor showers that peak around Nov. 4-5 and Nov. 11-12 this year, they each manage only about five meteors per hour under ideal conditions. In reality, you may see fewer. You may spend a long time seeing none. So what's the point?
paras.zh: 南北金牛座流星雨治愈了我的这一切。今年的两场相互关联的流星雨高峰期分别为 11 月 4 日至 5 日和 11 月 11 日至 12 日，在理想条件下，它们每小时只能产生约 5 颗流星。事实上，你看到的可能会更少。你可能会花很长时间看不到任何东西。那么有什么意义呢？

paras.en: I've come to regard their paucity of "shooting stars" as a feature, not a flaw, for the Taurids have taught me to stop counting meteors and instead just observe the sky. I go outside for Taurus, the Pleiades, Auriga, and whatever else happens to be visible. If a Taurid crosses the sky, excellent. If not, the evening hasn't failed. The reason is that they are also known for occasionally producing very bright meteors, or fireballs — although "occasionally" is important. Don't go outside expecting a procession of them.
paras.zh: 我开始把它们缺乏“流星”视为一种特征，而不是缺陷，因为金牛座流星雨教会我停止数流星，而只是观察天空。我出去寻找金牛座、昴宿星团、御夫座以及其他任何可见的东西。如果金牛座流星划过天空，那就太好了。如果没有，今晚还没有失败。原因是它们还因偶尔产生非常明亮的流星或火球而闻名——尽管“偶尔”很重要。不要出门等待他们的游行。

paras.en: The Taurids hit Earth's atmosphere at about 18 miles (29 kilometers) per second. That's relatively slow for a meteor shower. It's one reason Taurids can be more memorable than meteors from faster showers.
paras.zh: 金牛座流星雨以每秒约 18 英里（29 公里）的速度撞击地球大气层。这对于流星雨来说相对较慢。这就是金牛座流星雨比速度更快的流星雨更令人难忘的原因之一。

paras.en: For observers across much of the Northern Hemisphere, Taurus rises in the east during the evening and becomes increasingly well placed as the night progresses. Later evening into the overnight hours is therefore the best time to watch.
paras.zh: 对于北半球大部分地区的观察者来说，金牛座在晚上从东方升起，并且随着夜晚的进行而变得越来越有利。因此，傍晚到夜间是最佳观看时间。

paras.en: I love looking at the night sky around Taurus, but you really don't need to stare at it if you're looking for Taurids. The radiant is indeed within Taurus (close to the Pleiades), but meteors can appear anywhere in the sky. Look roughly east or southeast, then watch as much sky as possible for an hour or so.
paras.zh: 我喜欢看金牛座周围的夜空，但如果你正在寻找金牛座流星雨，你真的不需要盯着它。辐射点确实位于金牛座内（靠近昴宿星团），但流星可以出现在天空的任何地方。大致向东或东南方向看，然后在一个小时左右的时间里尽可能多地观察天空。

paras.en: This year the moon helps out. The new moon falls on Nov. 9, leaving only a young waxing crescent around the shower's peak. It sets during the evening, giving us properly dark skies later on.
paras.zh: 今年，月亮帮了忙。新月于 11 月 9 日降临，在流星雨的峰值周围仅留下一弯新月。它在晚上落下，稍后我们的天空就会变得漆黑一片。

paras.en: My Taurid observing strategy involves doing little direct meteor observing. I'll likely head outside once Taurus is reasonably high in the eastern sky, probably sometime in the later evening, and give myself other things to look at. The Pleiades are an obvious target — it's exciting to have this little open cluster back in the evening sky. So are the Hyades open cluster and bright orangey Aldebaran, also in Taurus. I'll probably set my smart telescope on the Pleiades and leave it alone to build up a long integration while I spend as much time as I can taking in the whole sky. Meteors are a naked-eye event and demand your attention — the second you avert your gaze from the night sky, a "shooting star" will appear. All stargazers know that!
paras.zh: 我的金牛座观测策略涉及很少进行直接流星观测。一旦金牛座在东方天空相当高的位置（可能是傍晚的某个时间），我可能会出去，给自己一些其他的东西可以看。昴宿星团是一个明显的目标——这个小小的疏散星团重新出现在夜空中真是令人兴奋。毕星团疏散星团和同样位于金牛座的明亮橙色毕宿五也是如此。我可能会把我的智能望远镜放在昴宿星团上，然后不去管它，以建立一个长期的积分，同时我花尽可能多的时间观察整个天空。流星是一种肉眼可见的现象，需要您的注意——当您将目光从夜空中移开时，一颗“流星”就会出现。所有观星者都知道！

paras.en: I won't travel for hours to find perfect darkness. A darker location will reveal fainter meteors, for sure, but the Taurids' occasional bright members can be seen from less-than-perfect skies. A backyard is fine for this one — make travel plans only for August's Perseids and December's Geminids (moon phases allowing).
paras.zh: 我不会花几个小时去寻找完美的黑暗。当然，较暗的位置会看到较暗的流星，但从不太完美的天空中偶尔也能看到金牛座流星雨的明亮成员。后院就适合这个——只为八月的英仙座流星雨和十二月的双子座流星雨（月相允许）制定旅行计划。

paras.en: Nor will I keep score. Meteor rates are statistical descriptions, not promises. Five per hour does not mean one meteor every 12 minutes. You could see two close together and then nothing at all for hours. We're all so used to being told exactly what to expect, but the night sky doesn't work like that — you need to be open to whatever it throws at you (or not). Once you stop expecting the sky to do what you want, meteor showers become more enjoyable.
paras.zh: 我也不会记分。流星发生率是统计描述，而不是承诺。每小时 5 颗并不意味着每 12 分钟就有一颗流星。你可以看到两个人靠得很近，然后几个小时内就什么也看不见了。我们都已经习惯了被确切地告知会发生什么，但夜空并不是这样运作的——你需要对它向你抛出的任何东西（或不）保持开放的态度。一旦你不再期待天空做你想做的事，流星雨就会变得更加令人愉快。

paras.en: Stargazer's corner: Oct. 31-Nov. 5, 2026
paras.zh: 观星者角：10 月 31 日至 11 月 31 日2026年5月

paras.en: The moon is moving out of the early evening sky this week, which is exactly what stargazers wait for at this time of year. It reaches third quarter around Nov. 1, rising later at night and leaving the evening dark. That gives us a useful 10-night window for observing before moonlight becomes an issue.
paras.zh: 本周，月亮将从傍晚的天空中移出，这正是观星者在每年这个时候所等待的。 11 月 1 日左右进入第三季度，夜间升起较晚，傍晚时分漆黑一片。这为我们提供了一个有用的 10 晚观察时间，以便在月光成为问题之前进行观察。

paras.en: I'm planning to use it for the Andromeda galaxy. From a genuinely dark location, M31 can be spotted with the naked eye as a faint patch. From brighter suburban skies, binoculars make life much easier. The beginner mistake is expecting anything resembling the photographs. Through binoculars, I'm looking for a subtle misty glow, not spiral arms. If you want a more impressive view, get yourself a smart telescope — they do a wonderful job on M31.
paras.zh: 我计划将它用于仙女座星系。在真正黑暗的地方，M31 可以用肉眼看到，就像一个微弱的斑块。从更明亮的郊区天空来看，双筒望远镜让生活变得更加轻松。初学者的错误是期待任何类似于照片的东西。通过双筒望远镜，我正在寻找微妙的雾气，而不是旋臂。如果您想要更令人印象深刻的景观，请为自己配备一台智能望远镜——它们在 M31 上表现出色。

paras.en: There's another practical change this weekend. Daylight saving time ends across most of the U.S. and Canada on Nov. 1. The stars haven't changed their schedule, of course, but getting outside under a dark sky after dinner — and even before — suddenly becomes much easier.
paras.zh: 本周末还有另一个实际变化。美国和加拿大大部分地区的夏令时将于 11 月 1 日结束。当然，明星们并没有改变他们的日程安排，但晚饭后（甚至饭前）在漆黑的天空下外出突然变得容易多了。

paras.en: Although you don't need to stare at Taurus, the Bull, to see Taurids, it's an obvious target this week. It's climbing into the eastern sky during the evening. Bright orange star Aldebaran — a red giant 67 light-years from the solar system (and the most luminous star within 100 light-years) — marks the bull's eye. It appears to sit within a V-shape of stars that forms the bull's face. This is the Hyades, the closest open cluster of stars to the solar system at just 150 light-years.
paras.zh: 虽然你不需要盯着金牛座、公牛座就能看到金牛座流星雨，但它是本周的一个明显目标。傍晚时分，它爬上了东方的天空。明亮的橙色恒星毕宿五——一颗距离太阳系 67 光年的红巨星（也是 100 光年范围内最亮的恒星）——标志着牛眼。它似乎坐落在构成牛脸的 V 形星星内。这就是毕宿星团，距离太阳系最近的疏散星团，距离仅 150 光年。

paras.en: The origin story of both Taurid meteor showers is genuinely awe-inspiring. They're associated with debris left in the inner solar system by Comet 2P/Encke, which orbits the sun once every 3.25 years (1,200 days) — the shortest orbital period of any known comet in the solar system, according to NASA. The second comet ever discovered, Encke, was discovered in 1786 and spans about 3 miles (4.8 kilometers) in diameter. It last reached perihelion — its closest point to the sun — on Oct. 22, 2023, and is due to do so again on Feb. 10, 2027, but Earth encounters debris associated with the comet every year.
paras.zh: 两次金牛座流星雨的起源故事确实令人惊叹。它们与 2P/Encke 彗星在内太阳系留下的碎片有关，该彗星每 3.25 年（1,200 天）绕太阳运行一周，据 NASA 称，这是太阳系中已知彗星中轨道周期最短的。有史以来发现的第二颗彗星恩克 (Encke) 于 1786 年被发现，直径约为 3 英里（4.8 公里）。它最后一次到达近日点是在 2023 年 10 月 22 日，即距离太阳最近的点，预计将于 2027 年 2 月 10 日再次到达近日点，但地球每年都会遇到与这颗彗星相关的碎片。

paras.en: The picture is more complicated than a single comet trail. The Southern and Northern Taurids are part of the broader Taurid Meteoroid Complex, a vast swarm of interplanetary dust, rocks, comets and asteroids thought to be related to Encke. It's thought that it originates from a much larger object that fragmented as it got close to the sun, perhaps just 5,000 to 6,000 years ago or as much as 20,000 years ago. Fears that huge, mile-wide "planet killer" asteroids may still reside in the Taurid Meteoroid Complex appear to have been ruled out. Phew.
paras.zh: 这幅图景比单一彗星轨迹还要复杂。南金牛座流星雨和北金牛座流星雨是更广泛的金牛座流星体综合体的一部分，这是一大群被认为与恩克有关的行星际尘埃、岩石、彗星和小行星。据认为，它起源于一个更大的物体，该物体在接近太阳时碎裂，可能距今 5,000 至 6,000 年前，甚至 20,000 年前。关于巨大的、一英里宽的“行星杀手”小行星可能仍然存在于金牛座流星体复合体中的担忧似乎已被排除。唷。

paras.en: Each fall, Earth passes through different parts of this sprawling stream, producing two overlapping meteor showers — and, occasionally, the larger fragments responsible for the Taurids' famous fireballs.
paras.zh: 每年秋天，地球都会穿过这条蔓延的流星雨的不同部分，产生两次重叠的流星雨，偶尔还会产生较大的碎片，形成金牛座流星雨著名的火球。

paras.en: Jamie is an experienced science and travel journalist, stargazer and eclipse chaser who writes about exploring the night sky, solar and lunar eclipses, the Northern Lights, moon-gazing, astro-travel, astronomy and space exploration. He is the editor of WhenIsTheNextEclipse.com, author of A Stargazing Program For Beginners, co-author of The Eclipse Effect, and a senior contributor at Forbes.
paras.zh: 杰米是一位经验丰富的科学和旅行记者、观星者和日食追踪者，撰写有关探索夜空、日食和月食、北极光、观月、天体旅行、天文学和太空探索的文章。他是 WhenIsTheNextEclipse.com 的编辑、《A Stargazing Program For Beginners》的作者、《The Eclipse Effect》的合著者以及《福布斯》的高级撰稿人。

articles.title: The rocket scientist who summoned demons: The true horror story of Jack Parsons
articles.author: Micah Hanks

paras.en: In the winter of 1946, two men from very different walks of life walked into California's Mojave Desert together, where one of them became convinced an extraordinary experiment they had been conducting had finally succeeded.
paras.zh: 1946 年冬天，两个来自不同行业的人一起走进加利福尼亚州的莫哈韦沙漠，其中一人确信他们一直在进行的一项非凡实验终于成功了。

paras.en: One of the men was pioneering rocket scientist Jack Parsons, a self-taught chemist who helped establish what would become NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory, and whose innovations in rocket propulsion would help lay the groundwork for the Space Race that would erupt in the years that followed. His unlikely companion was none other than L. Ron Hubbard, then a science fiction writer who had yet to compose the writings that would form the underpinnings of the Church of Scientology that he later established.
paras.zh: 其中一位是火箭科学家先驱杰克·帕森斯（Jack Parsons），他是一位自学成才的化学家，帮助建立了美国宇航局的喷气推进实验室，他在火箭推进方面的创新将为随后几年爆发的太空竞赛奠定基础。他意想不到的同伴正是 L. 罗恩·哈伯德 (L. Ron Hubbard)，当时他是一名科幻小说作家，但尚未创作出为他后来建立的山达基教会奠定基​​础的作品。

paras.en: Despite Parsons' work with rockets and his companion Hubbard's fictional writings about them, their work together in the early months of 1946 had nothing to do with rocket propulsion, spacecraft, or other technological innovations that would eventually carry humans to space. Instead, Parsons and Hubbard were engaged in an elaborate series of occult ceremonies at the time, whereby they intended to summon an elemental feminine goddess known as "Babalon" (not to be confused with Babylon) to help them bring an otherworldly entity into physical existence.
paras.zh: 尽管帕森斯从事火箭研究，他的同伴哈伯德也撰写了有关火箭的虚构著作，但他们在 1946 年初几个月的合作与火箭推进、航天器或其他最终将人类送入太空的技术创新无关。相反，帕森斯和哈伯德当时正在进行一系列精心设计的神秘仪式，他们打算召唤一位被称为“巴巴伦”（不要与巴比伦混淆）的元素女性女神来帮助他们将一个超凡脱俗的实体带入物理存在。

paras.en: Their efforts, known today as the "Babalon Working," represent one of the most unusual affairs in American history, with tangential connections to the history of space exploration.
paras.zh: 他们的努力今天被称为“巴巴隆工作”，代表了美国历史上最不寻常的事件之一，与太空探索的历史无关。

paras.en: Given its strangeness, the episode has garnered attention from several scholars and historians over the decades, who have sought to understand a series of events at the intersection of science and the occult involving one of the most unconventional innovators behind modern rocket propulsion.
paras.zh: 鉴于其奇怪之处，这一事件在几十年来引起了几位学者和历史学家的关注，他们试图了解科学与神秘学交叉领域的一系列事件，这些事件涉及现代火箭推进背后最非传统的创新者之一。

paras.en: Parsons, born in 1914, would become a key figure in the early development of American rocket technologies by the 1930s and 1940s in California, ultimately helping establish what would become the Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL). His contributions included the historic experiments at Pasadena's Arroyo Seco on Halloween Day in 1936, which NASA now recognizes as the foundational experiments that launched JPL.
paras.zh: 出生于 1914 年的帕森斯成为 20 世纪 30 年代和 1940 年代加利福尼亚州美国火箭技术早期发展的关键人物，最终帮助建立了喷气推进实验室 (JPL)。他的贡献包括 1936 年万圣节在帕萨迪纳阿罗约塞科进行的历史性实验，美国宇航局现在将其视为启动喷气推进实验室的基础实验。

paras.en: Very much in contrast with his scientific aptitudes, Parsons also cultivated an interest in ceremonial magic during this period. By the early 1940s, he had immersed himself within the California chapter of the Ordo Templi Orientis (OTO), the organization associated with the infamous British occultist Aleister Crowley and his religious philosophy known as Thelema. In 1943, Parsons became the new leader of the organization's Agape Lodge, which subsequently began operating out of his Pasadena residence on South Orange Grove Avenue.
paras.zh: 与他的科学天赋形成鲜明对比的是，帕森斯在此期间还培养了对仪式魔法的兴趣。到了 20 世纪 40 年代初期，他已经融入了东方圣殿教 (OTO) 的加州分会，该组织与臭名昭著的英国神秘学家阿莱斯特·克劳利 (Aleister Crowley) 及其名为泰勒玛 (Thelema) 的宗教哲学有关。 1943 年，帕森斯成为该组织 Agape Lodge 的新领导人，该组织随后开始在他位于南奥兰治格罗夫大道的帕萨迪纳住所开展业务。

paras.en: Parsons' occult interests became particularly focused on the evocation of supernatural entities during this period, which the young rocket scientist seemed to genuinely believe could be manifested in the physical world through ritual practices. Ultimately, this led him to undertake an ambitious — and utterly bizarre — series of ceremonies aimed at conjuring what was supposedly one of Thelema's most powerful supernatural entities.
paras.zh: 在此期间，帕森斯的神秘兴趣特别集中在超自然实体的召唤上，这位年轻的火箭科学家似乎真诚地相信，超自然实体可以通过仪式实践在物质世界中显现出来。最终，这导致他进行了一系列雄心勃勃且完全怪异的仪式，旨在召唤出据称是泰勒玛最强大的超自然实体之一。

paras.en: Parsons first became acquainted with L. Ron Hubbard in the summer of 1945, and shortly after meeting, Hubbard became a resident of the scientist's Pasadena home.
paras.zh: 帕森斯于 1945 年夏天首次结识 L. Ron Hubbard，见面后不久，哈伯德就成为了这位科学家位于帕萨迪纳的家中的居民。

paras.en: While Hubbard had no formal training in the occult arts, Parsons felt he demonstrated the kinds of aptitudes that would make him a promising partner for a serious ceremonial magic undertaking. Thus, in the first days of January 1946, the pair embarked on a series of rituals, which Parsons documented in a manuscript that later became known as The Book of Babalon.
paras.zh: 虽然哈伯德没有接受过正式的神秘艺术训练，但帕森斯认为他所表现出的才能使他成为严肃的仪式魔法事业的有前途的合作伙伴。因此，在 1946 年 1 月的第一天，两人开始了一系列仪式，帕森斯将这些仪式记录在一份手稿中，该手稿后来被称为《巴巴龙之书》。

paras.en: "In the introduction to this text [Parsons] explained that the underlying philosophy for the Babalon Working is that the present age is under the influence of a violent force," noted University of Gothenburg scholar Henrik Bogdan in a 2016 article published in the journal Numen. "The invocation of Babalon was thus, according to Parsons, an attempt to prevent the world from being destroyed."
paras.zh: 哥德堡大学学者亨里克·博格丹 (Henrik Bogdan) 在 2016 年发表在《Numen》杂志上的一篇文章中指出：“[帕森斯]在本文的引言中解释说，巴巴龙工作的基本理念是当今时代受到暴力力量的影响。” “因此，根据帕森斯的说法，巴巴隆的召唤是为了防止世界被毁灭。”

paras.en: Specifically, Parsons believed the force of Babalon could be manifested in a specific woman. "In this sense, the Babalon Working was not only an exercise in ritual magic, but a deliberate attempt to bring a divine feminine force into human form," Bogdan notes. With this goal in mind, during the first two weeks of January 1946, the pair worked to invoke this divine feminine figure, associated with liberation and spiritual transformation according to Crowley's Thelemic system.
paras.zh: 具体来说，帕森斯相信巴巴隆的力量可以在特定的女性身上体现出来。博格丹指出：“从这个意义上说，巴巴隆工作不仅是一种仪式魔法的练习，而且是一次有意将神圣的女性力量带入人类形态的尝试。”怀着这个目标，在 1946 年 1 月的前两周，两人努力唤起这个神圣的女性形象，根据克劳利的泰勒系统，它与解放和精神转变相关。

paras.en: On January 18, 1946, Parsons and Hubbard traveled into the Mojave Desert, where, according to Parsons' later writings, a change in atmosphere involving their ritual work suddenly became apparent. Now believing their operation had been a success, Parsons declared their work completed, and the two returned to Pasadena.
paras.zh: 1946 年 1 月 18 日，帕森斯和哈伯德前往莫哈韦沙漠，根据帕森斯后来的著作，那里的仪式气氛突然变得明显起来。帕森斯相信他们的手术已经成功，宣布他们的工作完成，两人返回帕萨迪纳。

paras.en: Soon afterward, Parsons reported to Hubbard that his elemental mistress had seemingly manifested with the sudden appearance at his home of a blue-eyed, red-haired artist named Marjorie Elizabeth Cameron. A former member of the U.S. Navy's WAVES program, Cameron had been invited to Parsons' residence by a colleague who, like Hubbard, was also lodging there at the time. Upon seeing her, Parsons became convinced this was the elemental lover he and Hubbard had worked to conjure, thereby confirming that the Babalon Working had produced its intended result.
paras.zh: 不久之后，帕森斯向哈伯德报告说，他的元素情妇似乎突然出现在他家中，一位名叫马乔里·伊丽莎白·卡梅伦的蓝眼睛、红发艺术家。卡梅伦曾是美国海军 WAVES 项目的成员，他的一位同事邀请他去帕森斯的住所，而这位同事当时也和哈伯德一样住在帕森斯的住所。看到她后，帕森斯确信这就是他和哈伯德努力召唤出来的元素情人，从而证实巴巴龙工作已经产生了预期的结果。

paras.en: Soon, Parsons and Cameron began a relationship, and borrowing ideas from Crowley's 1929 novel Moonchild, Parsons now believed that his romance with Cameron could facilitate the incarnation of a supernatural force through the literal conception of a child using ritual sex magic. The result, Parsons believed, could help to bring about a transformative new dawn in humanity's spiritual development.
paras.zh: 很快，帕森斯和卡梅伦开始了恋爱关系，并借鉴克劳利 1929 年的小说《月亮之子》中的想法，帕森斯现在相信他与卡梅伦的浪漫可以通过使用仪式性魔法来孕育一个孩子，从而促进超自然力量的化身。帕森斯相信，其结果可能有助于为人类精神发展带来变革性的新曙光。

paras.en: This phase of the Babalon Working mainly involved magic rituals and Enochian incantations performed by Parsons and Cameron, with Hubbard present and assisting (in addition to having proposed Rachmaninoff's "Isle of the Dead" as an eerie sonic backdrop for the occasion). For Parsons, the ultimate goal had been to conceive a "magical child" that would become the newborn Thelemic messiah.
paras.zh: 巴巴隆工作的这一阶段主要涉及由帕森斯和卡梅伦表演的魔法仪式和以诺咒语，哈伯德在场并提供协助（此外还提议拉赫玛尼诺夫的“死亡之岛”作为该场合的怪异声音背景）。对于帕森斯来说，最终目标是孕育一个“神奇的孩子”，成为新生的泰勒米斯救世主。

paras.en: Following completion of the rituals in late February 1946, Cameron left on a trip to New York, and Parsons returned to the Mojave Desert where he completed a short treatise entitled Liber 49, believing it to be a "channeled" fourth and final portion of The Book of the Law, Crowley's foundational Thelemic text.
paras.zh: 1946 年 2 月下旬完成仪式后，卡梅伦启程前往纽约，帕森斯则返回莫哈韦沙漠，在那里他完成了一篇题为《Liber 49》的短文，相信它是克劳利基础泰勒论文本《法律之书》的“通灵”第四部分，也是最后一部分。

paras.en: Upon returning from New York, Cameron even claimed to have observed an unusual aerial object—something akin to what later became known as "flying saucers" in the summer of the following year—which she believed to represent the "war engine" referenced in Crowley's work.
paras.zh: 从纽约回来后，卡梅伦甚至声称在第二年夏天观察到了一个不寻常的空中物体——类似于后来被称为“飞碟”的东西——她认为它代表了克劳利作品中提到的“战争引擎”。

paras.en: Crowley, however, was considerably less enthusiastic about all this. Upon learning what Parsons, Hubbard, and Cameron had been involved with, the famed British occultist confided to a colleague in an April 1946 correspondence that "Apparently he [Parsons] or Ron or somebody is producing a Moonchild. I get fairly frantic when I contemplate the idiocy of these louts."
paras.zh: 然而，克劳利对这一切的热情却要低得多。在得知帕森斯、哈伯德和卡梅伦所涉及的事情后，这位著名的英国神秘学家在 1946 年 4 月的一封信中向一位同事透露，“显然他（帕森斯）或罗恩或其他人正在生产一个月亮之子。当我想到这些笨蛋的愚蠢行为时，我感到相当疯狂。”

paras.en: Ultimately, a growing divide between Crowley and Parsons would cost the rocket scientist his leadership of the Agape Lodge, prompting his departure from Crowley's OTO before the end of 1946. His relationship with Hubbard similarly dissolved due to Parsons' worsening financial situation. Nevertheless, Parsons soldiered on, marrying Cameron in October 1946 and continuing his efforts to usher in a new spiritual age.
paras.zh: 最终，克劳利和帕森斯之间日益扩大的分歧导致这位火箭科学家失去了对 Agape Lodge 的领导权，促使他在 1946 年底之前离开克劳利的 OTO。同样，由于帕森斯的财务状况恶化，他与哈伯德的关系也破裂了。尽管如此，帕森斯仍坚持不懈，于 1946 年 10 月与卡梅伦结婚，并继续努力开创一个新的精神时代。

paras.en: On June 17, 1952, Parsons' unusual life ended prematurely when an explosion occurred in his home laboratory, resulting in fatal injuries. He was only 37 years old. Questions still surround the circumstances of his death; while it was ruled an accident, there have been allegations that it was suicide or even a murder.
paras.zh: 1952年6月17日，帕森斯不寻常的一生提前结束，他家中的实验室发生爆炸，造成致命伤。他年仅37岁。围绕他的死亡原因仍然存在疑问。虽然这起事故被裁定为事故，但也有指控称这是自杀，甚至是谋杀。

paras.en: During his short life, Parsons still managed to make significant contributions to the science of rocket propulsion, securing a place in the history of American space exploration — albeit one that is often overshadowed by the interest historians and scholars have taken in his occult activities.
paras.zh: 在他短暂的一生中，帕森斯仍然设法对火箭推进科学做出了重大贡献，在美国太空探索史上占有一席之地——尽管这一点常常被历史学家和学者对他的神秘活动的兴趣所掩盖。

paras.en: Nonetheless, Parsons remains a key figure responsible for helping lay the early foundations for what would become America's space program. Although decades before NASA would begin sending its spacecraft in pursuit of answers to cosmic mysteries, one of its early technological pioneers had been seeking answers to such cosmic questions in a very different way: by exploring the boundary between our physical world and the supernatural realms beyond.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，帕森斯仍然是帮助美国太空计划奠定早期基础的关键人物。尽管美国宇航局早在几十年前就开始发射航天器来寻找宇宙奥秘的答案，但其早期技术先驱之一一直在以一种截然不同的方式寻找此类宇宙问题的答案：探索我们的物质世界与超自然领域之间的界限。

paras.en: Anthony Testa, The Key of the Abyss: Jack Parsons, the Babalon Working and the Black Pilgrimage Decoded (2006), p. 128.
paras.zh: 安东尼·泰斯塔，《深渊的钥匙：杰克·帕森斯，巴巴龙的工作和解码的黑人朝圣》（2006），第 17 页。 128.

articles.title: Space Nuclear Power Corporation Awarded DARPA Agreement for Ground Test of Autonomous Nuclear Reactor Controller
articles.author: Space Nuclear Power Corporation

paras.en: LOS ALAMOS, N.M. — October 21, 2026 — Space Nuclear Power Corporation (SpaceNukes) announced today that the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) has awarded the company an Other Transaction Agreement (OTA) under the Fast Capacitance (Fat Cat) program. Managed by Dr. Tabitha Dodson in DARPA’s Defense Sciences Office, the Fat Cat program seeks to advance autonomous reactor operation for national security missions. The contract supports development and ground testing of advanced reactor control technologies that extend the demonstrated capability of American nuclear power.
paras.zh: 新墨西哥州洛斯阿拉莫斯 — 2026 年 10 月 21 日 — 太空核电公司 (SpaceNukes) 今天宣布，国防高级研究计划局 (DARPA) 已根据快速电容 (Fat Cat) 计划授予该公司一份其他交易协议 (OTA)。 Fat Cat 项目由 DARPA 国防科学办公室的 Tabitha Dodson 博士管理，旨在推进国家安全任务的自主反应堆运行。该合同支持先进反应堆控制技术的开发和地面测试，以扩展美国核电的展示能力。

paras.en: The award extends a continuous line of nuclear power development and builds directly on SpaceNukes’ successful nuclear power demonstration heritage. In 2018, key members of the SpaceNukes team, while employed by Los Alamos National Laboratory and NASA, performed the foundational Kilopower Reactor Using Stirling Technology (KRUSTY) work — conducting the only full-power ground test of a new American space reactor in five decades. Under the current agreement, SpaceNukes and Los Alamos National Laboratory will design, build, and conduct a follow-on nuclear ground test of a Kilopower reactor incorporating active control rod operation—an advancement beyond the passively controlled architecture demonstrated in the 2018 KRUSTY test.
paras.zh: 该奖项延伸了核电开发的连续路线，并直接建立在 SpaceNukes 成功的核电示范遗产之上。 2018 年，SpaceNukes 团队的主要成员在受雇于洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室和 NASA 的同时，进行了使用斯特林技术的千功率反应堆 (KRUSTY) 的基础工作——对美国新型太空反应堆进行了 5 年来唯一的全功率地面测试。根据目前的协议，SpaceNukes 和洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室将设计、建造并进行后续的 Kilopower 反应堆核地面测试，该反应堆采用主动控制棒操作，这是超越 2018 年 KRUSTY 测试中展示的被动控制架构的进步。

paras.en: “This award recognizes the maturity and continuity of the team that designed, built, and tested KRUSTY in 2018,” said Patrick McClure, COO of SpaceNukes. “We are proud to work alongside Dr. Dodson and Los Alamos National Laboratory to deliver the next demonstrated step in American nuclear power.”
paras.zh: SpaceNukes 首席运营官帕特里克·麦克卢尔 (Patrick McClure) 表示：“该奖项是对 2018 年设计、建造和测试 KRUSTY 团队的成熟度和连续性的认可。” “我们很自豪能够与多德森博士和洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室合作，在美国核电领域迈出下一步。”

paras.en: The phased program structure includes design, procurement, and integration gates leading to the ground demonstration, producing both nuclear-tested hardware and the engineering basis for autonomous, actively-controlled reactor operation. Integration work will be conducted at SpaceNukes’ workshop in Medina, Ohio, led by Chief Engineer Marc Gibson. The work positions American industry to provide reliable nuclear power across a broader range of mission profiles, including those requiring dynamic power management and rapid response under varying operational conditions.
paras.zh: 分阶段的计划结构包括设计、采购和集成，直至地面演示，生产核试验硬件和自主、主动控制反应堆运行的工程基础。集成工作将在 SpaceNukes 位于俄亥俄州麦地那的车间进行，由总工程师 Marc Gibson 领导。这项工作使美国工业界能够在更广泛的任务范围内提供可靠的核电，包括那些需要动态电力管理和在不同操作条件下快速响应的任务。

paras.en: “There is no substitute for demonstrated technology when American national security objectives are at stake,” said Andy Phelps, CEO of SpaceNukes. “This award lets us advance the work begun in the KRUSTY program and bring another tested capability forward for the nation.”
paras.zh: SpaceNukes 首席执行官安迪·菲尔普斯 (Andy Phelps) 表示：“当美国国家安全目标受到威胁时，已证实的技术是无可替代的。” “这个奖项让我们能够推进 KRUSTY 计划中开始的工作，并为国家带来另一种经过考验的能力。”

paras.en: About Space Nuclear Power Corporation (SpaceNukes)
paras.zh: 关于太空核电公司（SpaceNukes）

paras.en: Space Nuclear Power Corporation was founded on the belief that nuclear power is essential to our future, both on Earth and in space. The company’s goal is to enable the successful deployment of fission reactors in space. SpaceNukes brings together the core engineering and program management team behind the foundational KRUSTY demonstration in 2018. David Poston (CTO) and Patrick McClure (COO) performed this work at Los Alamos National Laboratory; Marc Gibson (Chief Engineer) led the program at NASA Glenn Research Center. The team is joined by Omar Mireles (formerly NASA Marshall Space Flight Center) and Andy Phelps (CEO). SpaceNukes holds a license from Los Alamos National Laboratory for the Kilopower technology and operates from headquarters in Los Alamos, New Mexico, and workshops in Los Alamos with additive 3D printing and in Medina, Ohio, with thermal and vacuum capabilities.
paras.zh: 太空核电公司的成立基于这样的信念：核电对我们的未来至关重要，无论是在地球上还是在太空中。该公司的目标是在太空成功部署裂变反应堆。 SpaceNukes 汇集了 2018 年 KRUSTY 基础演示背后的核心工程和项目管理团队。David Poston（首席技术官）和 Patrick McClure（首席运营官）在洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室执行了这项工作；马克·吉布森（首席工程师）在美国宇航局格伦研究中心领导了该项目。该团队由 Omar Mireles（前 NASA 马歇尔太空飞行中心）和 Andy Phelps（首席执行官）加入。 SpaceNukes 持有洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室的 Kilopower 技术许可证，总部位于新墨西哥州洛斯阿拉莫斯，在洛斯阿拉莫斯设有增材 3D 打印车间，在俄亥俄州麦地那设有热力和真空能力的车间。

articles.title: Astranis Upgrades Falcon 9 Launch Contract to Dedicated Mission for Entire Block 4 Production Run of Satellites
articles.author: Astranis

paras.en: SAN FRANCISCO —October 26, 2026—Today, Astranis announced it has upgraded its 4th launch to a dedicated mission aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket set to launch in 2028, allowing it to carry all of the “Block 4” production run of Astranis MicroGEO satellites.
paras.zh: 旧金山 — 2026 年 10 月 26 日 — 今天，Astranis 宣布已将其第四次发射升级为由 SpaceX Falcon 9 火箭执行的专用任务，该火箭定于 2028 年发射，使其能够运载 Astranis MicroGEO 卫星的所有“Block 4”生产运行。

paras.en: The mission will carry six MicroGEO satellites, placed directly into GEO via direct-inject using an Impulse Helios upper stage. These new satellites expand Astranis’ capacity to serve commercial and government customers around the world. The launch will bring Astranis’ total fleet size to 16, adding to the 10 satellites built across Blocks 1, 2, and 3. Astranis has already signed a number of initial customers for Block 4, to be announced at a later date. This is an amendment to an initial contract Astranis signed with SpaceX in late 2024 that gives Astranis the full payload capacity on the mission.
paras.zh: 该任务将携带六颗 MicroGEO 卫星，使用 Impulse Helios 上级通过直接注入直接放入 GEO。这些新卫星扩大了 Astranis 为全球商业和政府客户提供服务的能力。这次发射将使 Astranis 的总卫星规模达到 16 颗，在 Block 1、2 和 3 中建造的 10 颗卫星中又增加了。Astranis 已经签署了 Block 4 的一些初始客户，具体信息将在稍后公布。这是对 Astranis 于 2024 年底与 SpaceX 签署的初始合同的修订，该合同赋予 Astranis 任务中的全部有效载荷能力。

paras.en: Securing launches for multi-satellite blocks is a core benefit of Astranis’ responsive business model and provides the capacity needed to support the increased demand for dedicated space infrastructure.
paras.zh: 确保多卫星块的发射是 Astranis 响应式业务模式的核心优势，并提供支持专用空间基础设施不断增长的需求所需的容量。

paras.en: Governments and enterprises around the world are increasingly seeking dedicated space infrastructure for communications and other missions such as space domain awareness that they can fully control, rather than relying on shared capacity. Higher orbits like GEO are uniquely suited for this requirement.
paras.zh: 世界各地的政府和企业越来越多地寻求用于通信和其他任务的专用空间基础设施，例如他们可以完全控制的空间域意识，而不是依赖共享能力。像 GEO 这样的更高轨道非常适合这一要求。

paras.en: “We’ve only just begun to ramp up production to meet the demand we are seeing for commercial and national security missions,” said John Gedmark, CEO and co-founder of Astranis. “This launch means we can accelerate the critical infrastructure we’re building for customers in GEO and other higher orbits.”
paras.zh: Astranis 首席执行官兼联合创始人约翰·格德马克 (John Gedmark) 表示：“我们才刚刚开始提高产量，以满足商业和国家安全任务的需求。” “这次发射意味着我们可以加速为 GEO 和其他更高轨道的客户构建的关键基础设施。”

paras.en: This contract marks another step in Astranis’ continued expansion of high-orbit infrastructure and follows the recent introduction of Perceptor, which extends the company’s reach beyond communications into space domain awareness and maneuverability for commercial and national security missions. Astranis first proved that high-performance GEO satellites could be built faster and at scale. The company is now developing broader high-orbit platforms to connect, safeguard, and sustain critical infrastructure in GEO.
paras.zh: 该合同标志着 Astranis 持续扩展高轨道基础设施的又一步，之前推出了 Perceptor，将公司的业务范围从通信扩展到商业和国家安全任务的空间域感知和机动性。 Astranis 首先证明了高性能 GEO 卫星可以更快、更大规模地建造。该公司目前正在开发更广泛的高轨道平台，以连接、保护和维持地球静止轨道的关键基础设施。

paras.en: Astranis builds advanced satellites for high orbits, expanding humanity’s reach into the solar system. Today Astranis satellites provide dedicated, secure networks to highly-sophisticated customers across the globe — large enterprises, sovereign governments, and the US military.
paras.zh: Astranis 为高轨道建造先进的卫星，将人类的触角扩展到太阳系。如今，Atranis 卫星为全球高度复杂的客户（大型企业、主权政府和美国军方）提供专用、安全的网络。

paras.en: With multiple satellites now on orbit serving customers around the world, the company is servicing a backlog of more than $1 billion of commercial contracts. Astranis is the preferred satellite communications partner for buyers with stringent requirements for uptime, data security, network visibility, and customization.
paras.zh: 目前，该公司有多颗卫星在轨运行，为世界各地的客户提供服务，并正在为积压的超过 10 亿美元的商业合同提供服务。 Astranis 是对正常运行时间、数据安全、网络可见性和定制有严格要求的买家的首选卫星通信合作伙伴。

paras.en: Astranis has raised over $1.2 billion from some of the world’s best investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, BlackRock, Fidelity, Franklin Templeton, and Snowpoint, and employs a team of 500 engineers and entrepreneurs. Astranis designs, builds, and operates its satellites out of its 153,000 sq. ft. headquarters in Northern California, USA.
paras.zh: Astranis 已从安德森霍洛维茨 (Andreessen Horowitz)、贝莱德 (BlackRock)、富达 (Fidelity)、富兰克林邓普顿 (Franklin Templeton) 和 Snowpoint 等全球最佳投资者处筹集了超过 12 亿美元，并拥有一支由 500 名工程师和企业家组成的团队。 Astranis 在其位于美国北加州 153,000 平方英尺的总部设计、建造和运营其卫星。

articles.title: Flexell Space and Satoro Agree to Collaborate on In-Orbit Demonstration of Next-Generation Space Solar Cells
articles.author: Flexell Space

paras.en: – Two demonstration missions planned aboard SpaceX Falcon 9, one each in 2027 and 2028
paras.zh: – 计划在 SpaceX Falcon 9 上执行两次演示任务，分别于 2027 年和 2028 年执行一次

paras.en: – Satoro to provide “Satellite-as-a-service” solution; Flexell Space to supply solar cells and test modules
paras.zh: – Sataro 提供“卫星即服务”解决方案； Flexell Space 供应太阳能电池和测试模块

paras.en: Uiwang-si, Korea – Flexell Space, a space energy company led by CEO Taehun Ahn, announced that it has signed an agreement with Singapore-based CubeSat specialist Satoro, led by CEO Mark Lu, for the in-orbit demonstration and validation (IOD/IOV) of next-generation space solar cells.
paras.zh: 韩国义王市 - 由首席执行官 Taehun Ahn 领导的空间能源公司 Flexell Space 宣布，它已与由首席执行官 Mark Lu 领导的新加坡 CubeSat 专家 Satoro 签署协议，以进行下一代空间太阳能电池的在轨演示和验证 (IOD/IOV)。

paras.en: The agreement aims to verify the performance and reliability of Flexell Space’s solar cells in the actual space environment. The companies plan to conduct two demonstration missions, one in 2027 and another in 2028. Each demonstration satellite is scheduled to launch aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket.
paras.zh: 该协议旨在验证Flexell Space太阳能电池在实际太空环境中的性能和可靠性。两家公司计划进行两次演示任务，一次在 2027 年，另一次在 2028 年。每颗演示卫星都计划搭载 SpaceX Falcon 9 火箭发射。

paras.en: Flexell Space previously conducted two space demonstration missions through launches aboard Korea’s KSLV-II, in November 2025 and October 2026. Building on this experience, the agreement with Satoro will expand opportunities for in-orbit validation of its next-generation space solar cells and support the continued accumulation of operational data needed for commercialization.
paras.zh: Flexell Space 此前曾于 2025 年 11 月和 2026 年 10 月通过韩国 KSLV-II 发射进行了两次太空演示任务。基于这一经验，与 Satoro 的协议将扩大其下一代空间太阳能电池在轨验证的机会，并支持持续积累商业化所需的操作数据。

paras.en: Under the agreement, Satoro will manufacture the satellites for the demonstration missions, while Flexell Space will supply the solar cells and test modules to be integrated into them. The companies will coordinate technical requirements for the CubeSat platforms and demonstration payloads, working together to evaluate the solar cells’ operating characteristics and performance in orbit.
paras.zh: 根据协议，Satoro 将制造用于演示任务的卫星，而 Flexell Space 将提供太阳能电池和集成到卫星中的测试模块。两家公司将协调立方体卫星平台和演示有效载荷的技术要求，共同评估太阳能电池的运行特性和在轨性能。

paras.en: Through these missions, Flexell Space plans to compare and validate ground-test results against in-orbit operational data and assess the solar cells’ power output characteristics and performance changes over time. Data collected from both missions will support further design improvements and reliability validation, strengthening the technical foundation for evaluations by global customers and future commercial supply.
paras.zh: 通过这些任务，Flexell Space 计划将地面测试结果与在轨运行数据进行比较和验证，并评估太阳能电池的功率输出特性和性能随时间的变化。从这两个任务收集的数据将支持进一步的设计改进和可靠性验证，加强全球客户评估和未来商业供应的技术基础。

paras.en: The collaboration brings together Satoro’s expertise in CubeSat manufacturing and demonstration missions with Flexell Space’s capabilities in next-generation solar cell development. Flexell Space is developing solar cell technologies based on CIGS (copper indium gallium selenide) and perovskites, with a focus on commercializing low-cost, large-area, ultralight power solutions for satellites and a wide range of space infrastructure.
paras.zh: 此次合作将 Sataro 在 CubeSat 制造和演示任务方面的专业知识与 Flexell Space 在下一代太阳能电池开发方面的能力结合在一起。 Flexell Space 正在开发基于 CIGS（铜铟镓硒）和钙钛矿的太阳能电池技术，重点是将用于卫星和各种空间基础设施的低成本、大面积、超轻电源解决方案商业化。

paras.en: “Commercializing space solar cells requires both ground-based performance validation and data collected in orbit,” said Taehun Ahn, CEO of Flexell Space. “With two demonstration opportunities secured for 2027 and 2028, we will systematically verify the performance and reliability of our next-generation solar cells and build the technical evidence required by global customers.”
paras.zh: Flexell Space 首席执行官 Taehun Ahn 表示：“太空太阳能电池的商业化需要地面性能验证和在轨道上收集的数据。” “通过在 2027 年和 2028 年获得两次演示机会，我们将系统地验证下一代太阳能电池的性能和可靠性，并建立全球客户所需的技术证据。”

paras.en: He added, “Our collaboration with Satoro establishes a clear path from development to in-orbit demonstration and will accelerate our preparations for future commercial supply.”
paras.zh: 他补充道：“我们与 Sataro 的合作建立了从开发到在轨演示的清晰路径，并将加速我们为未来商业供应做准备。”

paras.en: “We are pleased to work with Flexell Space on the demonstration of its next-generation space solar cells,” said Mark Lu, CEO of Satoro. “Drawing on Satoro’s CubeSat platforms and mission integration capabilities, we will work closely with Flexell Space to help secure the in-orbit data needed to validate its technology.”
paras.zh: “我们很高兴与 Flexell Space 合作展示其下一代太空太阳能电池，”Satoro 首席执行官 Mark Lu 表示。 “利用 Satoro 的 CubeSat 平台和任务集成能力，我们将与 Flexell Space 密切合作，帮助确保验证其技术所需的在轨数据的安全。”

paras.en: He added, “We look forward to these two demonstration missions advancing the commercial potential of new space power technologies and laying the groundwork for continued technical collaboration between our companies.”
paras.zh: 他补充道：“我们期待这两项示范任务能够提升新太空动力技术的商业潜力，并为我们公司之间的持续技术合作奠定基础。”

paras.en: Flexell Space is a space energy company that originated as an internal venture at Hanwha Systems and develops next-generation space solar cells and power solutions. The company focuses on low-cost, large-area, ultralight products based on CIGS and perovskite solar cell technologies, with an emphasis on the durability, radiation tolerance, and long-term operational reliability required for space applications. Through collaboration with global satellite manufacturers and space agencies, Flexell Space is advancing the commercialization of solar cell technologies for satellites and space infrastructure.
paras.zh: Flexell Space 是一家空间能源公司，最初是韩华系统公司的内部合资企业，致力于开发下一代空间太阳能电池和电源解决方案。该公司专注于基于 CIGS 和钙钛矿太阳能电池技术的低成本、大面积、超轻产品，重点关注空间应用所需的耐用性、耐辐射性和长期运行可靠性。通过与全球卫星制造商和航天机构合作，Flexell Space 正在推进卫星和空间基础设施太阳能电池技术的商业化。

paras.en: Satoro is a Singapore-based “Satellite-as-a-service” solutions company providing integrated services spanning satellite manufacturing, payload integration, launch coordination, and in-orbit operations, demonstration, and validation (IOD/IOV). Since 2021, the company has successfully deployed 11 satellites into orbit across eight launches, achieving a 100% launch success rate. Drawing on this experience and technical expertise, Satoro supports global customers in validating and commercializing their space technologies.
paras.zh: Satero 是一家总部位于新加坡的“卫星即服务”解决方案公司，提供涵盖卫星制造、有效载荷集成、发射协调以及在轨运行、演示和验证 (IOD/IOV) 的综合服务。 2021年以来，公司共发射8次，成功将11颗卫星送入轨道，发射成功率100%。凭借这些经验和技术专长，Satoro 支持全球客户验证其空间技术并将其商业化。

articles.title: Vega Island Frozen in Fright

paras.en: Shrouded in ice in the lonely Weddell Sea, Vega Island is an eerie sight to behold. On this speck of land east of the Antarctic Peninsula, ice, rock outcrops, and glacial moraines combine to create the appearance of a smirking skull in profile looking toward Devil Island.
paras.zh: 维加岛被冰雪笼罩在孤独的威德尔海中，景色令人毛骨悚然。在南极半岛以东的这片土地上，冰、岩石露头和冰川冰碛结合在一起，形成了一个微笑的头骨侧面，朝向魔鬼岛。

paras.en: These images show Vega Island’s creepy countenance at the start of austral autumn (left) and in spring (right). They were acquired with the OLI (Operational Land Imager) on Landsat 9 on March 22, 2025, and October 10, 2026, respectively. (Clouds obscured the island in March 2026.) A nunatak jutting out of the ice has the appearance of an eye socket, a lateral moraine forms a mouth, and Bahía del Diablo (Devil’s Bay) Glacier constitutes a jawbone. In the March 2025 image, a layer of snow coats the ice, which is typical of the region’s wettest month. That contrasts with the October 2026 image, when snow is absent from large areas and darker ice surfaces are visible.
paras.zh: 这些图像显示了维加岛在南方初秋（左）和春季（右）时令人毛骨悚然的面貌。它们分别于 2025 年 3 月 22 日和 2026 年 10 月 10 日通过 Landsat 9 上的 OLI（操作陆地成像仪）获得。 （2026 年 3 月，云层遮住了该岛。）从冰中突出的努纳塔克峰看起来像眼窝，侧碛形成嘴巴，而魔鬼湾冰川则构成颚骨。在 2025 年 3 月的图像中，冰上覆盖着一层雪，这是该地区最潮湿的月份的典型特征。这与 2026 年 10 月的图像形成鲜明对比，当时大面积区域没有积雪，并且可以看到较暗的冰面。

paras.en: Above-average temperatures in winter 2026—particularly in June—were partly responsible for so much bare ice in October, said glaciologist Mauri Pelto of Nichols College. The ice exposed on Vega and nearby islands indicates limited new snow accumulation over the winter, further reduced by sublimation and wind scouring, he said. “The winter season was no treat for these glaciers.”
paras.zh: 尼科尔斯学院的冰川学家毛里·佩尔托 (Mauri Pelto) 表示，2026 年冬季（尤其是 6 月）的气温高于平均水平，是造成 10 月出现大量裸冰的部分原因。他说，维加和附近岛屿上暴露的冰表明冬季新积雪有限，升华和风冲刷进一步减少了积雪。 “冬季对这些冰川来说并不好受。”

paras.en: The melt season ahead may also be more trick than treat. Bare ice is darker than snow and absorbs more solar energy, meaning that melting is poised to speed up as the days grow longer and warmer. “Even a thin cover of new snow from a spring storm would be helpful in the short run,” Pelto said. “When entombed in snow and ice, the skull is preserved. But when exposed to melt, it weathers away, which will lead to a changing jawline and expanding eye socket.”
paras.zh: 即将到来的融化季节也可能是麻烦多于招待。裸露的冰比雪颜色更深，吸收更多的太阳能，这意味着随着白天变长和变暖，融化速度将会加快。佩尔托说：“从短期来看，即使春季暴风雨带来的薄薄的新雪也会有所帮助。” “当埋在冰雪中时，头骨会被保存下来。但当暴露在融化中时，它会风化，这将导致下巴轮廓的变化和眼窝的扩大。”

paras.en: The first comprehensive mapping of Vega Island’s ice was aided by Landsat imagery. In a study published in 1982, scientists described the island’s four ice caps with protruding rocky cliffs and outlet glaciers. They leveraged early Landsat observations along with aerial photos and topographic maps to catalog 29 glaciers on Vega.
paras.zh: 在陆地卫星图像的帮助下，第一次对维加岛冰进行全面测绘。在 1982 年发表的一项研究中，科学家描述了岛上的四个冰盖，以及突出的岩石悬崖和出口冰川。他们利用早期的陆地卫星观测结果以及航空照片和地形图对织女星上的 29 座冰川进行了编目。

paras.en: Of those glaciers, Devil’s Bay Glacier has been closely monitored since the austral summer of 1998-1999, with researchers measuring an overall decline in its mass. Satellite images acquired in recent decades show ice loss from other glaciers on the island as well, with increased areas of exposed bedrock.
paras.zh: 在这些冰川中，魔鬼湾冰川自 1998 年至 1999 年的南方夏季以来一直受到密切监测，研究人员测量了其质量的总体下降。近几十年来获得的卫星图像显示，岛上其他冰川的冰也在流失，裸露的基岩面积有所增加。

paras.en: Long before scientists began tracking its glaciers, Vega was a bright spot in a tale of terror born out of early exploration of the area. The Swedish Antarctic Expedition of 1901-1903 set out to study the geography, geology, climate, and wildlife on and around the eastern Antarctic Peninsula. The party became split into three groups during their explorations, isolated for a winter in different locations. Adding to the horror, they lost their ship to the pack ice. Cape Well-met, as it would come to be known, off the “forehead” of the Vega Island skull, was the site of a happy reunion of two of the groups in spring 1903. Soon thereafter, an Argentinean expedition rescued the survivors of the ordeal.
paras.zh: 早在科学家开始追踪其冰川之前，织女星就曾是该地区早期探索的恐怖故事中的一个亮点。 1901-1903 年瑞典南极探险队着手研究南极半岛东部及其周围的地理、地质、气候和野生动物。在探险过程中，一行人分成三组，在不同地点隔离过冬。更恐怖的是，他们的船被浮冰迷失了。 1903 年春天，维加岛头骨“额头”外的韦尔梅特角 (Cape Well-met) 是两个人幸福重聚的地方。不久之后，一支阿根廷探险队营救了这场苦难的幸存者。

articles.title: November’s Night Sky Notes: Light-Day Away

paras.en: In 1977, NASA launched twin spacecraft Voyager 1 and 2, taking advantage of a once-every-175-year planetary alignment of the four largest planets in our solar system: Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune. Using six gravity assists between them, this Grand Tour gave us up-close views of the gas and ice giants, including several moons. By the 1980s, the two probes went their separate ways at Saturn. As Voyager 2 continued toward Uranus and Neptune, Voyager 1 grabbed one more portrait of the solar system (excluding Mercury and Mars), including a final image of the pale blue dot we call home.
paras.zh: 1977 年，美国国家航空航天局 (NASA) 发射了双飞船航海者 1 号和航海者 2 号，利用太阳系中四颗最大行星：木星、土星、天王星和海王星每 175 年一次的行星排列。在它们之间的六个重力辅助下，这次伟大的旅行让我们近距离观察了气体和冰巨星，包括几颗卫星。到了 20 世纪 80 年代，两个探测器在土星上分道扬镳。当航海者 2 号继续前往天王星和海王星时，航海者 1 号又拍摄了一张太阳系（不包括水星和火星）的照片，其中包括我们称之为家的淡蓝色圆点的最终图像。

paras.en: “Hello from the children of planet Earth.”
paras.zh: “来自地球的孩子们，你们好。”

paras.en: Every good road trip needs some music to match. In this case, each craft carries the Golden Record, a 12-inch phonograph record with spoken greetings in 55 languages, 27 musical tracks, 116 images, and other sounds from Earth. Each record is protected by an outer cover featuring etchings showing our Sun's location relative to 14 pulsars, along with instructions on how to play it. The design used various metals to protect the information encoded from space radiation: the record used copper and gold plating, and the cover used aluminum. The cover was electroplated with an ultra-pure sample of the isotope uranium-238. Uranium-238 has a half-life of 4.468 billion years.
paras.zh: 每一次美好的公路旅行都需要一些音乐来搭配。在这种情况下，每艘飞船都携带金唱片，这是一张 12 英寸的留声机唱片，上面有 55 种语言的语音问候语、27 首音乐曲目、116 个图像和来自地球的其他声音。每张唱片均由外壳保护，外壳上刻有蚀刻图案，显示太阳相对于 14 颗脉冲星的位置，并附有如何播放的说明。该设计使用了各种金属来保护编码的信息免受太空辐射：唱片使用铜和镀金，盖子使用铝。盖子上电镀有同位素铀 238 的超纯样品。铀238的半衰期为44.68亿年。

paras.en: Did you know that a light-minute is a measure of distance, not time? In August 2012 and November 2018, Voyager 1 and 2 crossed the heliopause, the boundary where the Sun’s solar wind meets the interstellar medium. Using NASA’s Deep Space Network, Earth communicates with both spacecraft and tracks each on its journey. At the time of this article, the Canberra antenna tracked Voyager 1 at 25.80 billion km, or just over 16 billion miles.
paras.zh: 您是否知道光分钟是距离的单位，而不是时间的单位？ 2012年8月和2018年11月，航海者一号和航海者二号穿过日球层顶，即太阳的太阳风与星际介质相遇的边界。利用美国宇航局的深空网络，地球与两个航天器进行通信并跟踪每个航天器的旅程。在撰写本文时，堪培拉天线对 Voyager 1 的追踪距离为 258 亿公里，即略高于 160 亿英里。

paras.en: On November 18, 2026, 49 years after its launch, Voyager 1 will cross the one-light-day mark, 16.1 billion miles from the Sun. You may have heard the term light-year in your favorite sci-fi movie or show, or when stargazing and referring to an object outside of our solar system. This video best demonstrates the different distances between the inner solar system, outer solar system, and beyond, using light measurements. Additionally, track each Voyager spacecraft here.
paras.zh: 2026 年 11 月 18 日，也就是发射 49 年后，旅行者一号将跨越一光日大关，距离太阳 161 亿英里。您可能在您最喜欢的科幻电影或节目中，或者在观星时听说过光年这个词，它指的是太阳系之外的物体。该视频通过光测量最好地展示了内太阳系、外太阳系及其之外之间的不同距离。此外，还可以在此处追踪每艘航海者号航天器。

paras.en: You can get a real understanding of what a gravity assist might be like with our Gravity Assist activity and learn what it’s like to measure a “light minute” with our Measuring a Kid Minute activity guide!
paras.zh: 您可以通过我们的重力辅助活动真正了解重力辅助是什么样子，并通过我们的测量儿童一分钟活动指南了解测量“光分钟”是什么样的！

articles.title: NASA Explores Potential Commercial Servicing for Hubble Telescope

paras.en: NASA issued a Request for Information Oct. 29 to learn more about industry capabilities for in-space servicing to support the agency’s Hubble Space Telescope.
paras.zh: NASA 于 10 月 29 日发布了一份信息请求，以了解更多有关支持该机构哈勃太空望远镜的太空服务行业能力的信息。

paras.en: “Hubble still has important science ahead of it, and we should be looking at every reasonable opportunity to keep it delivering for as long as possible,” said NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman. “If there are innovative and cost-effective ways to extend the life of an asset already on orbit, we owe it to the American taxpayer and the scientific community to explore them. Extending Hubble’s life would mean more discoveries, more science, and more opportunities to expand our understanding of the universe.”
paras.zh: NASA 局长贾里德·艾萨克曼 (Jared Isaacman) 表示：“哈勃望远镜仍然拥有重要的科学成果，我们应该寻找一切合理的机会，让它尽可能长时间地发挥作用。” “如果有创新且经济有效的方法来延长已在轨道上的资产的寿命，我们有责任对美国纳税人和科学界进行探索。延长哈勃的寿命将意味着更多的发现、更多的科学以及更多的机会来扩大我们对宇宙的了解。”

paras.en: The Request for Information seeks commercial interest in: potentially conducting a mission to boost Hubble to a higher altitude to extend its science lifetime; servicing Hubble to enhance its capabilities; or performing a safe, controlled re-entry into Earth’s atmosphere or orbital disposal at the end of Hubble’s mission.
paras.zh: 信息请求寻求商业利益：可能执行将哈勃望远镜提升到更高高度的任务，以延长其科学寿命；为哈勃提供服务以增强其能力；或者在哈勃任务结束时安全、受控地重返地球大气层或轨道处置。

paras.en: “Hubble is a national icon that has fundamentally changed how humanity views our universe for more than 35 years,” said Nicky Fox, associate administrator, Science Mission Directorate, NASA Headquarters in Washington. “Commercial industry has rapidly evolved in recent years to offer new capabilities for in-space satellite capture and servicing. Given the time we have until Hubble’s anticipated re-entry, we are eager to explore the breadth of possibilities to boost Hubble to a higher orbit while we develop the flagship mission to follow.”
paras.zh: 美国宇航局华盛顿总部科学任务理事会副主任尼基·福克斯 (Nicky Fox) 表示：“哈勃望远镜是一个国家标志，在过去 35 年多的时间里，它从根本上改变了人类对宇宙的看法。” “商业产业近年来迅速发展，为太空卫星捕获和服务提供了新的能力。考虑到距离哈勃望远镜预期的重返大气层还有一段时间，我们渴望探索将哈勃望远镜提升到更高轨道的各种可能性，同时我们开发后续的旗舰任务。”

paras.en: The Request for Information is available online and will remain open for responses until 3 p.m. EST, Monday, Nov. 30.
paras.zh: 信息请求可在线获取，并将在下午 3 点之前持续开放以供回复。美国东部时间，11 月 30 日星期一。

paras.en: Like all spacecraft in low Earth orbit, Hubble’s altitude is slowly decreasing over time because of atmospheric drag. Hubble does not have a propulsion system to maintain its own orbit, and analysis predicts Hubble is likely to re-enter the atmosphere in the 2033 to 2034 timeframe. As such, NASA anticipates that a mission would need to take place by 2032.
paras.zh: 与所有近地轨道上的航天器一样，由于大气阻力，哈勃的高度随着时间的推移而缓慢降低。哈勃没有推进系统来维持自己的轨道，分析预测哈勃很可能在2033年至2034年的时间范围内重新进入大气层。因此，NASA 预计需要在 2032 年之前执行一次任务。

paras.en: The Hubble Space Telescope has been operating for more than three decades and continues to make ground-breaking discoveries that shape our fundamental understanding of the universe. Hubble is a project of international cooperation between NASA and ESA (European Space Agency). NASA’s Goddard Space Flight Center in Greenbelt, Maryland, manages the telescope and mission operations. Lockheed Martin Space, based in Denver, also supports mission operations at Goddard. The Space Telescope Science Institute in Baltimore, which is operated by the Association of Universities for Research in Astronomy, conducts Hubble science operations for NASA.
paras.zh: 哈勃太空望远镜已经运行了三十多年，并不断做出突破性的发现，塑造我们对宇宙的基本理解。哈勃望远镜是 NASA 和 ESA（欧洲航天局）之间的国际合作项目。美国宇航局位于马里兰州格林贝尔特的戈达德太空飞行中心负责管理望远镜和任务操作。总部位于丹佛的洛克希德·马丁航天公司也支持戈达德的任务运营。位于巴尔的摩的太空望远镜科学研究所由天文学研究大学协会运营，为美国宇航局进行哈勃科学操作。

paras.en: To learn more about NASA’s Hubble Space Telescope, visit:
paras.zh: 要了解有关 NASA 哈勃太空望远镜的更多信息，请访问：

paras.en: Goddard Space Flight Center, Greenbelt, Md.
paras.zh: 戈达德太空飞行中心，马里兰州格林贝尔特

articles.title: Yemen war makes reaching assistance too dangerous for many

paras.en: Yemen war makes reaching assistance too dangerous for many
paras.zh: 也门战争使许多人获得援助变得过于危险

paras.en: More than 280,000 people have now been displaced by fighting in Yemen and many vulnerable people are unable to access lifesaving relief because it is too dangerous to do so, the UN refugee agency (UNHCR) said on Friday.
paras.zh: 联合国难民署 (UNHCR) 周五表示，也门已有超过 28 万人因战斗而流离失所，许多弱势群体无法获得救生救济，因为这样做太危险了。

paras.en: In an alert, the agency said that tens of thousands of refugees and asylum seekers were struggling to survive.
paras.zh: 该机构在一份警报中表示，数以万计的难民和寻求庇护者正在为生存而苦苦挣扎。

paras.en: It described a rapidly worsening humanitarian crisis for more than 65,000 refugees and asylum seekers in Yemen, as “escalating insecurity, economic collapse, depleting resources and severe humanitarian access constraints leave tens of thousands with nowhere to turn”.
paras.zh: 报告描述了也门 65,000 多名难民和寻求庇护者面临的人道主义危机迅速恶化，“不安全局势不断升级、经济崩溃、资源枯竭和严重的人道主义准入限制使数万人无处可去”。

paras.en: Despite intensifying conflict between Houthi opposition fighters and Government forces which escalated last month and ended a four-year ceasefire, thousands of people continue to risk dangerous sea crossings from the Horn of Africa to Yemen, said UNHCR spokesperson Matthew Saltmarsh.
paras.zh: 联合国难民署发言人马修·索尔特马什表示，尽管胡塞反对派武装人员与政府军之间的冲突上个月升级并结束了四年的停火，但仍有数千人冒着危险从非洲之角越海前往也门。

paras.en: Aid teams are particularly worried about the situation in Kharaz refugee camp in the southwestern governorate of Lahj, close to the front line.
paras.zh: 援助小组尤其担心西南拉赫季省靠近前线的卡拉兹难民营的情况。

paras.en: The camp shelters around 9,500 refugees from Somalia and Ethiopia in a Government-controlled area. Although no refugee casualties have been verified so far, “nearby shelling has disrupted services and led to movement restrictions for those in the camps…who have already previously fled conflict”, Mr. Saltmarsh noted.
paras.zh: 该营地位于政府控制区，收容了来自索马里和埃塞俄比亚的约 9,500 名难民。索尔特马什先生指出，尽管到目前为止还没有核实难民伤亡情况，但“附近的炮击已经扰乱了服务，并导致难民营中的人们的行动受到限制……他们之前已经逃离了冲突”。

paras.en: UNHCR partners have distributed food inside the camp in coordination with local authorities, and health assistance and water provision continue, with significant difficulty. But most other services are on hold, with schools suspended, legal and documentation services interrupted and the rising prices of fuel and staple foods making it increasingly difficult for refugees to cover their basic needs.
paras.zh: 难民署合作伙伴与地方当局协调，在营地内分发了食物，卫生援助和供水仍在继续，但难度很大。但大多数其他服务都被搁置，学校停课，法律和文件服务中断，燃料和主食价格上涨，使难民越来越难以满足其基本需求。

paras.en: “When access allows, we do move in that assistance, but it has been challenging,” Mr. Saltmarsh said. “We’ve been hearing a lot that a number of displaced people have been unable to get to places where we have our supplies and our assistance… in many cases, it’s been too dangerous for us to get to them.”
paras.zh: “如果准入条件允许，我们确实会提供援助，但这一直具有挑战性，”萨尔马什先生说。 “我们经常听到一些流离失所者无法到达我们提供物资和援助的地方……在许多情况下，我们无法到达他们身边，这太危险了。”

paras.en: According to UNHCR, more than 280,000 people in Yemen have been displaced by the fighting. The significant increase in humanitarian needs has coincided with severe supply chain shocks in the Strait of Hormuz and the Bab El-Mandeb Strait, linked to the US-Iran war, while resources available to help them are falling short. Today, the agency’s appeal for Yemen only 19 per cent funded.
paras.zh: 据联合国难民署称，也门已有超过28万人因战斗而流离失所。人道主义需求大幅增加的同时，与美伊战争有关的霍尔木兹海峡和曼德海峡的供应链也受到严重冲击，而可用于帮助这些地区的资源却不足。如今，该机构对也门的呼吁仅获得了 19% 的资金。

paras.en: In a positive development, the agency announced that it has secured pro bono transport support for 11 containers of emergency relief items from Dubai to Yemen, “although shifting security conditions and logistical constraints are challenging those delivery efforts”, Mr. Saltmarsh noted.
paras.zh: 萨尔特马什先生指出，一个积极的进展是，该机构宣布已为从迪拜到也门的 11 个集装箱紧急救援物品提供无偿运输支持，“尽管不断变化的安全条件和后勤限制对这些运送工作构成了挑战”。

paras.en: “Those 11 containers should arrive tomorrow, bringing 3,000 relief kits to over 20,000 people in Yemen,” he added, before warning that the agency’s operations in Sudan, Djibouti and Ethiopia are among the most exposed to disrupted trade and shipping in the Red Sea.
paras.zh: 他补充说：“这 11 个集装箱将于明天抵达，为也门的 20,000 多人带来 3,000 个救援包。”然后他警告说，该机构在苏丹、吉布提和埃塞俄比亚的业务是最容易受到红海贸易和航运中断影响的地区之一。

articles.title: UN rights office warns of deepening displacement ‘nightmare’ in Gaza

paras.en: UN rights office warns of deepening displacement ‘nightmare’ in Gaza
paras.zh: 联合国人权办公室警告加沙流离失所问题加剧“噩梦”

paras.en: Israeli forces continue to push Palestinians into ever-smaller areas of the Gaza Strip while destroying civilian infrastructure and attacking displacement sites, the UN human rights office, OHCHR, warned on Friday amid concerns of ethnic cleansing.
paras.zh: 出于对种族清洗的担忧，联合国人权高专办周五警告说，以色列军队继续将巴勒斯坦人推入加沙地带越来越小的地区，同时摧毁民用基础设施并攻击流离失所地点。

paras.en: OHCHR said that Israel has stated that it aims to increase the area of military deployment to 70 per cent of Gaza’s territory.
paras.zh: 人权高专办表示，以色列已表示其目标是将军事部署面积扩大至加沙领土的70%。

paras.en: The relentless contraction of space has caused new displacement in areas adjacent to the “yellow line” demarcation boundary.
paras.zh: 空间的不断收缩，导致“黄线”分界线附近地区出现新的位移。

paras.en: Over the past two weeks, OHCHR documented the westward expansion of Israeli military deployment areas in Al Shujaiyeh, Gaza City, and in three locations in Middle Gaza – eastern Al Bureij, eastern Deir Al-Balah and eastern Al Maghazi.
paras.zh: 过去两周，人权高专办记录了以色列在加沙城舒贾耶和加沙中部三个地点——布赖吉东部、代尔巴拉赫东部和马加齐东部的军事部署区向西扩张的情况。

paras.en: In Al Shujaiyeh, at least two Israeli attacks were reported on displacement camps, while forces reportedly used explosive robots to detonate the few buildings left standing in the area.
paras.zh: 据报道，在舒贾耶耶，以色列至少对流离失所者营地发动了两起袭击，据报道，以色列军队使用爆炸机器人引爆了该地区仅存的几栋建筑物。

paras.en: OHCHR said that it received reports that on 25 October, an Israeli drone dropped munitions on tents sheltering displaced families at Al Shujaiyeh junction near the yellow line and the resulting fire burned for five hours.
paras.zh: 人权高专办表示，收到报告称，10月25日，一架以色列无人机向黄线附近舒贾耶路口为​​流离失所家庭提供庇护的帐篷投掷弹药，引发的大火燃烧了五个小时。

paras.en: As a result, 200 families comprising 800 people – mostly women, children and older persons - were displaced, according to the Palestinian Ministry of Public Works and Housing.
paras.zh: 据巴勒斯坦公共工程和住房部称，导致 200 个家庭 800 人——其中大部分是妇女、儿童和老人——流离失所。

paras.en: “The nightmare of displacement in Gaza is both acute and chronic,” said Ajith Sunghay, Head of UN Human Rights in the Occupied Palestinian Territory (OPT).
paras.zh: “加沙流离失所的噩梦既严重又长期，”联合国人权事务高级专员阿吉思·桑海 (Ajith Sunghay) 表示。

paras.en: “Those displaced before the announcement of a ceasefire have little to no prospect of return to the areas they fled, most of which are inaccessible because they fall beyond the so-called yellow line. And they continue to be displaced again and again.”
paras.zh: “那些在宣布停火之前流离失所的人几乎没有希望返回他们逃离的地区，其中大部分地区都无法进入，因为它们超出了所谓的黄线。而且他们仍然一次又一次地流离失所。”

paras.en: OHCHR said that as an occupying power, Israel must cease the forcible transfer of Palestinians within the Gaza Strip, noting that this is a war crime that may also amount to a crime against humanity.
paras.zh: 人权高专办表示，作为占领国，以色列必须停止在加沙地带强行转移巴勒斯坦人，并指出这是一种战争罪，也可能构成反人类罪。

paras.en: Israel also must facilitate Palestinians’ safe and dignified return to their homes and the areas they fled.
paras.zh: 以色列还必须帮助巴勒斯坦人安全、有尊严地返回家园和逃离的地区。

paras.en: Instead, its military operations have displaced nearly the entire population multiple times in addition to damaging and destroying buildings, structures and civilian infrastructure,
paras.zh: 相反，其军事行动除了破坏和摧毁建筑物、构筑物和民用基础设施外，还多次导致几乎全部人口流离失所，

paras.en: OHCHR said that Israeli forces appear to treat the yellow line as a kill zone, preventing Palestinians from returning to what is left of their homes on the other side.
paras.zh: 人权高专办表示，以色列军队似乎将黄线视为杀伤区，阻止巴勒斯坦人返回另一边的家园。

paras.en: Furthermore, the displacement crisis is worsened by the restrictions Israel has imposed on the entry of shelter-related humanitarian assistance.
paras.zh: 此外，以色列对与庇护所有关的人道主义援助进入的限制进一步加剧了流离失所危机。

paras.en: “There must be an end to this suffering. This is the fourth year of displacement for most Palestinians in Gaza, the fourth winter in tents too flimsy to withstand the rain, and they are still under fire through it all,” said Mr. Sunghay. “Let this be the last.”
paras.zh: “必须结束这种痛苦。对于加沙的大多数巴勒斯坦人来说，今年已经是流离失所的第四个年头了，他们已经在帐篷里度过了第四个冬天，帐篷太脆弱，无法抵御雨水，而且他们仍然遭受着炮火袭击，”桑海先生说。 “就让这成为最后一次吧。”

articles.title: DR Congo: Hunger deepens for millions amid conflict, Ebola and climate shocks

paras.en: DR Congo: Hunger deepens for millions amid conflict, Ebola and climate shocks
paras.zh: 刚果民主共和国：冲突、埃博拉和气候冲击导致数百万人的饥饿加剧

paras.en: More than 28 million people in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) are not getting enough to eat and the number is expected to tick up in the coming months, according to the latest alert from the IPC global food security monitor.
paras.zh: 根据 IPC 全球粮食安全监测机构的最新警报，刚果民主共和国 (DRC) 超过 2800 万人没有足够的食物，预计未来几个月这一数字还会增加。

paras.en: The DRC continues to confront a severe food security crisis due to persistent conflict in the east, widespread displacement, an expanding Ebola outbreak, economic shocks and the potential impacts of the El Niño weather pattern.
paras.zh: 由于东部持续冲突、大范围流离失所、埃博拉疫情扩大、经济冲击以及厄尔尼诺天气模式的潜在影响，刚果民主共和国继续面临严重的粮食安全危机。

paras.en: The IPC is a UN-backed platform that uses a five-phase scale to classify the severity of food insecurity, with level 5 being famine.
paras.zh: IPC 是一个联合国支持的平台，采用五级量表对粮食不安全的严重程度进行分类，其中 5 级为饥荒。

paras.en: Roughly 28.8 million people, or 23 per cent of the population analysed, are forecast to experience high levels of acute food insecurity (IPC Phase 3 or above) through December.
paras.zh: 预计到 12 月，大约 2880 万人（占分析人口的 23%）将经历严重的严重粮食不安全（IPC 第 3 阶段或以上）。

paras.en: More than 3.6 million people, three per cent, are facing emergency conditions or IPC Phase 4.
paras.zh: 超过 360 万人（占 3%）面临紧急情况或 IPC 第 4 阶段。

paras.en: The alert covers the period from September 2026 through next June and was published against the backdrop of the record Ebola outbreak that is about to enter a six month, with more than 10,000 cases as of this week.
paras.zh: 该警报涵盖的时期为 2026 年 9 月至明年 6 月，是在埃博拉疫情创纪录的背景下发布的，该疫情即将进入六个月，截至本周病例已超过 10,000 例。

paras.en: The crisis first emerged in Ituri province in the volatile eastern region – where armed groups have terrorised the population for decades - and has now spread to eight provinces nationwide.
paras.zh: 这场危机首先出现在动荡的东部地区的伊图里省——数十年来武装组织一直在那里恐吓民众——现在已经蔓延到全国八个省份。

paras.en: “While the national proportion of the population in Phase 3 or above is only marginally higher than in the previous analysis, conditions have deteriorated more markedly in the northeastern and eastern provinces,” the alert said.
paras.zh: 警报称：“虽然全国处于第三阶段或以上阶段的人口比例仅略高于之前的分析，但东北和东部省份的情况恶化更为明显。”

paras.en: North Kivu, South Kivu and Ituri remain the hardest-hit provinces, with 10.4 million people in Phase 3 or above, while four territories within them - Djugu, Fizi, Shabunda and Walungu - are classified in Phase 4.
paras.zh: 北基伍省、南基伍省和伊图里省仍然是受灾最严重的省份，有 1,040 万人处于第三阶段或以上阶段，而其中的四个地区——朱古、菲齐、沙本达和瓦伦古——属于第四阶段。

paras.en: Among those most affected are displaced persons, returnees, refugees and poor households.
paras.zh: 受影响最严重的是流离失所者、回返者、难民和贫困家庭。

paras.en: “In eastern DRC, conflict and violence continue to drive displacement, disrupt livelihoods and restrict access to food and markets,” the alert said.
paras.zh: 警报称：“在刚果民主共和国东部，冲突和暴力继续造成流离失所、扰乱生计并限制进入粮食和市场。”

paras.en: “A rapidly expanding Ebola outbreak, recurrent disease epidemics, rising food and fuel prices, and the impacts of floods and other climate shocks are compounding vulnerabilities,” leaving millions of people with only limited means to guard against hunger.
paras.zh: “迅速扩大的埃博拉疫情、反复出现的疾病流行、粮食和燃料价格上涨以及洪水和其他气候冲击的影响正在加剧脆弱性，”使数百万人仅有有限的手段来抵御饥饿。

paras.en: The IPC expects food security to worsen slightly from January to June. Some 30.3 million people are projected to face Phase 3 or above, including 4.2 million who are likely to face Phase 4.
paras.zh: IPC 预计 1 月至 6 月粮食安全将略有恶化。预计约有 3030 万人将面临第三阶段或以上阶段，其中包括 420 万人可能面临第四阶段。

paras.en: The increase will be driven by continued conflict and displacement, the spread of Ebola, and the anticipated impacts of El Niño, including flooding that could disrupt agricultural production and market access.
paras.zh: 持续的冲突和流离失所、埃博拉病毒的蔓延以及厄尔尼诺现象的预期影响（包括可能扰乱农业生产和市场准入的洪水）将推动这一增长。

paras.en: Other factors include rising food, fuel and agricultural input prices, along with declining humanitarian assistance.
paras.zh: 其他因素包括粮食、燃料和农业投入价格上涨，以及人道主义援助减少。

articles.title: Wilkin: Rugby League World Cup format 'fundamentally flawed'

paras.en: Rugby League World Cup: Jon Wilkin says tournament format is 'fundamentally flawed' as England on brink of historic exit
paras.zh: 橄榄球联盟世界杯：乔恩·威尔金表示，英格兰队正处于历史性出局的边缘，比赛形式“存在根本缺陷”

paras.en: England are teetering on the brink of a historic group-stage exit at the Rugby League World Cup despite beating Papua New Guinea on Friday; England need Tonga to defeat Samoa by more than 46 points to advance to the knockout stages
paras.zh: 尽管英格兰队在周五击败了巴布亚新几内亚，但在橄榄球联盟世界杯上，英格兰队仍处于历史性小组赛出局的边缘。英格兰队需要汤加队以46分以上的优势击败萨摩亚队才能晋级淘汰赛

paras.en: Sky Sports' Jon Wilkin believes the Rugby League World Cup format is "fundamentally flawed" after England were left on the brink of their first group-stage exit in the tournament's history.
paras.zh: 天空体育的乔恩·威尔金认为，在英格兰队处于赛事历史上首次小组赛出局的边缘后，橄榄球联盟世界杯的赛制存在“根本性缺陷”。

paras.en: England sealed a 34-12 victory against Papua New Guinea on Friday but needed to win by a margin of 68 points to give themselves a chance of leapfrogging Samoa in Pool B and C and advancing to the semi-finals on points difference.
paras.zh: 英格兰队周五以34-12战胜巴布亚新几内亚，但需要以68分的优势获胜，才能在B组和C组中超越萨摩亚，以分差晋级半决赛。

paras.en: Now their hopes rest on Tonga, who face off against Samoa on Sunday. England need Tonga to win by more than 46 points to secure a spot in the knockout stages.
paras.zh: 现在他们的希望寄托在汤加身上，汤加将于周日迎战萨摩亚。英格兰队需要汤加队以46分以上的优势获胜才能确保晋级淘汰赛。

paras.en: The new tournament structure, which has been downsized from 16 teams to 10, came after Australia stepped in as hosts following France's withdrawal in 2023 for financial reasons.
paras.zh: 新的赛事结构已从 16 支队伍缩减至 10 支队伍，是在法国因财政原因于 2023 年退出之后，澳大利亚作为东道主加入的。

paras.en: It has effectively meant that each group game in Pool B and C has carried more jeopardy than before.
paras.zh: 这实际上意味着B组和C组的每场小组赛都比以前面临更多的危险。

paras.en: "Australia have done a great job to organise a tournament in such a short space of time, but it was fundamentally flawed, unfair in the extreme to the start," Wilkin said.
paras.zh: 威尔金说：“澳大利亚在如此短的时间内组织了一场锦标赛，做得很好，但它存在根本性缺陷，从一开始就极其不公平。”

paras.en: "The actual competition structure is just diabolical. England were dealt an incredibly difficult task, because they essentially played their quarter-final in week one."
paras.zh: “实际的比赛结构简直是恶魔般的。英格兰队面临着一项极其艰巨的任务，因为他们基本上在第一周就打完了四分之一决赛。”

paras.en: The tournament has two pools, one featuring four teams - Australia, New Zealand, Cook Islands and Fiji - and the other featuring six teams.
paras.zh: 锦标赛有两个小组，一个有四支球队——澳大利亚、新西兰、库克群岛和斐济——另一个有六支球队。

paras.en: England were drawn in the second group, Pool B and C, alongside Tonga, Samoa, Papua New Guinea, Lebanon and France.
paras.zh: 英格兰队被分在第二组B组和C组，与汤加、萨摩亚、巴布亚新几内亚、黎巴嫩和法国同组。

paras.en: The top two teams from each group qualify for the knockout rounds, and in the event of a tie, teams are judged on their head-to-head record before points difference.
paras.zh: 每组前两名球队有资格进入淘汰赛，如果出现平局，则根据球队在积分差前的交锋战绩进行评判。

paras.en: Brian McDermott's side were beaten in their first match, a 30-12 defeat to Tonga, which put their hopes of qualifying in the balance, despite later thrashing France by 82 points in round two.
paras.zh: 布莱恩·麦克德莫特的球队在首场比赛中以 30-12 输给汤加队，尽管后来在第二轮以 82 分大胜法国队，但晋级希望渺茫。

paras.en: "England knew after their loss against Tonga that it was all going to be about points difference, and [qualifying] was going to be incredibly difficult," Wilkin said. "I think the structure and the setup of the competition was done in short notice.
paras.zh: “英格兰队在输给汤加队后知道，这一切都将取决于积分差异，而[资格]将非常困难，”威尔金说。 “我认为比赛的结构和设置是在短时间内完成的。

paras.en: "I think the International Rugby League, who set up this tournament, have done an incredible job to get it on and actually and get in a position where we can have the tournament.
paras.zh: “我认为举办这项赛事的国际橄榄球联盟做了令人难以置信的工作，让这项赛事得以顺利进行，并真正达到了我们可以举办这项赛事的位置。

paras.en: "So, I commend them for that, but I just think the tournament structure is laughable. Like, no quarter-finals? There's a number of ways you could have manufactured or engineered a quarter-finals situation.
paras.zh: “所以，我对此表示赞扬，但我只是认为锦标赛结构很可笑。比如，没有四分之一决赛？有很多方法可以制造或设计四分之一决赛的情况。

paras.en: "England should be in the quarter-finals, of the World Cup. They had a disappointing 30-40 minutes against Tonga, and they're out."
paras.zh: “英格兰应该能进入世界杯四分之一决赛。他们在对阵汤加的比赛中踢了 30-40 分钟，结果令人失望，然后就出局了。”

paras.en: Wilkin questions England's preparations but backs McDermott
paras.zh: 威尔金质疑英格兰队的准备工作，但支持麦克德莫特

paras.en: Wilkin backed McDermott to stay on as England head coach, but added he needed a new structure around him while questioning the decision to arrive in Australia just over a week before the tournament.
paras.zh: 威尔金支持麦克德莫特继续担任英格兰队主教练，但他补充说，他需要一个新的结构，同时质疑在比赛前一周抵达澳大利亚的决定。

paras.en: McDermott revealed earlier in October that the side had taken a convoluted route to reach their Perth base, flying from the north of England to Singapore first and then to Sydney, before travelling to Western Australia.
paras.zh: 麦克德莫特在十月初透露，球队采取了一条曲折的路线到达珀斯基地，先从英格兰北部飞往新加坡，然后飞往悉尼，然后前往西澳大利亚。

paras.en: "England knew they were playing in the World Cup," Wilkin said. "England knew the structure. England knew they needed to win the first game.
paras.zh: “英格兰知道他们正在参加世界杯，”威尔金说。 “英格兰知道比赛的结构。英格兰知道他们需要赢得第一场比赛。

paras.en: "How it is possible to fly your athletes out, economy class, to Singapore, to Sydney, then back to Perth, jet-lagged, and then expect to play against the NRL-standard Tonga team week one and produce a performance is laughable.
paras.zh: “怎么可能让你的运动员乘坐经济舱飞往新加坡、悉尼，然后在倒时差的情况下返回珀斯，然后期望在第一周与 NRL 标准的汤加队比赛并取得良好的表现，这是可笑的。

paras.en: "It's a laughable logistical mess that again isn't elite. Nothing elite about it. In any other elite sport it's like, 'no stone unturned', and I just don't think England had that going into this World Cup.
paras.zh: “这是一个可笑的后勤混乱，这又不是精英。这没有什么精英。在任何其他精英运动中，这就像‘千方百计’，我只是不认为英格兰在本届世界杯上有这样的表现。”

paras.en: "I think McDermott is an exceptional coach. I'd give him more time, but there needs to be some management and structure behind him to those things right.
paras.zh: “我认为麦克德莫特是一位出色的教练。我会给他更多的时间，但他需要一些管理和结构来支持他做正确的事情。

paras.en: "You know, those things really matter, and a jet-lagged team going into play a Tongan team who are rife with stars was fundamentally where it went wrong."
paras.zh: “你知道，这些事情真的很重要，一支时差队与一支云集的汤加队比赛从根本上来说就是问题所在。”

articles.title: Carrick's last chance? The fixes Man Utd may need at Chelsea

paras.en: Michael Carrick: What Man Utd boss could change for Saturday's Premier League game at Chelsea
paras.zh: 迈克尔·卡里克：曼联主帅可以为周六对阵切尔西的英超比赛做出什么改变

paras.en: Michael Carrick remains in charge at Manchester United despite going eight games without a win; William Bitibiri and Callum Bishop discuss what Carrick could change to revive his fortunes ahead of Saturday's Premier League trip to Chelsea
paras.zh: 尽管八场比赛未尝一胜，但迈克尔·卡里克仍执教曼联。威廉·比蒂比里和卡勒姆·毕肖普讨论了卡里克在周六对阵切尔西的英超联赛之前可以做出哪些改变来重振自己的命运

paras.en: You would be forgiven for wondering how much longer Michael Carrick will remain in the Manchester United dugout.
paras.zh: 如果你想知道迈克尔·卡里克还会在曼联的教练席上待多久，这是情有可原的。

paras.en: A run of eight games without a win has left Carrick searching for answers, with the performances raising as many questions as the results.
paras.zh: 连续八场比赛没有获胜让卡里克寻找答案，他的表现和结果一样引发了很多疑问。

paras.en: The energy and organisation of his interim spell last season has been replaced by a team struggling to find their identity.
paras.zh: 他上赛季临时时期的能量和组织已经被一支努力寻找自己身份的球队所取代。

paras.en: Chelsea away is next on Saturday. Carrick needs to find solutions, and quickly. But what can he actually change?
paras.zh: 下周六将客场挑战切尔西。卡里克需要尽快找到解决方案。但他到底能改变什么呢？
