paras.en: Stop the high press and make United harder to play through
paras.zh: 停止高压逼抢，让曼联更难度过难关

paras.en: One of the biggest problems facing Carrick is that Manchester United are making life too easy for their opponents.
paras.zh: 卡里克面临的最大问题之一是曼联让对手的日子过得太轻松了。

paras.en: The intention to be more aggressive out of possession is understandable, but the execution has been off. United have repeatedly been pulled out of position, with gaps opening between the forward line and midfield that opponents have exploited to progress through the centre or find space out wide.
paras.zh: 在控球后变得更具侵略性的意图是可以理解的，但执行力却不佳。曼联多次被拉出位置，前锋线和中场之间出现空档，对手利用这些空档突破中路或在边路寻找空间。

paras.en: United are among the Premier League's most frequent users of a high block, employing it for 36 per cent of opposition build-up phases. Only Tottenham and Liverpool have used it more often, with Manchester City level with United.
paras.zh: 曼联是英超联赛中最常使用高位拦网的球队之一，36%的对手组织进攻阶段都会使用高位拦网。只有热刺和利物浦使用频率更高，曼城与曼联持平。

paras.en: But pressing high is one thing, making it work is another. United have won the ball high up the pitch 52 times this season, but only 10 of those occasions have led to a shot. They have yet to score from one.
paras.zh: 但压力大是一回事，让它发挥作用又是另一回事。曼联本赛季在球场上赢得了 52 次球权，但其中只有 10 次成功射门。他们还没有得分。

paras.en: Defeats to Atletico Madrid and Como exposed those weaknesses. United's attempts to press have lacked the coordination and intensity required to make the approach effective, leaving defenders exposed when the first line is bypassed.
paras.zh: 输给马德里竞技和科莫暴露了这些弱点。曼联的逼抢尝试缺乏有效进攻所需的协调性和强度，导致防守队员在第一道防线被绕过时暴露在外。

paras.en: Bruno Fernandes questioned the decision not to press man to man against Como, arguing that opponents were being given too much time to build attacks. But the answer is not necessarily to press higher and harder. United must first establish a structure they can execute consistently.
paras.zh: 布鲁诺·费尔南德斯质疑在对阵科莫的比赛中不进行一对一逼抢的决定，他认为给对手太多的时间来发动进攻。但答案并不一定是压得更高、更用力。曼联必须首先建立一个能够持续执行的结构。

paras.en: There were encouraging signs against Leeds, when Carrick's side looked more disciplined and compact, even if they could not turn a 1-1 draw into victory.
paras.zh: 对阵利兹联的比赛中出现了令人鼓舞的迹象，卡里克的球队看起来更有纪律性和紧凑性，即使他们无法将1-1战平转化为胜利。

paras.en: There is also a wider issue with United's defensive shape. They have spent just 56.5 minutes in a high defensive compactness structure this season, the 18th-lowest figure in the Premier League.
paras.zh: 曼联的防守阵型还存在一个更广泛的问题。本赛季他们在高度紧凑的防守结构中只花了56.5分钟的时间，在英超联赛中排名第18。

paras.en: A similar approach to the Leeds game at Chelsea would make sense. United need shorter distances between their defensive and midfield lines, better protection in central areas and a clearer understanding of when to engage.
paras.zh: 与利兹联对阵切尔西的比赛采取类似的做法是有意义的。曼联需要缩短防守线和中场线之间的距离，更好地保护中场，并更清楚地了解何时进攻。

paras.en: Until United can defend as a unit, their tactical confusion will continue.
paras.zh: 在曼联能够作为一个整体进行防守之前，他们的战术混乱将会持续下去。

paras.en: Fernandes must return to the starting XI
paras.zh: 费尔南德斯必须重返首发阵容

paras.en: Leaving Fernandes on the bench against Bournemouth was a significant decision, particularly after the captain questioned United's tactics following the Champions League defeat to Como.
paras.zh: 在对阵伯恩茅斯的比赛中让费尔南德斯坐在替补席上是一个重大决定，特别是在欧冠输给科莫后队长质疑曼联的战术之后。

paras.en: Carrick insisted it was a football decision, but the midfielder's absence was impossible to ignore as United suffered another damaging defeat. Fernandes was not even introduced as the situation deteriorated, leaving questions over whether the decision was based purely on performance or also reflected a power play from Carrick.
paras.zh: 卡里克坚称这是一个足球决定，但这位中场球员的缺席不容忽视，因为曼联再次遭受了毁灭性的失败。随着局势的恶化，费尔南德斯甚至没有被引进，这让人怀疑这个决定是纯粹基于表现还是也反映了卡里克的权力发挥。

paras.en: The clear-the-air talks between the pair this week appear to have drawn a line under the disagreement. Carrick has reiterated that Fernandes remains captain and said the club can move forward together.
paras.zh: 本周两人之间的明确会谈似乎已经划清了分歧。卡里克重申费尔南德斯仍然是队长，并表示俱乐部可以共同前进。

paras.en: There is no guarantee Fernandes alone can transform United's fortunes. His own performances have not consistently reached the levels of last season, and the team cannot continue relying on individual quality to compensate for collective shortcomings.
paras.zh: 无法保证仅费尔南德斯就能改变曼联的命运。他本人的表现并没有持续达到上赛季的水平，球队也无法继续依靠个人素质来弥补集体的不足。

paras.en: However, he remains one of United's most influential players, capable of creating chances, progressing possession and providing the decisive pass in transition. When he is on song, his ability to connect midfield and attack is particularly important when United struggle to break down organised defences.
paras.zh: 然而，他仍然是曼联最有影响力的球员之一，能够创造机会、推进控球并在攻防转换中提供决定性的传球。当他在唱歌时，当曼联难以打破有组织的防守时，他连接中场和进攻的能力尤为重要。

paras.en: Carrick needs his best players on the pitch, especially when results are this poor. If Fernandes is fit and ready, leaving him out again would be difficult to justify.
paras.zh: 卡里克需要球场上最好的球员，尤其是在成绩如此糟糕的情况下。如果费尔南德斯已经恢复健康并做好了准备，那么再次将他排除在外就很难证明是合理的。

paras.en: What is ironic about Manchester United's recent struggles is that the senior players Carrick relied on during his impressive interim spell last season are now struggling to deliver the same levels of performance.
paras.zh: 曼联最近的困境具有讽刺意味的是，卡里克在上赛季令人印象深刻的过渡时期所依赖的高级球员现在却难以提供同样水平的表现。

paras.en: Fernandes must return to the starting XI but reinstating the captain should not mean ignoring the youngsters who could inject some much-needed energy into a team that has looked short of intensity and conviction.
paras.zh: 费尔南德斯必须重返首发阵容，但恢复队长身份并不意味着忽视年轻球员，他们可以为一支看起来缺乏强度和信念的球队注入一些急需的能量。

paras.en: Harry Amass impressed during pre-season and deserves an opportunity to compete for a place at left-back. With United struggling to find consistency in that position, there is a case for giving the youngster a chance to show what he can offer.
paras.zh: 哈里·阿马斯在季前赛中给人留下了深刻的印象，值得有机会竞争左后卫的位置。由于曼联在这个位置上很难保持稳定，因此有理由给这位年轻球员一个展示他能力的机会。

paras.en: Shea Lacey is another option. The 19-year-old has had limited opportunities since scoring in the Carabao Cup against Brighton, but has shown the enthusiasm and willingness to take responsibility that United have lacked at times.
paras.zh: 谢伊·莱西是另一种选择。自从在卡拉宝杯对阵布莱顿的比赛中进球以来，这位19岁的球员获得的机会有限，但他表现出了曼联有时所缺乏的热情和承担责任的意愿。

paras.en: Introducing young players is not a solution to every problem, and throwing them into a struggling side comes with its own risks. But if experienced players are not delivering, Carrick must be willing to look elsewhere.
paras.zh: 引入年轻球员并不能解决所有问题，将他们投入到陷入困境的球队也有其自身的风险。但如果经验丰富的球员无法发挥作用，卡里克必须愿意寻找其他球员。

paras.en: Fernandes can provide the quality to complement that youthful energy. United need a balance of experience and enthusiasm - and Carrick should not be afraid to give the next generation an opportunity to make their mark.
paras.zh: 费尔南德斯可以提供补充年轻活力的品质。曼联需要经验和热情之间的平衡——卡里克不应该害怕给下一代留下留下印记的机会。

paras.en: Go back to basics and stop moving players around
paras.zh: 回到基础并停止移动球员

paras.en: Man Utd this season appear to be spending as much time adapting to new positions as they are trying to find form.
paras.zh: 曼联本赛季似乎在适应新位置上花费了与寻找状态一样多的时间。

paras.en: Diogo Dalot has operated at both right-back and left-back, while Leny Yoro has been used at right-back as well as centre-back. Mason Mount has featured on the right, and Youri Tielemans, previously viewed as a deeper-lying midfielder, has recently been pushed into more advanced positions.
paras.zh: 迪奥戈·达洛特曾踢过右后卫和左后卫的位置，而莱尼·约罗则曾踢过右后卫和中后卫的位置。梅森·芒特（Mason Mount）在右路出战，而尤里·蒂勒曼斯（Youri Tielemans）此前被视为后撤中场，最近被推到了更靠前的位置。

paras.en: Further forward, Matheus Cunha has been asked to operate from the left and through the middle, while Bryan Mbeumo has predominantly featured on the right despite producing some of his best football centrally last season.
paras.zh: 再往前走，马修斯·库尼亚被要求从左路和中路进攻，而布莱恩·姆博莫则主要踢右路，尽管他上赛季在中路踢出了一些最好的足球。

paras.en: Players out of position? Square pegs in round holes? How familiar does that sound?
paras.zh: 球员不在位置？方钉插在圆孔里？这听起来有多熟悉？

paras.en: There are understandable reasons for some of these changes, including injuries and the need to find a winning combination. But the constant reshuffling has made it difficult for United to establish consistent partnerships and give players a settled understanding of their roles.
paras.zh: 其中一些变化的原因是可以理解的，包括伤病和寻找获胜组合的需要。但不断的改组让曼联很难建立一致的合作伙伴关系，也很难让球员对自己的角色有一个固定的认识。

paras.en: Carrick's willingness to experiment was one of the positives of his interim spell, especially in the transition away from what Ruben Amorim was often critiqued for.
paras.zh: 卡里克愿意进行尝试是他过渡期间的积极因素之一，尤其是在摆脱鲁本·阿莫林经常受到批评的过渡时期。

paras.en: Against Chelsea, he needs to identify the strongest available XI and give players the best opportunity to perform in positions that suit them. That does not mean abandoning tactical adjustments, but United need a reliable foundation before they can start building something more ambitious.
paras.zh: 对阵切尔西时，他需要确定最强的可用阵容，并为球员提供在适合他们的位置上表现的最佳机会。这并不意味着放弃战术调整，但曼联需要一个可靠的基础才能开始建设更雄心勃勃的球队。

articles.title: Rickelton, Mulder hit tons as South Africa set Australia 288 to win decider

paras.en: South Africa vs Australia, third Test: Centuries by Ryan Rickelton and Wiaan Mulder lift hosts back into series contention in Newlands decider
paras.zh: 南非对阵澳大利亚，第三次测试：瑞恩·里克尔顿和维安·穆德的世纪之战将东道主带回纽兰兹决胜局的系列赛争夺中

paras.en: Ryan Rickelton and Wiaan Mulder strike centuries as South Africa set Australia 288 to win third Test and seal series victory; series winners take top spot in Test rankings; watch final day live on Sky Sports Cricket from 8am on Saturday
paras.zh: 瑞安·里克尔顿 (Ryan Rickelton) 和威安·穆德 (Wiaan Mulder) 帮助南非队以 288 杆击败澳大利亚队，赢得第三次测试赛并锁定系列赛胜利；系列赛获胜者在测试排名中名列前茅；周六上午 8 点开始观看天空体育板球比赛最后一天的直播

paras.en: Ryan Rickelton and Wiaan Mulder struck centuries as South Africa were bowled out for 387 to close day four of the decisive third Test against Australia, setting the touring side a victory target of 288 on the final day.
paras.zh: 瑞安·里克尔顿 (Ryan Rickelton) 和维安·穆德 (Wiaan Mulder) 的表现令人惊叹，南非队在与澳大利亚队进行的决定性的第三次测试赛第四天结束时以 387 分出局，为巡回赛球队在最后一天设定了 288 分的胜利目标。

paras.en: Australia toiled, taking a single wicket in the opening two sessions before a burst after tea, but it was still very much the home side's day and sets up an intriguing tussle on Saturday.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚队苦苦挣扎，在开场两节比赛中只拿下一个三柱门，然后在茶后爆发，但这仍然是主队的一天，并在周六展开了一场有趣的争斗。

paras.en: Mulder top-scored with 115, his fourth Test century, while Rickelton amassed 101 as the pair ensured Australia will need to complete the second-highest successful run chase in 137 years of Test cricket at Newlands.
paras.zh: 穆德 (Mulder) 以 115 分获得最高分，这是他的第四个测试百分，而里克尔顿 (Rickelton) 则获得了 101 分，两人确保澳大利亚队需要在纽兰兹 (Newlands) 板球测试赛 137 年来完成第二高的成功追逐。

paras.en: - Scorecard: South Africa vs Australia, third Test, Cape Town
paras.zh: - 记分卡：南非 vs 澳大利亚，第三次测试，开普敦

paras.en: - Get the latest Sky Sports deals or stream with no contract
paras.zh: - 获取最新的天空体育优惠或无合同直播

paras.en: - Listen to latest episode of the Sky Sports Cricket Podcast
paras.zh: - 收听天空体育板球播客的最新一集

paras.en: "It was about trying to win the small moments," Rickelton said. "We knew we were effectively 40 for four this morning and that Australia would come hard at us.
paras.zh: “这是为了努力赢得小时刻，”里克尔顿说。 “我们知道今天早上我们的四人战绩实际上是 40 分，澳大利亚会对我们严厉打击。

paras.en: "It was about spending time at the crease rather than worrying about scoring runs or getting too far ahead of ourselves. We had our plans and needed to stick to them.
paras.zh: “这是为了把时间花在折痕上，而不是担心得分或超出自己太多。我们有自己的计划，需要坚持下去。

paras.en: "We knew the longer we batted, the more frustrated Australia would become. Perhaps they expected things to happen quite quickly because of the deteriorating wicket."
paras.zh: “我们知道我们击球的时间越长，澳大利亚就会变得越沮丧。也许由于三柱门的恶化，他们预计事情会很快发生。”

paras.en: The pitch is starting to show signs of wear, with Australia batter Josh Inglis saying on Thursday a chase of over 200 would be a difficult one batting last.
paras.zh: 球场开始出现磨损迹象，澳大利亚击球手乔什·英格利斯 (Josh Inglis) 周四表示，超过 200 分的追击将是一场艰难的最后一击。

paras.en: They will need considerably more than that at more than three runs an over against a South African bowling attack that has had its feet up for more than a day and a half.
paras.zh: 他们需要的不仅仅是三分以上，以对抗已经站起来超过一天半的南非保龄球进攻。

paras.en: South Africa resumed on the fourth morning at 140-4 and lost only Matthew Breetzke (43) in two sessions as he fell to a pull shot off Pat Cummins (2-71) and was caught on the boundary by Mitchell Starc, a familiar mode of dismissal for the home side this Test.
paras.zh: 南非队在第四天早上以 140-4 的成绩重新开始，两场比赛中只输掉了马修·布里茨克（Matthew Breetzke，43 岁），因为他在帕特·康明斯（2-71）的拉球中摔倒，并在界线被米切尔·斯塔克抓住，这是本次测试中主队熟悉的出局模式。

paras.en: Rickelton and Mulder put on 154 for the sixth wicket as they took few risks and accumulated runs.
paras.zh: 里克尔顿和穆德在第六个三柱门上打出 154 分，因为他们几乎不冒险并积累了分数。

paras.en: There was considerable turn for spinner Nathan Lyon (2-101) and variable bounce for the seamers.
paras.zh: 旋转球手内森·里昂（2-101）有相当大的转弯，而接缝球手的弹跳则变化多端。

paras.en: Mulder was the last man out as he tried to up the tempo, caught on the boundary - again by Starc off Cummins - to bring a close to the day.
paras.zh: Mulder 是最后一个出局的人，他试图加快节奏，但在边界处再次被康明斯的 Starc 抓住，为这一天画上了句号。

paras.en: The series is level at 1-1 after Australia won the first Test by 214 runs in Durban and South Africa responded with a victory by an innings and 31 runs in Gqeberha.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚在德班以 214 分赢得首场测试赛，而南非则在格克贝哈以一局和 31 分获胜，系列赛战成 1-1 平。

paras.en: "It's been a special series. It's ebbed and flowed across all three games," Rickelton added. "Both teams have got ahead at different stages, only for the other to fight back. There have been mistakes and some really good cricket as well.
paras.zh: “这是一个特殊的系列赛。三场比赛都有起有落，”里克尔顿补充道。 “两支球队在不同的阶段都取得了领先，只是为了对方的反击。有一些错误，也有一些非常好的板球。

paras.en: "Hopefully it comes down to a really good day for South Africa tomorrow."
paras.zh: “希望明天对南非来说是真正美好的一天。”

paras.en: The winners of the match will occupy the No 1 spot in the Test world rankings, which is currently held by Australia.
paras.zh: 这场比赛的获胜者将占据测试世界排名第一的位置，该排名目前由澳大利亚占据。

articles.title: Italy’s PM deploys troops as nation faces widespread strikes and port blockades
articles.author: Sara Monetta

paras.en: ROME — Tens of thousands of people were getting ready to take to the streets of Rome, Milan and other Italian cities Friday as part of nationwide demonstrations against the cost of living and high military spending.
paras.zh: 罗马——周五，数万人准备走上罗马、米兰和其他意大利城市的街头，这是反对生活成本和高额军费的全国性示威活动的一部分。

paras.en: After several weeks of violent protests in Italy and throughout Europe, more widespread disruption is expected after the Unione Sindacale di Base (USB) and other trade unions called on workers in both the public and private sectors to strike and protest.
paras.zh: 在意大利和整个欧洲发生了数周的暴力抗议活动之后，辛达卡莱基地工会 (USB) 和其他工会呼吁公共和私营部门的工人罢工和抗议，预计会造成更广泛的破坏。

paras.en: The demonstrations in Italy appear to have been partly inspired by those in France, where some of the worst rioting in decades erupted in cities across the country after student protests about the state of education in the country evolved into wider actions about the cost of living and social security.
paras.zh: 意大利的示威活动似乎在一定程度上受到了法国示威活动的启发，在学生针对该国教育状况的抗议演变成针对生活成本和社会保障的更广泛行动后，法国各地城市爆发了数十年来最严重的骚乱。

paras.en: Elsewhere in Europe, a huge encampment of tents has occupied a square in Madrid since late last month, and thousands of people in Portugal have taken to the streets in the city of Lisbon. Tear gas and water cannons were also used on black-clad protesters in Brussels.
paras.zh: 在欧洲其他地方，自上个月末以来，一个巨大的帐篷营地占据了马德里的一个广场，而葡萄牙的数千人则走上里斯本市的街道。布鲁塞尔的黑衣抗议者也使用了催泪瓦斯和高压水枪。

paras.en: In Rome, many waved communist and Palestinian flags, as well as signs against the Iran war. Some let off pink smoke bombs. There was a jovial mood among the demonstrators as they lined up before the march, as has often been the case early on at previous protests, only for violence to break out later.
paras.zh: 在罗马，许多人挥舞着共产主义和巴勒斯坦旗帜，以及反对伊朗战争的标语。有些人发射了粉红色烟雾弹。游行前排队的示威者心情愉快，就像之前抗议活动初期经常出现的情况一样，但后来却爆发了暴力事件。

paras.en: Giovanna Di Matteo, a member of the left-wing Potere al Popolo! party, said she was protesting against the government that “did nothing for the people of this country.”
paras.zh: 乔凡娜·迪·马泰奥 (Giovanna Di Matteo)，左翼人民党成员！该党表示，她抗议政府“没有为这个国家的人民做任何事”。

paras.en: The government had spent money on the military “while they cut on welfare, they cut on services and people cannot reach the end of the month,” she said. “They have no money for their houses, they have no money for gasoline and everything.”
paras.zh: 她说，政府在军队上花钱，“同时削减福利，削减服务，人们无法活到月底”。 “他们没有钱买房子，没有钱买汽油等等。”

paras.en: Luca, a 20-year-old medical student said the protesters felt they were “still not being heard, that everything is still the same,” and the government didn’t “care about our voice, about our voices, and about the future of this nation that is our nation.”
paras.zh: 20 岁的医科学生卢卡 (Luca) 表示，抗议者感到“仍然没有被听到，一切还是一样”，政府并不“关心我们的声音，关心我们的声音，关心我们这个国家的未来”。

paras.en: “We have been completely screwed by by by the fact that the wages do not keep up on on inflation and the wages in general do not keep up with the corps of living,” added Luca, asked to have his last name withheld out of fear of repercussions from law enforcement.
paras.zh: 卢卡补充道：“工资跟不上通货膨胀，工资总体跟不上生活水平，我们彻底被搞砸了。”由于担心执法部门的影响，卢卡要求隐去自己的姓氏。

paras.en: Major demonstrations also took place in other cities and towns across Italy.
paras.zh: 意大利其他城镇也发生了大规模示威活动。

paras.en: They came after a number of protests in recent weeks have turned violent. Groups of masked protesters looted stores in Milan and elsewhere and threw projectiles at police, who responded with tear gas and water cannons earlier this month.
paras.zh: 他们是在最近几周的多起抗议活动演变成暴力事件之后提出的。成群结队的蒙面抗议者抢劫了米兰和其他地方的商店，并向警察投掷投掷物，本​​月早些时候，警察用催泪瓦斯和水枪回应。

paras.en: Italian police were out in force again Friday with riot brigades, drones and helicopters visible in the skies above the Rome protest.
paras.zh: 周五，意大利警方再次出动，防暴队、无人机和直升机出现在罗马抗议活动的上空。

paras.en: Their presence was heavy after protesters stormed Rome’s historic Colosseum on Saturday, while in the south, farmers and truckers have blockaded highways and ports to protest high fuel prices which have risen since the United States and Israel launched the war against Iran.
paras.zh: 周六，抗议者袭击了罗马历史悠久的罗马斗兽场后，他们的身影大量出现，而在南部，农民和卡车司机封锁了高速公路和港口，以抗议自美国和以色列对伊朗发动战争以来不断上涨的高油价。

paras.en: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni, who has made law and order a key tenet of her administration, said she had “great respect” for peaceful protesters on X earlier this month.
paras.zh: 意大利总理乔治亚·梅洛尼(Giorgia Meloni)将法律和秩序作为其政府的一项重要宗旨，她本月早些时候表示，她对X日的和平抗议者“非常尊重”。

paras.en: But her right-wing government has since introduced tougher penalties for rioters, including financial liability for parents whose children take part in vandalism and looting.
paras.zh: 但她的右翼政府此后对骚乱者实施了更严厉的惩罚，包括对孩子参与破坏和抢劫的父母承担经济责任。

paras.en: “There is nothing revolutionary about vandalizing and stealing. Vandalism and theft are not protest, they are criminality,” Meloni said on social media after unveiling the legislation.
paras.zh: “破坏和盗窃并没有什么革命性的。破坏和盗窃不是抗议，而是犯罪行为，”梅洛尼在公布这项立法后在社交媒体上表示。

paras.en: The government also said it would deploy 500 army troops alongside the police in Milan until the end of the year.
paras.zh: 政府还表示，将在米兰部署 500 名军队和警察，直至年底。

articles.title: Evacuations begin in Ukraine under localized ceasefire brokered by Melania Trump
articles.author: Alexander Smith

paras.en: A landmark evacuation and humanitarian aid mission was underway Friday inside a devastated Russian-occupied city in Ukraine, during a localized ceasefire brokered by first lady Melania Trump and with the involvement of Pope Leo XIV.
paras.zh: 周五，在第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普的斡旋和教皇利奥十四世的参与下，在乌克兰一座被俄罗斯占领的城市内，一项具有里程碑意义的疏散和人道主义援助任务正在进行。

paras.en: Ukrainian officials have described the operation in Oleshky as one of the most significant pauses in fighting since Russia launched its full-scale invasion more than four and a half years ago. Humanitarian teams from both sides were on the ground early Friday, with the first lady posting to X that they were “delivering aid and preparing the convoy for civilian evacuation.”
paras.zh: 乌克兰官员称奥列什基行动是自四年半前俄罗斯发动全面入侵以来最重大的战斗停顿之一。双方的人道主义救援队于周五早些时候抵达现场，第一夫人在 X 上发帖称，他们正在“提供援助并为平民疏散做好车队准备”。

paras.en: However, any sense that the ceasefire might yield wider progress in the war was tempered by Russian missile strikes on other cities ahead of what is predicted to be a bitter winter for Ukraine.
paras.zh: 然而，在乌克兰预计将迎来一个严冬之前，俄罗斯对其他城市的导弹袭击削弱了人们对停火可能会在战争中取得更广泛进展的感觉。

paras.en: Some Ukrainians in the city were also worried about where they would end up after being evacuated.
paras.zh: 该市的一些乌克兰人也担心他们被疏散后最终会去往何处。

paras.en: Though Oleshky is just across the Dnieper River from Ukrainian-held Kherson, the planned escape route to Ukrainian-controlled territory runs through Russia and its ally Belarus. Some residents told Sky News they feared they would not be allowed to continue into Ukraine, leaving them weighing whether to board the buses or remain in the devastated city.
paras.zh: 尽管奥列什基与乌克兰控制的赫尔松仅隔第聂伯河相望，但计划中的逃往乌克兰控制领土的路线将经过俄罗斯及其盟友白俄罗斯。一些居民告诉天空新闻，他们担心自己将不被允许继续进入乌克兰，这让他们权衡是登上公共汽车还是留在这座被摧毁的城市。

paras.en: Designated routes into the city had been cleared of mines. A convoy of 25 buses with a total capacity of 750 passengers, along with nine ambulances and more than 50 medical professionals, had been prepared to help residents leave, according to Russia’s human rights commissioner, Yana Lantratova.
paras.zh: 进城指定路线上的地雷已被清除。俄罗斯人权专员亚娜·兰特拉托娃 (Yana Lantratova) 表示，一支由 25 辆公共汽车组成的车队，总载客量为 750 名乘客，加上 9 辆救护车和 50 多名医疗专业人员，已准备好帮助居民离开。

paras.en: “People who wish to leave for the territory of the Russian federation are gathering here,” Lantratova said in a video from the city posted Friday. “Over there are also people who wish to leave for the territory of Ukraine. Everyone will be given the opportunity to do so. People are gradually boarding the buses.”
paras.zh: 兰特拉托娃在周五发布的该市视频中说：“希望前往俄罗斯联邦领土的人们正在聚集在这里。” “那边也有人希望前往乌克兰境内。每个人都有机会这样做。人们正在逐渐登上巴士。”

paras.en: Ukrainian representatives also said they were on the ground.
paras.zh: 乌克兰代表也表示他们已在现场。

paras.en: “We are in Oleshky!” Ukraine’s human rights ombudsman, Dmytro Lubinets, said in a statement, adding that the ceasefire had now lasted more than 80 hours. “I am now speaking with local residents on the ground to hear about their needs and to understand what help they need most.”
paras.zh: “我们在奥列什基！”乌克兰人权监察员德米特罗·鲁比内茨 (Dmytro Lubinets) 在一份声明中表示，并补充说停火现已持续了 80 多个小时。 “我现在正在与当地居民交谈，了解他们的需求并了解他们最需要什么帮助。”

paras.en: Kyrylo Budanov, head of President Volodymyr Zelenskyy’s office, said in a statement that it was “an important operation, and it must be continued. For Ukraine, the life of every citizen matters. We keep working.”
paras.zh: 总统办公室主任凯里洛·布达诺夫在一份声明中表示，这是“一项重要行动，必须继续下去。对于乌克兰来说，每个公民的生命都很重要。我们将继续努力。”

paras.en: Russian forces seized Oleshky in the early stages of the 2022 invasion and fighting has devastated the city since. The dominance of drone warfare in this conflict makes aboveground travel extremely dangerous, and services and supplies have deteriorated sharply since May.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯军队在 2022 年入侵初期占领了奥列什基，此后战斗一直摧毁了这座城市。无人机战争在这场冲突中占据主导地位，使得地面旅行变得极其危险，自 5 月份以来，服务和供应急剧恶化。

paras.en: Oleshky’s pre-invasion population of more than 20,000 has dwindled to an estimated 2,000, with those left behind surviving on tiny amounts of grain and edible weeds.
paras.zh: 奥列什基在入侵前的人口超过 20,000 人，现已减少至约 2,000 人，留下来的人靠少量谷物和可食用杂草为生。

paras.en: This perilous situation caught the attention of Leo, who called Russian President Vladimir Putin on Oct. 16 to express his “deep concern” and urge a pause in fighting to allow evacuations and aid deliveries.
paras.zh: 这种危险的局势引起了利奥的注意，他于 10 月 16 日致电俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京，表达了他的“深切关注”，并敦促暂停战斗，以便疏散和运送援助物资。

paras.en: The first lady’s office said she learned of the city’s plight during a United Nations gathering in September and used contacts developed through her efforts to reunite Ukrainian children with their families to help broker the truce. Both sides have praised her contribution.
paras.zh: 第一夫人办公室表示，她在九月份的一次联合国会议上了解到了该市的困境，并利用自己努力让乌克兰儿童与家人团聚所建立的人脉来帮助促成停战。双方都对她的贡献表示赞赏。

paras.en: The ceasefire was announced Oct. 23 and took effect Tuesday. It is due to expire at 10:59 p.m. Sunday, Kyiv time (3:59 p.m. ET).
paras.zh: 停火于 10 月 23 日宣布，并于周二生效。它将于晚上 10:59 到期。基辅时间星期日（东部时间下午 3:59）。

paras.en: Asked if the truce could be used as a blueprint for ceasefires in other locations, Putin’s spokesman Dmitry Peskov told journalists Monday that “for humanitarian purposes — it absolutely could.”
paras.zh: 当被问及停战协议是否可以作为其他地点停火的蓝图时，普京的发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫周一告诉记者，“出于人道主义目的，这绝对可以”。

paras.en: That was “especially given the direct, highly positive, and coordinating involvement of the American side — American negotiators and U.S. first lady Melania Trump — in this process,” he added. “We greatly value these efforts, and, certainly, this could set a precedent.”
paras.zh: 他补充说，“特别是考虑到美方——美国谈判代表和美国第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普——在这一过程中的直接、高度积极和协调的参与。” “我们非常重视这些努力，当然，这可以开创先例。”

paras.en: Outside this relative pocket of calm, however, the war ground on.
paras.zh: 然而，在这片相对平静的区域之外，战争仍在继续。

paras.en: Ukraine’s air force said Russian strikes had hit 17 locations overnight, while its air defenses had shot down or suppressed 96 drones and three missiles.
paras.zh: 乌克兰空军表示，俄罗斯一夜之间袭击了 17 个地点，而其防空系统击落或压制了 96 架无人机和三枚导弹。

paras.en: Meanwhile, drone manufacturer Fire Point said Ukraine had used its FP-1 drones to strike the Novokuibyshevsk oil refinery in Russia’s Samara region. Ukrainian officials have not commented.
paras.zh: 与此同时，无人机制造商Fire Point表示，乌克兰使用其FP-1无人机袭击了俄罗斯萨马拉地区的新伊比雪夫斯克炼油厂。乌克兰官员尚未发表评论。

articles.title: ExxonMobil and Chevron report blowout profits as Trump touts benefits of high oil prices
articles.author: Steve Kopack

paras.en: The two largest U.S. oil companies, ExxonMobil and Chevron, on Friday reported blowout profits that easily beat expectations as oil prices remain sharply elevated because of the U.S. war with Iran.
paras.zh: 美国最大的两家石油公司埃克森美孚和雪佛龙周五公布的井喷利润轻松超出预期，因美国与伊朗的战争导致油价持续大幅上涨。

paras.en: ExxonMobil reported a profit that doubled from the same period last year, while Chevron’s earnings surged more than 180% from a year earlier.
paras.zh: 埃克森美孚公布的利润较去年同期翻了一番，而雪佛龙的盈利较去年同期飙升超过180%。

paras.en: As part of the bumper returns, Exxon said it was increasing the dividend it pays to investors.
paras.zh: 作为丰厚回报的一部分，埃克森美孚表示正在增加向投资者支付的股息。

paras.en: The returns at both companies came as the price of oil surged beyond $100 per barrel and has remained there for months. On Friday, prices accelerated again, with Brent oil trading just under $118 per barrel.
paras.zh: 两家公司的回报都是在石油价格飙升至每桶 100 美元以上并持续数月之际实现的。周五，价格再次上涨，布伦特原油交易价格略低于每桶 118 美元。

paras.en: The highest level that Brent reached since the United States and Israel launched the Iran war in late February was $126, which it is now approaching again.
paras.zh: 布伦特原油价格自2月底美国和以色列发动伊朗战争以来达到的最高水平为126美元，目前正在再次逼近该水平。

paras.en: Since the start of the year, Exxon shares have risen 52%, and Chevron shares have returned 50%.
paras.zh: 自今年年初以来，埃克森美孚股价上涨了 52%，雪佛龙股价上涨了 50%。

paras.en: Overnight, another major oil company, BP, reported that its profit skyrocketed to an 18-year high.
paras.zh: 一夜之间，另一家大型石油公司英国石油公司(BP)报告称，其利润飙升至18年来的新高。

paras.en: The average price of regular gasoline has soared 40% for consumers since the war broke out. Soaring prices continue to pressure consumers ahead of the midterm elections, where voters have repeatedly said that prices and inflation are primary concerns.
paras.zh: 自战争爆发以来，消费者的普通汽油平均价格已飙升 40%。中期选举前，价格飙升继续给消费者带来压力，选民一再表示价格和通胀是主要担忧。

paras.en: In 2024, Donald Trump repeatedly pledged to drive energy costs down. “My plan will cut energy prices in half or more than that within 12 months of taking office,” the then-candidate said in September 2024, while adding that it would mean “gasoline below $2 a gallon.”
paras.zh: 2024 年，唐纳德·特朗普多次承诺降低能源成本。这位当时的候选人在 2024 年 9 月表示：“我的计划将在上任后 12 个月内将能源价格降低一半或以上。”他同时补充说，这意味着“汽油价格将低于每加仑 2 美元”。

paras.en: As of Friday, the average gasoline price is currently more than double that.
paras.zh: 截至周五，平均汽油价格目前是该价格的两倍多。

paras.en: In recent rallies on the campaign trail, the president has celebrated the higher oil and gas profits. “I wonder if I should say this,” Trump mused aloud during a rally Oct. 24, before saying “our country is making hundreds of billions of dollars because of what’s happened in the Middle East.”
paras.zh: 在最近的竞选集会上，总统庆祝了石油和天然气利润的提高。 “我不知道我是否应该这么说，”特朗普在 10 月 24 日的一次集会上沉思道，然后说道，“由于中东发生的事情，我们的国家正在赚取数千亿美元。”

paras.en: Trump touts U.S. oil business making ‘hundreds of billions’
paras.zh: 特朗普吹捧美国石油业创造“数千亿美元”

paras.en: “My people said, ‘Please don’t mention that, sir,’ because people are paying a little higher,” Trump continued. “But what we’ve done for this country, we’re making money like this country has never made before.”
paras.zh: “我的人民说，‘先生，请不要提这个，’因为人们付的钱要高一些，”特朗普继续说道。 “但我们为这个国家所做的一切，我们正在赚这个国家以前从未赚过的钱。”

paras.en: “I don’t give a damn: I’m going to say it. We’re making a freaking fortune.”
paras.zh: “我不在乎：我就这么说。我们正在赚大钱。”

paras.en: The higher prices are also a result of the war between Ukraine and Russia following President Vladimir Putin’s full-scale invasion of his neighbor in 2022.
paras.zh: 价格上涨也是俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京 (Vladimir Putin) 于 2022 年全面入侵其邻国后乌克兰和俄罗斯之间爆发战争的结果。

paras.en: “There’s a lot of disruption happening in the world,” ExxonMobil CEO Darren Woods told CNBC on Friday morning. “What you’re finding is because of the closure” in the Strait of Hormuz, “shipping has to find new routes around to continue to deliver the products that society desperately needs.”
paras.zh: 埃克森美孚首席执行官达伦·伍兹 (Darren Woods) 周五早上对 CNBC 表示：“世界上正在发生很多混乱。” “你会发现，由于霍尔木兹海峡的关闭，航运业必须寻找新的航线，才能继续提供社会迫切需要的产品。”

paras.en: “About half of Russia’s refinery capacity has been taken out from the Ukraine bombing,” he added.
paras.zh: “乌克兰爆炸事件导致俄罗斯大约一半的炼油能力被削减，”他补充道。

paras.en: “That shortage of refining capacity and availability to the world is what’s driving product prices as high as it is, and frankly, diesel is the key crunch point here because it is so critical to economic growth,” Woods continued.
paras.zh: “全球炼油能力和供应量的短缺是导致产品价格如此之高的原因，坦率地说，柴油是这里的关键关键点，因为它对经济增长至关重要，”伍兹继续说道。

paras.en: Since the start of the year, the average nationwide price for diesel fuel has risen 78%. New York-traded diesel futures have soared 130% since the start of the year, likely indicating more price rises could still come at the pump.
paras.zh: 今年以来，全国柴油平均价格上涨78%。自今年年初以来，纽约交易的柴油期货已飙升 130%，这可能表明油价仍可能进一步上涨。

paras.en: Both Exxon and Chevron said that they were running their refineries at maximum output to continue making as much diesel as possible.
paras.zh: 埃克森美孚和雪佛龙均表示，他们正在以最大产量运行炼油厂，以继续生产尽可能多的柴油。

paras.en: Trump has taken specific note of the impact that diesel could have on the economy. The administration has quickly issued multiple orders and policies in an attempt to bring prices down.
paras.zh: 特朗普特别注意到柴油可能对经济产生的影响。政府迅速发布了多项命令和政策，试图降低价格。

paras.en: The president signed an order allowing more widespread use of an off-road dyed variety of diesel, has pressured European allies to release more of the diesel reserves into the global market, and has announced a deal with Putin for some of that country’s diesel supplies.
paras.zh: 总统签署了一项命令，允许更广泛地使用越野染色柴油，向欧洲盟国施压，要求其向全球市场释放更多柴油储备，并宣布与普京就该国的部分柴油供应达成协议。

paras.en: Trump’s latest move came last week, when he announced $150 million in Defense Production Act funding to “expand petroleum production, storage, and logistics at refineries across.”
paras.zh: 特朗普的最新举措是在上周，当时他宣布为《国防生产法》拨款 1.5 亿美元，以“扩大炼油厂的石油生产、储存和物流”。

paras.en: The moves have not meaningfully brought prices down.
paras.zh: 这些举措并没有显着降低价格。

paras.en: On Friday, Woods said his refineries were already being pushed to the limit. “We are at record levels of utilization for our refineries,” he said on CNBC.
paras.zh: 周五，伍兹表示他的炼油厂已经达到极限。他在 CNBC 上表示：“我们炼油厂的利用率达到了创纪录的水平。”

paras.en: “If you look at North America, we produce record volumes of diesel. That’s all been a function of trying to drive more product into the marketplace to meet that demand and to drive costs down.”
paras.zh: “如果你看看北美，我们的柴油产量创历史新高。这都是努力将更多产品推向市场以满足需求并降低成本的结果。”

articles.title: Snowy 2.0 still has a place in a world of batteries
articles.author: Nathan Morris

paras.en: The origin story of Snowy 2.0 is a fitting metaphor for one of the most ambitious renewable energy projects in Australia's history.
paras.zh: Snowy 2.0 的起源故事是澳大利亚历史上最雄心勃勃的可再生能源项目之一的恰当比喻。

paras.en: "We had a couple of Snowy Hydro execs having a beer in the corner, and the plans for Snowy 2.0 were just drawn out on a coaster," the publican of the Alpine Hotel in Cooma told the ABC's Four Corners program in 2023.
paras.zh: “我们有几个 Snowy Hydro 高管在角落里喝啤酒，而 Snowy 2.0 的计划只是在过山车上制定的，”库马高山酒店的酒馆老板告诉 ABC 2023 年的“四个角落”节目。

paras.en: A recent major review of the project cited design immaturities and building complexities among the reasons for the $25 billion price tag, about 12 times the original cost.
paras.zh: 最近对该项目的一项重大审查指出，设计不成熟和建筑复杂是造价 250 亿美元（约为原始成本的 12 倍）的原因。

paras.en: "It was a political announcement at the time," said Stephanie Bashir, a former AGL Energy executive and now CEO of Nexa Energy.
paras.zh: “这在当时是一项政治声明，”AGL 能源公司前高管、现任 Nexa 能源公司首席执行官斯蒂芬妮·巴希尔 (Stephanie Bashir) 表示。

paras.en: "If they had just taken a bit more time at the start … but I mean, that's history now and we've got to keep moving on."
paras.zh: “如果他们一开始多花一点时间就好了……但我的意思是，这已经成为历史了，我们必须继续前进。”

paras.en: Batteries getting bigger, able to run longer
paras.zh: 电池越来越大，可以运行更长时间

paras.en: It was March 2017 when then-prime minister Malcolm Turnbull announced Snowy 2.0, during a heated national debate around climate and energy policy that would eventually factor in to his political downfall.
paras.zh: 2017 年 3 月，时任总理马尔科姆·特恩布尔在一场围绕气候和能源政策的激烈全国辩论中宣布了“雪域 2.0”，这最终导致了他的政治垮台。

paras.en: It came in the months after a freak storm in late 2016 sparked the infamous South Australia blackout, exposing the fragility of a grid transitioning to renewables.
paras.zh: 就在几个月前，2016 年底的一场反常风暴引发了臭名昭著的南澳大利亚大停电，暴露了电网向可再生能源过渡的脆弱性。

paras.en: At the time, big grid-scale batteries did not really exist. Remember when Elon Musk and Mike Cannon-Brookes made a bet on Twitter to build the world's biggest battery in South Australia in 100 days?
paras.zh: 当时，大型电网规模的电池并不真正存在。还记得埃隆·马斯克和迈克·坎农-布鲁克斯在 Twitter 上打赌要在 100 天内在南澳大利亚建造世界上最大的电池吗？

paras.en: Nearly 10 years on, the latest quarterly report from the Australian Energy Market Operator (AEMO) shows the contribution of big batteries to evening out power in Australia's biggest grid has more than doubled in a year, overtaking gas.
paras.zh: 近十年过去了，澳大利亚能源市场运营商 (AEMO) 的最新季度报告显示，大型电池对澳大利亚最大电网电力平衡的贡献在一年内增加了一倍多，超过了天然气。

paras.en: As a result, power prices in the last quarter fell to their lowest average since 2021.
paras.zh: 结果，上季度电价跌至2021年以来的平均最低水平。

paras.en: Centralised power in a decentralised grid
paras.zh: 分散电网中的集中电力

paras.en: Next to the Eraring, NSW coal-fired power station, which is set to close in 2029, Origin Energy is building a series of battery storage systems.
paras.zh: 在新南威尔士州埃拉林燃煤发电站（预计将于 2029 年关闭）旁边，Origin Energy 正在建设一系列电池存储系统。

paras.en: The latest is flagged to have 500 megawatts of capacity with the ability to supply power for eight hours — enough storage to run hundreds of thousands of homes.
paras.zh: 最新的标称容量为 500 兆瓦，能够供电 8 小时——足够存储数十万个家庭的电力。

paras.en: AEMO has approved 3.6 gigawatts in battery projects, which will come online between 2028-29, about the same time Snowy 2.0 is set to be finished.
paras.zh: AEMO 已批准 3.6 吉瓦的电池项目，该项目将于 2028-29 年间上线，大约在同一时间 Snowy 2.0 也将完成。

paras.en: By then, rooftop solar and household batteries will be even more common. Apartment dwellers will soon be able to hang solar panels off their balconies and plug portable, esky-sized batteries into the wall.
paras.zh: 届时，屋顶太阳能和家用电池将更加普遍。公寓居民很快就能将太阳能电池板挂在阳台上，并将便携式、天空大小的电池插入墙上。

paras.en: Trials are also underway to plug electric cars into the home and connect them to the grid.
paras.zh: 将电动汽车插入家中并将其连接到电网的试验也在进行中。

paras.en: "We had centralised energy, and we're moving to more decentralised energy," Ms Bashir said
paras.zh: 巴希尔女士说：“我们拥有集中式能源，我们正在转向更加分散的能源。”

paras.en: "Wind farms, solar farms, batteries, they can be located anywhere."
paras.zh: “风力发电场、太阳能发电场、电池，它们可以位于任何地方。”

paras.en: The relevant number with Snowy 2.0 is the one with the 'h' in it. It stands for hours.
paras.zh: Snowy 2.0 的相关数字是其中带有“h”的数字。它代表几个小时。

paras.en: Gigawatts (GW) measure how much power can be delivered at once. Gigawatt-hours (GWh) tell us how much energy is available to be delivered over time.
paras.zh: 吉瓦 (GW) 衡量的是一次可以输送多少电力。吉瓦时 (GWh) 告诉我们随着时间的推移可以输送多少能量。

paras.en: Snowy 2.0 has a generating capacity of 2.2GW, and the water stored in its reservoir provides 350GWh of energy storage, according to Snowy Hydro.
paras.zh: 据Snowy Hydro称，Snowy 2.0的发电量为2.2GW，其水库中储存的水可提供350GWh的能量存储。

paras.en: So while Origin might be building a battery that can run for about eight hours, Snowy 2.0 can run for about 160 hours — or as its promotional material suggests, about long enough to power 3 million homes for a week.
paras.zh: 因此，虽然 Origin 可能正在制造可运行约 8 小时的电池，但 Snowy 2.0 可以运行约 160 小时——或者正如其宣传材料所暗示的那样，大约足以为 300 万个家庭供电一周。

paras.en: "We have so many batteries being installed, but it still adds up to being about kind of 30 gigawatt hours," professor Marnie Shaw, an energy infrastructure expert from Australian National University, said.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚国立大学能源基础设施专家 Marnie Shaw 教授表示：“我们安装了如此多的电池，但加起来仍然约为 30 吉瓦时。”

paras.en: "It's really only one 10th of the size of Snowy 2.0 in terms of gigawatt hours."
paras.zh: “就千兆瓦时而言，它实际上只有 Snowy 2.0 的十分之一。”

paras.en: AEMO's energy road map to 2050 says Australia needs about 650GWh of dispatchable storage, and with its 350GWh, Dr Shaw said Snowy 2.0 made up more than half of that.
paras.zh: AEMO 到 2050 年的能源路线图显示，澳大利亚需要约 650GWh 的可调度存储，Shaw 博士表示，Snowy 2.0 的容量为 350GWh，其中一半以上。

paras.en: "So the majority of our energy, our long-term energy storage in the future, is being supplied by Snowy 2.0," she said.
paras.zh: “所以我们的大部分能源，我们未来的长期能源储存，都是由 Snowy 2.0 提供的，”她说。

paras.en: But Bruce Mountain from Victoria University has long questioned how useful that capacity would be in practice.
paras.zh: 但维多利亚大学的布鲁斯·山长期以来一直质疑这种能力在实践中有多大用处。

paras.en: "The top reservoir does not have a water supply of its own," Dr Mountain told the ABC's Business Daily this week.
paras.zh: “顶部水库没有自己的供水系统，”芒特博士本周告诉美国广播公司商业日报。

paras.en: "The problem is you need to pump the water up to the upper dam, which means you need to have the water available in a lower dam, which only gets some water from a river."
paras.zh: “问题是你需要将水抽到上层大坝，这意味着你需要从下层大坝获得水，而下层大坝只能从河流中获取一些水。”

paras.en: "This fantastic ability to run flat out for a week is a service that is simply not practically usable because once you've done that, you've spent your resource."
paras.zh: “这种连续运行一周的出色能力是一项实际上无法使用的服务，因为一旦你这样做了，你就已经耗尽了你的资源。”

paras.en: There are also questions about how often Snowy 2.0's enormous storage capacity will be needed, according to associate professor Roger Dargaville, an energy systems and storage expert from Monash University.
paras.zh: 莫纳什大学能源系统和存储专家副教授罗杰·达格维尔 (Roger Dargaville) 表示，还存在关于 Snowy 2.0 的巨大存储容量多久需要一次的问题。

paras.en: "The idea that you would need to run the Snowy 2.0 for two weeks continuously, it's not very likely that would actually eventuate," he said.
paras.zh: “需要连续运行 Snowy 2.0 两周的想法，实际上不太可能实现，”他说。

paras.en: "It's nice to have as an insurance policy in case."
paras.zh: “作为保险单以防万一真是太好了。”

paras.en: But Snowy 2.0 does have an advantage because achieving the same amount of deep storage with batteries is much more expensive.
paras.zh: 但 Snowy 2.0 确实有一个优势，因为用电池实现相同数量的深度存储的成本要高得多。

paras.en: "The difference for pumped hydro is to have more hours of storage, you just make the reservoir bigger, which is only a small component of the total system," Dr Dargaville said.
paras.zh: 达格维尔博士说：“抽水蓄能的区别在于有更多的存储时间，你只需将水库做得更大，这只是整个系统的一小部分。”

paras.en: "Whereas for batteries, if you want to double the storage, it is doubling the cost."
paras.zh: “而对于电池来说，如果你想将存储容量增加一倍，成本就会增加一倍。”

paras.en: Snowy 2.0's cost blowout will continue to be a focus for critics, and nobody could have foreseen how fundamentally the energy landscape in Australia would change in just 10 years.
paras.zh: Snowy 2.0的成本井喷将继续成为批评者关注的焦点，没有人能够预见到澳大利亚的能源格局在短短10年内会发生多么根本的变化。

paras.en: "At $24 or $25 billion, we're starting to question whether it makes sense anymore," Dr Dargaville said.
paras.zh: “在 24 或 250 亿美元的情况下，我们开始质疑它是否还有意义，”达格维尔博士说。

paras.en: "And it's going to require really, really high volatility in the market for it to make its money back."
paras.zh: “而且市场需要非常非常高的波动才能收回资金。”

paras.en: But Snowy 2.0 is built to operate for 150 years, long after the talk of cost blowouts has faded.
paras.zh: 但 Snowy 2.0 的设计寿命是 150 年，而这距离成本井喷的传闻已经淡去很久了。

paras.en: "There will always be volatility in the market in a renewable energy system, and storage will always be useful," Dr Dargaville said.
paras.zh: 达格维尔博士说：“可再生能源系统的市场总是会出现波动，而存储总是有用的。”

paras.en: Ms Bashir said the lesson from Snowy 2.0 was that long-duration storage was needed in the energy grid, but future pumped hydro projects might be smaller and more modular.
paras.zh: 巴希尔女士表示，Snowy 2.0的教训是，能源网需要长期存储，但未来的抽水蓄能项目可能会更小、更模块化。

paras.en: "You can have pumped hydro projects that are actually much smaller, and they can be located much easier and built much faster and therefore at a lower cost," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“你可以拥有实际上小得多的抽水蓄能项目，而且它们的定位更容易，建造速度更快，因此成本更低。”

paras.en: "We're so used to big builds, and we're used to centralised energy.
paras.zh: “我们已经习惯了大型建筑，也习惯了集中能源。

paras.en: "We need to be thinking in the way that technology is going, which is smaller, flexible, and can be located in a distributed way rather than in a centralised way."
paras.zh: “我们需要以技术的发展方式来思考，这种方式更小、更灵活，并且可以以分布式方式而不是集中式方式定位。”

articles.title: Students use 'rage bait' and AI bots to sway fictional election
articles.author: Cam Wilson

paras.en: Computer engineering student Kaira Dumasia has an unusual university assignment — using AI bots to interfere in an election.
paras.zh: 计算机工程专业的学生凯拉·杜马西亚（ Kaira Dumasia ）有一个不寻常的大学任务--使用人工智能机器人干涉选举。

paras.en: "I am really going to try to rage bait everybody," she said.
paras.zh: “我真的会尝试用愤怒来引诱每个人，”她说。

paras.en: Fortunately for democracy, the election — and the voters she hopes to influence — are not real.
paras.zh: 对于民主来说幸运的是，选举——以及她希望影响的选民——并不是真实的。

paras.en: Kaira is part of a competition led by researchers at the University of New South Wales, which pits teams against one another to manipulate social media to win a simulated vote.
paras.zh: Kaira 是新南威尔士大学研究人员领导的一项竞赛的一部分，该竞赛让各团队相互竞争，操纵社交媒体来赢得模拟投票。

paras.en: They're allowed to build AI bots to post, like, share and reply on a made-up social media platform. Points are awarded for grabbing attention, changing voters' views and spotting rival teams' bots.
paras.zh: 他们可以构建人工智能机器人，在虚构的社交媒体平台上发帖、点赞、分享和回复。吸引注意力、改变选民观点和发现对手团队的机器人即可获得积分。

paras.en: The aim is to help students understand how AI can conduct in-authentic behaviour online by experimenting with controlling it themselves.
paras.zh: 目的是帮助学生通过自行控制实验来了解人工智能如何在网上进行不真实的行为。

paras.en: UNSW computer science senior lecturer, Hammond Pearce, said it helped students recognise the signs of manipulation, and functioned as a Petri dish for academics hoping to study AI electoral interference.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士大学计算机科学高级讲师哈蒙德·皮尔斯表示，它帮助学生识别操纵的迹象，并为希望研究人工智能选举干扰的学者充当培养皿。

paras.en: "We're trying to expose that tech… to students in a safe environment so they can learn both what the attackers are doing by doing it themselves and also what the defenders need to do in order to try and catch that kind of attack," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我们正试图在安全的环境中向学生展示这项技术，以便他们能够通过自己的操作来了解攻击者在做什么，以及防御者需要做什么才能尝试捕捉这种攻击。”

paras.en: This year, the competition is set in Kingstonia, a fictional island nation that is having a referendum on whether proof of vaccination against dolphin flu should be required to enter public spaces.
paras.zh: 今年的比赛在金斯顿尼亚举行，金斯顿是一个虚构的岛国，该国正在就是否需要提供海豚流感疫苗接种证明才能进入公共场所进行全民投票。

paras.en: Teams campaign for their chosen side on a platform called Legit Social. The AI-powered citizens read posts, interact and change their views over the month-long competition.
paras.zh: 球队在一个名为“Legit Social”的平台上为自己选择的球队进行竞选活动。在为期一个月的比赛中，人工智能支持的公民阅读帖子、互动并改变他们的观点。

paras.en: Kaira's strategy has been inspired by real life. Her plan is to make people angry enough to comment, boosting her posts and earning more points.
paras.zh: 凯拉的策略受到现实生活的启发。她的计划是让人们愤怒地发表评论，提高她的帖子并获得更多积分。

paras.en: "I see a lot of it is rage bait content, engagement bait content,"
paras.zh: “我看到很多都是愤怒诱饵内容、订婚诱饵内容，”

paras.en: But there is a countervailing force: rival teams can report posts they suspect have been sent by other bots, and not simulated citizens.
paras.zh: 但存在一种抵消力量：竞争对手团队可以报告他们怀疑是由其他机器人而不是模拟公民发送的帖子。

paras.en: Correctly identifying this AI bot activity also earns points for a team.
paras.zh: 正确识别此人工智能机器人活动也可为团队赢得积分。

paras.en: Dr Pearce said they built Legit Social specifically for the competition to have a safe place to practise their manipulation and detection skills under the watchful eyes of the organisers.
paras.zh: 皮尔斯博士说，他们专门为比赛建立了合法社交网站，以便在组织者的监视下有一个安全的地方来练习他们的操纵和检测技能。

paras.en: The fictional vote is taking place in the lead-up to the US midterm elections and shortly after Australia's election watchdog warned about AI's role in amplifying existing election integrity threats.
paras.zh: 这次虚构的投票发生在美国中期选举前夕，澳大利亚选举监管机构就人工智能在放大现有选举诚信威胁方面所发挥的作用发出警告后不久。

paras.en: Earlier this month, Australian Electoral Commissioner Jeff Pope told parliament's joint committee inquiry into AI that includes misinformation, influence operations and foreign interference, as well as physical security risks through harassment and impacts on social cohesion.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，澳大利亚选举专员杰夫·波普告诉议会联合委员会对人工智能的调查，其中包括错误信息、影响力操作和外国干涉，以及骚扰和对社会凝聚力影响带来的人身安全风险。

paras.en: Researchers also use the game to study how participants build AI bot networks and identify other bot activity.
paras.zh: 研究人员还利用该游戏来研究参与者如何构建人工智能机器人网络并识别其他机器人活动。

paras.en: A preliminary academic paper published online about last year's competition examined the techniques used by competitors to win.
paras.zh: 网上发表的一篇关于去年比赛的初步学术论文研究了参赛者获胜所使用的技巧。

paras.en: It found some participants turned to high-volume posting because the scoring rewarded engagement.
paras.zh: 研究发现，一些参与者转向大量发帖，因为评分可以奖励参与度。

paras.en: Kaira, who was a moderator in last year's competition, said the competition helped her recognise more AI-generated, bot-like posts.
paras.zh: 凯拉是去年比赛的主持人，她表示比赛帮助她认识了更多由人工智能生成的、类似机器人的帖子。

paras.en: She also recognises how easily attention-grabbing content can work on her.
paras.zh: 她还认识到，吸引注意力的内容很容易对她产生影响。

paras.en: "Yes, my strategy does come from a lot of posts that I see on social media. And I often find myself falling to rage bait and then I'm like, whoa, take a step back."
paras.zh: “是的，我的策略确实来自我在社交媒体上看到的很多帖子。我经常发现自己陷入了愤怒的陷阱，然后我想，哇，退一步。”

articles.title: Politics is an image game, and the government needs to find better visuals
articles.author: Jacob Greber

paras.en: Politics at its most visceral is visual, which is why governments and oppositions spend so much time crafting the perfect image. Burnishing and beavering away to dispel the dismal, disguise the dishonest and nudge the narrative.
paras.zh: 政治最本质的是视觉，这就是为什么政府和反对派花费大量时间来打造完美形象的原因。打磨和努力消除阴郁、掩饰不诚实并推动叙事。

paras.en: When it gets really fun is when the unexpected happens. Like a purposeful set-up that backfires, embarrassing the participants. Awks, as the kids might say.
paras.zh: 当意外发生时，事情才真正变得有趣。就像一个有目的的设置却适得其反，让参与者感到尴尬。正如孩子们可能会说的那样，awks。

paras.en: There have been many examples over the years, but there was something in the air this week that rekindled memories of a 2015 photograph of then-prime minister Tony Abbott and his treasurer, Joe Hockey.
paras.zh: 多年来这样的例子有很多，但本周空气中弥漫着某种东西，让人们重新回忆起 2015 年时任总理托尼·阿博特 (Tony Abbott) 和他的财务主管乔·霍基 (Joe Hockey) 的一张照片。

paras.en: Taken in the prime minister's office on the eve of that year's budget, the photograph captured the two men side-by-side. Abbott leans to his left and puts a pastoral hand on Hockey's bare forearm.
paras.zh: 这张照片是当年预算公布前夕在总理办公室拍摄的，照片中两人并肩而立。阿博特向左侧倾斜，将一只田园般的手放在霍奇裸露的前臂上。

paras.en: Hockey looks miserable. Forlorn. Like a man beaten. Which it turned out he was. As was Abbott.
paras.zh: 曲棍球看起来很惨。绝望。就像一个被殴打的人。事实证明他就是这样。雅培也是如此。

paras.en: The photo was taken 12 months after what was regarded at the time as one of the least popular budgets in history: the notorious 2014 edition with all its broken-promise spending cuts.
paras.zh: 这张照片是在当时被认为是历史上最不受欢迎的预算案之一之后 12 个月拍摄的：臭名昭著的 2014 年预算案，其所有的支出削减都没有兑现。

paras.en: A year later, still in its first term but with an eye on the coming election in 2016, the Coalition released its second budget at a time of deep poll trouble.
paras.zh: 一年后，联盟党仍处于第一任期，但着眼于即将到来的 2016 年大选，在民意调查陷入严重困境之际发布了第二份预算。

paras.en: Hemmed in by the Senate and a popular backlash against the cuts, a politically battered and bruised Hockey was forced to shelve his ambitions for big reform that began when he declared an end to the "age of entitlement".
paras.zh: 由于受到参议院的围堵和民众对削减开支的强烈反对，在政治上饱受打击和伤痕累累的曲奇被迫搁置了他宣布结束“权利时代”时开始的大规模改革雄心。

paras.en: Instead, his second budget was a plodding affair full of cash handouts that spent almost every dollar saved. It was panned by the economic commentariat as a do-little effort that left the country drifting sideways.
paras.zh: 相反，他的第二份预算是一项充满现金发放的缓慢工作，几乎花光了节省下来的每一块钱。经济评论人士批评此举是徒劳无功，导致国家陷入困境。

paras.en: Having Abbott sit with Hockey was intended to demonstrate unity and resolve. Instead, it produced snickering.
paras.zh: 让阿博特和曲棍球坐在一起的目的是为了展示团结和决心。相反，它产生了窃笑。

paras.en: Four months later, almost to the day, both men were out of their jobs, rolled by Malcolm Turnbull who cited the fact Abbott had lost 30 straight NewsPolls to Labor.
paras.zh: 四个月后，几乎到了这一天，马尔科姆·特恩布尔（Malcolm Turnbull）宣布两人都失业了，他引用了阿博特在新闻民意调查中连续 30 次输给工党的事实。

paras.en: Towards the end of Question Time on Wednesday — a day of bleak news on the economy, with rising inflation and interest rate worries — the prime minister got a question from the opposition about when he plans to replace Jim Chalmers with cabinet secretary Andrew Charlton.
paras.zh: 周三的提问时间快结束时——这一天经济消息黯淡，通货膨胀和利率担忧加剧——首相收到反对派的提问，询问他计划何时用内阁秘书安德鲁·查尔顿取代吉姆·查尔默斯。

paras.en: The question was a political shit stir, designed to highlight the bad blood between the prime minister and treasurer.
paras.zh: 这个问题是一场政治骚乱，旨在凸显总理和财政部长之间的不和。

paras.en: Albanese used his answer to pump up the treasurer, who has made no secret in recent weeks of his frustration at being seen as the locus of blame for everything wrong with the government.
paras.zh: 阿尔巴尼斯用他的回答来鼓舞财政部长，最近几周，财政部长毫不掩饰自己的沮丧，因为他被视为政府所有问题的罪魁祸首。

paras.en: "This treasurer produced back-to-back surpluses," the prime minister began, before laying it on thick.
paras.zh: “这位财务主管连续实现了盈余，”总理开始说道，然后又详细阐述了这一点。

paras.en: "This treasurer returned 75 per cent of revenue upgrades to the bottom line. He's one of only nine treasurers of finance ministers around the world to have a AAA credit rating from all of the agencies."
paras.zh: “这位财务主管将 75% 的收入升级恢复到了底线。他是全球仅有的九位财政部长财务主管中获得所有机构 AAA 信用评级的人之一。”

paras.en: As he sat listening, Chalmers had the air of a man who wasn't entirely over the moon about the praise. How helpful it was, given tensions in the air, is debatable.
paras.zh: 查尔默斯坐在那儿听着，脸上的表情似乎并没有因为这些赞美而欣喜若狂。考虑到空气中的紧张气氛，它有多大帮助是值得商榷的。

paras.en: It certainly reminded those who saw it of the pressure Chalmers is under, which is looking more and more like an uncontrolled pile-on.
paras.zh: 这无疑让那些看到它的人想起了查尔默斯所承受的压力，这种压力看起来越来越像不受控制的堆积。

paras.en: The risk when prime ministers have to defend their treasurers in a performative manner is that it sets tongues wagging.
paras.zh: 当首相们不得不以表演性的方式为财长辩护时，存在的风险是会引发议论。

paras.en: Why now? What's the goal? Who is he trying to convince?
paras.zh: 为什么是现在？目标是什么？他想说服谁？

paras.en: "If Jim could have flipped Albanese the bird in the middle of it, he would have," said one Labor observer.
paras.zh: 一位工党观察员表示：“如果吉姆能够将阿尔巴内斯的那只鸟翻转到中间，他就会这么做。”

paras.en: A cynical interpretation is that the prime minister was also reminding the public that it's the treasurer who owns the government's economic story.
paras.zh: 一种愤世嫉俗的解释是，总理还提醒公众，掌握政府经济故事的是财政部长。

paras.en: Which — as Donald Trump once said of an ill-fated US ambassador to Ukraine — is "going to go through some things".
paras.zh: 正如唐纳德·特朗普曾经对一位命运多舛的美国驻乌克兰大使所说的那样，这“将经历一些事情”。

paras.en: Next week will almost certainly be brutal for the government, given the likelihood of another Reserve Bank rate hike on Tuesday, the fifth this year.
paras.zh: 考虑到周二储备银行可能再次加息（今年第五次），下周对政府来说几乎肯定是残酷的。

paras.en: The prime minister will be in the Caribbean for a Commonwealth Heads Of Government Meeting (CHOGM), leaving Chalmers to face the music.
paras.zh: 总理将前往加勒比海地区参加英联邦政府首脑会议（CHOGM），查尔默斯将面临困境。

paras.en: Like a rogue wave bouncing off a seawall, a story then appeared on Friday in the Sydney Morning Herald citing "government sources", suggesting Chalmers is a victim rather than villain of the government's deteriorating economic story.
paras.zh: 就像汹涌的海浪从海堤上反弹一样，《悉尼先驱晨报》周五刊登了一篇援引“政府消息来源”的报道，暗示查尔默斯是政府不断恶化的经济故事的受害者，而不是恶棍。

paras.en: The Herald quoted people saying that Chalmers' push for spending discipline was obstructed by the prime minister's razor gang in the lead-up to the May budget. And that his heroic fiscal rectitude was undermined by the prime minister's inner cabal of spendy left-faction ministers, led by Katie Gallagher, Mark Butler, Penny Wong and Tim Ayres.
paras.zh: 《先驱报》援引知情人士的话称，查尔默斯推动支出纪律的努力在五月预算出台前遭到了总理的剃刀团伙的阻挠。他英勇的财政正直遭到了以凯蒂·加拉格尔（Katie Gallagher）、马克·巴特勒（Mark Butler）、黄英贤（Penny Wong）和蒂姆·艾尔斯（Tim Ayres）为首的总理内部挥金如土的左派部长阴谋集团的破坏。

paras.en: Alarmingly for the government more broadly, it hints at a shift in the underlying ecosystem of the government. It is far from irretrievable or terminal — and old hands speak of the current tensions as nothing compared to the Gillard-Rudd years. But the change is noticeable.
paras.zh: 对于更广泛的政府来说，令人震惊的是，它暗示着政府底层生态系统的转变。它远非不可挽回或终结——老专家们都说，当前的紧张局势与吉拉德-陆克文时代相比根本不算什么。但变化是显而易见的。

paras.en: People are getting jittery, looking sideways. The easy confidence of key figures in the government is dwindling.
paras.zh: 人们变得紧张不安，纷纷侧目。关键人物对政府的信心正在减弱。

paras.en: This week — like workers returning to the office on a Monday to discover the fridge stopped working over the weekend — drove home the sense that things that used to be certain have gone off.
paras.zh: 这周——就像工人们周一回到办公室，发现冰箱在周末停止工作一样——让人们感觉到过去确定的事情已经消失了。

paras.en: Next to the soured milk sits the slightly whiffy items of the government's thus-far successful operating model — like the notion that cabinet stability is an unquestionable virtue. The government is in its fifth year, and many ministers have been in their portfolios since 2019.
paras.zh: 在酸奶旁边坐着政府迄今为止成功的运营模式中略带气味的项目—就像内阁稳定性是一种毫无疑问的美德。政府已经进入第五个年头，许多部长自2019年以来一直担任部长职务。

paras.en: As this columnist noted in February, some of Labor's frontbench is starting to look tired.
paras.zh: 正如这位专栏作家在二月份指出的那样，工党的一些前座议员开始显得疲惫不堪。

paras.en: Nearly eight months on and that hasn't changed. Too many are carrying baggage. Punters have tired of them. Their lines resonate a little less each day.
paras.zh: 近八个月过去了，这一点没有改变。太多人带着行李。投注者已经厌倦了它们。他们的台词引起的共鸣一天比一天少。

paras.en: One view is that it's also strange that Labor is not making opportunities for its next generation of leaders. The backbench is full of talent, some of whom are reduced to nodding for the Question Time camera.
paras.zh: 一种观点认为，工党没有为其下一代领导人创造机会也很奇怪。后座议员才华横溢，其中一些人只能对着提问时间点头点头。

paras.en: Another souring reality is that Labor can no longer blame the previous government for all of today's problems, even if that were true.
paras.zh: 另一个令人痛苦的现实是，工党不能再将当今的所有问题归咎于前任政府，即使这是事实。

paras.en: Finally, on the war against Iran, it's not clear voters are as forgiving of the consequences as they were in March, April and May, when the government scrambled to secure fuel supplies. Back then, voters blamed Donald Trump.
paras.zh: 最后，关于针对伊朗的战争，目前尚不清楚选民是否像三月、四月和五月那样宽容，当时政府忙于确保燃料供应。当时，选民指责唐纳德·特朗普。

paras.en: Today's mood — as reflected in the polls, social media comments and political observers — suggests voters are blaming the government for rising transport costs.
paras.zh: 今天的情绪——正如民意调查、社交媒体评论和政治观察家所反映的那样——表明选民将交通成本上涨归咎于政府。

paras.en: It might be time for some better visuals.
paras.zh: 也许是时候提供一些更好的视觉效果了。

paras.en: Jacob Greber is political editor of ABC's 7.30 program.
paras.zh: 雅各布·格雷伯 (Jacob Greber) 是美国广播公司 (ABC) 7.30 节目的政治编辑。

articles.title: Binance says $6.3B US hacked in what could be largest cryptocurrency theft ever

paras.en: Binance says $6.3B US hacked in what could be largest cryptocurrency theft ever
paras.zh: 币安称美国 6.3B 美元遭到黑客攻击，这可能是有史以来最大的加密货币盗窃案

paras.en: Binance says in new statement multiple 'points of breach' discovered
paras.zh: 币安在新声明中表示发现多个“违规点”

paras.en: A U.S.-based blockchain intelligence firm says a North Korean unit was likely behind the hack that impacted more than $6 billion US on Binance, the world's biggest cryptocurrency exchange.
paras.zh: 一家总部位于美国的区块链情报公司表示，朝鲜单位可能是此次黑客攻击的幕后黑手，这起全球最大的加密货币交易所币安遭受的损失超过 60 亿美元。

paras.en: Binance in a statement early Friday called it a "complex attack" and said it worked with blockchain partners to freeze roughly $3 billion US in affected assets. The company updated that figure to $5 billion US on Friday afternoon.
paras.zh: 币安在周五早些时候的一份声明中称这是一次“复杂的攻击”，并表示它与区块链合作伙伴合作冻结了大约 30 亿美元的受影响资产。该公司于周五下午将该数字更新为 50 亿美元。

paras.en: "Binance has begun recovering affected assets for users and continues to work with law enforcement, issuers, blockchain intelligence firms and industry partners to trace, freeze and recover additional funds," the company told CBC News in a statement.
paras.zh: 该公司在一份声明中告诉 CBC News，“币安已开始为用户追回受影响的资产，并继续与执法机构、发行人、区块链情报公司和行业合作伙伴合作，追踪、冻结和追回额外资金。”

paras.en: The cryptocurrency exchange said that deposits were unaffected, while withdrawals have been suspended and are expected to resume in the next day or two. It said it will cover all losses.
paras.zh: 该加密货币交易所表示，存款不受影响，而提款已暂停，预计将在未来一两天内恢复。它表示将弥补所有损失。

paras.en: The company said on X Friday that an initial investigation suggested the incident may have involved a compromised laptop, but that a subsequent investigation uncovered additional "points of breach."
paras.zh: 该公司于 X 周五表示，初步调查表明该事件可能涉及一台受损的笔记本电脑，但随后的调查发现了其他“违规点”。

paras.en: Blockchain analysis firm TRM, in a post on its website Thursday, attributed the attack to TraderTraitor, which it described as North Korea's elite hacking unit. "We make this judgment with high confidence," the firm said.
paras.zh: 区块链分析公司 TRM 周四在其网站上发布帖子，将此次攻击归咎于 TraderTraitor，并将其描述为朝鲜的精英黑客组织。该公司表示：“我们非常有信心地做出这一判断。”

paras.en: "An attacker moved approximately $6.36 billion US out of Binance wallets on 10 blockchains, most of it in about 20 minutes," TRM said.
paras.zh: TRM 表示：“攻击者从 10 个区块链上的币安钱包中转移了约 63.6 亿美元，其中大部分在大约 20 分钟内转移。”

paras.en: That would make the hack the largest cryptocurrency theft on record, it said.
paras.zh: 据称，这将使此次黑客攻击成为有记录以来最大的加密货币盗窃案。

paras.en: In February last year, another cryptocurrency exchange, Bybit, suffered a $1.5-billion hit when it was hacked. The FBI said North Korea and TraderTraitor were responsible for the hack.
paras.zh: 去年2月，另一家加密货币交易所Bybit遭受黑客攻击，损失15亿美元。美国联邦调查局 (FBI) 表示，朝鲜和 TraderTraitor 对此次黑客攻击负有责任。

paras.en: "Several features of this attack match earlier North Korea-linked heists, including the Bybit hack," TRM said.
paras.zh: TRM 表示：“这次攻击的几个特征与之前与朝鲜有关的抢劫事件相符，包括 Bybit 黑客攻击。”

paras.en: Blockchain analysis company Chainalysis also believed the Binance hack was "likely done by DPRK group TraderTraitor," its co-founder and CEO Jonathan Levin wrote on X. DPRK stands for the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, North Korea's official name.
paras.zh: 区块链分析公司 Chainaanalysis 的联合创始人兼首席执行官 Jonathan Levin 在 X 上写道，币安的黑客攻击“很可能是由 DPRK 组织 TraderTraitor 所为”。DPRK 代表朝鲜民主主义人民共和国，这是朝鲜的官方名称。

paras.en: Asked about the potential ties to North Korea, a Binance spokesperson said only that the company is "working closely with our law enforcement partners to confirm the identity of the criminals and bring them to justice."
paras.zh: 当被问及与朝鲜的潜在联系时，币安发言人仅表示，该公司正在“与我们的执法合作伙伴密切合作，以确认犯罪分子的身份并将他们绳之以法”。

paras.en: Experts say North Korea has turned to crypto-hacking and other illicit cyberactivities as a source of badly needed foreign currency to support its troubled economy and fund its nuclear program in the wake of tough UN sanctions and other difficulties.
paras.zh: 专家表示，在联合国严厉制裁和其他困难之后，朝鲜已转向加密货币黑客和其他非法网络活动作为急需的外汇来源，以支持其陷入困境的经济并为其核计划提供资金。

paras.en: In December 2022, South Korea's spy agency said North Korean hackers had stolen an estimated 1.5 trillion won ($1.1 billion US) in cryptocurrency and other virtual assets in the past five years, more than half of it in 2022 alone. It said North Korea's capacity to steal digital assets was considered among the best in the world.
paras.zh: 2022 年 12 月，韩国间谍机构表示，朝鲜黑客在过去五年中窃取了估计 1.5 万亿韩元（11 亿美元）的加密货币和其他虚拟资产，仅 2022 年就窃取了一半以上。报告称，朝鲜窃取数字资产的能力被认为是世界上最好的。

paras.en: Changpeng Zhao, a Canadian businessman also known as CZ, founded Binance in 2017. In 2023, he pleaded guilty to a felony linked to failing to prevent money laundering on the platform and stepped down as the company's CEO. U.S. President Donald Trump pardoned Zhao in 2025.
paras.zh: 加拿大商人赵长鹏（CZ）于 2017 年创立了币安。2023 年，他承认了未能防止平台洗钱的重罪，并辞去了公司首席执行官的职务。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普于 2025 年赦免了赵。

paras.en: - Trump pardons Canadian Binance CEO who failed to stop illegal activity on crypto platform
paras.zh: - 特朗普赦免了未能阻止加密平台非法活动的加拿大币安首席执行官

paras.en: - What we know about ongoing Coldcard hack that's stolen over $100M worth of bitcoin
paras.zh: - 我们对正在进行的 Coldcard 黑客攻击的了解，该黑客攻击被盗了价值超过 1 亿美元的比特币

paras.en: Zhao posted Thursday on X that "User funds are safe!" but added that the theft "does look like a hack on Binance." He added that while he doesn't manage Binance anymore, "as a shareholder, I expect all user funds will be fully covered."
paras.zh: 赵周四在X上发帖称“用户资金是安全的！”但他补充说，这起盗窃事件“看起来确实像是对币安的黑客攻击”。他补充说，虽然他不再管理币安，但“作为股东，我预计所有用户资金都将得到全额保障。”

paras.en: The event, meanwhile, also raises questions about why stronger approval controls were not in place, said Kok Tin Gan, co-founder and CEO of cybersecurity firm NyxLab.
paras.zh: 与此同时，网络安全公司 NyxLab 联合创始人兼首席执行官 Kok Tin Gan 表示，此次活动也引发了人们的疑问，即为什么没有实施更强有力的审批控制。

paras.en: "This looks like one signature that gave the attacker a never-expiring, full-access token to a Binance hot wallet," he said, referring to cryptocurrency wallets that hold users' "private keys," or unique authorizations, digitally and which are connected to the internet.
paras.zh: 他说：“这看起来像是一个签名，它为攻击者提供了一个永不过期、完全访问币安热钱包的令牌。”他指的是以数字方式保存用户“私钥”或唯一授权并连接到互联网的加密货币钱包。

paras.en: Binance said on X it had "found no evidence of any wallet private key leak" and that the company would release more technical details when its probe is complete.
paras.zh: 币安在 X 上表示，“没有发现任何钱包私钥泄露的证据”，该公司将在调查完成后发布更多技术细节。

articles.title: Aid operation, evacuations underway in Ukraine's stricken city of Oleshky

paras.en: Aid operation, evacuations underway in Ukraine's stricken city of Oleshky
paras.zh: 乌克兰受灾城市奥列什基的援助行动和疏散正在进行

paras.en: Localized ceasefire holds for more than 3 days but attacks continue elsewhere in Ukraine
paras.zh: 局部停火已持续超过三天，但乌克兰其他地区的袭击仍在继续

paras.en: Starving and exhausted residents of a Russian-held town in southern Ukraine were being evacuated on Friday as part of a joint relief operation by the opposing sides, the first of its kind in four years and eight months of war.
paras.zh: 周五，作为敌对双方联合救援行动的一部分，乌克兰南部一个俄罗斯控制的城镇中饥饿和疲惫的居民被疏散，这是四年零八个月的战争中的首次此类行动。

paras.en: Under a local ceasefire brokered by U.S. first lady Melania Trump, an aid convoy arrived in the town of Oleshky to distribute food and medicine.
paras.zh: 在美国第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普的斡旋下，当地达成停火协议，一支援助车队抵达奥列什基镇分发食品和药品。

paras.en: Those wishing to leave — some for Russia, some for Ukraine — were taken initially to Russian-annexed Crimea in 25 buses and nine ambulances, Russian human rights commissioner Yana Lantratova said, before splitting into separate convoys.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯人权专员雅娜·兰特拉托娃 (Yana Lantratova) 表示，那些希望离开的人——一些前往俄罗斯，一些前往乌克兰——最初被 25 辆巴士和 9 辆救护车送往俄罗斯吞并的克里米亚，然后分成不同的车队。

paras.en: Senior Ukrainian lawmaker David Arakhamia said those heading for Ukraine would be taken from there to Anapa, in southern Russia, before flying to Belarus and finally crossing back into Ukraine by bus — a route of more than 1,600 kilometres.
paras.zh: 乌克兰高级议员戴维·阿拉哈米亚(David Arakhamia)表示，那些前往乌克兰的人将被从那里带到俄罗斯南部的阿纳帕，然后飞往白俄罗斯，最后乘巴士返回乌克兰——这条路线长达1600多公里。

paras.en: "The problem is that a lot of people are staying," one woman told Ukraine's human rights ombudsman, Dmytro Lubinets, who was on the ground to co-ordinate the operation with Lantratova.
paras.zh: “问题是很多人都留下来了，”一名妇女告诉乌克兰人权监察员德米特罗·鲁比内茨(Dmytro Lubinets)，后者当时正在现场与兰特拉托娃协调行动。

paras.en: "I’ve been told that it’s their own choice," Lubinets replied. "At the very least, we’ll do what we can to ensure that somehow humanitarian aid gets through."
paras.zh: “我被告知这是他们自己的选择，”鲁宾涅茨回答道。 “至少，我们将尽我们所能确保人道主义援助能够顺利进行。”

paras.en: Although it was a striking example of co-operation between the warring sides, a spokesperson for Russian President Vladimir Putin described it as "difficult to extrapolate" to the wider search for peace.
paras.zh: 尽管这是交战双方合作的一个引人注目的例子，但俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京的发言人称，“很难推断”到更广泛的和平寻求。

paras.en: Attacks continued elsewhere, with Russian strikes overnight targeting seven regions of Ukraine, as well as the capital Kyiv and the southeastern city of Dnipro, officials said. On Thursday, a Russian drone killed at least 15 people on a rail platform in the Ukrainian city of Dnipro.
paras.zh: 官员称，其他地方的袭击仍在继续，俄罗斯连夜对乌克兰七个地区以及首都基辅和东南部城市第聂伯罗发动袭击。周四，一架俄罗斯无人机在乌克兰第聂伯罗市的一个铁路站台上造成至少 15 人死亡。

paras.en: People stand next to a building in Kyiv, Ukraine, on Friday that was damaged by a late-evening Russian missile strike. (Valentyn Ogirenko/Reuters)
paras.zh: 周五，人们站在乌克兰基辅的一栋建筑旁，该建筑在深夜的俄罗斯导弹袭击中受损。 （瓦连廷·奥吉连科/路透社）

paras.en: Russia said Ukraine had resumed strikes on its oil refineries despite a request from U.S. President Donald Trump to stop such attacks, which Trump has blamed for raising the cost of diesel ahead of U.S. midterm elections next week. There was no comment from Ukraine.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯表示，尽管美国总统唐纳德·特朗普要求停止此类袭击，乌克兰仍恢复了对其炼油厂的罢工，特朗普指责乌克兰在下周美国中期选举前提高了柴油成本。乌克兰方面没有发表评论。

paras.en: - Russian drone strike kills at least 14 on Ukrainian rail platform
paras.zh: - 俄罗斯无人机袭击乌克兰铁路站台造成至少14人死亡

paras.en: - Russia, Ukraine begin ceasefire in city of Oleshky as deadly strikes continue elsewhere
paras.zh: - 俄罗斯和乌克兰开始在奥列什基市停火，而其他地方的致命袭击仍在继续

paras.en: Both sides have heaped praise on the U.S. first lady for brokering the deal for Oleshky. Both have a strong interest in ensuring its success to avoid antagonizing her husband at a crucial moment, with the U.S. elections only days away and U.S.-mediated peace talks due to resume in November after nine months.
paras.zh: 双方都对美国第一夫人为奥列什基促成这笔交易大加赞赏。两人都强烈希望确保谈判取得成功，以避免在关键时刻激怒她的丈夫，因为距离美国大选只有几天了，美国斡旋的和平谈判将于九个月后于 11 月恢复。

paras.en: For Russia, which seized Oleshky in the first days of the war in 2022, the operation also provides a PR opportunity. Russian state TV has shown aid boxes destined for Oleshky, decorated with the Russian flag, being loaded by people wearing T-shirts reading "Putin's Team — The People's Front."
paras.zh: 对于在 2022 年战争初期夺取奥列什基的俄罗斯来说，这次行动也提供了一次公关机会。俄罗斯国家电视台画面显示，运往奥列什基的援助箱上装饰着俄罗斯国旗，身穿T恤的人们正在装载，上面写着“普京的团队——人民阵线”。

paras.en: Oleshky, on the Dnipro River opposite the city of Kherson, has suffered extensive damage and was badly flooded after the destruction of the huge upriver Kakhovka dam in 2023.
paras.zh: 奥列什基位于赫尔松市对面的第聂伯河上，2023 年上游卡霍夫卡大坝被毁后，该地区遭受了广泛的破坏，并被严重淹没。

paras.en: Residents have given harrowing accounts of risking their lives traveling along mine-strewn roads — one known as the "road of death" — to get food and water. Some say they have survived on a cup of rice or buckwheat a day, sometimes with a tomato, cucumber or wild plants added.
paras.zh: 居民们讲述了他们冒着生命危险沿着布满地雷的道路——一条被称为“死亡之路”——去获取食物和水的悲惨经历。有人说，他们每天靠一杯大米或荞麦生存，有时还添加番茄、黄瓜或野生植物。

paras.en: Russia's Lantratova said food, hygiene products, medical supplies and fuel were being delivered to the town. Ukraine's Lubinets said everyone in need of help would get it.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯的兰特拉托娃表示，食品、卫生用品、医疗用品和燃料正在运往该镇。乌克兰的卢宾涅茨表示，每个需要帮助的人都会得到帮助。

paras.en: Relations between the two were strikingly cordial — something not seen between Russian and Ukrainian officials since the start of the war — as they appeared side by side to address reporters.
paras.zh: 当他们并肩向记者发表讲话时，两人之间的关系出奇地友好——这是自战争开始以来俄罗斯和乌克兰官员之间从未见过的情况。

paras.en: They later spoke together to residents, some of whom were in tears. One woman switched hesitantly between Russian and Ukrainian, a moment that seemed to symbolize the plight of fearful people caught in the midst of a war.
paras.zh: 他们后来一起与居民交谈，其中一些人流下了眼泪。一名妇女犹豫着在俄语和乌克兰语之间切换，这一时刻似乎象征着陷入战争之中的恐惧人民的困境。

paras.en: The ceasefire had come into force in Oleshky and the Kherson region on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 停火协议于周二在奥列什基和赫尔松地区生效。

paras.en: "This is the first time since 2022 that a ceasefire has been established across such an extensive stretch of the front line and has been maintained for such a significant duration," Lubinets said.
paras.zh: 鲁比涅茨说：“这是自 2022 年以来首次在前线如此大范围内实现停火，并维持如此长的时间。”

paras.en: The arrival of the aid convoy was preceded by demining operations in which Lantratova said a Russian sapper and one other person were killed.
paras.zh: 兰特拉托娃说，援助车队抵达之前进行了排雷行动，其中一名俄罗斯工兵和另外一人被打死。

paras.en: She said 25 buses were on hand for evacuations, with special provision for those who were bedridden, and 50 medical personnel were present. There was even a bus with pet cages for those who wished to take their animals with them.
paras.zh: 她说，现场有 25 辆巴士可供疏散，并为卧床不起的人提供特殊服务，还有 50 名医务人员在场。甚至还有一辆带有宠物笼的巴士，供那些希望携带宠物同行的人使用。

paras.en: The joint relief operation showed the two sides are capable of working together despite the ferocity of the war, in which both have intensified long-range air strikes this year while battlefield front lines remain largely static.
paras.zh: 联合救援行动表明，尽管战争十分激烈，但双方有能力共同努力，今年双方都加强了远程空袭，而战场前线基本保持静止。

paras.en: Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said there was a "high degree of coordination" between Lantratova and Lubinets.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫表示，兰特拉托娃和卢宾涅茨之间存在“高度协调”。

paras.en: However, asked later by a state TV reporter if this showed it was possible for Russia and Ukraine to agree on other issues, he replied: "This is an isolated situation, which is difficult to extrapolate to the entire settlement process at this stage."
paras.zh: 然而，后来被国家电视台记者问及这是否表明俄罗斯和乌克兰有可能在其他问题上达成一致时，他回答说：“这是一个孤立的情况，现阶段很难推断整个解决进程。”

paras.en: The two sides remain far apart on terms for a peace deal, but technical talks are due to resume in Abu Dhabi next month for the first time since the U.S. and Israel launched their war against Iran in February, distracting Trump from his long-running effort to end the conflict.
paras.zh: 双方在和平协议条款上仍存在很大分歧，但技术谈判将于下个月在阿布扎比恢复，这是自美国和以色列二月份对伊朗发动战争以来的首次，这分散了特朗普为结束冲突而长期努力的注意力。

articles.title: Pope Leo votes in U.S. midterms, Vatican confirms

paras.en: Pope Leo votes in U.S. midterms, Vatican confirms
paras.zh: 梵蒂冈证实教皇利奥在美国中期选举中投票

paras.en: Leo requested a mail-in ballot from Illinois earlier this month
paras.zh: 利奥本月早些时候要求伊利诺伊州邮寄选票

paras.en: Pope Leo XIV has become the first pope to vote in a U.S. general election.
paras.zh: 教皇利奥十四世成为第一位在美国大选中投票的教皇。

paras.en: The Vatican confirmed Friday that pontiff had submitted a mail-in ballot in Chicago ahead of the Nov. 3 midterm elections, citing his long-standing belief in civic participation.
paras.zh: 梵蒂冈周五证实，教宗已在 11 月 3 日中期选举之前在芝加哥提交了邮寄选票，理由是他长期以来对公民参与的信念。

paras.en: Leo, formerly Robert Prevost, "has exercised his right to vote as a United States citizen" and has done so "whenever he was eligible to do so," the Holy See press office said.
paras.zh: 罗马教廷新闻办公室表示，利奥（原名罗伯特·普雷沃斯特）“已经行使了作为美国公民的投票权”，并且“只要有资格”就这样做了。

paras.en: "The Holy Father expresses his belief in the right and the duty of citizens to participate in democratic processes," it added.
paras.zh: 声明补充说：“教宗表达了他对公民参与民主进程的权利和义务的信念。”

paras.en: The U.S. Council of Catholic Bishops praised the decision in a statement.
paras.zh: 美国天主教主教理事会在一份声明中赞扬了这一决定。

paras.en: "In voting, our Holy Father sets the example that encourages each citizen to exercise their civic responsibility," said spokesperson Chieko Noguchi. "The U.S. bishops have emphasized it's not 'who' one is voting for, but rather on encouraging Catholics to inform their conscience as they prepare to vote and to uphold human dignity and the common good in doing so."
paras.zh: 发言人野口千惠子说：“在投票中，我们的教宗树立了榜样，鼓励每个公民履行公民责任。” “美国主教们强调，这不是投票给‘谁’，而是鼓励天主教徒在准备投票时告知自己的良心，并在这样做时维护人类尊严和共同利益。”

paras.en: Leo's vote was first reported by the Chicago Sun-Times, which quoted the chief of staff at the Will County clerk's office as saying the pope, registered at a New Lenox address, requested a mail-in ballot on Oct. 3.
paras.zh: 《芝加哥太阳报》首先报道了利奥的投票，该报援引威尔县书记员办公室主任的话说，登记在新莱诺克斯地址的教皇要求在 10 月 3 日进行邮寄选票。

paras.en: The request was made just 10 days before Leo underwent surgery to remove a cancerous tumour from his right lung. Leo has been slowly resuming his activities at the Vatican after being released from the hospital on Oct. 17.
paras.zh: 这一请求是在 Leo 接受右肺癌肿瘤切除手术前 10 天提出的。 10月17日出院后，利奥一直在慢慢恢复在梵蒂冈的活动。

paras.en: It is unclear how Leo returned the ballot.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚利奥如何退回选票。

paras.en: Leo is the head of state of a foreign country, the Holy See. The city-state is an absolute monarchy with no political elections. U.S. federal law allows citizens living abroad, even those working for foreign governments, to vote via absentee ballot.
paras.zh: 利奥是外国罗马教廷的国家元首。城邦是绝对君主制国家，没有政治选举。美国联邦法律允许居住在国外的公民，甚至是为外国政府工作的公民，通过缺席投票进行投票。

paras.en: Leo, 71, is also a Peruvian citizen, having lived there as a missionary priest and bishop for over 20 years. The Vatican statement said he had also voted while living in Peru whenever he was eligible, but there's no evidence he cast a ballot in the national election held earlier this year in the South American country.
paras.zh: 71 岁的利奥也是秘鲁公民，作为传教士和主教在那里生活了 20 多年。梵蒂冈声明称，他在秘鲁居住期间也曾在有资格的情况下投票，但没有证据表明他在今年早些时候在这个南美国家举行的全国选举中投票。

paras.en: There are also no known Vatican statements indicating that any of the three popes before Leo, dating back a half-century, had voted in their countries of origin.
paras.zh: 梵蒂冈也没有任何已知的声明表明，半个世纪前的利奥之前的三位教皇中的任何一位都曾在其原籍国投票。

paras.en: Michael Kelly, a papal historian, told CNN in a published report Friday he wasn't aware of any pope voting in a democratic election before.
paras.zh: 教皇历史学家迈克尔·凯利在周五发表的一份报告中告诉美国有线电视新闻网，他以前不知道有任何教皇在民主选举中投票。

paras.en: Since becoming Pope, Leo has drawn criticism from U.S. President Donald Trump for repeatedly condemning the U.S.-Israeli war in Iran and calling for dignified treatment of immigrants.
paras.zh: 自成为教皇以来，利奥因多次谴责美以在伊朗的战争并呼吁给予移民有尊严的待遇而受到美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的批评。

paras.en: Earlier this year, Trump called Leo "weak" and captive to the "radical left."
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，特朗普称利奥“软弱”，是“激进左派”的俘虏。

paras.en: Responding to Trump's public rebuke, Leo told reporters en route to Algeria: "I'm not afraid of the Trump administration or of speaking out loudly about the message of the Gospel, which is what the church works for.
paras.zh: 针对特朗普的公开谴责，利奥在前往阿尔及利亚的途中告诉记者：“我不害怕特朗普政府，也不害怕大声谈论福音的信息，这就是教会的工作目的。

paras.en: "I will continue to speak out strongly against war, seeking to promote peace, promoting dialogue and multilateralism among states to find solutions to problems," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我将继续强烈反对战争，寻求促进和平，促进各国之间的对话和多边主义，以找到问题的解决方案。”

paras.en: Leo also supported a rare special message by the U.S. Conference of Catholic Bishops that decried the "vilification of immigrants" and implored countries to "recognize the fundamental dignity of all persons, including immigrants."
paras.zh: 利奥还支持美国天主教主教会议发出的罕见的特别信息，谴责“对移民的诽谤”，并恳求各国“承认包括移民在内的所有人的基本尊严”。

paras.en: Voted in primaries of both parties in past
paras.zh: 过去曾在两党初选中投票

paras.en: Since 2000, Robert Prevost has voted in five primary elections, requesting Democratic ballots twice and Republican ballots three times, according to records held by the Illinois State Board of Elections.
paras.zh: 根据伊利诺伊州选举委员会的记录，自 2000 年以来，罗伯特·普雷沃斯特已在五次初选中投票，其中两次要求民主党投票，三次要求共和党投票。

paras.en: The records do not show which candidates he supported. Illinois voters must declare a party preference to receive a primary ballot. No such declaration is required in general elections.
paras.zh: 记录没有显示他支持哪些候选人。伊利诺伊州选民必须声明政党偏好才能获得初选。大选中不需要这样的声明。

paras.en: While registered in heavily Democratic Cook County, Prevost requested Democratic primary ballots in 2008 and 2010. After moving to the more conservative suburban Will County, he requested Republican primary ballots in 2012, 2014 and 2016.
paras.zh: 虽然普雷沃斯特在民主党占主导地位的库克县登记，但他在 2008 年和 2010 年要求进行民主党初选。搬到更为保守的郊区威尔县后，他在 2012 年、2014 年和 2016 年要求进行共和党初选。

paras.en: The records also show that he submitted ballots in every general election since 2000 except those in 2020 and 2022.
paras.zh: 记录还显示，自2000年以来，除了2020年和2022年之外，他在每次大选中都提交了选票。

paras.en: This election, Illinois voters are deciding whether to elect Illinois Gov. JB Pritzker to his third term, and they're also filling an open U.S. Senate seat after longtime Democrat Dick Durbin, a Catholic, announced his retirement. Democrat Juliana Stratton, the Illinois lieutenant governor, and Don Tracy, a longtime Republican figure in the state.
paras.zh: 这次选举，伊利诺伊州选民将决定是否选举伊利诺伊州州长 JB Pritzker 连任第三个任期，并且在长期担任民主党人、天主教徒的迪克·杜宾 (Dick Durbin) 宣布退休后，他们还将填补美国参议院的一个空缺席位。民主党人、伊利诺伊州副州长朱安娜·斯特拉顿和该州长期共和党人物唐·特雷西。

articles.title: Bollywood and the underworld — together in the spotlight?

paras.en: "In the entire film industry, whoever works without aligning with us, or works with Salman Khan, will be killed."
paras.zh: “在整个电影行业，任何不与我们结盟的人，或者与萨尔曼·汗合作的人，都将被杀死。”

paras.en: This warning was delivered in an audio message by presumed attackers on Indian actor Tiger Shroff in Mumbai earlier this month, as they claimed responsibility for the shooting.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候在孟买袭击印度演员泰格·史洛夫的疑似袭击者在音频中发出了这一警告，他们声称对这起枪击事件负责。

paras.en: The apparent perpetrators said they were connected to Lawrence Bishnoi, a student-politician-turned-gangster who has been in prison since 2014. Notably, police have not confirmed the gang's involvement.
paras.zh: 明显的肇事者表示，他们与学生政治家出身的黑帮成员劳伦斯·比什诺伊 (Lawrence Bishnoi) 有关，自 2014 年以来一直入狱。值得注意的是，警方尚未证实该团伙参与其中。

paras.en: The shots fired at Shroff, which injured his driver, were only the latest in a string of attacks targeting prominent figures from the Mumbai-based film industry, popularly known as "Bollywood".
paras.zh: 向史洛夫开枪导致他的司机受伤，这只是针对孟买电影业（俗称“宝莱坞”）知名人物的一系列袭击中的最新一起。

paras.en: Since 2022, gunmen fired shots at actor Salman Khan's apartment and at the home of filmmaker Rohit Shetty in Mumbai, as well as actor Disha Patani's family home in northern India. Actor Ranveer Singh also reportedly received an extortion demand of nearly $1.1 million (around €980,000).
paras.zh: 自 2022 年以来，持枪歹徒向演员萨尔曼·汗 (Salman Khan) 的公寓、电影制片人罗希特·谢蒂 (Rohit Shetty) 在孟买的家以及演员迪莎·帕塔尼 (Disha Patani) 在印度北部的家中开枪。据报道，演员 Ranveer Singh 也收到了近 110 万美元（约合 98 万欧元）的敲诈勒索。

paras.en: The attacks have spread to the other side of the globe, with a cafe owned by comedian Kapil Sharma in Surrey, Canada, also hit three times.
paras.zh: 袭击事件已蔓延至地球的另一端，加拿大萨里市喜剧演员卡皮尔·夏尔马 (Kapil Sharma) 开办的一家咖啡馆也遭受了 3 次袭击。

paras.en: For an industry that once lived in the shadow of organized crime, the attacks have revived old fears, harking back to the crime bosses of the 1990s. But experts say the threat facing Bollywood today looks very different from the one it faced three decades ago.
paras.zh: 对于一个曾经生活在有组织犯罪阴影下的行业来说，这些袭击事件重新唤起了人们对过去的恐惧，让人回想起 20 世纪 90 年代的犯罪头目。但专家表示，宝莱坞如今面临的威胁与三十年前截然不同。

paras.en: In the 1990s, Mumbai's underworld was deeply entangled with the Hindi film industry.
paras.zh: 20世纪90年代，孟买的黑社会与印地语电影业纠缠不清。
