paras.en: "The mafia was always fascinated with the movie industry," said S. Hussain Zaidi, crime journalist and author of "Dongri to Dubai: Six Decades of the Mumbai Mafia," who has covered organized crime in the city for over three decades.
paras.zh: “黑手党总是对电影业着迷，”犯罪记者、《东日到迪拜：孟买黑手党的六个十年》一书的作者 S. Hussain Zaidi 说，他三十多年来一直报道该市的有组织犯罪。

paras.en: Gangsters like Dawood Ibrahim, Abu Salem and Chhota Shakeel "were totally obsessed" with Bollywood, he told DW, much like mafiosi who sought a foothold in Hollywood.
paras.zh: 他告诉德国之声，像达乌德·易卜拉欣、阿布·萨利姆和乔塔·沙基尔这样的黑帮“完全沉迷于”宝莱坞，就像黑手党在好莱坞寻求立足点一样。

paras.en: To the gangsters, films offered glitz and glamor, but also a way to launder their profits. They invested in films "so that they could control the industry and have a legitimate way of making money," Zaidi added.
paras.zh: 对于黑帮来说，电影带来了浮华和魅力，但也是他们洗钱的一种方式。扎伊迪补充道，他们投资电影“是为了控制整个行业并拥有合法的赚钱方式”。

paras.en: When producers didn't cooperate, the consequences could be fatal. In 1997, music mogul Gulshan Kumar, founder of the label T-Series, was shot dead. In 2000, filmmaker Rakesh Roshan, father of Bollywood star Hrithik Roshan, was shot and wounded.
paras.zh: 如果生产者不合作，后果可能是致命的。 1997 年，音乐大亨、T-Series 厂牌创始人古尔尚·库马尔 (Gulshan Kumar) 被枪杀。 2000 年，宝莱坞明星赫里尼克·罗斯汉 (Hrithik Roshan) 的父亲、电影制作人拉克什·罗斯汉 (Rakesh Roshan) 被枪杀。

paras.en: Mumbai's streets were "made red with blood" in 1998, Zaidi said, describing the year as the pinnacle of gang killings.
paras.zh: 扎伊迪说，1998 年孟买的街道“被鲜血染红”，并称这一年是帮派杀戮达到顶峰的一年。

paras.en: D. Sivanandhan, the former Police Commissioner of Mumbai, who led the crackdown, says 101 businessmen were shot dead in 1998 alone, or one "every third day," mostly over unpaid extortion demands.
paras.zh: 领导此次镇压活动的孟买前警察局长 D. Sivanandhan 表示，仅 1998 年就有 101 名商人被枪杀，或者“每三天”就有 1 名商人被枪杀，大部分是因为未支付勒索要求。

paras.en: Police efforts were reinforced by a tough new organized crime law passed in 1999, which Sivanandhan calls the "ultimate weapon." Security forces used electronic surveillance and preventive detention, and seized some 2,500 illegal weapons.
paras.zh: 1999 年通过的一项严厉的新的有组织犯罪法加强了警方的努力，Sivanandhan 称其为“终极武器”。安全部队利用电子监视和预防性拘留，缴获了约 2,500 件非法武器。

paras.en: "A few encounters also happened, but that is not a policy nor a strategy,” he told DW, referring to police shootouts.
paras.zh: “也发生了一些冲突，但这不是政策，也不是策略，”他告诉德国之声，指的是警察枪战。

paras.en: By the early 2000s, the gangs' hold had been broken, and a new Mumbai seemed to be emerging.
paras.zh: 到了 2000 年代初期，帮派的控制已经被打破，一个新的孟买似乎正在崛起。

paras.en: The man believed to be behind the latest wave of attacks is not from Mumbai.
paras.zh: 据信最新一波袭击的幕后黑手并非来自孟买。

paras.en: Bishnoi, 33, comes from a landowning family in the northern state of Punjab and was studying in Chandigarh when he was drawn into violent student politics. Then, he was arrested, incarcerated and eventually turned to crime, says journalist Jupinderjit Singh, author of "Gangs of Punjab."
paras.zh: 33 岁的比什诺伊来自北部旁遮普邦的一个地主家庭，在昌迪加尔读书时卷入了暴力学生政治。 《旁遮普黑帮》一书的作者、记者朱平德吉特·辛格 (Jupinderjit Singh) 说，随后他被捕、入狱，并最终走上犯罪道路。

paras.en: "He was introduced to the University of Crime through the jail," Singh told DW.
paras.zh: 辛格告诉德国之声：“他是通过监狱被介绍进入犯罪大学的。”

paras.en: Bishnoi went on to build what Singh describes as one of the first criminal syndicates spanning several northern Indian states. Investigators say he still directs operations from prison using concealed phones and messaging apps.
paras.zh: 比什诺伊继续建立了辛格所说的横跨印度北部几个邦的最早的犯罪集团之一。调查人员表示，他仍然使用隐蔽的电话和短信应用程序在监狱里指挥行动。

paras.en: Currently, Bishnoi is held in a jail in Prime Minister Narendra Modi's home state of Gujarat.
paras.zh: 目前，比什诺伊被关押在总理纳伦德拉·莫迪家乡古吉拉特邦的一所监狱中。

paras.en: His network stretches beyond India's borders. In September 2025, Canada designated the Bishnoi gang a terrorist entity. Last month, the FBI added Satinderjeet Singh, popularly known as Goldy Brar, to its Ten Most Wanted list, offering up to $1 million for information leading to his arrest. US prosecutors described him as the alleged leader of Bishnoi's group in North America.
paras.zh: 他的网络延伸到印度境外。 2025年9月，加拿大将比什诺伊帮派列为恐怖实体。上个月，美国联邦调查局 (FBI) 将萨丁德吉特·辛格 (Satinderjeet Singh)（俗称戈尔迪·布拉尔 (Goldy Brar)）列入其十大通缉犯名单，并悬赏高达 100 万美元以获取导致他被捕的信息。美国检察官称他为北美比什诺伊组织的领导人。

paras.en: While Bishnoi comes from an affluent landowning family, his shooters are mostly poor. The gang usually recruits them online.
paras.zh: 虽然比什诺伊来自一个富裕的地主家庭，但他的射手大多是穷人。该团伙通常在网上招募他们。

paras.en: "There are so many youngsters who want to do something… they are just pulled by the lore attached to Lawrence Bishnoi," Singh explained. "Recruiting is no big issue… They offer money, protection, weapons."
paras.zh: “有很多年轻人想做点什么……他们只是被劳伦斯·比什诺伊的传说所吸引，”辛格解释道。 “招募并不是什么大问题……他们提供金钱、保护和武器。”

paras.en: In 1998, Salman Khan was accused of killing a blackbuck, an antelope revered by Bishnoi's community. Bishnoi vowed revenge, and many of the attacks targeted people close to the actor, including the 2024 killing of politician Baba Siddique, which police have linked to the gang.
paras.zh: 1998 年，萨尔曼·汗被指控杀死了一只黑羚羊，这是比什诺伊社区所崇敬的羚羊。比什诺伊发誓要报仇，许多袭击都针对与该演员关系密切的人，包括 2024 年杀害政客巴巴·西迪克 (Baba Siddique) 的事件，警方认为这起事件与该团伙有关。

paras.en: Singh sees the feud as a bid for respectability. Criminals "always try to find something that makes them a moral guardian," he says, and this case was Bishnoi's "chance to redeem himself."
paras.zh: 辛格认为这种不和是为了赢得尊重。他说，犯罪分子“总是试图找到一些让他们成为道德守护者的东西”，而这个案件是比什诺伊“救赎自己的机会”。

paras.en: "Bollywood has a lot of money," Singh added, pointing that the previous generation of gangsters was no longer in position to take advantage.
paras.zh: “宝莱坞有很多钱，”辛格补充道，并指出上一代黑帮已经不再能够利用。

paras.en: "With Dawood Ibrahim and his counterparts away, there was a vacuum, and Lawrence Bishnoi is trying to exploit that."
paras.zh: “随着达乌德·易卜拉欣和他的同行离开，出现了真空，劳伦斯·比什诺伊正试图利用这一点。”

paras.en: Sivanandhan explained the old Mumbai gangs ran a whole "basket" of illegal businesses, from smuggling to protection rackets and cricket match-fixing. Their members were "local boys," while the Bishnoi gang has “nothing to do with Mumbai,” he added. It targets Bollywood because the industry is "loaded with money" and a "soft underbelly."
paras.zh: 西瓦南丹解释说，孟买的老帮派经营着一整套非法生意，从走私到收取保护费和打假球。他补充说，他们的成员是“当地男孩”，而比什诺伊帮派“与孟买无关”。它瞄准宝莱坞，因为该行业“资金雄厚”且有“软肋”。

paras.en: "They are using Bollywood as an ATM," he told DW. "Insert a card and collect your money."
paras.zh: “他们把宝莱坞当作自动提款机，”他告诉德国之声。 “插入卡并收钱。”

paras.en: Meanwhile, Zaidi sees the attacks mainly as publicity. "It's a way to grab headlines," he told DW. Within hours of the recent attack on Shroff, someone claimed on social media that he was targeted for being close to Khan, a logic Zaidi called "absolutely illogical and absurd."
paras.zh: 与此同时，扎伊迪认为这些袭击主要是为了宣传。 “这是抢占头条新闻的一种方式，”他告诉德国之声。在最近针对史罗夫的袭击发生后的几个小时内，有人在社交媒体上声称他因与汗关系密切而成为攻击目标，扎伊迪称这种逻辑“绝对不合逻辑且荒谬”。

paras.en: But publicity is useful to gangs that live off extortion. "The base material of extortion is: create fear," a security professional responsible for the protection of several Bollywood stars, who asked not to be named because of the sensitivity of the issue, told DW.
paras.zh: 但宣传对于靠敲诈勒索为生的团伙很有用。一位负责保护几位宝莱坞明星的安全专家告诉德国之声：“敲诈勒索的基本内容是：制造恐惧。”由于问题的敏感性，他要求不透露姓名。

paras.en: Still, experts say its hard to argue that the ongoing violence is comparable to the 1990s crime wave.
paras.zh: 不过，专家表示，很难说当前的暴力事件可以与 20 世纪 90 年代的犯罪浪潮相媲美。

paras.en: "I won't say resurgence, because that would be a bit of an exaggeration," Zaidi said. In the 1990s, several rival gangs fought for control of Mumbai. Today, other than Bishnoi's faction, other gangs are not considered active in Mumbai.
paras.zh: “我不会说复苏，因为这有点夸张，”扎伊迪说。 20 世纪 90 年代，多个敌对帮派争夺孟买的控制权。如今，除了比什诺伊派之外，其他帮派在孟买并不活跃。

paras.en: The film industry is also not paying up the way it once did, because the shift to digital payments has made large cash transactions hard to hide, he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说，电影业也不再像以前那样付款，因为向数字支付的转变使得大额现金交易难以隐藏。

paras.en: Sivanandhan disagrees. The shootings at walls and gates, followed by quick claims on social media, are "all aimed at collecting… extortion money," he said. In his view, "cash-rich Bollywood would be coughing up so much, which is enough to run an army of people."
paras.zh: 西瓦南丹不同意。他说，针对墙壁和大门的枪击事件以及随后在社交媒体上迅速发布的声明“都是为了收取……勒索资金”。在他看来，“现金充裕的宝莱坞会吐出这么多钱，足以管理一支军队。”

paras.en: And even if violence is not as prevalent, hundreds of thousands of people rely on the Mumbai film industry for their livelihoods.
paras.zh: 即使暴力事件没有那么普遍，孟买仍有数十万人依赖电影业维持生计。

paras.en: "If the fear of the underworld continues, leading names may be forced to leave Mumbai," the All Indian Cine Workers Association (AICWA) President Suresh Shyamlal Gupta wrote to Home Minister Amit Shah.
paras.zh: 全印度电影工人协会 (AICWA) 主席苏雷什·夏姆拉尔·古普塔 (Suresh Shyamlal Gupta) 写信给内政部长阿米特·沙阿 (Amit Shah)，“如果对黑社会的恐惧持续下去，知名人士可能会被迫离开孟买。”

paras.en: "Mumbai will not be allowed to go back to the underworld days of the 1990s, and Bollywood will not be allowed to work in the shadow of fear," Gupta wrote.
paras.zh: 古普塔写道：“孟买不会被允许回到 20 世纪 90 年代的黑社会时代，宝莱坞也不会被允许在恐惧的阴影下工作。”

paras.en: With security forces seemingly on the back foot, gangsters are likely to continue their campaign.
paras.zh: 由于安全部队似乎处于不利地位，歹徒很可能会继续他们的活动。

paras.en: Several Bollywood stars have already stepped up their security.
paras.zh: 几位宝莱坞明星已经加强了安全保护。

articles.title: Seoul fears being sidelined as US reaches out to North Korea

paras.en: South Korea's relationship with the North, always strained, seems to be going through a particularly hostile patch in recent weeks.
paras.zh: 韩国与朝鲜的关系一向紧张，最近几周似乎正经历一段特别敌对的时期。

paras.en: Last month, Seoul accused North Korea of planting a mine on the southern side of the heavily fortified border. The device exploded, injuring three South Korean soldiers. Pyongyang refused to apologize and insisted this was a false-flag incident designed to tarnish the isolated nation. The North Korean regime has since conducted multiple weapons tests, held its first-ever exhibition of military drones attended by Kim Jong Un, brought up self-propelled artillery units to the border and started preparing loudspeaker systems that will blast propaganda into the South.
paras.zh: 上个月，首尔指责朝鲜在戒备森严的边境南侧埋设地雷。该装置爆炸，造成三名韩国士兵受伤。平壤拒绝道歉，并坚称这是一起假旗事件，旨在玷污这个孤立的国家。此后，朝鲜政权进行了多次武器试验，举行了金正恩出席的首次军用无人机展览，将自行火炮部队运送到边境，并开始准备扬声器系统，向韩国进行宣传。

paras.en: On Thursday, North Korea also fired around 10 short-range ballistic missiles towards the Sea of Japan just before a scheduled visit to South Korea by German Chancellor Friedrich Merz.
paras.zh: 周四，就在德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨计划访问韩国之前，朝鲜还向日本海发射了约 10 枚短程弹道导弹。

paras.en: On top of South Korea's issues with its arch rival, many in Seoul are growing increasingly wary of their most important ally, the United States. South Korean politicians are worried that the US could push for a diplomatic breakthrough with North Korea at the cost of ignoring South Korea's security, or even leave it exposed to Pyongyang's nuclear arsenal.
paras.zh: 除了韩国与其主要竞争对手的问题之外，首尔的许多人对他们最重要的盟友美国也越来越警惕。韩国政界人士担心，美国可能会以无视韩国安全为代价推动与朝鲜的外交突破，甚至让韩国暴露在平壤核武库之下。

paras.en: Who gets a voice on South Korea's future?
paras.zh: 谁对韩国的未来有发言权？

paras.en: US President Donald Trump famously claimed he and Kim Jong Un "fell in love" during Trump's first term. More recently, Trump has indicated he would like to resume talks . There have been suggestions that a meeting could take place on November 18 in the Chinese city of Shenzhen, where Trump is expected to attend the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普曾声称他和金正恩在特朗普第一个任期内“坠入爱河”。最近，特朗普表示他希望恢复谈判。有消息称，会议可能于 11 月 18 日在中国深圳举行，预计特朗普将出席亚太经合组织峰会。

paras.en: The North Korean side has made no official response to Washington's hints, although South Korea's National Intelligence Service informed a closed-door meeting of Seoul's intelligence committee on Thursday that Kim Jong Un discussed the possibility of meeting Trump when he met with senior members of China's politburo in Dandong on Saturday.
paras.zh: 朝鲜方面尚未对华盛顿的暗示做出正式回应，尽管韩国国家情报院周四在首尔情报委员会闭门会议上通报称，金正恩周六在丹东会见中国政治局高级成员时讨论了与特朗普会面的可能性。

paras.en: Seoul's fears were also fueled by the US proposing three-way talks with Russia and China on the fate of Ukraine without inviting a representative of Kyiv to attend. The worry in Seoul is that President Donald Trump may conduct a similar bypass manoeuvre on the Korean Peninsula.
paras.zh: 美国提议与俄罗斯和中国就乌克兰的命运进行三方会谈，但没有邀请基辅代表参加，这也加剧了首尔的担忧。首尔担心唐纳德·特朗普总统可能会在朝鲜半岛进行类似的绕行行动。

paras.en: Washington-Seoul relationship shaken by tariffs, funding disputes
paras.zh: 华盛顿与首尔关系因关税和资金纠纷而动摇

paras.en: "Right now, there is a problem of trust between the two governments," said Kim Sang-woo, a former politician with the left-leaning South Korean Congress for New Politics and now a member of the board of the Kim Dae-jung Peace Foundation.
paras.zh: “目前，两国政府之间存在信任问题，”左倾韩国新政治国会前政治家、现任金大中和平基金会董事会成员金相宇说。

paras.en: A security and trade relationship that was previously considered secure has been rocked by tariffs, trade restrictions and demands from Washington that the South pay more for the US troops stationed in the country, Kim told DW.
paras.zh: 金向德国之声表示，关税、贸易限制以及华盛顿要求韩国为驻扎在该国的美军支付更多费用的要求，之前被认为是安全的安全和贸易关系受到了影响。

paras.en: President Lee's diplomats have lost access to key decision-making personnel in this White House, he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说，李总统的外交官无法接触到白宫的关键决策人员。

paras.en: "I do not think this US administration is thinking long-term in the relationship with South Korea," Kim said. "They do not see South Korea as a part of their wider national security network and I do not think they are listening to experts on the importance of allies in the region."
paras.zh: 金正恩表示：“我不认为本届美国政府对与韩国的关系有长远考虑。” “他们不认为韩国是其更广泛的国家安全网络的一部分，我认为他们没有听取专家关于该地区盟友重要性的意见。”

paras.en: "I also think that Trump is eager to meet with Kim because of his personal quest to obtain a Nobel Peace Prize."
paras.zh: “我还认为特朗普渴望与金正恩会面，因为他个人寻求获得诺贝尔和平奖。”

paras.en: Trump's widely publicized efforts to secure a Nobel have been thwarted so far. However, this might change if Trump somehow manages to formally end the Korean War that was put on hold by the 1953 armistice.
paras.zh: 迄今为止，特朗普为获得诺贝尔奖而广为人知的努力遭到了挫败。然而，如果特朗普设法正式结束因 1953 年停战协定而搁置的朝鲜战争，这种情况可能会改变。

paras.en: South Korea eyeing its own nuclear deterrent
paras.zh: 韩国着眼于建立自己的核威慑力量

paras.en: "The most serious concern is that the US recognizes Pyongyang as a nuclear power, which would legitimize the North's program and undermine efforts to convince it to abolish its nuclear weapons as well as the broader non-proliferation system," said Lim Eun-jung, a professor of international studies at Kongju National University.
paras.zh: “最严重的担忧是美国承认平壤是一个核国家，这将使朝鲜的计划合法化，并破坏说服其废除核武器以及更广泛的防扩散体系的努力，”公州国立大学国际研究教授林恩正说。

paras.en: In parallel, she said, there are fears that Trump could reach an agreement with North Korea that requires it to scrap its long-range nuclear missiles — those that are capable of hitting targets in the United States — but permits it to retain short-range weapons that can still easily reach South Korea and Japan.
paras.zh: 她表示，与此同时，人们担心特朗普可能与朝鲜达成协议，要求朝鲜废弃其远程核导弹——那些能够击中美国目标的导弹——但允许其保留仍然可以轻松到达韩国和日本的短程武器。

paras.en: That would raise questions about the US commitment to defend South Korea in case of a nuclear attack. That uncertainty, in turn, is likely to give credence to voices arguing that South Korea needs to develop its own nuclear deterrent.
paras.zh: 这将引发人们对美国在发生核攻击时保卫韩国的承诺的质疑。反过来，这种不确定性可能会让韩国需要发展自己的核威慑力量的声音变得可信。

paras.en: "For years, we have depended on US extended deterrence guarantees under the nuclear umbrella, but this US administration is unpredictable and there are more and more people asking why we don't just go it alone," Lim told DW.
paras.zh: “多年来，我们一直依赖美国在核保护伞下提供的延伸威慑保证，但美国政府难以预测，越来越多的人问我们为什么不单打独斗，”林告诉德国之声。

paras.en: "Virtually, all our neighbors have nuclear weapons, and while no-one wants the dominoes to start falling, it could happen."
paras.zh: “事实上，我们所有的邻国都拥有核武器，虽然没有人希望多米诺骨牌开始倒下，但这种情况可能会发生。”

paras.en: Merz says Korean security affects Europe
paras.zh: 默茨称韩国安全影响欧洲

paras.en: The latest escalation between Seoul and Pyongyang comes amid repeated attempts by South Korean President Lee to improve communication with Pyongyang. The perceived outreach has irritated South Korea's European allies, who are angry over North Korea deploying soldiers and supplying munition and missiles to help Russia in the Ukraine war.
paras.zh: 首尔和平壤之间的最新升级是在韩国总统李明博一再试图改善与平壤的沟通之际发生的。这种主动接触激怒了韩国的欧洲盟友，他们对朝鲜在乌克兰战争中部署士兵、提供弹药和导弹帮助俄罗斯感到愤怒。

paras.en: Moscow is believed to be repaying Pyongyang's support with money, military technology and security guarantees.
paras.zh: 据信莫斯科将以资金、军事技术和安全保障来回报平壤的支持。

paras.en: During his visit to South Korea, Germany's Merz pointed out that "Korea's security affects Europe's security. And Europe's security also affects the security of Korea."
paras.zh: 德国总理默茨访问韩国时指出，“韩国的安全影响欧洲的安全，欧洲的安全也影响韩国的安全”。

paras.en: "The world is small — even in war," Merz added.
paras.zh: “世界很小——即使在战争中也是如此，”默茨补充道。

paras.en: Berlin, just like Seoul, has been disoriented by the Trump administration turning hostile on many of its allies while seeking reproachment with geopolitical rivals such as Russia and China. During his Asia tour, Merz pushed for an alliance of middle powers to protect free trade and oppose "unilateralism, autocratic power politics and violations of international law."
paras.zh: 就像首尔一样，特朗普政府对其许多盟友怀有敌意，同时又寻求俄罗斯和中国等地缘政治对手的指责，这让柏林迷失了方向。默茨在亚洲之行期间推动建立中等强国联盟，以保护自由贸易，反对“单边主义、独裁强权政治和违反国际法的行为”。

paras.en: "The fact remains that the United States is shifting its foreign policy, its foreign economic policy, and redefining its interests. As they do so, we must do the same," he said in South Korea.
paras.zh: “事实仍然是，美国正在改变其外交政策、对外经济政策，并重新定义其利益。当他们这样做时，我们也必须这样做，”他在韩国表示。

paras.en: It was not clear if Seoul will respond to Merz's appeal by moving closer to the European Union. At the moment, however, it seems apparent that the South Korean government is struggling to communicate with either North Korea or the US.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚首尔是否会响应梅尔茨的呼吁，向欧盟靠拢。然而，目前看来韩国政府正在努力与朝鲜或美国进行沟通。

paras.en: "It is a very difficult situation," said Kim Sang-woo. "There is no trust and no connections and that, to me, is very worrisome."
paras.zh: “这是一个非常困难的情况，”金相宇说。 “没有信任，没有联系，对我来说，这非常令人担忧。”

articles.title: What the rift within the Tsikhanouski family means for the Belarusian opposition in exile

paras.en: Blogger and dissident Siarhei Tsikhanouski , 48, was detained in Belarus in May 2020, after he had announced to challenge the country's ruler, Alexander Lukashenko, in the upcoming presidential elections. In December 2021, Tsikhanouski was convicted to 18 years in prison, in part for organizing "mass unrest."
paras.zh: 48 岁的博主兼持不同政见者 Siarhei Tsikhanouski 于 2020 年 5 月在白俄罗斯被拘留，此前他宣布在即将举行的总统选举中挑战该国统治者亚历山大·卢卡申科。 2021 年 12 月，齐哈努斯基被判 18 年监禁，部分罪名是组织“大规模骚乱”。

paras.en: After his arrest his wife, Sviatlana Tsikhanouskaya, took his place and challenged Lukashenko as presidential candidate. Despite allegations of large-scale vote-rigging, Lukashenko was declared the winner of the election in August 2020. This triggered unprecedented mass protests across the country. They were violently suppressed, and thousands of government critics were arrested or fled into exile. Tsikhanouskaya also fled her homeland and became the leading representative of the Belarusian democratic movement.
paras.zh: 他被捕后，他的妻子斯维亚特兰娜·齐哈努斯卡娅（Sviatlana Tsikhanouskaya）接替了他的位置，挑战卢卡申科作为总统候选人。尽管被指控大规模舞弊，卢卡申科还是在 2020 年 8 月的选举中被宣布获胜。这引发了全国前所未有的大规模抗议活动。他们遭到暴力镇压，数千名政府批评者被捕或流亡。齐哈努斯卡娅也逃离了祖国，成为白俄罗斯民主运动的主要代表。

paras.en: In June 2025, Siarhei Tsikhanouski was released after nearly five years in prison and was forcibly taken out of the country.
paras.zh: 2025年6月，西亚尔海·齐哈努斯基(Siarhei Tsikhanouski)在入狱近五年后获释，并被强行带出境。

paras.en: Some 14 months after his release, the blogger has re-activated his YouTube channel, where he not only denounces Alexander Lukashenko's regime, but also Sviatlana Tsikhanouskaya's office, Belarusian media in exile, political analysts and others. Thousands of people follow his streams.
paras.zh: 获释约 14 个月后，这位博主重新启动了他的 YouTube 频道，他不仅谴责亚历山大·卢卡申科政权，还谴责斯维亚特兰娜·齐哈努斯卡娅的办公室、白俄罗斯流亡媒体、政治分析人士等。成千上万的人关注他的直播。

paras.en: In one of them, Tsikhanouski claims that while Sviatlana Tsikhanouskaya obviously enjoyed "a certain legitimacy from the European Union," the people who were living "quietly and silently" in Belarus today had not granted her any. He said that many of those who had voted for her as joint candidate of Belarus' opposition were regretting this today.
paras.zh: 齐哈努斯基在其中一篇文章中声称，虽然斯维亚特兰娜·齐哈努斯卡娅显然享有“欧盟的某种合法性”，但今天“安静地、默默地”生活在白俄罗斯的人们并没有给予她任何合法性。他说，许多投票支持她作为白俄罗斯反对派联合候选人的人今天对此感到遗憾。

paras.en: Tsikhanouski has suggested that a supervisory board should be established under the label "United Office of Demoratic Forces." It would be made up of "former presidential candidates, protest leaders and iconic figures of the revolution," including himself and his wife. "There would not be a full legitimacy but one which was at least granted by Belarusians," Tsikhanouski said, adding that such a supervisory board could oversee the distribution of grant funds.
paras.zh: 齐哈努斯基建议应在“民主力量联合办公室”的名义下设立一个监事会。该委员会将由“前总统候选人、抗议领袖和革命标志性人物”组成，其中包括他本人和他的妻子。齐哈努斯基说：“不会有完全的合法性，但至少得到白俄罗斯人的认可。”他补充说，这样的监事会可以监督赠款资金的分配。

paras.en: Speaking about his wife, he said: "Sviatlana Tsikhanouskaya was a so-called technical candidate, who received the votes of all those who were against Lukashenko. The percentage of votes she received in the 2020 election was negligible because no one knew who she was. She was allowed to run because she did not pose a threat for the regime, and because she had neither supporters nor political experience."
paras.zh: 谈到他的妻子，他说：“斯维亚特兰娜·齐哈努斯卡娅是一名所谓的技术候选人，她得到了所有反对卢卡申科的人的选票。她在2020年选举中获得的选票比例可以忽略不计，因为没有人知道她是谁。她被允许参选，因为她没有对政权构成威胁，因为她既没有支持者，也没有政治经验。”

paras.en: What's happening in the Tsikhanouski family?
paras.zh: 齐哈努斯基家族发生了什么事？

paras.en: Asked by DW what his goals were, Siarhei Tsikhanouski refused to comment and referred to his livestreams instead. The former political prisoner is residing in the US and is, by his own account, currently unemployed. At the beginning of summer he said he was living in Los Angeles, learning English, preparing for university studies and writing a book. It is also known that his children — a teenage son and a younger daughter — temporarily stayed with him in the US. Today, however, they attend school in Poland, where Tsikhanouskaya resides.
paras.zh: 当被德国之声问及他的目标是什么时，齐哈努斯基拒绝发表评论，而是提到了他的直播。这位前政治犯现居住在美国，据他自己说，目前失业。夏初，他说他住在洛杉矶，学习英语，为大学学习做准备，并写一本书。据了解，他的孩子——一个十几岁的儿子和一个小女儿——暂时和他一起住在美国。然而今天，他们在齐哈努斯卡娅居住的波兰上学。

paras.en: Neither she nor her office have commented on the family situation or her husband's allegations. Even before the public dispute, the leader of the Belarusian democratic forces avoided commenting on her husband. Asked about his activities, she often suggested to approach him directly.
paras.zh: 她和她的办公室都没有对家庭状况或她丈夫的指控发表评论。甚至在公开争论之前，白俄罗斯民主力量领导人就避免对她的丈夫发表评论。当被问及他的活动时，她经常建议直接与他联系。

paras.en: Speaking to DW in December 2025, Sviatlana Tsikhanouskaya merely said: "What happens in the public sphere and what happens at home, are different things. I understand Siarhei's deep traumatization and also his very strong reactions to certain events. Siarhei was in prison for five years, and I look at it with great understanding. This is why I'm not going public or making any comments. We'll deal with it among ourselves."
paras.zh: 2025年12月，斯维亚特兰娜·齐哈努斯卡娅在接受德国之声采访时仅表示：“公共领域发生的事情和家里发生的事情是不同的。我理解西亚尔海所遭受的深深的创伤，也理解他对某些事件的强烈反应。西亚尔海在监狱里呆了五年，我对此非常理解。这就是为什么我不会公开或发表任何评论。我们会自己处理这件事。”

paras.en: Democratic forces in a leadership crisis?
paras.zh: 民主力量陷入领导危机？

paras.en: During the 32-year-long rule of the Lukashenko regime, the Belarusian opposition has weathered many crises and conflicts. Sviatlana Tsikhanouskaya's leadership role has been called into question more than once. However, she and her team have always managed to work themselves out of difficult situations during the last couple of years. But will she still be able to do that now, with her own husband having turned into her critic?
paras.zh: 卢卡申科政权32年统治期间，白俄罗斯反对派经历了多次危机和冲突。斯维亚特兰娜·齐哈努斯卡娅 (Sviatlana Tsikhanouskaya) 的领导角色不止一次受到质疑。然而，在过去的几年里，她和她的团队总是设法摆脱困境。但现在，她自己的丈夫已经成为她的批评者，她还能这么做吗？

paras.en: Siarhei Tsikhanouski had gone back to his own self, said political scientist Yury Drakakhrust: "With all his idiosyncrasies, his style of debate, which is not exactly in line with common practice. This is likely to strike many as odd, including Sviatlana Tsikhanouskaya's international partners."
paras.zh: 政治学家尤里·德拉卡赫鲁斯特 (Yury Drakakhrust) 表示，西亚尔海·齐哈努斯基 (Siarhei Tsikhanouskaya) 又回到了自己的本性：“尽管他有种种特质，但他的辩论风格并不完全符合惯例。这可能会让很多人感到奇怪，包括斯维亚特兰娜·齐哈努斯卡娅 (Sviatlana Tsikhanouskaya) 的国际合作伙伴。”

paras.en: Tsikhanouski, Drakakhrust pointed out, insisted that he was the key figure of the 2020 events, which is why he was entitled to all the benefits, privileges, recognition and invitations. But there was no way back.
paras.zh: 德拉卡赫鲁斯特指出，齐哈努斯基坚称自己是 2020 年赛事的关键人物，这就是为什么他有权获得所有好处、特权、认可和邀请。但已经没有回头路了。

paras.en: "Even if we assume that Tsikhanouski is right, that he was the central figure, what good would it do today?" he asked. "If, suddenly, hundreds of thousands of Belarusians watched his livestreams, collected funds, formed local groups or associations in Tsikhanouski's name, then perhaps it would be possible to turn back the wheel. But this will hardly be the case."
paras.zh: “即使我们假设齐哈努斯基是对的，他是核心人物，但这对今天有什么好处呢？”他问道。 “如果突然间，成千上万的白俄罗斯人观看了他的直播，筹集资金，以齐哈努斯基的名义成立当地团体或协会，那么也许有可能扭转局面。但事实并非如此。”

paras.en: Drakakhrust described the current situation within the democratic forces as a "crisis." He doubted that Tsikhanouski would be able to reach an agreement with all the members of the supervisory board he has proposed. Furthermore, his wife, in particular, had since established certain assets, resources, and a status for herself through her office.
paras.zh: 德拉卡赫鲁斯特将民主力量内部的现状描述为一场“危机”。他怀疑齐哈努斯基能否与他提议的监事会所有成员达成协议。此外，特别是他的妻子，此后通过她的办公室为自己建立了一定的资产、资源和地位。

paras.en: Tsikhanouskaya — recognized beyond Belarusian borders
paras.zh: Tsikhanouskaya——在白俄罗斯边界之外得到认可

paras.en: "Tsikhanouskaya is being received at high levels, if not as an elected president, then as a leader for Belarus and Belarusian democracy. She's not regarded as just one of several democratic leaders from Belarus," the political scientist said.
paras.zh: 这位政治学家说：“齐哈努斯卡娅受到高层的欢迎，即使不是作为民选总统，也是白俄罗斯和白俄罗斯民主的领导人。她不仅仅被视为白俄罗斯的几位民主领导人之一。”

paras.en: He pointed out that not only Tsikhanouskaya, but also other actors from the 2020 election campaign are in exile. They, however, had not achieved a similar level of representation or comparable access to resources. "She has surpassed them as a politician, and that's what counts."
paras.zh: 他指出，不仅齐哈努斯卡娅，2020 年竞选活动的其他演员都在流亡。然而，他们并没有达到类似的代表性水平或类似的资源获取机会。 “作为一名政治家，她已经超越了他们，这才是最重要的。”

paras.en: Drakakhrust said that the Belarusian government views disputes among the opposition with a touch of irony, occasionally adding fuel to the fire: "Basically, they don't care who wins. The main thing is that there is conflict, bickering and mutual vilification."
paras.zh: 德拉卡赫鲁斯特表示，白俄罗斯政府以一种讽刺的态度看待反对派之间的争端，有时甚至火上浇油：“基本上，他们并不关心谁获胜。主要的是存在冲突、争吵和相互诽谤。”

paras.en: This article was originally published in Russian.
paras.zh: 本文最初以俄语发表。

articles.title: Barcelona’s Flick praises Yamal’s ‘mentality’ after missing out on Ballon d’Or

paras.en: Lamine Yamal has “reacted very well” following the disappointment of the Ballon d’Or being awarded to Harry Kane, Barcelona coach Hansi Flick said on Friday.
paras.zh: 巴塞罗那主教练汉西·弗里克周五表示，在金球奖授予哈里·凯恩令人失望之后，拉明·亚马尔“反应非常好”。

paras.en: Despite winning La Liga with the Catalan club and lifting the World Cup with Spain, the 19-year-old winger came third in the vote for the best player in the world on Monday, behind Kane and Kylian Mbappe.
paras.zh: 尽管随加泰罗尼亚俱乐部赢得了西甲冠军，并随西班牙队夺得了世界杯冠军，但这位 19 岁的边锋在周一的世界最佳球员投票中名列第三，仅次于凯恩和基利安·姆巴佩。

paras.en: “Harry Kane deserved it, but you already know what I think about Lamine. He’s at the level required to win this award,” Flick said ahead of the La Liga leaders’ home match against Alaves.
paras.zh: “哈里·凯恩应得的，但你已经知道我对拉明的看法。他达到了赢得这个奖项所需的水平，”弗里克在西甲领头羊主场对阵阿拉维斯的比赛前说道。

paras.en: “I’m very proud of Lamine. He reacted very well and was very focused in training.
paras.zh: “我为拉明感到非常自豪。他反应非常好，并且在训练中非常专注。

paras.en: “That’s the way to respond. His mentality is very good for the team.”
paras.zh: “这就是回应的方式。他的心态对球队来说非常好。”

paras.en: Yamal will have a chance to put any lingering disappointment behind him on Saturday when Barcelona look to correct course at home to Alaves following two high-profile defeats.
paras.zh: 亚马尔将有机会在周六将任何挥之不去的失望抛在脑后，巴塞罗那希望在主场对阵阿拉维斯的两场备受瞩目的失利后纠正路线。

paras.en: After winning their first 11 matches in all competitions, Barcelona were flying but then came undone when they travelled to PSG in the Champions League last Tuesday.
paras.zh: 在赢得所有比赛的前 11 场比赛后，巴塞罗那队表现出色，但在上周二的欧冠联赛中客场挑战巴黎圣日耳曼队时却遭遇失败。

paras.en: That 4-2 reverse in the French capital was swiftly followed by a Mbappe-inspired 2-1 loss at home to Real Madrid in La Liga last weekend.
paras.zh: 在法国首都2-4逆转之后，上周末在姆巴佩的带领下，西甲联赛主场1-2输给了皇家马德里。

paras.en: “The most important thing tomorrow is to win,” Flick said.
paras.zh: “明天最重要的事情就是获胜，”弗里克说。

paras.en: “The team is playing well and we believe in our strengths. I’ve seen a good training session and a positive mood. We have to show that tomorrow.
paras.zh: “球队踢得很好，我们相信自己的优势。我看到了良好的训练和积极的情绪。明天我们必须证明这一点。”

paras.en: “Alaves are a team that know how to defend well, but we’re Barca and we want to show our best version.”
paras.zh: “阿拉维斯是一支知道如何防守的球队，但我们是巴萨，我们想展示我们最好的版本。”

paras.en: Barcelona still hold a two-point lead at the top of La Liga ahead of their meeting with Atletico Madrid.
paras.zh: 在与马德里竞技队的比赛之前，巴塞罗那在西甲联赛中仍领先两分。

paras.en: While the German coach admitted he does not like losing, he insisted that the campaign is “a long road”.
paras.zh: 尽管这位德国教练承认他不喜欢失败，但他坚称这场比赛是“一条漫长的路”。

paras.en: “It’s at the end of the season that we can win trophies,” he added.
paras.zh: “只有在赛季结束时我们才能赢得奖杯，”他补充道。

paras.en: “We have to deal with it. We could have won, but we have to accept defeat and learn from it.”
paras.zh: “我们必须应对它。我们本来可以赢，但我们必须接受失败并从中吸取教训。”

articles.title: Report reveals campaign promoting racist, Islamophobic, anti-Qatar views

paras.en: A years-long, paid-for influence operation promoting racist, Islamophobic and anti-Qatar views has been uncovered by two academics, with the evidence suggesting the campaign was intended to serve Israeli interests.
paras.zh: 两位学者揭露了一项长达数年的、有偿的影响力行动，宣扬种族主义、伊斯兰恐惧症和反卡塔尔观点，有证据表明该行动旨在服务以色列的利益。

paras.en: The investigation, which took three years, was published on Thursday. It detailed an operation that likely cost more than $11m and was carried out across 30 countries, including in Europe, the United States and Lebanon.
paras.zh: 这项历时三年的调查于周四公布。它详细介绍了一项可能耗资超过 1100 万美元、在 30 个国家/地区进行的行动，其中包括欧洲、美国和黎巴嫩。

paras.en: Marc Owen Jones, a professor at Northwestern University’s Doha campus, and independent researcher Sohan Dsouza, the academics who published the report, called it “perhaps one of the biggest digital influence and disinformation operations ever documented”.
paras.zh: 西北大学多哈校区教授马克·欧文·琼斯（Marc Owen Jones）和独立研究员索汉·杜萨（Sohan Dsouza）（发表该报告的学者）称其“可能是有史以来最大的数字影响力和虚假信息操作之一”。

paras.en: One example, also reported by French newspaper Le Monde, looked at how the campaign had targeted France and found that “a historical analysis of the ads pushed by the campaign’s backers suggests that they repeatedly sought to align with national electoral calendars”, the newspaper said.
paras.zh: 法国报纸《世界报》也报道了一个例子，该报研究了该竞选活动如何针对法国，发现“对该竞选活动支持者推送的广告的历史分析表明，他们一再寻求与国家选举日历保持一致”。

paras.en: “Buying in France ran through the months before the June 2024 European Parliament elections, and UK buying stopped on 17 May 2024, days before the general election was called,” the researchers said.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示：“法国的购买持续了 2024 年 6 月欧洲议会选举前的几个月，而英国的购买则于 2024 年 5 月 17 日停止，即大选召开前几天。”

paras.en: “Its sustained promotion of anti-Muslim and anti-migrant narratives raises concerns about attempts to shape the political environment ahead of these votes, beyond the formal election campaign period,” they added.
paras.zh: 他们补充说：“它持续宣传反穆斯林和反移民的言论，引发了人们对在正式竞选期间之外，在这些投票之前塑造政治环境的企图的担忧。”

paras.en: Additionally, the report warned that “the campaign remains active in countries approaching major elections, including France and Italy in 2027”.
paras.zh: 此外，报告警告说，“在即将举行重大选举的国家，这场竞选活动仍然活跃，包括 2027 年的法国和意大利”。

paras.en: “In Europe, the ads use the structure of the Great Replacement conspiracy theory, that white people are being replaced by immigrants,” Jones said.
paras.zh: “在欧洲，广告使用了大替代阴谋论的结构，即白人正在被移民取代，”琼斯说。

paras.en: “Qatar takes the role that anti-Semitic versions give to George Soros: a hidden power directing Muslim immigration to ‘Islamise’ Europe,” he noted, referring to the Jewish billionaire philanthropist and frequent target of anti-Semitic conspiracy theories.
paras.zh: 他指出，“卡塔尔扮演了反犹太主义版本赋予乔治·索罗斯的角色：一种引导穆斯林移民‘伊斯兰化’欧洲的隐性力量。”他指的是这位犹太亿万富翁慈善家，也是反犹太主义阴谋论的频繁攻击目标。

paras.en: Separately, one of the campaigns that appeared on TikTok promoted regime change in Iran to audiences in Europe. The ads first began running on February 24, four days before the US and Israel launched their war on the country, the investigation found.
paras.zh: 另外，TikTok 上出现的一项活动向欧洲受众宣传伊朗政权更迭。调查发现，这些广告于 2 月 24 日首次投放，即美国和以色列对该国发动战争的四天前。

paras.en: According to the report, the evidence suggests with “moderate to high confidence” that the influence operation was launched from within Israel and sought to portray Qatar as the driving force behind mass migration meant to allegedly “Islamise” Europe.
paras.zh: 报告称，证据“中度到高度可信”地表明，影响力行动是从以色列内部发起的，旨在将卡塔尔描绘成大规模移民背后的驱动力，据称意在“伊斯兰化”欧洲。

paras.en: The researchers said metadata shows that video editors working on the campaign did so in the Israeli time zone. It also reveals that they used machines with Hebrew drive and folder names.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，元数据显示，参与该活动的视频编辑是在以色列时区进行的。它还显示他们使用具有希伯来语驱动器和文件夹名称的机器。

paras.en: Qatar has been the focus of Israeli-linked campaigns before. Last month, the Israeli newspaper Haaretz found that a group of Israeli influence experts and political advisers had worked on a secret campaign targeting Doha in the weeks after the Hamas-led October 7, 2023, attacks.
paras.zh: 卡塔尔此前一直是与以色列有关的活动的焦点。上个月，以色列报纸《国土报》发现，在哈马斯领导的 2023 年 10 月 7 日袭击发生后的几周内，一群以色列影响力专家和政治顾问正在开展针对多哈的秘密活动。

paras.en: Israeli politicians have also lashed out at Qatar several times in recent years, with former Prime Minister Naftali Bennett calling for the country to be declared an enemy state.
paras.zh: 近年来，以色列政界人士也多次猛烈抨击卡塔尔，前总理纳夫塔利·贝内特呼吁将该国宣布为敌国。

paras.en: Most recently, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s Likud party accused Doha, without evidence, of interfering in Israeli elections held on Tuesday. The Qatari Foreign Ministry has denounced the allegations as a “disinformation campaign”.
paras.zh: 最近，总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡领导的利库德集团在没有证据的情况下指责多哈干涉周二举行的以色列选举。卡塔尔外交部谴责这些指控是“虚假信息活动”。

articles.title: How cuts under Colombia’s de la Espriella threaten a key human rights court

paras.en: Bogota, Colombia – Angela Cordon was only a teenager when her father and uncle disappeared.
paras.zh: 哥伦比亚波哥大——安吉拉·科登（Angela Cordon）的父亲和叔叔失踪时只有十几岁。

paras.en: They were among a string of farmers and merchants to go missing in the southwestern department of Huila in Colombia.
paras.zh: 他们是哥伦比亚西南部威拉省一系列失踪的农民和商人之一。

paras.en: First came her uncle Reynaldo Cordon Herrera's kidnapping. A grocer by trade, he had been travelling by truck on January 22, 2003, when he went missing.
paras.zh: 首先是她的叔叔雷纳尔多·科登·埃雷拉被绑架。他是一名杂货商，2003 年 1 月 22 日乘坐卡车出行时失踪。

paras.en: The next month, Guillermo Cordon Herrera — Angela's father — set out to discover what happened to his brother, tracing his whereabouts through rural Colombia.
paras.zh: 下个月，安吉拉的父亲吉列尔莫·科登·埃雷拉 (Guillermo Cordon Herrera) 开始寻找他哥哥的下落，并在哥伦比亚乡村追踪他的下落。

paras.en: Guillermo called home one night with news: He had made contact with the rebel fighters he believed to be responsible for his brother's abduction.
paras.zh: 一天晚上，吉列尔莫打电话回家，带来了消息：他已经与他认为对他兄弟绑架负有责任的叛乱分子取得了联系。

paras.en: It was the last time his family would ever hear from him. His body was never found, nor was his brother's.
paras.zh: 这是他的家人最后一次收到他的消息。他的尸体从未被发现，他兄弟的尸体也没有被发现。

paras.en: Angela's father and uncle are among the more than 450,664 people killed as part of Colombia's six-decade-long internal armed conflict.
paras.zh: 安吉拉的父亲和叔叔是哥伦比亚长达六年的国内武装冲突中丧生的超过 450,664 人中的一员。

paras.en: In the 23 years since their disappearance, Angela and her family have sought any information they could find about their loved ones' last days. "I have dedicated my life to this search," she told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: 自失踪 23 年来，安吉拉和她的家人一直在寻找有关亲人最后日子的任何信息。 “我将一生奉献给了这次搜索，”她告诉半岛电视台。

paras.en: She credits one institution in particular with helping her find answers: Colombia's Special Jurisdiction for Peace (JEP), a transitional justice court.
paras.zh: 她特别感谢一个机构帮助她找到了答案：哥伦比亚和平特别管辖权（JEP），一个过渡时期司法法院。

paras.en: Set up in 2016 as part of a peace deal between the government and the Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC), the country's largest rebel group at the time, the court handles the prosecution and investigation of crimes committed during the conflict.
paras.zh: 该法院成立于 2016 年，是政府与当时最大的反叛组织哥伦比亚革命武装力量 (FARC) 之间达成的和平协议的一部分，负责对冲突期间所犯罪行进行起诉和调查。

paras.en: But victims, their loved ones and even some former fighters fear that budget cuts could gut JEP, leaving the court unable to fulfil its mission.
paras.zh: 但受害者、他们的亲人，甚至一些前战士担心预算削减可能会削弱 JEP，导致法院无法履行其使命。

paras.en: This month, the administration of right-wing President Abelardo de la Espriella announced it would enact a 2027 budget with dramatic reductions for government bodies like JEP.
paras.zh: 本月，右翼总统阿韦拉多·德拉埃斯普里埃拉 (Abelardo de la Espriella) 的政府宣布将颁布 2027 年预算，大幅削减 JEP 等政府机构的预算。

paras.en: The total cuts to JEP were valued at around 181 billion Colombian pesos, or roughly $57m.
paras.zh: JEP 的总削减额约为 1,810 亿哥伦比亚比索，约合 5,700 万美元。

paras.en: On Wednesday, a Senate committee also advanced a bill to eliminate JEP altogether by March 2028, with a proposal to transfer its functions to the general court system.
paras.zh: 周三，参议院委员会还提出了一项法案，要求在 2028 年 3 月之前完全消除 JEP，并提议将其职能转移给普通法院系统。

paras.en: Angela, however, credits JEP with offering closure that the criminal justice system was never able to provide. She worries that slashing the court's funding — much less shuttering it entirely — could derail its work.
paras.zh: 然而，安吉拉认为 JEP 提供了刑事司法系统永远无法提供的解决方案。她担心削减法院的资金——更不用说完全关闭法院——可能会破坏其工作。

paras.en: Through JEP, Angela learned about her father and uncle's time in captivity, as well as the site of their execution. JEP has also worked with former FARC members to try to locate their remains.
paras.zh: 通过 JEP，安吉拉了解了她父亲和叔叔被囚禁的经历，以及他们被处决的地点。 JEP 还与前哥伦比亚革命武装力量成员合作，试图找到他们的遗骸。

paras.en: "Fewer resources mean fewer missions to the field to find answers, less humanitarian personnel," Angela said, bracing for the cuts.
paras.zh: 安吉拉在为削减做好准备时说：“资源减少意味着前往实地寻找答案的任务减少，人道主义人员也减少。”

paras.en: "It probably means that we will never be able to return to the site."
paras.zh: “这可能意味着我们永远无法返回现场。”

paras.en: De la Espriella has framed the budget reduction as necessary to combat Colombia's rising public debt, which exceeds $370bn.
paras.zh: 德拉埃斯普里埃拉认为，为了应对哥伦比亚不断上升的公共债务（超过 3700 亿美元），必须削减预算。

paras.en: "It is my duty to manage spending, demand results, and allocate the government's limited resources to a justice system that serves everyone," de la Espriella wrote in a September statement, defending his decision to trim JEP's funding.
paras.zh: 德拉埃斯普里埃拉在 9 月份的一份声明中写道，“我有责任管理支出、要求结果，并将政府有限的资源分配给为所有人服务的司法系统。”他为自己削减 JEP 资金的决定辩护。

paras.en: He estimated that its payroll budget alone was north of 404 billion pesos, or $127m, in 2026.
paras.zh: 他估计，到 2026 年，仅工资预算就超过 4040 亿比索（1.27 亿美元）。

paras.en: Critics, however, have questioned whether austerity is the motive for the downsizing.
paras.zh: 然而，批评者质疑紧缩政策是否是裁员的动机。

paras.en: At around 634 trillion pesos or $200bn, de la Espriella's 2027 budget increases spending overall.
paras.zh: de la Espriella 的 2027 年预算增加了总体支出，约为 634 万亿比索（2000 亿美元）。

paras.en: Passed by presidential decree, the budget is considered the largest spending package in the history of the country.
paras.zh: 该预算经总统令通过，被认为是该国历史上最大的支出计划。

paras.en: But de la Espriella has targeted JEP for reasons beyond its cost. He has repeatedly criticised JEP as slow and ineffective, failing to deliver on its promises of justice.
paras.zh: 但德拉埃斯普里埃拉瞄准 JEP 的原因不仅仅是其成本。他多次批评 JEP 行动缓慢、效率低下，未能兑现正义的承诺。

paras.en: He has also slammed the court's investigations as biased against military members — and too lenient on rebels.
paras.zh: 他还抨击法院的调查对军人存在偏见，而且对叛乱分子过于宽容。

paras.en: In an interview with the radio show Recap Blu, he accused JEP of "persecuting the heroes of the homeland" while "washing the hands of the guerrillas who committed crimes against humanity".
paras.zh: 在接受广播节目Recap Blu采访时，他指责JEP“迫害祖国的英雄”，同时“为犯下反人类罪的游击队洗白”。

paras.en: But many victims' rights advocates dispute that assessment.
paras.zh: 但许多受害者权利倡导者对这一评估提出异议。

paras.en: Ana Maria Rodriguez, a lawyer who represents victims of Colombia's conflict, described the accusation of bias as "patently false".
paras.zh: 代表哥伦比亚冲突受害者的律师安娜·玛丽亚·罗德里格斯 (Ana Maria Rodriguez) 表示，这种偏见指控“明显是错误的”。

paras.en: She pointed out that JEP has convicted some of the top leadership in the FARC, the rebel group that disarmed as part of the 2016 peace deal.
paras.zh: 她指出，JEP 已对哥伦比亚革命武装力量 (FARC) 的一些高层领导定罪，该叛乱组织根据 2016 年和平协议解除了武装。

paras.en: “It hasn’t been perfect or complete,” Rodriguez said of the JEP's work. "But the peace process here has become a model studied by other countries around the world. We have to keep this process functional.”
paras.zh: “它并不完美或完整，”罗德里格斯在谈到 JEP 的工作时说道。 “但这里的和平进程已成为世界其他国家研究的典范。我们必须保持这一进程的运转。”

paras.en: She believes that cuts to the court's budget will lead to fewer convictions, furthering impunity rather than preventing it.
paras.zh: 她认为，削减法院预算将导致定罪数量减少，从而加剧而不是阻止有罪不罚现象。

paras.en: “Many of the [perpetrators] have never faced any justice mechanisms outside of the JEP,” Rodriguez said.
paras.zh: “许多[肇事者]从未面对过 JEP 之外的任何司法机制，”罗德里格斯说。

paras.en: In its effort to close unsolved cases, the court has offered leniency to soldiers, rebels and other fighters in exchange for cooperation with ongoing investigations.
paras.zh: 在努力结案的过程中，法院对士兵、叛乱分子和其他武装分子表示宽大处理，以换取他们配合正在进行的调查。

paras.en: Those cases typically result in rehabilitation work instead of a prison sentence, with defendants asked to engage in community service.
paras.zh: 这些案件通常会导致康复工作而不是监禁，被告会被要求从事社区服务。

paras.en: Those kinds of sentences have fuelled some of the criticism against JEP. But Rodriguez feels such trade-offs are necessary to offer resolution to victims' families.
paras.zh: 此类判决激起了一些针对 JEP 的批评。但罗德里格斯认为，为了给受害者家属提供解决方案，这种权衡是必要的。

paras.en: After all, more than 100,000 people have been reported missing in Colombia's conflict. Their fate remains unknown.
paras.zh: 毕竟，据报道已有超过 10 万人在哥伦比亚冲突中失踪。他们的命运仍然未知。

paras.en: “It isn’t clear how cases will be able to proceed without witness cooperation programmes," Rodriguez said.
paras.zh: 罗德里格斯说：“目前尚不清楚，如果没有证人合作计划，案件将如何进行。”

paras.en: She predicted that shrinking JEP's funding will be "absolutely disastrous for victims".
paras.zh: 她预测，JEP 资金的缩减将“对受害者来说绝对是灾难性的”。

paras.en: Ahead of the anticipated cuts to JEP this month, more than 20 Colombian Congress members signed an open letter to the International Criminal Court (ICC), asking for help.
paras.zh: 在本月预计削减 JEP 之前，20 多名哥伦比亚国会议员签署了一封致国际刑事法院 (ICC) 的公开信，寻求帮助。

paras.en: The ICC shares a similar mandate as JEP, as both are charged with investigating and prosecuting war crimes.
paras.zh: 国际刑事法院与 JEP 有着相似的职责，因为两者都负责调查和起诉战争罪。

paras.en: The international court was also supportive of the 2016 peace deal that gave rise to JEP's creation.
paras.zh: 国际法院也支持 2016 年和平协议，该协议促成了 JEP 的成立。

paras.en: "We are concerned that [the budget's] approval will jeopardise investigations, trials and the execution of sentences for crimes under the court's jurisdiction," the lawmakers wrote to the ICC, in a request for support.
paras.zh: “我们担心[预算]的批准将危及法院管辖范围内犯罪的调查、审判和判决执行，”议员们在写给国际刑事法院的支持请求中写道。

paras.en: Alberto Yepes, a spokesman for the Colombia-Europe-United States Coordination Group, a human rights coalition, is among those rallying against the JEP cuts.
paras.zh: 人权联盟哥伦比亚-欧洲-美国协调小组的发言人阿尔贝托·耶佩斯 (Alberto Yepes) 是反对 JEP 削减的人士之一。

paras.en: He sees a connection between the attacks on JEP and de la Espriella's heavy-handed approach to law enforcement.
paras.zh: 他认为对 JEP 的攻击与 de la Espriella 的严厉执法方式之间存在联系。

paras.en: De la Espriella, he explained, has modelled his security platform on hardline programmes in countries like El Salvador and Ecuador, where police and soldiers have been granted expanded powers.
paras.zh: 他解释说，德拉埃斯普里埃拉的安全平台以萨尔瓦多和厄瓜多尔等国家的强硬计划为蓝本，这些国家的警察和士兵被授予了更大的权力。

paras.en: Yepes believes that, by weakening JEP, the president may seek to prevent the future prosecution of military leaders in cases involving state crimes.
paras.zh: 耶佩斯认为，通过削弱 JEP，总统可能会寻求阻止未来在涉及国家犯罪的案件中起诉军事领导人。

paras.en: "These policies accompany aggressive new security measures, and combined, I think it seems very clear that this government is seeking impunity for the military," Yepes said.
paras.zh: 耶佩斯说：“这些政策伴随着激进的新安全措施，综合起来，我认为很明显，这个政府正在寻求军方有罪不罚。”

paras.en: In addition to reducing JEP's funding, de la Espriella's government is reportedly weighing a 116-page "counterterrorism" bill that would increase penalties for certain offences, criminalise some forms of protest, and make it more difficult to suspend military operations.
paras.zh: 据报道，除了减少 JEP 的资金外，德拉埃斯普里埃拉政府还在权衡一项长达 116 页的“反恐”法案，该法案将加大对某些犯罪行为的处罚力度，将某些形式的抗议定为刑事犯罪，并加大暂停军事行动的难度。

paras.en: In Yepes's view, the ultimate goal is to shield law enforcement from accountability.
paras.zh: 在耶佩斯看来，最终目标是让执法部门免受问责。

paras.en: "De la Espriella is making decisions for a minority of the people that will benefit from these policies," he said.
paras.zh: “德拉埃斯普里埃拉正在为少数将从这些政策中受益的人做出决定，”他说。

articles.title: Israel is in a political deadlock. What comes next?
articles.author: Itay Stern

paras.en: Israel is in a political deadlock. What comes next?
paras.zh: 以色列陷入政治僵局。接下来会发生什么？

paras.en: TEL AVIV, Israel — Israel's election has produced a political deadlock, leaving neither Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu nor his main challenger, Gadi Eisenkot, with a clear path to forming a government.
paras.zh: 以色列特拉维夫——以色列的选举造成了政治僵局，导致总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡和他的主要挑战者加迪·艾森科特都没有明确的组建政府之路。

paras.en: The final results announced Friday give opposition parties more seats than Netanyahu's right-wing bloc. But Eisenkot, a center-right former military chief of staff, cannot reach a governing majority without the support of predominantly Arab parties — an option Eisenkot's allies repeatedly ruled out during the campaign.
paras.zh: 周五公布的最终结果使反对党获得的席位多于内塔尼亚胡的右翼集团。但中右翼的前军事参谋长艾森科特，如果没有主要阿拉伯政党的支持，就无法获得执政多数——艾森科特的盟友在竞选期间一再排除这一选择。

paras.en: Netanyahu's Likud party received the most votes — winning 27 seats — but his bloc lost the majority it had before the election. The coalition of right-wing, far-right and ultra-Orthodox parties that supported his government won a combined 53 seats. At least 61 seats are needed for a majority in Israel's 120-seat parliament, known as the Knesset.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡领导的利库德集团获得最多选票——赢得 27 个席位——但他的集团失去了选举前的多数席位。支持其政府的右翼、极右翼和极端正统政党联盟总共赢得了 53 个席位。以色列议会（以色列议会）有 120 个席位，要获得多数席位，至少需要 61 个席位。

paras.en: Here is what happens next and the possible paths to a new Israeli government.
paras.zh: 以下是接下来发生的事情以及以色列新政府的可能路径。

paras.en: In the next few days, Israel's president will consult with the leaders of every party elected to parliament. Each party will recommend the party leader it believes should be given the first opportunity to form a coalition.
paras.zh: 在接下来的几天里，以色列总统将与当选议会各党派的领导人进行磋商。每个政党都会推荐其认为应该首先有机会组成联盟的政党领导人。

paras.en: The president is not required to choose the leader of the largest party. Instead, the president selects the candidate considered most likely to assemble a governing coalition.
paras.zh: 总统无需选择最大政党的领导人。相反，总统选择被认为最有可能组建执政联盟的候选人。

paras.en: That candidate is given 28 days to secure the support of at least 61 lawmakers. The president may grant an extension of up to 14 days. If the effort fails, the president can give another candidate an opportunity to form a government.
paras.zh: 该候选人有 28 天的时间来获得至少 61 名立法者的支持。总统可授予最多 14 天的延期。如果努力失败，总统可以给另一位候选人组建政府的机会。

paras.en: The process could take weeks, or months, or end without anyone assembling a majority.
paras.zh: 这个过程可能需要数周或数月的时间，或者在没有任何人获得多数票的情况下结束。

paras.en: Who is most likely to get the first opportunity to form a coalition?
paras.zh: 谁最有可能获得第一个组建联盟的机会？

paras.en: Based on the election results, Eisenkot appears more likely than Netanyahu to receive the largest number of recommendations from newly elected lawmakers.
paras.zh: 根据选举结果，艾森科特似乎比内塔尼亚胡更有可能获得新当选立法者最多的建议。

paras.en: But that does not mean Eisenkot — a relative newcomer to politics — will be able to form a coalition. The group of parties he campaigned with won 48 seats.
paras.zh: 但这并不意味着艾森科特——一个相对较新的政坛新人——将能够组建联盟。他竞选的政党集团赢得了 48 个席位。

paras.en: If his bloc allies with Arab-led parties, which won a historic 19 seats, that would form a majority. Palestinian citizens of Israel represent 21% of the population.
paras.zh: 如果他的集团与阿拉伯领导的政党结盟，赢得历史性的 19 个席位，那么这将构成多数​​。以色列的巴勒斯坦公民占人口的21%。

paras.en: But Eisenkot and others in his bloc have promised not rely on Arab parties' support. Eisenkot has said the Arab parties' positions on Hamas and the war in Gaza prevent him from governing with them — some have refused to endorse the military goal of eliminating Hamas, or condemning it as a terrorist organization. Other leaders in his bloc made similar statements before and after the election.
paras.zh: 但艾森科特和他的集团中的其他人承诺不依赖阿拉伯政党的支持。艾森科特表示，阿拉伯政党对哈马斯和加沙战争的立场阻止他与他们一起执政——一些人拒绝支持消灭哈马斯的军事目标，或谴责其为恐怖组织。他所在集团的其他领导人在选举前后也发表了类似的声明。

paras.en: Netanyahu faces a different version of the same problem. His traditional coalition partners do not have enough seats to return him to power.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡面临着同一问题的不同版本。他的传统联盟伙伴没有足够的席位让他重新掌权。

paras.en: One possibility is a unity government bringing together Netanyahu and Eisenkot.
paras.zh: 一种可能性是内塔尼亚胡和艾森科特组成联合政府。

paras.en: Israeli and some U.S. media outlets have reported that President Trump may favor such an outcome — although NPR has not independently confirmed the reports. A unity government would likely include more moderate parties from Israel's political center and right.
paras.zh: 以色列和一些美国媒体报道称，特朗普总统可能会支持这样的结果——尽管 NPR 尚未独立证实这些报道。联合政府可能会包括来自以色列政治中间派和右翼的更为温和的政党。

paras.en: President Trump endorsed Netanyahu in the lead-up to the election, and later boasted that he thought it turned the tide in the election.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统在选举前支持内塔尼亚胡，后来吹嘘说他认为这扭转了选举的局势。

paras.en: Such a coalition could make it easier for Israel to work with the Trump administration on its regional priorities, including the reconstruction of Gaza and a potential normalization agreement with Saudi Arabia.
paras.zh: 这样的联盟可以使以色列更容易与特朗普政府就其地区优先事项进行合作，包括加沙的重建以及与沙特阿拉伯的潜在正常化协议。

paras.en: But Eisenkot has repeatedly pledged not to serve in a government led by Netanyahu. The two leaders would also have to resolve questions about who would serve as prime minister and whether the position would rotate between them.
paras.zh: 但艾森科特一再承诺不会在内塔尼亚胡领导的政府中任职。两位领导人还必须解决谁将担任总理以及该职位是否由他们轮流的问题。

paras.en: A second possibility is an Eisenkot government supported by Arab parties.
paras.zh: 第二种可能性是阿拉伯政党支持的艾森科特政府。

paras.en: Together, Eisenkot's bloc and the Arab parties would command a comfortable parliamentary majority of more than 67 seats. But such a coalition remains unlikely because Eisenkot and his allies have repeatedly rejected it.
paras.zh: 艾森科特的集团和阿拉伯政党将共同占据议会多数席位，超过 67 个席位。但这样的联盟仍然不太可能，因为艾森科特和他的盟友一再拒绝。

paras.en: Support from the Arab parties would not necessarily require them to join the government. They could support a minority government from outside the coalition. But that arrangement would still contradict the campaign promises made by Eisenkot and several of his potential partners.
paras.zh: 阿拉伯政党的支持并不一定要求他们加入政府。他们可以支持联盟之外的少数派政府。但这种安排仍然与艾森科特和他的几个潜在合作伙伴做出的竞选承诺相矛盾。

paras.en: A third possibility is another election.
paras.zh: 第三种可能性是再次选举。

paras.en: Israel's president has urged political leaders to avoid sending the country back to the polls, particularly after an election that drew the highest turnout in decades. Israeli President Isaac Herzog said he expects party leaders "to come with an open mind" in their discussions with him.
paras.zh: 以色列总统敦促政治领导人避免让该国重返投票站，特别是在这场投票率达到数十年来最高水平的选举之后。以色列总统艾萨克·赫尔佐格表示，他希望党派领导人在与他的讨论中“以开放的态度”。

paras.en: But if no candidate can assemble a majority, another election remains possible.
paras.zh: 但如果没有候选人能够获得多数席位，则仍有可能举行另一次选举。

paras.en: Netanyahu may believe a repeat election could work in his favor. Arab turnout could decline if Arab voters conclude that the predominantly Jewish opposition parties will not allow their representatives to participate in government. Liberal Israelis who traveled from overseas to vote in this election may also be less likely to return for another vote.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡可能认为再次选举可能对他有利。如果阿拉伯选民认为以犹太人为主的反对党不会允许其代表参与政府，那么阿拉伯选民的投票率可能会下降。从海外前往本次选举投票的自由派以色列人也不太可能返回另一次投票。

paras.en: A fourth possibility is that one bloc persuades lawmakers from the opposing camp to defect to their side.
paras.zh: 第四种可能性是，一个集团说服对方阵营的议员倒戈到自己一边。

paras.en: That would be difficult under the current results. Netanyahu would need to attract roughly eight lawmakers from outside his bloc. Eisenkot would need approximately 13 defectors if he continued to exclude the Arab parties — a scenario that currently appears highly unlikely.
paras.zh: 从目前的结果来看，这将是困难的。内塔尼亚胡需要吸引来自其集团之外的大约八名议员。如果艾森科特继续排除阿拉伯政党，他将需要大约 13 名叛逃者——目前看来这种情况极不可能发生。

paras.en: How can the opposition undermine Netanyahu during this stalemate?
paras.zh: 在这场僵局中，反对派如何削弱内塔尼亚胡的影响？

paras.en: A parliamentary majority opposed to Netanyahu could begin advancing legislation before a new government is formed, with support from Arab lawmakers.
paras.zh: 在阿拉伯立法者的支持下，反对内塔尼亚胡的议会多数派可以在新政府组建之前开始推进立法。

paras.en: Eisenkot's bloc is considering an effort to replace the speaker of the Knesset, a powerful position that helps determine parliament's legislative agenda.
paras.zh: 艾森科特的集团正在考虑更换议长，这是一个有助于确定议会立法议程的重要职位。

paras.en: The bloc also hopes to pass legislation establishing a state commission of inquiry into the political and security failures that preceded the Hamas-led attack on Israel on Oct. 7, 2023.
paras.zh: 欧盟还希望通过立法，成立一个国家调查委员会，对 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯领导的袭击以色列之前的政治和安全失败进行调查。

paras.en: Eisenkot's allies could also try to reverse legislation advanced by Netanyahu's government that critics say weakened Israel's democratic institutions and judicial independence.
paras.zh: 艾森科特的盟友还可能试图推翻内塔尼亚胡政府提出的立法，批评者称这些立法削弱了以色列的民主制度和司法独立。

paras.en: These steps would not, by themselves, establish a new government. But they would allow Netanyahu's opponents to exercise significant power in parliament while coalition negotiations continue.
paras.zh: 这些步骤本身并不会建立新政府。但他们将允许内塔尼亚胡的反对者在议会中行使重要权力，同时联合谈判继续进行。

paras.en: Could a renewed war with Iran affect the political negotiations?
paras.zh: 与伊朗重新开战会影响政治谈判吗？

paras.en: In his election night speech, Netanyahu said Israel still had to complete its mission against Iran and permanently remove what he described as an existential threat.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡在选举之夜的讲话中表示，以色列仍然必须完成针对伊朗的使命，并永久消除他所说的生存威胁。

paras.en: On the same night, Eisenkot warned Netanyahu not to use "Israel's security for your political needs."
paras.zh: 同一天晚上，艾森科特警告内塔尼亚胡不要利用“以色列的安全来满足你的政治需要”。

paras.en: A renewed war with Iran, particularly one involving the United States, could disrupt the opposition's planned legislative moves. It could also increase public and political pressure on Eisenkot to enter an emergency unity government with Netanyahu.
paras.zh: 与伊朗重新爆发战争，特别是涉及美国的战争，可能会扰乱反对派计划的立法行动。它还可能增加艾森科特与内塔尼亚胡组成紧急联合政府的公众和政治压力。

paras.en: A similar dynamic followed the Oct. 7 attack. Eisenkot joined Netanyahu's emergency government and war Cabinet, before resigning eight months later. Eisenkot said Netanyahu was making decisions based on political considerations rather than Israel's national interests.
paras.zh: 10 月 7 日的袭击事件后也出现了类似的情况。艾森科特加入了内塔尼亚胡的紧急政府和战时内阁，八个月后辞职。艾森科特表示，内塔尼亚胡的决定是基于政治考虑，而不是以色列的国家利益。

paras.en: Danny Citrinowicz, an Israeli analyst on Iran, said Netanyahu has a political incentive to renew the fighting while negotiations over a new government are underway.
paras.zh: 以色列问题伊朗问题分析师丹尼·西特里诺维奇表示，在新政府谈判正在进行之际，内塔尼亚胡有重启战斗的政治动机。

paras.en: "Netanyahu definitely has an incentive to go to war," Citrinowicz said. "He understands that returning to war against Iran while a government is being formed would serve his interests. When you have an emergency in Israel, the pressure on Eisenkot to enter some sort of unity government would obviously mount."
paras.zh: “内塔尼亚胡肯定有发动战争的动机，”西特里诺维奇说。 “他明白，在政府组建期间重返对伊朗的战争符合他的利益。当以色列出现紧急情况时，艾森科特加入某种联合政府的压力显然会增加。”

paras.en: Daniel Estrin in Tel Aviv contributed to this story
paras.zh: 特拉维夫的丹尼尔·埃斯特林 (Daniel Estrin) 对这个故事做出了贡献

articles.title: Alaska's Senate race faces claims of spoiler candidate. And, Hegseth ousts Army general
articles.author: Brittney Melton

paras.en: Alaska's Senate race faces claims of spoiler candidate. And, Hegseth ousts Army general
paras.zh: 阿拉斯加州的参议员竞选面临着破坏候选人的指控。并且，赫格斯驱逐了陆军将军

paras.en: It is the final stretch before Election Day on Tuesday and candidates are making final campaign stops and delivering closing arguments. President Trump has been campaigning for at-risk Republicans, but he has abruptly switched to virtual rallies.
paras.zh: 这是周二选举日之前的最后阶段，候选人正在进行最后的竞选活动并发表结案陈词。特朗普总统一直在为面临风险的共和党人竞选，但他突然转向虚拟集会。

paras.en: - 🎧 Trump's tour to boost voter turnout has focused largely on competitive Republican-leaning states, NPR's Saige Miller tells Up First. He's hosting 19 telerallies alongside in-person events. The shift in strategy, plus polling data, suggests that Republicans may face challenges, at least in the House, Miller says. Trump knows he's a key motivator for his party, but his strategy could also backfire by energizing Democrats.
paras.zh: - NPR 的 Saige Miller 告诉 Up First，特朗普为提高选民投票率而进行的巡演主要集中在有竞争力的倾向共和党的州。他主持了 19 场电视集会以及现场活动。米勒表示，策略的转变加上民意调查数据表明共和党人可能面临挑战，至少在众议院是这样。特朗普知道他是民主党的关键推动者，但他的策略也可能因激励民主党而适得其反。

paras.en: - 🎧 Alaska's governor has ordered an investigation following a New York Times report on the state's toss-up U.S. Senate race. The article revealed that Democratic campaign operatives were attempting to recruit a candidate, whom Republicans claim could confuse voters and siphon support from GOP incumbent Dan Sullivan. The candidate also shares the name Dan Sullivan. Democrat Mary Peltola, a former congresswoman, aims to flip the seat. Alaska Public Media's Liz Ruskin spoke with election law experts, who found no applicable laws but noted that the conduct described crosses moral and ethical lines.
paras.zh: - 🎧 在《纽约时报》报道该州美国参议院选举悬而未决的情况后，阿拉斯加州州长已下令对此进行调查。文章透露，民主党竞选人员正试图招募一名候选人，共和党人声称该候选人可能会迷惑选民并窃取共和党现任总统丹·沙利文的支持。该候选人的名字也为丹·沙利文。前国会女议员、民主党人玛丽·佩尔托拉(Mary Peltola)的目标是翻转席位。阿拉斯加公共媒体的利兹·罗斯金与选举法专家进行了交谈，他们没有找到适用的法律，但指出所描述的行为跨越了道德和伦理界限。

paras.en: - ➡️ The Department of Justice subpoenaed election workers in Los Angeles amid rising tensions with California officials over the Trump administration's efforts to identify noncitizens on voter rolls.
paras.zh: - ➡️ 由于特朗普政府试图识别选民名册上的非公民身份，司法部与加州官员之间的紧张关系日益紧张，司法部传唤了洛杉矶的选举工作人员。

paras.en: - ➡️ At the start of this election cycle, Democrats appeared unlikely to gain Senate seats because many races were in red states. But the ongoing war in Iran has changed the landscape. Here are the key Senate races to watch.
paras.zh: - ➡️ 在本次选举周期开始时，民主党似乎不太可能获得参议院席位，因为许多竞选都在红色州进行。但伊朗持续的战争改变了局面。以下是值得关注的关键参议院竞选。

paras.en: - ➡️ NPR member stations are compiling essential info for voters, from guides to local races. Discover resources in your community here.
paras.zh: - ➡️ NPR 成员电台正在为选民收集重要信息，从指南到当地种族。在这里发现您社区中的资源。

paras.en: - ➡️ The NPR App has all of NPR's election coverage in one place — from the biggest stories across the country, to the issues that matter close to home. Browse headlines, playlists, podcast episodes, videos and more, all on the 2026 Election tab.
paras.zh: - ➡️ NPR 应用程序将 NPR 的所有选举报道集中在一个地方 - 从全国最大的新闻到与家庭息息相关的问题。浏览头条新闻、播放列表、播客剧集、视频等，所有这些都在 2026 年选举选项卡上。

paras.en: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has dismissed Army Lt. Gen. Brett Sylvia, who oversaw planning at the Pentagon. Sylvia was also part of the Joint Chiefs of Staff. His removal comes as the U.S. and Israel prepare for a new potential round of attacks against Iran. Although Sylvia held a senior position in strategy, planning and policy, he was not directly involved in day-to-day operations regarding the Iran conflict.
paras.zh: 国防部长皮特·赫格斯解雇了负责五角大楼规划的陆军中将布雷特·西尔维亚。西尔维娅也是参谋长联席会议的成员。他被免职之际，美国和以色列正准备对伊朗发动新一轮潜在袭击。尽管西尔维娅在战略、规划和政策方面担任高级职务，但他并未直接参与有关伊朗冲突的日常行动。

paras.en: - 🎧 The Pentagon is investigating a leak but has not provided details, NPR's Greg Myre says. Hegseth has dismissed several generals and admirals, often without explanation. These firings have disrupted senior military operations, Myre says. The U.S. currently has two aircraft carriers in the Arabian Sea, with a third, the USS Theodore Roosevelt, en route. According to Myre, it is unusual for the U.S. to have multiple carriers in one region. The last time it stationed three in the Middle East was during the 2003 invasion of Iraq.
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 的格雷格·迈尔 (Greg Myre) 表示，五角大楼正在调查泄密事件，但尚未提供详细信息。赫格塞斯解雇了几位将军和海军上将，而且往往没有给出任何解释。迈雷说，这些解雇扰乱了高级军事行动。美国目前在阿拉伯海有两艘航空母舰，第三艘航空母舰西奥多·罗斯福号正在航行中。迈尔表示，美国在一个地区拥有多家运营商的情况并不常见。上一次在中东驻扎三艘是在2003年入侵伊拉克期间。

paras.en: Thousands of military veterans with VA-backed mortgages have faced higher interest rates and monthly payments since last year, after the Trump administration shut down a key part of the VA's home loan program. Before it was shut down, the Veterans Affairs Servicing Purchase (VASP) program, created under the Biden administration, helped tens of thousands of veterans who had fallen behind on their payments by rolling missed payments into a new, low-interest mortgage. The mortgage industry and housing groups warned the administration not to kill the program without first creating a viable replacement. Without one, vets had to modify loans at higher interest rates. An NPR investigation found that more than 15,000 veterans experienced monthly payment increases of at least $150 after their loans were modified due to financial hardship. More than 700 veterans saw their payments rise by $1,000 or more.
paras.zh: 自去年特朗普政府关闭退伍军人管理局住房贷款计划的一个关键部分后，数千名拥有退伍军人管理局支持的抵押贷款的退伍军人面临着更高的利率和月供。在拜登政府创建的退伍军人事务服务购买（VASP）计划被关闭之前，该计划通过将拖欠的付款转入新的低息抵押贷款，帮助了数万名拖欠付款的退伍军人。抵押贷款行业和住房团体警告政府，在没有首先制定可行的替代方案之前，不要终止该计划。如果没有这一条件，退伍军人就必须以更高的利率修改贷款。 NPR 的一项调查发现，超过 15,000 名退伍军人因经济困难而修改贷款后，每月付款至少增加 150 美元。 700 多名退伍军人的付款增加了 1,000 美元或更多。

paras.en: by Rob Stein, NPR's science desk correspondent and senior editor
paras.zh: 作者：Rob Stein，NPR 科学台记者兼高级编辑

paras.en: I've been doing stories about the organ transplantation system for decades. One of the most fundamental guiding ethical principles in organ donation has long been the "dead donor rule." That rule, stated simply, says: Organs should only be retrieved for transplants from a person who is dead, and death should never be accelerated to try to boost the chances their organs will be usable. To make sure that's the case, there's long been a strict firewall between the doctors and nurses trying to save patients in the hospital, and the organ retrieval teams standing by to try to procure their organs.
paras.zh: 几十年来我一直在写有关器官移植系统的故事。长期以来，器官捐献最基本的道德指导原则之一就是“死亡捐献者规则”。这条规则简单地说就是：只能从死者身上取出器官用于移植，并且永远不应该为了增加器官可用的机会而加速死亡。为了确保情况确实如此，医院里试图抢救病人的医生和护士与随时待命试图获取他们器官的器官检索小组之间一直存在着严格的防火墙。

paras.en: But over the years, I've heard many stories from family members who nevertheless felt pressured to donate their loved one's organs. So when I got a tip that the Organ Procurement & Transplantation Network, which runs the nation's organ system, was planning to relax that firewall, I instantly knew that was a big story.
paras.zh: 但多年来，我从家人那里听到了许多故事，他们仍然感到捐献亲人器官的压力。因此，当我得知负责管理国家器官系统的器官采购和移植网络计划放松防火墙时，我立即知道这是一个大新闻。

paras.en: I rushed to confirm the documentation that the network's board of directors had indeed endorsed the change, which would go into effect Nov. 18. I then reached out to bioethicists and others for their reaction to this major change. The revision was part of a set of new policies designed to boost donations and improve patient safety. Those changes were spurred by disturbing revelations about mistakes, including patients literally being wheeled into the operating room to remove their organs when they were still alive. Some of the changes were praised as improving safety. But many bioethicists and even some transplant surgeons and patient and organ donation advocates say relaxing the firewall between care and organ retrieval teams is dangerous. The fear is it could lead to families and caregivers discontinuing treatment too soon, and deepening distrust in the organ donation system.
paras.zh: 我赶紧确认文件，证明网络董事会确实批准了这一变更，该变更将于 11 月 18 日生效。然后我联系了生物伦理学家和其他人，了解他们对这一重大变更的反应。此次修订是旨在增加捐赠和改善患者安全的一系列新政策的一部分。这些变化是由于有关错误的令人不安的揭露而引发的，包括患者在活着的时候被推入手术室切除器官。其中一些变化因提高安全性而受到称赞。但许多生物伦理学家，甚至一些移植外科医生以及患者和器官捐赠倡导者表示，放松护理和器官检索团队之间的防火墙是危险的。人们担心这可能会导致家人和护理人员过早停止治疗，并加深对器官捐献系统的不信任。

paras.en: I explored what these rule changes will mean for organ donors. You can read about it here.
paras.zh: 我探讨了这些规则的变化对器官捐献者意味着什么。您可以在这里阅读相关内容。

articles.title: Blockchain intelligence firms link North Korea to $6.3B hack on Binance
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: Blockchain intelligence firms link North Korea to $6.3B hack on Binance
paras.zh: 区块链情报公司将朝鲜与币安 6.3B 美元黑客事件联系起来

paras.en: A U.S.-based blockchain intelligence firm says a North Korean unit was likely behind the hack that impacted more than $6 billion on Binance, the world's biggest cryptocurrency exchange.
paras.zh: 一家总部位于美国的区块链情报公司表示，朝鲜单位可能是此次黑客攻击的幕后黑手，此次黑客攻击对全球最大的加密货币交易所币安造成了超过 60 亿美元的损失。

paras.en: Binance said it worked with blockchain partners to freeze roughly $3 billion in affected assets. It said Friday that it was beginning to recover assets for users.
paras.zh: 币安表示，它与区块链合作伙伴合作冻结了大约 30 亿美元的受影响资产。该公司周五表示，已开始为用户追回资产。

paras.en: The cryptocurrency exchange said deposits were unaffected, while withdrawals have been suspended and are expected to resume in the next day or two. It said it will cover all losses.
paras.zh: 该加密货币交易所表示，存款不受影响，而提款已暂停，预计将在未来一两天内恢复。它表示将弥补所有损失。

paras.en: The company said on X that an initial investigation suggested the incident may have involved a compromised laptop, but that a subsequent investigation uncovered additional "points of breach."
paras.zh: 该公司在 X 上表示，初步调查表明该事件可能涉及一台遭到入侵的笔记本电脑，但随后的调查发现了其他“违规点”。

paras.en: TRM, in a post on its website Thursday, attributed the attack to TraderTraitor, which it described as North Korea's elite hacking unit. "We make this judgment with high confidence," the firm said.
paras.zh: TRM 周四在其网站上发布帖子，将此次攻击归咎于 TraderTraitor，并将其描述为朝鲜的精英黑客组织。该公司表示：“我们非常有信心地做出这一判断。”

paras.en: "An attacker moved approximately USD 6.36 billion out of Binance wallets on ten blockchains, most of it in about 20 minutes," TRM said. That would make the hack the largest cryptocurrency theft on record, it said.
paras.zh: TRM 表示：“攻击者从十个区块链上的币安钱包中转移了约 63.6 亿美元，其中大部分在大约 20 分钟内转移。”据称，这将使此次黑客攻击成为有记录以来最大的加密货币盗窃案。

paras.en: In February last year, another cryptocurrency exchange, Bybit, suffered a $1.5 billion hit when it was hacked. The FBI said North Korea and TraderTraitor were responsible for the hack.
paras.zh: 去年2月，另一家加密货币交易所Bybit遭受黑客攻击，损失达15亿美元。美国联邦调查局 (FBI) 表示，朝鲜和 TraderTraitor 对此次黑客攻击负有责任。

paras.en: "Several features of this attack match earlier North Korea-linked heists, including the Bybit hack," TRM said.
paras.zh: TRM 表示：“这次攻击的几个特征与之前与朝鲜有关的抢劫事件相符，包括 Bybit 黑客攻击。”

paras.en: Blockchain analysis company Chainalysis also believed the Binance hack was "likely done by DPRK group TraderTraitor," its co-founder and CEO Jonathan Levin wrote on X. DPRK stands for the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, North Korea's official name.
paras.zh: 区块链分析公司 Chainaanalysis 的联合创始人兼首席执行官 Jonathan Levin 在 X 上写道，币安的黑客攻击“很可能是由 DPRK 组织 TraderTraitor 所为”。DPRK 代表朝鲜民主主义人民共和国，这是朝鲜的官方名称。

paras.en: Asked about the potential ties to North Korea, a Binance spokesperson said only that the company is "working closely with our law enforcement partners to confirm the identity of the criminals and bring them to justice."
paras.zh: 当被问及与朝鲜的潜在联系时，币安发言人仅表示，该公司正在“与我们的执法合作伙伴密切合作，以确认犯罪分子的身份并将他们绳之以法”。

paras.en: Experts say North Korea has turned to crypto hacking and other illicit cyber activities as a source of badly needed foreign currency to support its troubled economy and fund its nuclear program in the wake of tough U.N. sanctions and other difficulties.
paras.zh: 专家表示，在联合国严厉制裁和其他困难之后，朝鲜已转向加密黑客和其他非法网络活动作为急需的外汇来源，以支持其陷入困境的经济并为其核计划提供资金。

paras.en: In December 2022, South Korea's spy agency said North Korean hackers had stolen an estimated 1.5 trillion won ($1.1 billion) in cryptocurrency and other virtual assets in the past five years, more than half of it in 2022 alone. It said North Korea's capacity to steal digital assets was considered among the best in the world.
paras.zh: 2022 年 12 月，韩国间谍机构表示，朝鲜黑客在过去五年中窃取了估计 1.5 万亿韩元（11 亿美元）的加密货币和其他虚拟资产，仅 2022 年就窃取了一半以上。报告称，朝鲜窃取数字资产的能力被认为是世界上最好的。

paras.en: Changpeng Zhao, also known as CZ, founded Binance in 2017. In 2023, he pleaded guilty to a felony linked to failing to prevent money laundering on the platform, and stepped down as the company's CEO. U.S. President Donald Trump pardoned Zhao in 2025.
paras.zh: 赵长鹏，又名 CZ，于 2017 年创立了币安。2023 年，他承认了与未能防止平台洗钱有关的重罪，并辞去了公司首席执行官的职务。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普于 2025 年赦免了赵。

paras.en: Zhao posted Thursday on X that "User funds are safe!" but added that the theft "does look like a hack on Binance." He added that while he doesn't manage Binance anymore, "as a shareholder, I expect all user funds will be fully covered."
paras.zh: 赵周四在X上发帖称“用户资金是安全的！”但他补充说，这起盗窃事件“看起来确实像是对币安的黑客攻击”。他补充说，虽然他不再管理币安，但“作为股东，我预计所有用户资金都将得到全额保障。”

paras.en: The event, meanwhile, also raises questions about why stronger approval controls were not in place, said Kok Tin Gan, cofounder and CEO of cybersecurity firm NyxLab.
paras.zh: 与此同时，网络安全公司 NyxLab 联合创始人兼首席执行官 Kok Tin Gan 表示，此次活动也引发了人们的疑问，即为什么没有实施更强有力的审批控制。

paras.en: "This looks like one signature that gave the attacker a never-expiring, full-access token to a Binance hot wallet," he said, referring to cryptocurrency wallets that hold users' "private keys," or unique authorizations, digitally and which are connected to the internet.
paras.zh: 他说：“这看起来像是一个签名，它为攻击者提供了一个永不过期、完全访问币安热钱包的令牌。”他指的是以数字方式保存用户“私钥”或唯一授权并连接到互联网的加密货币钱包。

paras.en: Binance said on X it had "found no evidence of any wallet private key leak" and that the company would release more technical details when its probe is complete.
paras.zh: 币安在 X 上表示，“没有发现任何钱包私钥泄露的证据”，该公司将在调查完成后发布更多技术细节。

paras.zh: 您将获得近两年的无息喘息空间，这可以在您还清债务的同时节省大量资金。

paras.en: If you're looking for cash back or travel rewards, this is not the card for you. The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card has no rewards program and no welcome bonus. It loses most of its value the moment the intro period ends.
paras.zh: 如果您正在寻求现金返还或旅行奖励，那么这张卡不适合您。 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡没有奖励计划，也没有欢迎奖金。一旦介绍期结束，它就失去了大部分价值。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card's headline feature is 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers. (A 17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR applies after.)
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的主要特点是，自开户购买和合格余额转账起 21 个月内，年利率为 0%。 （此后适用 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率。）

paras.en: That's one of the longest 0% APR periods you'll find anywhere -- which is why it earned Motley Fool Money's award for Best 0% Intro APR Card of 2026.
paras.zh: 这是您能在任何地方找到的最长的 0% 年利率卡之一 - 这就是为什么它获得 Motley Fool Money 颁发的 2026 年最佳 0% 年利率介绍卡奖。

paras.en: This long intro APR is particularly handy for large balances (think anything $5,000+). The longer the promo window, the less you need to pay each month to clear your balance while paying no interest.
paras.zh: 这个长篇介绍年利率对于大额余额（想想任何 5,000 美元以上的东西）特别方便。促销窗口越长，您每月需要支付的费用就越少，无需支付利息即可结清余额。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges no annual fee, so it costs nothing to keep in your wallet. For anyone building credit history -- or, like me, holding onto a top credit card for the long haul -- that's a real plus.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不收取年费，因此放在钱包中无需支付任何费用。对于任何建立信用记录的人来说——或者像我一样长期持有顶级信用卡——这是一个真正的优势。

paras.en: Keeping the card open can help your credit score by lengthening your average credit history over time.
paras.zh: 保持信用卡开放可以随着时间的推移延长您的平均信用记录，从而提高您的信用评分。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card includes cellphone protection when you pay your monthly phone bill with the card. It covers up to $600 per claim for theft or damage, with a $25 deductible, and you can file up to two claims per 12-month period.
paras.zh: 当您使用 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡支付每月的电话费时，该卡包含手机保护功能。每次盗窃或损坏索赔的赔付额最高为 600 美元，免赔额为 25 美元，并且每 12 个月最多可以提出两次索赔。

paras.en: I've never had to use cellphone insurance, but as a frequent phone-dropper and generally clumsy person, I've always loved having it in my back pocket.
paras.zh: 我从来没有使用过手机保险，但作为一个经常丢手机而且通常很笨拙的人，我一直喜欢把它放在我的后口袋里。

paras.en: We recommend comparing options to ensure the card you're selecting is the best fit for you. To make your search easier, here's a short list of standout credit cards.
paras.zh: 我们建议比较选项，以确保您选择的卡最适合您。为了让您的搜索更容易，这里列出了一些优秀的信用卡。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card earns no rewards. If you want a card with long-term perks like cash back or travel points, this isn't it.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不赚取任何奖励。如果您想要一张具有现金返还或旅行积分等长期福利的卡，那么这张卡不合适。

paras.en: A strong alternative is the Wells Fargo Active Cash® Card (rates and fees), which earns a flat 2% cash rewards on purchases for a $0 annual fee. It's our Best Overall Credit Card of 2026, and a fan favorite for flat-rate rewards.
paras.zh: 一个强有力的替代方案是 Wells Fargo Active Cash® 卡（费率和费用），该卡以 0 美元年费购买即可获得 2% 的固定现金奖励。这是我们 2026 年最佳综合信用卡，也是粉丝最喜欢的统一费率奖励信用卡。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges a balance transfer fee of 5%, min: $5 -- this is on the high side for a balance transfer card.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡收取 5% 的余额转账费用，最低 5 美元——这对于余额转账卡来说偏高。

paras.en: If you move a $10,000 balance, you'd owe a $500 fee, even though you'd pay the balance off at 0% during the intro period.
paras.zh: 如果您转移 10,000 美元的余额，则需要支付 500 美元的费用，即使您在介绍期内以 0% 的利率还清余额。

paras.en: Run the math before you transfer, because the fee should cost less than the interest you'd otherwise pay. If you won't clear the balance within the 0% APR period, then an alternative balance transfer card with a lower transfer fee may serve you better.
paras.zh: 在转账之前先计算一下，因为费用应该低于您原本支付的利息。如果您无法在 0% 年利率期间清除余额，那么转账费用较低的替代余额转账卡可能会为您提供更好的服务。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges a 3% foreign transaction fee, so you'll pay extra on purchases made outside the U.S. If you travel abroad and want to skip that cost, consider one of our favorite travel credit cards.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡收取 3% 的国外交易费，因此您在美国境外购物时需要支付额外费用。如果您出国旅行并想跳过这笔费用，请考虑我们最喜欢的旅行信用卡之一。

paras.en: It also has no purchase protection or extended warranty on purchases.
paras.zh: 它也没有购买保护或延长购买保修。

paras.en: You'll generally need good to excellent credit (Motley Fool Money estimates this to be a FICO® Score of about 670 or higher) to qualify for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card. Wells Fargo doesn't publish an official cutoff, and applicants closer to 700 tend to be the best-qualified candidates.
paras.zh: 您通常需要良好到优秀的信用（Motley Fool Money 估计 FICO® 分数约为 670 或更高）才有资格获得 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡。富国银行没有公布官方截止日期，接近 700 名的申请者往往是最合格的候选人。

paras.en: Keep in mind, your score isn't the only factor. Wells Fargo also weighs your income, existing debt, and overall credit history. You can check for pre-selected offers on Wells Fargo's site without a hard inquiry to gauge your chances first.
paras.zh: 请记住，您的分数并不是唯一的因素。富国银行还会衡量您的收入、现有债务和整体信用记录。您可以在富国银行网站上查看预先选定的优惠，无需进行严格询问即可首先评估您的机会。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card comes with a minimum credit limit of $1,000, and higher scores and income generally earn higher limits. Wells Fargo sets your limit individually based on your full credit profile, so two applicants can get very different lines of credit.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的最低信用额度为 1,000 美元，分数和收入越高，信用额度通常越高。富国银行根据您的完整信用状况单独设置您的限额，因此两个申请人可以获得截然不同的信用额度。

paras.en: Your starting limit isn't permanent, though. Once your account is open and in good standing, usually after six to 12 months, you can request an increase. Or, Wells Fargo may raise it automatically for on-time payments and low utilization.
paras.zh: 不过，您的起始限制并不是永久的。一旦您的账户开设且信誉良好，通常在 6 到 12 个月后，您就可以请求增加金额。或者，富国银行可能会因按时付款和利用率低而自动提高费用。

paras.en: To get the 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on qualifying balance transfers (then 17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR), you must complete qualifying transfers within 120 days of opening your account.
paras.zh: 要在开户后 21 个月内通过合格余额转账获得 0% 初始年利率（然后是 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率），您必须在开户后 120 天内完成合格转账。

paras.en: I recommend starting the transfer online or by phone as soon as you're approved. Having your old account details ready speeds things up.
paras.zh: 我建议您在获得批准后立即开始在线或通过电话转移。准备好旧帐户详细信息可以加快速度。

paras.en: One important note: you can't transfer a balance from another Wells Fargo or affiliated card. Transfers have to come from a different issuer, and the 5%, min: $5 transfer fee applies to each one.
paras.zh: 一个重要的注意事项：您无法从另一张富国银行或附属卡转移余额。转账必须来自不同的发行人，并且每笔转账均需缴纳 5%（最低 5 美元）的转账费。

paras.en: Applying for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is quick. Here's what to do:
paras.zh: 申请 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的速度很快。该怎么做：

paras.en: Approvals are usually instant, but can take a few days if Wells Fargo needs to verify some of your information.
paras.zh: 批准通常是即时的，但如果富国银行需要验证您的某些信息，则可能需要几天的时间。

paras.en: Yes, the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is worth it if your priority is paying off debt or financing a large purchase without interest. Very few cards give you a long no-interest runway like this.
paras.zh: 是的，如果您的首要任务是偿还债务或为大额购买提供无息融资，那么 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡是值得的。很少有卡可以给你这样一条漫长的无息跑道。

paras.en: It's not worth it if you want rewards or perks after the intro period, since it offers neither.
paras.zh: 如果您在介绍期后想要奖励或福利，那么这是不值得的，因为它两者都没有提供。

paras.en: Ready to make a dent in your debt? Apply for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card today -- awarded Motley Fool Money's Best 0% Intro APR Card of 2026.
paras.zh: 准备好减少债务了吗？立即申请 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡 - 荣获 Motley Fool Money 2026 年最佳 0% 年利率介绍卡。

paras.en: When the 0% intro APR period ends, any remaining balance starts accruing interest at your regular variable APR from that point forward. The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card doesn't charge deferred or retroactive interest, so you only pay on what's left -- not on the full original balance.
paras.zh: 当 0% 介绍年利率期结束时，任何剩余余额将开始按照您的常规可变年利率计息。 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不收取递延或追溯利息，因此您只需支付剩余金额，而不是全额原始余额。

paras.en: No, the 0% intro APR does not cover cash advances. Cash advances start accruing interest immediately at a separate, higher APR and come with their own fee. The intro offer only applies to purchases and qualifying balance transfers.
paras.zh: 不可以，0% 的年利率不包括现金预支。现金预支立即开始以单独的、较高的年利率计息，并收取自己的费用。介绍优惠仅适用于购买和符合条件的余额转账。

paras.en: Keeping the card open is usually the better move, even after your balance hits $0. If it has no annual fee, it costs nothing to hold, and the open account helps your credit score by supporting your total available credit and length of history.
paras.zh: 即使您的余额达到 0 美元，保持卡打开通常是更好的选择。如果它没有年费，那么持有它就不需要任何成本，并且开放账户通过支持您的总可用信用和历史长度来帮助您的信用评分。

paras.zh: 富国银行是 Motley Fool Money 的广告合作伙伴。乔尔·奥利里 (Joel O'Leary) 没有持有上述任何股票的头寸。 Motley Fool 没有持有上述任何股票的头寸。 Motley Fool 有披露政策。
