articles.title: The most beautiful sections of China's Great Wall

paras.en: Editor’s Note: Monthly Ticket is a CNN Travel series that spotlights some of the most fascinating topics in the travel world. In September, we’re celebrating superlatives as we look at some of the world’s biggest, tallest and most expensive attractions and destinations.
paras.zh: 编者注：《月票》是 CNN 的旅游系列节目，重点关注旅游界一些最有趣的话题。九月，当我们参观世界上一些最大、最高和最昂贵的景点和目的地时，我们正在庆祝最高级。

paras.en: Having lived in Beijing for almost 12 years, I’ve had plenty of time to travel widely in China.
paras.zh: 在北京生活了近12年，我有足够的时间去中国各地旅行。

paras.en: I’ve visited more than 100 cities, not to mention countless towns and villages throughout the mainland’s 31 provinces.
paras.zh: 我去过100多个城市，更不用说遍布大陆31个省份的无数城镇和村庄。

paras.en: Looking back, I’ve come to realize it was my frequent visits to different parts of the Great Wall in Beijing that were a driving force behind my desire to explore the rest of the country and, along with it, the many sections of wall that lie outside the capital’s boundaries.
paras.zh: 回想起来，我逐渐意识到，正是我对北京长城不同部分的频繁访问，推动了我探索中国其他地区以及首都边界之外的许多长城的愿望。

paras.en: Work on the Great Wall began more than 2,500 years ago, its origins dating back to China’s Spring and Autumn Period of around 770 BCE to 476 BCE. Various sections were added in subsequent eras as competing dynasties and factions sought to exert their control.
paras.zh: 长城的修建始于 2500 多年前，其起源可以追溯到公元前 770 年至公元前 476 年左右的中国春秋时期。在随后的时代中，随着相互竞争的王朝和派系试图施加控制，各个部分被添加。

paras.en: Work eventually stopped in the 17th century.
paras.zh: 工程最终于 17 世纪停止。

paras.en: Though not a single, unbroken structure, the wall spans over 21,000 kilometers, winding through 15 provinces, 97 prefectures and 404 counties.
paras.zh: 长城虽然不是一个完整的结构，但全长超过 21,000 公里，蜿蜒穿过 15 个省、97 个地区和 404 个县。

paras.en: And while certain sections have been incredibly popular among tourists, many parts have slipped into obscurity, disrepair and sometimes oblivion.
paras.zh: 虽然某些部分非常受游客欢迎，但许多部分却变得默默无闻、年久失修，有时甚至被遗忘。

paras.en: Whether you’re planning to visit the Great Wall for the first time or the 50th, the following destinations are sure to make your trip to China even more worthwhile. (Check out the above video for dramatic aerial footage of some of these amazing sites.)
paras.zh: 无论您是第一次还是第 50 次游览长城，以下目的地一定会让您的中国之旅更加值得。 （查看上面的视频，了解其中一些令人惊叹的景点的戏剧性航拍镜头。）

paras.en: The Great Wall is not simply a brick and mortar bulwark; in certain places, towers on jagged mountain peaks, fortress towns or even wide rivers count as sections of “wall.”
paras.zh: 长城不仅仅是一座砖砌的堡垒，更是一座砖砌的堡垒。在某些地方，锯齿状山峰上的塔楼、要塞城镇甚至宽阔的河流都算作“墙”的一部分。

paras.en: The Turtle City, built in the Ming Dynasty (1368-1644) as part of the Great Wall’s “Yellow River Defense Line,” was completed in 1608 and was home to around 2,000 infantrymen and 500 cavalry units during peak use.
paras.zh: 龟城建于明朝（1368-1644 年），是长城“黄河防线”的一部分，于 1608 年竣工，在高峰期可容纳约 2,000 名步兵和 500 名骑兵。

paras.en: Today, this fortress city is located in the Sitan Township of Jingtai County in north central Gansu province.
paras.zh: 如今，这座要塞城市位于甘肃省中北部景泰县泗滩乡。

paras.en: While there aren’t many real turtles in the “Turtle City,” the garrison town got its nickname due to its unique shape.
paras.zh: 虽然“龟城”中真正的乌龟不多，但这座驻军小镇因其独特的造型而得名。

paras.en: The south gate acts as the head and the west and east gates as the flippers. The town’s oval wall is the body, while the north gate acts as its tail. As one of the most well-preserved and truly authentic walled cities left in China today, it’s definitely worth your time.
paras.zh: 南门为头，西门、东门为脚蹼。椭圆形城墙为城身，北门为城尾。作为当今中国保存最完好、最真实的城墙之一，这里绝对值得您花时间。

paras.en: Staying in the Jingtai County center is recommended. The ancient city is only a 30-minute cab ride from your lodgings, so you can visit whenever the light is best for photos.
paras.zh: 推荐住在景泰县城中心。从您的住处乘坐出租车仅需 30 分钟即可到达古城，因此您可以在光线最适合拍照的时候前往游览。

paras.en: When in Jingtai, try local specialties such as the five Buddha tofu and the Jingtai cold mixed noodles – both are spicy vegetarian dishes. A walk through the sprawling night market in Jingtai County People’s Square, which boasts more than 50 snack stalls, is also recommended for adventurous foodies.
paras.zh: 到了景泰，一定要尝尝当地的特色菜，比如五佛豆腐和景泰冷拌面——都是麻辣素菜。景泰县人民广场的夜市拥有 50 多个小吃摊位，值得喜欢冒险的美食家们前往逛一逛。

paras.en: Getting there: Lanzhou, the capital of Gansu province, has a major international airport and high-speed train connections from many cities in China. The drive to Yongtai Turtle City from downtown Lanzhou takes about 2.5 hours (195 kilometers). From Lanzhou Zhongchuan Airport, it’s only 1.5 hours (125 kilometers).
paras.zh: 交通：兰州是甘肃省的省会，拥有一个主要的国际机场和连接中国许多城市的高速列车。从兰州市区驾车至永泰龟城，车程约2.5小时（195公里）。距兰州中川机场仅1.5小时（125公里）。

paras.en: Mutianyu and Jiankou are two parts of the same Stone Dragon – two contiguous sections of the Great Wall that together stretch for roughly 25 kilometers along Beijing’s mountaintops.
paras.zh: 慕田峪和剑口是同一条石龙的两个部分——长城的两个连续部分，沿着北京的山顶绵延约 25 公里。

paras.en: Historical records show that millions of men spent centuries constructing the Great Wall. Stand atop the wall at either Mutianyu or Jiankou, and you’ll begin to comprehend the gravity of this statement.
paras.zh: 历史记录表明，数百万人花费了几个世纪的时间建造长城。站在慕田峪或剑口的城墙上，你就会开始理解这句话的严重性。

paras.en: These two sections are arguably the two most classic examples of Ming Dynasty Great Wall surviving today, and climbing either is guaranteed to be a life-changing experience.
paras.zh: 这两段可以说是现存明代长城中最经典的两个例子，攀登其中任何一段都将是一次改变人生的经历。

paras.en: Mutianyu is the best portion of the “tourist wall.” Restored in the 1980s, it’s very commercial but also superbly beautiful. Visitors not up for the hike can take a cable car to the top.
paras.zh: 慕田峪是“旅游墙”中最好的部分。它于 20 世纪 80 年代修复，非常商业化，但也非常美丽。不适合徒步的游客可以乘坐缆车到达山顶。

paras.en: To the west of Mutianyu, Jiankou is colloquially known as the “wild wall” – no ticket needed and not commercialized. That being said, as of 2020, hiking at Jiankou has become somewhat frowned upon by the local government because of safety concerns.
paras.zh: 慕田峪以西的剑口俗称“野墙”，不需门票，不商业化。尽管如此，从2020年开始，出于安全考虑，当地政府对剑口徒步有些不满。

paras.en: Mutianyu and Jiankou are less than a 90-minute drive (without traffic) from downtown Beijing, yet it’s highly recommended to enjoy a night in the countryside if time allows.
paras.zh: 慕田峪和剑口距离北京市中心不到 90 分钟车程（不堵车），但如果时间允许，强烈建议在乡村享受一晚。

paras.en: Jiankou can be accessed via Xizhazi village; if dates align, you might even be able to spend a few days with William Lindesay, world-renowned Great Wall historian, and his wonderful family at The Barracks, their wall-side courtyard home.
paras.zh: 经西栅子村可到达剑口；如果日期一致，您甚至可以与世界著名的长城历史学家威廉·林德赛 (William Lindesay) 和他的家人一起在军营 (The Barracks) 度过几天，这是他们位于墙边的庭院住宅。

paras.en: For lodgings around Mutianyu, The Brickyard is a superbly comfortable choice.
paras.zh: 对于慕田峪周边的住宿而言，瓦厂是一个非常舒适的选择。

paras.en: In fall and spring, shades of the wall’s gray brick contrast with nature’s vibrant colors. Peak autumn foliage and spring cherry blossoms provide stunning backdrops for photos.
paras.zh: 在秋季和春季，灰色砖墙的色调与大自然鲜艳的色彩形成鲜明对比。秋天的枫叶和春天的樱花为照片提供了令人惊叹的背景。

paras.en: For winter sports enthusiasts, there’s skiing and skating next to the Wall at locations not far from Mutianyu.
paras.zh: 对于冬季运动爱好者来说，距离慕田峪不远的长城旁有滑雪场和滑冰场。

paras.en: Getting to Mutianyu: Restrictions on applying for temporary driving licenses in China were relaxed in September 2019, so renting a car as a foreign tourist is entirely possible. (International driving licenses are not accepted in China.)
paras.zh: 前往慕田峪：2019年9月，中国放宽了申请临时驾驶执照的限制，因此外国游客完全可以租车。 （中国不接受国际驾照。）

paras.en: You can also hire a car with a driver for the day or take the Mutianyu Special Tourism Bus from the Dongzhimen Wai Bus Station.
paras.zh: 您也可以当天租一辆带司机的汽车，或者从东直门外汽车站乘坐慕田峪旅游专线巴士。

paras.en: Getting to Jiankou: Renting a car or booking private transport is recommended. As Xizhazi is a small village, buses are scarce so it can take up to five hours to get there by public transport, as opposed to 90 minutes by car.
paras.zh: 前往剑口：建议租车或预订私人交通工具。由于西栅子是一个小村庄，公交车很少，因此乘坐公共交通工具最多需要 5 个小时才能到达那里，而开车则需要 90 分钟。

paras.en: Bataizi village sits just inside the Motianling section of the Great Wall and is home to the ruins of a Gothic church built in 1876 under the direction of a German missionary.
paras.zh: 八台子村位于磨天岭长城内，是一座哥特式教堂的遗址，这座教堂建于 1876 年，由一位德国传教士主持建造。

paras.en: The church has been damaged and repaired numerous times in its nearly 150-year history; the bell tower is the only part still standing.
paras.zh: 这座教堂在近150年的历史中曾多次遭到损坏和修复。钟楼是唯一仍然矗立的部分。

paras.en: The juxtaposition of its ruins against the rammed-earth Great Wall makes Bataizi a unique place to spend a morning or afternoon.
paras.zh: 其遗址与夯土长城并列，使八台子成为度过早晨或下午的独特场所。

paras.en: After finishing your hike along the wall and visiting the church ruins, drop in to the village’s “new” church to say hello to Father Pan; if you speak Chinese, he can answer any questions about the village’s long connection with Catholicism.
paras.zh: 完成沿着城墙的徒步旅行并参观教堂遗址后，顺便去村里的“新”教堂向潘神父问好；如果你会说中文，他可以回答有关该村与天主教的悠久联系的任何问题。

paras.en: Besides Bataizi, Datong should also be on your tourist map; visiting the Yungang Grottoes (a UNESCO world heritage site) and the Hengshan Hanging Temple will make your trip even more memorable.
paras.zh: 除了八台子，大同也应该出现在你的旅游地图上；参观云冈石窟（联合国教科文组织世界遗产）和恒山悬空寺将使您的旅行更加难忘。

paras.en: Late summer is an ideal time to visit Bataizi, as you’ll see a wonderful contrast between the Great Wall and the lush green hills.
paras.zh: 夏末是游览八台子的理想时间，因为您会看到长城和郁郁葱葱的青山之间的奇妙对比。

paras.en: Getting there: Bataizi village is 80 kilometers west of Datong, one of Shanxi province’s largest and most famous cities. Zuoyun County is only 22 kilometers away from Bataizi – about a 35-minute drive.
paras.zh: 交通：八台子村位于山西省最大、最著名的城市之一大同以西 80 公里处。左云县距八台子仅22公里，车程约35分钟。

paras.en: Datong is easily accessible by plane or high-speed train from other cities in China; a taxi from downtown Datong to Bataizi should cost roughly 300 yuan (about $43).
paras.zh: 从中国其他城市乘坐飞机或高铁可轻松抵达大同；从大同市中心到八台子的出租车费用约为 300 元（约合 43 美元）。

paras.en: Alternatively, you can make your way to Zuoyun County by bus then hop in a taxi.
paras.zh: 或者，您也可以乘坐巴士前往左云县，然后乘坐出租车。

paras.en: In Datong, luxury seekers will want to head for the five-star Yunzhong Traditional Courtyard Hotel. Zuoyun County has one hotel that can accept foreigners: Zuoyun Jinshan International Hotel. Both can be found on popular hotel booking sites.
paras.zh: 在大同，追求奢华的游客将会前往五星级的云中传统四合院酒店。左云县有一家可以接待外国人的酒店：左云金山国际酒店。两者都可以在热门酒店预订网站上找到。

paras.en: Laoniuwan (aka the Old Ox Bend Great Wall)
paras.zh: 老牛湾（又名老牛弯长城）

paras.en: As the locals say, Laoniuwan is where the Great Wall and the mighty Yellow River shake hands.
paras.zh: 当地人说，老牛湾是长城与浩瀚黄河握手的地方。

paras.en: The Laoniuwan Fortress was built in 1467, while the most famous tower of the Great Wall in this area, Wanghe Tower (literally meaning river-watching tower), was constructed in 1544.
paras.zh: 老牛湾城建于1467年，而该地区最著名的长城塔望河楼则建于1544年。

paras.en: Laoniuwan village is located in Pianguan County, part of Xinzhou city in Shanxi province, just across the river from Inner Mongolia.
paras.zh: 老牛湾村位于山西省忻州市偏关县，与内蒙古隔江相望。

paras.en: Late summer or early fall is a great time to visit, as you’ll avoid the potentially dangerous mountain roads during spring rainstorms, or being uncomfortably cold in a place without great infrastructure.
paras.zh: 夏末或初秋是游览的好时机，因为您可以避开春季暴雨期间潜在危险的山路，或者在没有良好基础设施的地方感到不舒服的寒冷。

paras.en: Along the Great Wall, there are only a few places where it meets bodies of water; of all those, this is the most stunning.
paras.zh: 长城沿线只有少数地方与水体交汇；其中，这是最令人惊叹的。

paras.en: A boat ride along the river is highly recommended. You’ll be able to soak in the natural beauty of the Yellow River Gorge while marveling at the steadfast resolve of these ancient architects.
paras.zh: 强烈推荐沿河乘船游览。您将能够沉浸在黄河峡谷的自然美景中，同时惊叹于这些古代建筑师的坚定决心。

paras.en: Getting there: Laoniuwan is difficult to get to by public transportation. The best option is to rent or book a car to take you from Datong to Laoniuwan via Bataizi – this way, you’ll be able to see two incredible locations along the Great Wall in one trip.
paras.zh: 交通：老牛湾乘坐公共交通不太方便。最好的选择是租赁或预订一辆车，从大同经八台子前往老牛湾——这样，您将能够在一次旅行中看到长城沿线的两个令人难以置信的景点。

paras.en: Pianguan is the nearest city, about one hour away. Pianguan does not have a train station or an airport. The only option is to arrive by bus. Shuozhou, 140 kilometers from Laoniuwan, has an airport opening later this year.
paras.zh: 偏关是最近的城市，大约一小时车程。偏关没有火车站和机场。唯一的选择是乘坐巴士到达。距离老牛湾 140 公里的朔州机场将于今年晚些时候开业。

paras.en: Construction on the Great Wall in Simatai began in 1373. It was expanded and reinforced periodically throughout the Ming Dynasty.
paras.zh: 司马台长城始建于 1373 年。明代期间不断扩建和加固。

paras.en: The Fairy Tower is one of the best-known towers of the wall at Simatai but also one of the least visited due to how difficult it is to access.
paras.zh: 仙塔是司马台最著名的城墙塔楼之一，但由于难以进入，也是参观人数最少的塔楼之一。

paras.en: Instead, aim to take in incredible views of the Fairy Tower from Wangjing Tower (just a few hundred meters away). It’s a journey that will satiate even the most adventurous hikers, yet can be done without any ropes, ladders or other essential safety gear.
paras.zh: 相反，您的目标是从望京塔（仅数百米外）欣赏仙女塔的壮丽景色。这是一次即使是最具冒险精神的徒步旅行者也能满足的旅程，而且无需任何绳索、梯子或其他必要的安全装备即可完成。

paras.en: As with a visit to Mutianyu/Jiankou, this section of wall is guaranteed to deliver stunning views any time of year. My only suggestion is to wait for a clear day (usually visibility is great the day after it rains or snows), as the view from Wangjing Tower is unobstructed in every direction.
paras.zh: 与游览慕田峪/剑口一样，这一段城墙保证在一年中的任何时候都能呈现出令人惊叹的景色。我唯一的建议是等待晴天（通常下雨或下雪后的第二天能见度很好），因为从望京塔的各个方向都一览无余。

paras.en: The hike to the Fairy Tower will leave you in awe of the Northern Barbarians’ supposed determination to reach the capital; the mountains are nearly impassable on foot, let alone by horse, with sheer cliff faces on either side.
paras.zh: 徒步前往仙塔，会让您对北蛮人到达首都的决心感到敬畏；这些山脉几乎无法步行通过，更不用说骑马了，两侧都是陡峭的悬崖。

paras.en: It makes for absolutely world-class hiking and an interesting history lesson.
paras.zh: 它绝对是世界一流的徒步旅行和有趣的历史课。

paras.en: Five-star lodgings are available at Hobo Farm; they also have an incredible restaurant that serves delicious Western and Chinese fare. For 4.5 star lodgings with a lower price tag, try Yatou’s Homestay. Both can be found on major hotel booking sites.
paras.zh: Hobo农场提供五星级住宿；他们还有一家令人难以置信的餐厅，供应美味的西餐和中餐。如果想要价格较低的 4.5 星级住宿，可以试试丫头民宿。两者都可以在主要的酒店预订网站上找到。

paras.en: Getting there: Both the Fairy Tower and Wangjing Tower should be accessed via Tangjiazhai village, located in Beijing’s Miyun district.
paras.zh: 交通：仙女塔和望京塔均需经由位于北京密云区的唐家寨村到达。

paras.en: Tangjiazhai village is 140 kilometers from downtown Beijing, depending on your route. Booking a private car from the city is probably the most time-effective way to get there.
paras.zh: 唐家寨距离北京市中心 140 公里，具体取决于您的路线。从市区预订私家车可能是到达那里最省时的方式。

paras.en: You can also take a high-speed train from Beijing Station to Miyun district and switch to a bus or taxi from there.
paras.zh: 您也可以从北京站乘坐高铁到密云区，然后从那里换乘公交车或出租车。

paras.en: Constructed during the reign of Emperor Jiajing (1507-1567), this single-wall section stands seven meters tall in some spots – no small feat considering it was made by piling stones.
paras.zh: 这座单墙建筑建于嘉靖年间（1507-1567 年），有些地方高达 7 米，考虑到它是用石头堆砌而成，这可不是一件小事。

paras.en: It’s located just across the road from the town of Dushikou, in Chicheng in Hebei province.
paras.zh: 它位于河北省赤城独市口镇的马路对面。

paras.en: The piled-stone wall at Dushikou is unique, as many other sections of the Great Wall close to Beijing were constructed using kiln-fired bricks.
paras.zh: 独市口的石堆墙是独一无二的，因为许多靠近北京的长城都是用窑烧砖建造的。

paras.en: Dushikou is best visited in the summer, specifically July and August, when the rolling hills of the surrounding grasslands are peak green. Cool evenings make for perfect outdoor barbecue/bonfire weather.
paras.zh: 独石口的最佳旅游时间是夏季，特别是七月和八月，此时周围草原连绵起伏的山丘呈现出翠绿的景色。凉爽的夜晚是完美的户外烧烤/篝火天气。

paras.en: You’ll be able to find clean and comfortable farmhouse lodgings in Dushikou town; alternatively, Chicheng, 45 minutes away, has a range of hotels to choose from.
paras.zh: 在都市口镇你可以找到干净舒适的农家住宿；或者，距酒店 45 分钟路程的赤城也有多家酒店可供选择。

paras.en: Lamb skewers and roast leg of lamb are specialties in these parts, as this part of Hebei is very close to the border with Inner Mongolia. Noodle lovers should also try the local oat noodles, which are delicious.
paras.zh: 河北这一地区靠近内蒙古边境，羊肉串、烤羊腿是这些地区的特色菜。喜欢吃面食的人还应该尝尝当地的燕麦面，味道鲜美。

paras.en: Getting there: Thanks to all the infrastructure built for the 2022 Winter Olympics, the drive to Dushikou has been shortened by almost two hours. If you prefer not to drive, hop on a bus to Chicheng from the Liuliqiao Transport Hub in Beijing and take a 45-minute taxi ride to Dushikou.
paras.zh: 交通：得益于为 2022 年冬奥会建设的所有基础设施，前往都市口的车程缩短了近两个小时。如果您不想开车，可以从北京六里桥交通枢纽搭乘巴士前往赤城，然后乘坐出租车 45 分钟即可到达独市口。

paras.en: Note that public transportation will take one or two hours longer than private car.
paras.zh: 请注意，公共交通将比私家车多花一到两个小时。

articles.title: Americans 'frustrated' about Iran war going into midterms as Trump admin has decision to make: GOP lawmaker

paras.en: A Republican member on the House Armed Services Committee told Fox News Digital ahead of the midterm elections that the Trump administration has a key decision to make on the future of the U.S.-Iran war as "continuing to do just enough not to lose, but not enough to win, is not OK."
paras.zh: 众议院军事委员会的一名共和党成员在中期选举前对福克斯新闻数字频道表示，特朗普政府需要就美伊战争的未来做出关键决定，因为“继续做足够的事情不让输，但不足以赢得胜利，这是不行的”。

paras.en: Rep. Pat Harrigan, R-N.C., made the comments as Vice President JD Vance declared during a Fox News town hall on Thursday that he promises "Donald Trump is not going to let Iran become a forever war." Official and military sources also told Fox News this week that movements are being made in the Middle East to give the president options if he decides to resume strikes against Iran.
paras.zh: 北卡罗来纳州共和党众议员帕特·哈里根发表了上述言论，副总统万斯周四在福克斯新闻市政厅宣布，他承诺“唐纳德·特朗普不会让伊朗成为一场永远的战争”。官方和军方消息人士本周还告诉福克斯新闻，中东正在采取行动，以便在总统决定恢复对伊朗的打击时为他提供选择。

paras.en: "I share my constituents and many Americans' perspective that I'm very, very frustrated that this war is not over. The way that ultimately this administration went about conducting the war, it needed to execute it and wrap it up in a very short period of time, and we are not there yet," said Harrigan, who is running for re-election in North Carolina's 10th Congressional District.
paras.zh: “我同意我的选民和许多美国人的观点，即我对这场战争尚未结束感到非常非常沮丧。最终本届政府进行战争的方式是，它需要在很短的时间内执行并结束战争，而我们还没有做到这一点，”正在北卡罗来纳州第十国会选区竞选连任的哈里根说。

paras.en: "That being said, Iran can't have a nuclear weapon. And so at the end of the day, I do believe that this was a war that was inevitable at some point, but the party that's in power and the administration that decided to pull the trigger on it is responsible for the outcome, and they're responsible for the outcome in a very short period of time. Otherwise, things get really, really difficult," Harrigan continued. "And I think we've been seeing that, both from a political perspective but also from a policy perspective."
paras.zh: “话虽这么说，伊朗不可能拥有核武器。所以归根结底，我确实相信这是一场在某种程度上不可避免的战争，但掌权的一方和决定扣动扳机的政府应对结果负责，而且他们要在很短的时间内对结果负责。否则，事情会变得非常非常困难，”哈里根继续说道。 “我认为我们已经看到了这一点，无论是从政治角度还是从政策角度。”

paras.en: "And so while the administration needs to wrap this up, we are not in a forever war, but we need to make sure that we're not... we keep the mission the same. We accomplish the mission. And we do what it takes to either win or come home," Harrigan added. "And that binary decision has to get made by this administration."
paras.zh: 哈里根补充道：“因此，虽然政府需要解决这个问题，但我们并不是处于一场永远的战争中，但我们需要确保我们不会……我们保持使命不变。我们完成使命。我们会不惜一切代价赢得胜利或回家。” “这个二元决定必须由本届政府做出。”

paras.en: Harrigan told Fox News Digital that Trump "needs to involve Congress" if he chooses to renew military action against the Iranian regime.
paras.zh: 哈里根告诉福克斯新闻数字频道，如果特朗普选择重新对伊朗政权采取军事行动，他“需要让国会参与”。

paras.en: "I think that that will long-term set the course for the country to be resolute in affirming and actually executing and accomplishing the objectives that exist. Because look, like it or not, Congress is responsible for the funding arm of the government. And if they run out of money to accomplish the objectives, then that is not good for our strategic interests," he said. "So, in my opinion, Congress and the White House need to be very closely involved in making the next set of decisions that exist for this conflict."
paras.zh: “我认为，这将为国家坚定地确认、实际执行和实现现有目标奠定长期基础。因为无论你喜欢与否，国会都对政府的资助部门负责。如果他们用完资金来实现目标，那么这对我们的战略利益不利，”他说。 “因此，在我看来，国会和白宫需要密切参与针对这场冲突做出的下一组决定。”

paras.en: "And we do need to make sure, again, that we either do what it takes to actually win in Iran, or we need to take the three out of five objectives that we've accomplished and say that, you know what? We've largely accomplished our strategic objectives. We've got more work to do over the long-term that's going to require consistent and persistent over the horizon monitoring of their nuclear program. And we're going to have to mow the lawn every now and again, and everybody's got to realize that, and leave, right?" Harrigan continued, mentioning how the U.S. has prevented Iran from obtaining a nuclear weapon and eliminated Tehran's missile and drone production.
paras.zh: “我们确实需要再次确保，我们要么采取实际行动在伊朗取得胜利，要么我们需要拿出我们已经实现的五个目标中的三个，然后说，你知道吗？我们已经基本上实现了我们的战略目标。从长远来看，我们还有更多的工作要做，这需要对他们的核计划进行持续和持久的监控。我们将不得不时不时地修剪草坪，每个人都必须意识到这一点，并且离开吧？”哈里根继续提到美国如何阻止伊朗获得核武器并消除德黑兰的导弹和无人机生产。

paras.en: "But we've got to choose one of those two options because continuing to do just enough not to lose, but not enough to win, is not OK," he said. "It's not OK for the American people, it's not OK for our troops, it's not OK for geopolitical and economic stability. And it does not serve the long-term strategic interests of the United States. So it's time to choose."
paras.zh: “但我们必须在这两个选项中选择一个，因为继续只做足够的事情不至于失败，但又不足以获胜，这是不行的，”他说。 “这对美国人民不好，对我们的军队不好，对地缘政治和经济稳定不好。而且它不符合美国的长期战略利益。所以是时候做出选择了。”

paras.en: Harrigan, a Green Beret and business entrepreneur, is running for re-election on Tuesday in North Carolina. He is facing off against Democrat challenger Ashley Bell, a physician associate, and Libertarian candidate Steve Feldman, who ran unsuccessfully for the seat two years ago.
paras.zh: 哈里根是一名绿色贝雷帽和商业企业家，将于周二在北卡罗来纳州竞选连任。他的对手是民主党挑战者、医师助理阿什利·贝尔(Ashley Bell)，以及两年前竞选该席位失败的自由党候选人史蒂夫·费尔德曼(Steve Feldman)。

paras.en: As a current member of Congress, Harrigan told Fox News there is "no question" the Republican Party's House majority is at stake heading into Election Day.
paras.zh: 作为现任国会议员，哈里根告诉福克斯新闻，“毫无疑问”共和党在众议院的多数席位在选举日即将到来之际岌岌可危。

paras.en: "Whoever has 218 votes gets to chart the course of the direction of the House, the work that its committees do. And in particular, as it relates to the Trump administration, whether or not President Trump's going to get impeached," he added.
paras.zh: “无论谁拥有 218 票，都可以制定众议院的方向及其委员会的工作。特别是，因为这与特朗普政府有关，无论特朗普总统是否会被弹劾，”他补充道。

paras.en: "What this boils down to is the future direction of the country. Are we going to be stuck looking backwards instead of actually looking forwards, dealing with the actual business of the county and the free world, or are we going to be stuck in some sort of a Democratically-led nightmare that is simply going to be obstructionist to the conservative principles and values that people voted for in 2024?" Harrigan asked. "That's what's on the line this election cycle."
paras.zh: “这归根结底就是国家的未来方向。我们是否会陷入向后看而不是真正向前看，处理国家和自由世界的实际事务，或者我们是否会陷入某种民主党主导的噩梦，而这只会阻碍人们在 2024 年投票支持的保守原则和价值观？”哈里根问道。 “这就是本次选举周期面临的问题。”

articles.title: Minnesota Dem declined to refer Ilhan Omar for ethics probe despite fellow lawmaker's 2019 request

paras.en: Rep. Angie Craig, D-Minn., directed a Minnesota state lawmaker to the congressional ethics complaint process in 2019 after he urged her to seek an investigation into Rep. Ilhan Omar, D-Minn., according to correspondence obtained by Fox News Digital.
paras.zh: 根据福克斯新闻数字公司获得的信件，明尼苏达州民主党众议员安吉·克雷格 (Angie Craig) 在 2019 年敦促一名明尼苏达州议员寻求对明尼苏达州民主党众议员伊尔汗·奥马尔 (Ilhan Omar) 进行调查后，指示她进入国会道德投诉程序。

paras.en: In a 2019 letter, Craig told Steve Drazkowski, then a Minnesota state representative, that he could submit a complaint himself to the Office of Congressional Ethics (OCE) if he wanted to pursue an investigation into Omar.
paras.zh: 在 2019 年的一封信中，克雷格告诉当时的明尼苏达州众议员史蒂夫·德拉科斯基 (Steve Drazkowski)，如果他想对奥马尔进行调查，他可以亲自向国会道德办公室 (OCE) 提交投诉。

paras.en: The Office of Congressional Ethics website states that members of the public, advocacy organizations and members of Congress can submit information regarding alleged misconduct to the agency's Office of Congressional Conduct (OCC). Complaints may also be submitted to the House Committee on Ethics.
paras.zh: 国会道德办公室网站指出，公众、倡导组织和国会议员可以向该机构的国会行为办公室（OCC）提交有关涉嫌不当行为的信息。投诉也可以提交给众议院道德委员会。

paras.en: Craig wrote, "With respect to your request for an ethics inquiry into Rep. Omar, the Office of Congressional Ethics (OCE) of the U.S. House of Representatives is the independent, non-partisan entity charged with reviewing allegations of misconduct against Members, officers, and staff of the U.S. House of Representatives and, when appropriate, referring matters to the House Committee on Ethics."
paras.zh: 克雷格写道，“关于你对众议员奥马尔进行道德调查的请求，美国众议院国会道德办公室（OCE）是一个独立的无党派实体，负责审查针对美国众议院议员、官员和工作人员的不当行为指控，并在适当的时候将此事提交给众议院道德委员会。”

paras.en: "The OCE accepts and reviews information concerning allegations within its jurisdiction from members of the public," Craig’s letter continued.
paras.zh: 克雷格在信中继续说道：“OCE 接受并审查公众在其管辖范围内提出的指控信息。”

paras.en: Craig's response came two days after Drazkowski sent her a letter urging her to refer his concerns to the House Ethics Committee, then chaired by former Rep. Ted Deutch, D-Fla.
paras.zh: 克雷格做出回应的两天前，德拉科夫斯基给她发了一封信，敦促她将自己的担忧提交给众议院道德委员会，该委员会由前佛罗里达州民主党众议员特德·多伊奇担任主席。

paras.en: Among Drazkowski’s accusations was that Omar filed joint tax returns with Ahmed Abdisalan Hirsi in 2014 and 2015, despite the two not being legally married at the time.
paras.zh: 德拉科夫斯基的指控之一是，奥马尔在 2014 年和 2015 年与艾哈迈德·阿卜迪萨兰·希尔西 (Ahmed Abdisalan Hirsi) 提交了联合纳税申报表，尽管当时两人尚未合法结婚。

paras.en: Fox News Digital obtained a copy of a report by the Minnesota Campaign Finance and Public Disclosure Board indicating that Omar and Hirsi jointly filed their tax returns in 2014 and 2015.
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻数字频道获得了明尼苏达州竞选财务和公开披露委员会的一份报告副本，表明奥马尔和希尔西在 2014 年和 2015 年联合提交了纳税申报表。

paras.en: Omar legally married Ahmed Nur Said Elmi on Feb. 12, 2009, in Hennepin County, Minn., according to Newsweek. Omar and Elmi’s legal divorce proceeding concluded in December 2017. In a 2017 filing from her divorce case obtained by Fox News Digital, Omar stated she had not been in contact with Elmi since 2011.
paras.zh: 据《新闻周刊》报道，奥马尔于 2009 年 2 月 12 日在明尼苏达州亨内平县与艾哈迈德·努尔·赛义德·埃尔米 (Ahmed Nur Said Elmi) 合法结婚。奥马尔和埃尔米的离婚诉讼于 2017 年 12 月结束。福克斯新闻数字频道获得的一份 2017 年离婚案文件中，奥马尔表示，她自 2011 年以来就没有与埃尔米联系过。

paras.en: "Representative Craig, I am your constituent. In that capacity, I formally request that you immediately forward the attached material, and open an ethics investigation in the United States House of Representatives regarding actions taken by Rep. Ilhan Omar leading up to the 2018 election," Drazkowski wrote.
paras.zh: “克雷格代表，我是你的选民。以我的身份，我正式要求你立即转发所附材料，并在美国众议院针对伊尔汗·奥马尔众议员在 2018 年大选前采取的行动展开道德调查，”德拉科夫斯基写道。

paras.en: "This month, the Minnesota Campaign Finance Board issued a report on Rep. Omar, who found that she broke multiple Minnesota campaign finance laws," Drazkowski wrote.
paras.zh: “本月，明尼苏达州竞选财务委员会发布了一份关于众议员奥马尔的报告，奥马尔发现她违反了多项明尼苏达州竞选财务法，”德拉科夫斯基写道。

paras.en: Drazkowski told Fox News Digital that he was first prompted to seek an investigation from the Minnesota Campaign Finance Board into Omar after noticing that she had not filed a required statement of economic interest with the board.
paras.zh: 德拉科夫斯基告诉福克斯新闻数字频道，在注意到奥马尔没有向明尼苏达州竞选财务委员会提交所需的经济利益声明后，他首先被要求寻求明尼苏达州竞选财务委员会对奥马尔进行调查。

paras.en: The board confirmed in a statement to Fox News Digital that Omar submitted the statement of economic interest after she was made aware that Drazkowski’s complaint triggered an investigation.
paras.zh: 董事会在向福克斯新闻数字频道发表的一份声明中证实，奥马尔在得知德拉科夫斯基的投诉引发调查后提交了经济利益声明。

paras.en: Drazkowski said the information he included in two complaints to the board ultimately contributed to the board's determination that Omar had violated state campaign finance laws.
paras.zh: 德拉科夫斯基表示，他在向委员会提出的两份投诉中所包含的信息最终促使委员会判定奥马尔违反了州竞选财务法。

paras.en: On June 6, 2019, the board issued findings after Drazkowski filed two separate complaints. The board found that Omar had improperly used $1,500 in campaign funds to pay for personal tax-related services concerning the tax returns she filed jointly with Hirsi in 2014 and 2015.
paras.zh: 2019 年 6 月 6 日，董事会在 Drazkowski 提出两份单独的投诉后发布了调查结果。委员会发现，奥马尔在 2014 年和 2015 年与希尔西联合提交的纳税申报表中，不当使用了 1,500 美元的竞选资金来支付个人税务相关服务费用。

paras.en: The board also required Omar to repay campaign funds she had used to pay for travel to Boston, New York, and Washington, D.C.
paras.zh: 董事会还要求奥马尔偿还她用于支付前往波士顿、纽约和华盛顿特区旅行费用的竞选资金。

paras.en: After the campaign's 2019 assessment of the violations, in a statement, Omar stated that she was "glad" the process was over, and was "glad" to know that the board did not find her guilty of having used the money for personal use, as was first alleged.
paras.zh: 在竞选团队对 2019 年违规行为进行评估后，奥马尔在一份声明中表示，她“很高兴”这一过程已经结束，并且“很高兴”知道委员会没有像最初指控的那样，认定她将这笔钱用于个人用途。

paras.en: After receiving Craig's response, Drazkowski, who lived in her congressional district, submitted his own complaint seeking an ethics investigation into Omar.
paras.zh: 在收到克雷格的答复后，居住在她所在国会选区的德拉科夫斯基提交了自己的申诉，寻求对奥马尔进行道德调查。

paras.en: "Please find below my formal request for an investigation into the activities of Congresswoman Ilhan Omar (D-MN)," Drazkowski wrote to the Ethics Committee, which he also shared with the OCE.
paras.zh: “请在下面查看我对国会女议员伊尔汗·奥马尔（明尼苏达州民主党人）的活动进行调查的正式请求，”德拉科斯基写给道德委员会的信中说道，他也向 OCE 分享了该请求。

paras.en: "The United States of America is a nation of law and order. No one is above the law, and our elected officials must always be held accountable. We demand the highest of ethical standards from every member of Congress," the letter continued.
paras.zh: “美利坚合众国是一个法治国家。没有人可以凌驾于法律之上，我们当选的官员必须始终承担责任。我们要求每一位国会议员遵守最高的道德标准，”信中继续说道。

paras.en: Despite submitting his concerns, Drazkowski told Fox News Digital that he struggled to obtain a substantive response through the congressional ethics process.
paras.zh: 尽管提出了他的担忧，德拉科夫斯基告诉福克斯新闻数字频道，他很难通过国会道德程序获得实质性回应。

paras.en: He said he subsequently brought his allegations to the FBI's Minneapolis office after receiving no substantive response from the ethics process or Craig's office.
paras.zh: 他说，在没有收到道德程序或克雷格办公室的实质性回应后，他随后向联邦调查局明尼阿波利斯办公室提出了指控。

paras.en: "I went to the FBI and unloaded all the information I had to them, including names and phone numbers of people," Drazkowski told Fox News Digital.
paras.zh: “我去了联邦调查局，向他们透露了我掌握的所有信息，包括人员的姓名和电话号码，”德拉科斯基告诉福克斯新闻数字频道。

paras.en: Drazkowski said he received no meaningful response from federal investigators and expressed frustration with the bureau's handling of the information.
paras.zh: 德拉科夫斯基表示，他没有收到联邦调查人员的任何有意义的回应，并对联邦调查局处理这些信息的方式表示失望。

paras.en: The House Ethics Committee and FBI declined Fox News Digital's requests for comment.
paras.zh: 众议院道德委员会和联邦调查局拒绝了福克斯新闻数字媒体的置评请求。

paras.en: Omar and Craig did not respond to Fox News Digital's requests for comment.
paras.zh: 奥马尔和克雷格没有回应福克斯新闻数字频道的置评请求。

articles.title: Russian society being ‘systematically crushed’ says Novaya Gazeta as newspaper announces closure
articles.author: Shaun Walker

paras.en: Novaya Gazeta, one of Russia’s best-known independent media outlets, has announced it will permanently close next month. The newspaper, whose former editor-in-chief Dmitry Muratov won the Nobel peace prize in 2021, cited intolerable pressure, including being stripped of its newsroom, its donation platforms and its legal right to publish.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯最著名的独立媒体之一《新报》宣布将于下个月永久关闭。该报前主编德米特里·穆拉托夫 (Dmitry Muratov) 于 2021 年荣获诺贝尔和平奖，该报称其面临难以忍受的压力，包括被剥夺新闻编辑部、捐赠平台和合法出版权。

paras.en: “This is not just our own story; it is the story of a country and a society that are being systematically crushed,” wrote its editor-in-chief, Sergei Sokolov, on the newspaper’s website.
paras.zh: 该报主编谢尔盖·索科洛夫在该报网站上写道：“这不仅仅是我们自己的故事；这是一个国家和社会正在遭受系统性镇压的故事。”

paras.en: Launched in the 1990s and for many years partly funded by the late Soviet leader Mikhail Gorbachev, Novaya made its name through dogged, long-form reporting on corruption, rights abuses and social issues. Over the years, six of its journalists have been assassinated, including Anna Politkovskaya, who was gunned down in the stairwell of her Moscow apartment block in 2006.
paras.zh: 《Novaya》于 20 世纪 90 年代创办，多年来由已故苏联领导人米哈伊尔·戈尔巴乔夫 (Mikhail Gorbachev) 部分资助，凭借对腐败、侵犯权利和社会问题的顽强长篇报道而闻名。多年来，已有六名记者被暗杀，其中包括 2006 年在莫斯科公寓楼楼梯间被枪杀的安娜·波利特科夫斯卡娅 (Anna Politkovskaya)。

paras.en: While Novaya always swam against a tide of repression, the full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022 made independent reporting almost impossible and decimated the Russian media landscape. Novaya was one of the last critical voices still operating from inside the country.
paras.zh: 虽然《Novaya》总是逆流而上，但 2022 年 2 月对乌克兰的全面入侵使独立报道几乎不可能，并摧毁了俄罗斯媒体格局。 Novaya 是国内仅存的最后一批批评声音之一。

paras.en: “For nearly five years of ***, we managed to keep working while being completely encircled by the security services. Now it’s over. We have found ourselves in a ‘kill zone’,” wrote Sokolov. The stars were used in place of the word “war”, as under Russian law, journalists must refer to the war in Ukraine as a “special military operation” or face consequences.
paras.zh: “近五年来，我们在被安全部门完全包围的情况下设法继续工作。现在一切都结束了。我们发现自己处于‘杀戮区’，”索科洛夫写道。这些星星被用来代替“战争”一词，因为根据俄罗斯法律，记者必须将乌克兰战争称为“特殊军事行动”，否则将面临后果。

paras.en: The newspaper’s first response to the invasion was to put out a special bilingual Russian-Ukrainian edition in the days after Vladimir Putin launched the invasion. It described the war as “madness” on its front page. Soon after, the Kremlin implemented draconian new censorship laws, which forced media outlets to publish only the Russian official narrative about the conflict.
paras.zh: 该报对入侵的第一个反应是在弗拉基米尔·普京发动入侵后几天推出了俄罗斯-乌克兰双语特别版。它在头版上将这场战争描述为“疯狂”。不久之后，克里姆林宫实施了严厉的新审查法，迫使媒体只能发布有关冲突的俄罗斯官方叙述。

paras.en: “We said it’s not journalism and we’re not going to do that,” said Nadezhda Prusenkova, the head of Novaya’s press service. The newspaper published blank white spaces instead of euphemisms and false information, to provide a visible reminder of the censorship laws.
paras.zh: “我们说过这不是新闻业，我们不会这么做，”诺瓦亚新闻服务部负责人纳德日达·普鲁森科娃 (Nadezhda Prusenkova) 说。该报纸刊登了空白，而不是委婉说法和虚假信息，以明显地提醒人们注意审查制度。

paras.en: By the end of March 2022, Novaya decided to stop publishing its print edition altogether, but the threats and pressure only increased. In April that year, Muratov was doused with red paint while on a train, an attack that damaged his eyesight and that US officials say was carried out on the orders of Russian intelligence agencies. In September that year, the newspaper’s official licence was taken away and soon after their website was blocked in Russia.
paras.zh: 到 2022 年 3 月底，Novaya 决定完全停止出版其印刷版，但威胁和压力却有增无减。同年 4 月，穆拉托夫在火车上被泼红色油漆，这次袭击损害了他的视力，美国官员称这是根据俄罗斯情报机构的命令进行的。同年 9 月，该报的官方许可证被吊销，不久其网站在俄罗斯也被封锁。

paras.en: Novaya’s journalists, long used to operating in a hostile environment, found ways to circumvent the bans. Many left Russia, and a number of exiled former employees set up Novaya Gazeta Europe, a legally distinct outlet. Muratov and a core team stayed behind and continued to publish a series of magazines with a print run of 999 copies, taking advantage of a law that means magazines with under 1,000 copies do not require an official licence. Novaya’s website continued running, too, although the Russian state hit the outlet with various new legal threats.
paras.zh: 长期习惯在敌对环境中工作的诺瓦亚记者找到了规避禁令的方法。许多人离开了俄罗斯，一些流亡的前雇员创办了新报欧洲报，这是一个合法的独立媒体。 Muratov 和核心团队留下来，继续出版一系列印数为 999 份的杂志，利用法律规定印数在 1000 份以下的杂志不需要官方许可。尽管俄罗斯政府向该网站发出了各种新的法律威胁，但 Novaya 的网站仍然继续运行。

paras.en: “The fact Novaya kept working for this four and a half years after everything that happened was a miracle, but it was not just a miracle, it was also the daily choice of people who continued to go to work even when it was very scary,” said Elena Kostyuchenko, a former Novaya journalist who spent 17 years at the newspaper. “Today I feel very inspired by my colleagues, but also very painful and sad for them, and for all of us.”
paras.zh: 在该报工作了 17 年的前《Novaya》记者埃琳娜·科斯图琴科 (Elena Kostyuchenko) 表示：“在发生这一切之后，Novaya 仍然坚持工作四年半，这是一个奇迹，但这不仅仅是一个奇迹，这也是人们的日常选择，即使在非常可怕的情况下，他们仍然继续工作。” “今天，我受到同事们的启发，但也为他们和我们所有人感到非常痛苦和悲伤。”

paras.en: In recent months, Prusenkova said the pressure had become intolerable. In April, the journalist Oleg Roldugin was arrested and charged with “unlawful access to computerised information”. He is under house arrest awaiting trial and last month Sokolov’s home was searched as part of the case.
paras.zh: 普鲁森科娃表示，近几个月来，压力已经变得难以忍受。 4 月，记者奥列格·罗尔杜金 (Oleg Roldugin) 被捕，并被指控“非法获取计算机信息”。他被软禁等待审判，上个月，作为案件的一部分，索科洛夫的家被搜查。

paras.en: This month, the newspaper’s landlords informed Novaya staff that they must vacate their longstanding office premises in central Moscow by 9 November. The newsroom has been the hub of the newspaper for decades and houses a memorial museum to Politkovskaya in the former office of the murdered journalist. Prusenkova said the exhibits would be taken down and put into storage, for now.
paras.zh: 本月，该报的房东通知 Novaya 员工，他们必须在 11 月 9 日之前腾出位于莫斯科市中心的长期办公场所。几十年来，新闻编辑室一直是报纸的中心，在被谋杀记者的前办公室内设有波利特科夫斯卡娅纪念博物馆。普鲁森科娃表示，这些展品目前将被拆除并入库。

paras.en: On top of the eviction notice, all the outlet’s donation platforms have been shut down, leaving the paper without any source of funding. The court case, combined with the eviction and the lack of funds, gave the newspaper no choice but to close, said staff.
paras.zh: 除了驱逐通知之外，该报的所有捐款平台都已被关闭，导致该报没有任何资金来源。工作人员表示，法庭案件，加上驱逐和缺乏资金，该报别无选择，只能关闭。

paras.en: “Sometimes it happens that your enemies win. At this moment in time, it seems like they have won, and we have no options left,” said Prusenkova. But she said it was probable Novaya’s journalists would try to find some way to continue their work. “After all, we don’t know how to do anything else,” she said.
paras.zh: “有时你的敌人会赢。此时此刻，他们似乎赢了，我们别无选择，”普鲁森科娃说。但她表示，诺瓦亚的记者很可能会试图找到某种方式来继续他们的工作。 “毕竟，我们不知道还能做什么，”她说。

articles.title: Evacuation of civilians begins in besieged Ukrainian city of Oleshky
articles.author: Peter Beaumont Senior international correspondent

paras.en: People living in the besieged Russian-held city of Oleshky in southern Ukraine were evacuated on Friday as part of a joint relief operation, the first of its kind in four years and eight months of war.
paras.zh: 作为联合救援行动的一部分，居住在乌克兰南部被围困的俄罗斯控制城市奥列什基的居民于周五被疏散，这是四年零八个月战争以来的首次此类行动。

paras.en: The city, which lies on the Russian-occupied side of the Dnipro River, opposite Kherson, has suffered months of serious food and medical shortages, leading to warnings of starvation for the few thousand people remaining there, including about 50 children.
paras.zh: 这座城市位于第聂伯河被俄罗斯占领的一侧，与赫尔松对面，数月来遭受严重的食品和医疗短缺，导致当地数千人面临饥饿的警告，其中包括约 50 名儿童。

paras.en: The humanitarian convoy, including 25 buses and ambulances, had arrived in the city to deliver food and medicine and evacuate those wishing to leave for Russia or Ukraine.
paras.zh: 包括 25 辆巴士和救护车在内的人道主义车队已抵达该市，运送食品和药品，并疏散那些希望前往俄罗斯或乌克兰的人。

paras.en: The localised ceasefire in Ukraine’s southern Kherson region allowed for the roads out of Oleshky to be de-mined, making evacuation possible.
paras.zh: 乌克兰南部赫尔松地区的局部停火允许奥列什基道路上的地雷被清除，从而使撤离成为可能。

paras.en: While Ukrainian territory lies just 3 miles (5km) from Oleshky, evacuees will need to travel to the southern Russian city of Anapa and on to Belarus, and then drive across the border into Ukraine’s Chernihiv region.
paras.zh: 虽然乌克兰领土距离奥列什基仅 3 英里（5 公里），但撤离人员需要前往俄罗斯南部城市阿纳帕，然后前往白俄罗斯，然后开车穿过边境进入乌克兰的切尔尼戈夫地区。

paras.en: Davyd Arakhamia, a lawmaker with the Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelenskyy’s Servant of the People party – who was part of the delegation to Oleshky – confirmed the evacuation of some people who were travelling to Anapa.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基领导的人民公仆党议员达维德·阿拉卡米亚（Davyd Arakhamia）是前往奥列什基代表团的成员，他证实了一些前往阿纳帕的人员已撤离。

paras.en: “From there, they will fly by plane to Belarus, and then travel by bus to their homes,” he said.
paras.zh: “从那里，他们将乘飞机飞往白俄罗斯，然后乘巴士回家，”他说。

paras.en: Kyrylo Budanov, the head of Ukraine’s presidential office, wrote in an online post: “At this moment, the humanitarian operation is under way in Oleshky.” Budanov is not part of the delegation in Oleshky.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统办公室主任基里洛·布达诺夫在网上发帖称：“此时此刻，奥列什基的人道主义行动正在进行中。”布达诺夫不是奥列什基代表团成员。

paras.en: While earlier reports had suggested more than 500 people wanted to move to Ukrainian territory, it was unclear how many people travelled in the convoy.
paras.zh: 虽然早些时候的报道称有 500 多人想要前往乌克兰领土，但目前尚不清楚车队中有多少人。

paras.en: Kyiv’s delegation reached the city late on Friday morning to prepare for the evacuation, with footage on social media showing tearful residents embracing delegation members as they gathered in heavy rain to wait for the main evacuation convoy to arrive. Several hundred people, mainly older people, have chosen to stay.
paras.zh: 基辅代表团于周五上午晚些时候抵达该市，为疏散做准备，社交媒体上的视频显示，当地居民在大雨中聚集，泪流满面地拥抱代表团成员，等待主要疏散车队的到来。数百人选择留下来，其中主要是老年人。

paras.en: Asked if she was packed and ready to leave by a member of the Ukrainian delegation, a woman who identified herself as “Anna” was shown on video saying: “Yes, we are on bus 20, my son is on bus 17. To Ukraine.”
paras.zh: 当乌克兰代表团的一名成员问她是否收拾好行李并准备离开时，视频中一位自称“安娜”的女士说道：“是的，我们乘坐 20 路公交车，我儿子乘坐 17 路公交车。前往乌克兰。”

paras.en: Oleshky’s population has declined to about 2,000 since the star of the war, according to authorities and volunteers, and many of those who stayed have given harrowing accounts of risking their lives travelling along mine-strewn roads to get food and water.
paras.zh: 据当局和志愿者称，自战争爆发以来，奥列什基的人口已减少至约 2,000 人，许多留下来的人都讲述了冒着生命危险沿着布满地雷的道路寻找食物和水的悲惨经历。

paras.en: Some say they have survived on a cup of rice or buckwheat a day, sometimes with a tomato, cucumber or wild plants added.
paras.zh: 有人说，他们每天靠一杯大米或荞麦生存，有时还添加番茄、黄瓜或野生植物。

paras.en: “We’ve been through so much here in these five years,” one woman said in a report broadcast on Ukrainian TV. Another older woman, preparing to evacuate, said: “If we had our health, maybe we’d stay there a bit longer, but that’s it. We just want to be with our children.”
paras.zh: “这五年来我们在这里经历了太多事情，”一名妇女在乌克兰电视台播出的报道中说道。另一位准备撤离的年长妇女说：“如果我们身体健康，也许我们会在那里呆更长时间，但仅此而已。我们只想和孩子们在一起。”

paras.en: Ksenia Arkhipova, a volunteer who previously lived in Oleshky and remains in contact with people there, said large numbers of Russian military personnel were in the city.
paras.zh: 曾居住在奥列什基并与当地居民保持联系的志愿者克塞尼亚·阿尔希波娃表示，该市有大量俄罗斯军事人员。

paras.en: “They are currently checking empty houses and, in some cases, moving into them,” she told the Associated Press. “They are also pressuring local residents to evacuate to Russia, rather than to Ukraine,” she added.
paras.zh: “他们目前正在检查空置房屋，在某些情况下，他们会搬进去，”她告诉美联社。 “他们还向当地居民施压，要求他们撤离到俄罗斯，而不是乌克兰，”她补充道。

paras.en: The convoy arrived under a ceasefire in the area, which the US first lady, Melania Trump, claimed to have helped broker – a rare example of cooperation between the warring sides.
paras.zh: 车队是在该地区停火协议下抵达的，美国第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普声称帮助促成了停火协议——这是交战双方合作的罕见例子。

paras.en: On Friday, the Kremlin, however, described it as a special case that was “difficult to extrapolate” to the wider search for a peace settlement.
paras.zh: 然而，周五，克里姆林宫将其描述为一个特殊案例，“很难推断”到更广泛的和平解决方案。

paras.en: Oleshky was seized by Russian troops during the first days of the full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022.
paras.zh: 奥列什基在 2022 年 2 月全面入侵乌克兰的头几天被俄罗斯军队占领。

paras.en: It has suffered extensive damage and was badly flooded after the destruction of the huge upriver Kakhovka dam in June 2023.
paras.zh: 2023 年 6 月上游卡霍夫卡大坝被毁后，这里遭受了广泛的破坏，并被严重淹没。

paras.en: “The problem is that a lot of people are staying,” one woman told Ukraine’s human rights ombudsman, Dmytro Lubinets, who was on the ground to coordinate the operation with his Russian counterpart, Yana Lantratova.
paras.zh: “问题是很多人都留下来了，”一名妇女告诉乌克兰人权监察员德米特罗·鲁宾涅茨(Dmytro Lubinets)。鲁宾涅茨当时正在现场与俄罗斯人权监察员亚娜·兰特拉托娃(Yana Lantratova)协调行动。

paras.en: “I’ve been told that it’s their own choice,” Lubinets replied. “At the very least, we’ll do what we can to ensure that somehow humanitarian aid gets through.”
paras.zh: “我被告知这是他们自己的选择，”鲁宾涅茨回答道。 “至少，我们将尽我们所能确保人道主义援助能够顺利进行。”

paras.en: He added: “This is the first time since 2022 that a ceasefire has been established across such an extensive stretch of the frontline and has been maintained for such a significant duration.”
paras.zh: 他补充道：“这是自 2022 年以来首次在前线如此大范围内实现停火，并维持如此长的时间。”

articles.title: How crypto hacking funds isolated North Korea’s nuclear programme
articles.author: Dan Sabbagh Defence and security editor

paras.en: North Korea plays by its own rules. The isolated, secretive and autocratic country is largely cut off from the world’s economic system – but when it comes to generating foreign earnings it relies on some of the world’s most sophisticated hacking.
paras.zh: 朝鲜按照自己的规则行事。这个孤立、神秘和独裁的国家在很大程度上与世界经济体系隔绝——但在创造外汇收入方面，它依赖于一些世界上最复杂的黑客活动。

paras.en: Experts, such as TRM Labs, quickly attributed the extraordinary $6.3bn (£4.7bn) Binance cryptocurrency theft to TraderTraitor, an elite North Korean hacking unit that has also been known as the Lazarus Group. Though the link may not be proven yet, the pattern of behaviour is familiar.
paras.zh: TRM Labs 等专家很快将币安 63 亿美元（47 亿英镑）的加密货币盗窃案归咎于 TraderTraitor，这是一个朝鲜精英黑客组织，也被称为 Lazarus Group。尽管这种联系可能尚未得到证实，但其行为模式是熟悉的。

paras.en: North Korea has a history of cryptocurrency theft dating back to 2017, focusing on the sector’s relatively lax security controls as a way of stealing money and generating revenues for its military, including its nuclear weapons programme.
paras.zh: 朝鲜的加密货币盗窃历史可以追溯到 2017 年，重点关注该行业相对宽松的安全控制，以此窃取资金并为其军队（包括其核武器计划）创收。

paras.en: Kim Jong-un, its dictatorial ruler, controls a stockpile of about 50 nuclear warheads, and has been supplying troops and weapons to help Russia in its war in Ukraine. But North Korea is also extremely poor: 40% of the population are undernourished according to the UN and nearly one in five of its children are stunted.
paras.zh: 其独裁统治者金正恩控制着约50枚核弹头的库存，并一直在向俄罗斯提供军队和武器来帮助其在乌克兰的战争。但朝鲜也极其贫穷：根据联合国的数据，该国 40% 的人口营养不良，近五分之一的儿童发育迟缓。

paras.en: A UN panel of experts, reporting to the security council, said in the spring of 2024 that it was reviewing “58 suspected cyber-attacks” by North Korea “on cryptocurrency-related companies between 2017 and 2023” worth $3bn.
paras.zh: 联合国专家小组在 2024 年春天向安理会报告时表示，正在审查朝鲜“在 2017 年至 2023 年间对加密货币相关公司发动的 58 起疑似网络攻击”，价值 30 亿美元。

paras.en: The panel said the cash was estimated to generate half of North Korea’s foreign currency income. One unnamed country went further with its estimate: the stolen billions fund “40% of the weapons of mass destruction programmes”.
paras.zh: 该小组表示，这些现金估计占朝鲜外汇收入的一半。一个未透露姓名的国家进一步估计：被盗的数十亿美元资金用于“40%的大规模杀伤性武器计划”。

paras.en: The suspected crypto hacks amounted to as many as 17 in 2023 alone: thefts valued at $750m, and disturbingly, the sums involved are only increasing. The world’s largest previous crypto hack took place in February 2025, when $1.5bn was stolen from the Bybit exchange – the work, the FBI said, of TraderTraitor.
paras.zh: 仅 2023 年一年，涉嫌加密货币黑客攻击的事件就多达 17 起：盗窃案价值达 7.5 亿美元，而且令人不安的是，涉案金额还在不断增加。此前全球最大规模的加密货币黑客攻击发生在 2025 年 2 月，当时 Bybit 交易所被盗 15 亿美元，FBI 称这是 TraderTraitor 所为。

paras.en: Ciaran Martin, a former head of the UK’s National Cyber Security Centre, argues that North Korea appears to have targeted crypto because traditional banks have developed sophisticated defences that the fast-growing and lightly regulated sector has yet to match.
paras.zh: 英国国家网络安全中心前负责人夏兰·马丁 (Ciaran Martin) 认为，朝鲜似乎将加密货币作为目标，因为传统银行已经开发出复杂的防御措施，而快速增长且监管宽松的行业尚未与之匹敌。

paras.en: “Over the last decade, hackers have walked off with nine- or 10-figure sums from crypto hacks on more than 30 occasions. The number of traditional banks who have suffered a loss of more than $100m as a result of a cyber-attack in the same period is zero or one,” Martin said.
paras.zh: “在过去的十年中，黑客已经通过加密货币黑客攻击窃取了 9 到 10 位数的 30 多次资金。同期因网络攻击而遭受 1 亿美元以上损失的传统银行数量为零或一家，”Martin 说道。

paras.en: North Korea was behind one of the last large cyber thefts on a traditional bank – an attack on Bangladesh Bank in February 2016, where North Korean hackers tried to illicitly move $951m from an account the bank had with the Federal Reserve Bank of New York, taking advantage of time differences between the two.
paras.zh: 朝鲜是最近针对传统银行的大规模网络盗窃事件之一——2016 年 2 月对孟加拉国银行的攻击，朝鲜黑客试图利用两者之间的时差，从该银行在纽约联邦储备银行的账户中非法转移 9.51 亿美元。

paras.en: A piece of luck prevented most of the money from being sent to an intermediate account in the Philippines. The corresponding bank was based on Jupiter Street, which shares its first word with the name of a sanctioned Iranian ship, so most of the transfers were held up. In the end, $81m was stolen.
paras.zh: 幸运的是，大部分资金未能汇入菲律宾的一个中间账户。相应的银行位于木星街，该银行的第一个单词与一艘受制裁的伊朗船只的名称相同，因此大部分转账都被搁置。最终，8100 万美元被盗。

paras.en: The isolated state has long been accused of engaging in criminal activities to survive, including the forgery of high-quality $100 bills, known as “supernotes” in the 1990s, and the production and trafficking of crystal meth for export in the 2000s.
paras.zh: 这个与世隔绝的国家长期以来一直被指控为生存而从事犯罪活动，包括在 2000 年代伪造高质量的 100 美元纸币（被称为“超级纸币”），以及在 2000 年代生产和贩运用于出口的冰毒。

paras.en: The UK has been rarely targeted. In 2019, North Korean hackers did try to take control of cash machines linked to 56 financial institutions to make them pay out sums well in excess of normal. British officials spotted what was afoot, alerted the banks and the hack was quietly suppressed with no media coverage.
paras.zh: 英国很少成为攻击目标。 2019 年，朝鲜黑客确实试图控制与 56 家金融机构相关的提款机，使它们支付远远超出正常水平的金额。英国官员发现了正在发生的事情，并向银行发出了警报，这次黑客攻击被悄悄镇压，没有媒体报道。

paras.en: The irony is that the internet in North Korea is severely restricted, with access denied to the general population. Maths and science are pushed at school, however, and at university some of the best students are recruited into hacker groups, such as Lazarus, operating under the auspices of the country’s Reconnaissance General Bureau spy agency.
paras.zh: 具有讽刺意味的是，朝鲜的互联网受到严格限制，普通民众无法使用。然而，数学和科学在学校里受到推崇，在大学里，一些最优秀的学生被招募到黑客组织中，例如在国家侦察总局间谍机构的支持下运作的拉撒路。

paras.en: Hacking is closely tied to the all-powerful state. In December 2014, it emerged, to the embarrassment of Sony Pictures, that film stars Jennifer Lawrence and Amy Adams were paid less than their male counterparts in American Hustle. It was one of thousands of embarrassing emails leaked from the Hollywood studio through a hack.
paras.zh: 黑客攻击与强大的国家密切相关。 2014 年 12 月，令索尼影业尴尬的是，电影明星詹妮弗·劳伦斯和艾米·亚当斯的片酬低于《美国骗局》中的男演员。这是好莱坞工作室因黑客攻击而泄露的数千封令人尴尬的电子邮件之一。

paras.en: The attack, by North Korea’s Lazarus Group, was conducted because Sony had funded a film, The Interview: a Seth Rogen comedy that depicted the assassination of Kim Jong-un. Amid the chaos of the revelations, Sony tried to cancel the movie, then had to U-turn on its retreat, releasing it online and to a handful of cinemas, after being criticised for caving in to North Korean pressure.
paras.zh: 朝鲜拉撒路集团发动这次袭击是因为索尼资助了一部描绘金正恩遇刺事件的塞斯·罗根喜剧《采访》。在爆料的混乱中，索尼试图取消这部电影，然后在因屈服于朝鲜压力而受到批评后，不得不掉头撤退，在网上和少数几家电影院上映。

articles.title: G20 'family photo' cancelled after protests over presence of Russian minister

paras.en: European diplomats have refused to stand for an official photo with Russia's Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov at the G20 Foreign Ministers' Meeting in the US, leading to the American hosts cancelling the planned picture.
paras.zh: 欧洲外交官拒绝在美国举行的二十国集团外长会议上与俄罗斯外长拉夫罗夫起立拍照，导致美国主办方取消了原计划的拍照。

paras.en: Two officials confirmed to the BBC the cancellation of the so-called family photo scheduled for Friday morning, which would usually include representatives from all the nations in attendance.
paras.zh: 两名官员向英国广播公司证实，原定于周五上午举行的所谓全家福照片被取消，通常会有来自所有国家的代表出席。

paras.en: The meeting, which gathers top diplomats from the world's biggest economies, is being hosted in Atlanta by US Secretary of State Marco Rubio.
paras.zh: 这次会议由美国国务卿马可·卢比奥在亚特兰大主办，云集了世界最大经济体的高级外交官。

paras.en: Ukraine is not not a G20 member but has been invited to similar meetings in recent years. However, Ukraine was not invited to this meeting.
paras.zh: 乌克兰并非不是G20成员，但近年来已被邀请参加类似会议。不过，乌克兰没有被邀请参加这次会议。

paras.en: Relations between Ukraine and the US have been particularly tense this month, with a diplomatic standoff between Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky and US President Donald Trump over Kyiv's strikes on oil infrastructure within Russia.
paras.zh: 乌克兰和美国之间的关系本月尤其紧张，乌克兰总统泽伦斯基和美国总统唐纳德·特朗普因基辅袭击俄罗斯境内石油基础设施而陷入外交僵局。

paras.en: British Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband is present and a diplomatic source confirmed the UK was among the countries which refused to participate in the picture.
paras.zh: 英国外交大臣埃德·米利班德也在场，一位外交消息人士证实，英国是拒绝参与拍摄的国家之一。

paras.en: One British official said: "The UK has a longstanding policy not to have direct, bilateral engagement with Russian ministers since the invasion of Ukraine and we are not about to change that".
paras.zh: 一位英国官员表示：“自入侵乌克兰以来，英国的一项长期政策是不与俄罗斯部长进行直接的双边接触，我们不打算改变这一点”。

paras.en: A US official said the photo was cancelled "after it became clear some of the delegations were unwilling to participate in a joint photo".
paras.zh: 一名美国官员表示，“在一些代表团明显不愿意参加合影后”，这张照片被取消了。

paras.en: "Rather than allow a ceremonial photo opportunity to become a diplomatic distraction, the US decided to forgo the photo and keep the focus on the substantive discussions," the official said.
paras.zh: 这位官员表示：“美国不想让仪式性的合影机会成为外交干扰，而是决定放弃合影，将重点放在实质性讨论上。”

paras.en: In contrast to Ukraine, relations between the US and Russia appear to have partially thawed in recent weeks, as Trump waived some sanctions and agreed a deal to import Russian diesel for the American market.
paras.zh: 与乌克兰不同的是，随着特朗普放弃部分制裁并同意为美国市场进口俄罗斯柴油，美国和俄罗斯之间的关系近几周似乎已部分解冻。

paras.en: The move comes as Trump attempts to lower fuel prices in the US ahead of mid-term elections at the start of November, after months spent grappling with the political consequences of the Iran war.
paras.zh: 此举出台之际，特朗普在花费数月时间应对伊朗战争的政治后果后，正试图在 11 月初的中期选举之前降低美国的燃油价格。

paras.en: Ukraine and its European allies have heavily criticised Trump's deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin.
paras.zh: 乌克兰及其欧洲盟友严厉批评特朗普与俄罗斯总统普京的协议。

paras.en: Zelensky called it "a gift" to Putin that amounts to "an investment in a war that must be ended, not prolonged".
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基称这是给普京的“一份礼物”，相当于“对一场必须结束而不是延长的战争的投资”。

paras.en: Trump said his decision to suspend several Russian sanctions is an effort to keep Moscow at the negotiating table in the war between Russia and Ukraine.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，他决定暂停对俄罗斯的多项制裁，是为了让莫斯科留在俄罗斯和乌克兰战争的谈判桌上。

paras.en: Putin has said Russia, which introduced a ban on diesel exports earlier this year, is willing to supply both the US and global markets with oil and petroleum products.
paras.zh: 普京表示，今年早些时候实行柴油出口禁令的俄罗斯愿意向美国和全球市场供应石油和石油产品。

paras.en: Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022 and currently controls approximately a fifth of Ukrainian territory.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯于2022年对乌克兰发动全面入侵，目前控制着乌克兰约五分之一的领土。

paras.en: Moscow has in recent weeks intensified its deadly missile and drone attacks on Kyiv and other Ukrainian cities.
paras.zh: 最近几周，莫斯科加强了对基辅和其他乌克兰城市的致命导弹和无人机袭击。

articles.title: Crypto giant Binance attempting to recover $6.3bn stolen in hack linked to North Korea

paras.en: Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, says it has frozen around half of the funds stolen in a "complex" hack, after $6.3bn (Â£4.7bn) was accessed in what is believed to be a record heist.
paras.zh: 全球最大的加密货币交易所币安表示，在63亿美元（ 47亿英镑）被认为是创纪录的抢劫之后，它已经冻结了大约一半在“复杂”黑客中被盗的资金。

paras.en: The firm said $3bn of its stolen digital assets had been secured - but many were still in the hands of unidentified hackers. It initially thought an engineer's laptop had been compromised, allowing unauthorised withdrawals, but later said the attack was wider.
paras.zh: 该公司表示，其被盗的 30 亿美元数字资产已得到保护，但许多资产仍掌握在身份不明的黑客手中。它最初认为一名工程师的笔记本电脑已被入侵，允许未经授权的提款，但后来表示攻击范围更广。

paras.en: Several analytics firms have linked the hack, which eclipses a $1.5bn (Â£1.12bn) heist on the Bybit exchange in 2025, to a North Korean hacking unit.
paras.zh: 几家分析公司将此次黑客攻击与朝鲜黑客部门联系起来，此次黑客攻击比 2025 年 Bybit 交易所的 15 亿美元（11.2 亿英镑）盗窃案黯然失色。

paras.en: The US Secret Service said it was "working around the clock" "to identify, freeze, trace, and recover" stolen funds.
paras.zh: 美国特勤局表示，正在“昼夜不停地工作”，以“识别、冻结、追踪和追回”被盗资金。

paras.en: America's lead federal agency for investigating financial crimes added that it would "identify the cyber criminals responsible and bring them to justice", while Binance also said it was working with the FBI.
paras.zh: 美国负责调查金融犯罪的主要联邦机构补充说，它将“查明负责的网络犯罪分子并将他们绳之以法”，而币安也表示正在与联邦调查局合作。

paras.en: While Binance said its US-facing exchange was unaffected, the US would still have jurisdiction to investigate the hack and help track down stolen funds - an effort which generally involves a global law enforcement effort.
paras.zh: 尽管币安表示其面向美国的交易所未受到影响，但美国仍拥有调查黑客行为并帮助追查被盗资金的管辖权——这项工作通常涉及全球执法工作。

paras.en: The hack also involved some US-linked assets, such as stablecoins Tether and Circle â cryptocurrencies pegged to the dollar.
paras.zh: 此次黑客攻击还涉及一些与美国相关的资产，例如与美元挂钩的稳定币 Tether 和 Circle 等加密货币。

paras.en: Binance told its users "your money is safe, and we're covering every loss".
paras.zh: 币安告诉用户“您的资金是安全的，我们将承担所有损失”。

paras.en: It had initially suspended all deposits and withdrawals - but then said in an update that "deposits remain unaffected".
paras.zh: 它最初暂停了所有存款和取款，但随后在更新中表示“存款不受影响”。

paras.en: Binance's co-CEO Richard Teng said: "This was not carried out by one person. Our initial investigation suggested that the security incident may have involved a compromised laptop, however our subsequent investigation has uncovered additional points of breach."
paras.zh: 币安联合首席执行官理查德·滕（Richard Teng）表示：“这不是一个人所为。我们的初步调查表明，安全事件可能涉及一台受到感染的笔记本电脑，但我们随后的调查发现了其他漏洞点。”

paras.en: Teng also describes how the hackers used "a self-destruct mechanism that destroyed tooling and traces as they went, making it more difficult for us to trace and investigate".
paras.zh: 滕还描述了黑客如何使用“自毁机制，摧毁工具和痕迹，使我们更难以追踪和调查”。

paras.en: Initially, the company had indicated the breach "may have started with a compromised DevOps engineer's laptop" but later statements have pointed to a broader breach.
paras.zh: 最初，该公司表示此次违规行为“可能是由一名 DevOps 工程师的笔记本电脑遭到入侵而引发的”，但后来的声明指出了更广泛的违规行为。

paras.en: Binance, which was founded in China in 2017, allows users to trade digital assets and is estimated to have more than 300 million registered users worldwide.
paras.zh: 币安于 2017 年在中国成立，允许用户交易数字资产，估计在全球拥有超过 3 亿注册用户。

paras.en: The company said in 2024 that it had more than $160bn in assets under its custody.
paras.zh: 该公司在 2024 年表示，其托管资产超过 1600 亿美元。

paras.en: A lot of the fear right now from Binance users - and the crypto industry at large - is whether or not Binance will actually be capable of covering this enormous financial loss.
paras.zh: 币安用户以及整个加密货币行业现在的很多担忧是币安是否真的有能力弥补这一巨大的财务损失。

paras.en: The company has said repeatedly that customer funds will be covered and that the firm is strong enough to weather the storm.
paras.zh: 该公司多次表示，客户资金将得到保障，并且公司有足够的实力度过这场风暴。

paras.en: But crypto history watchers have been pointing out online that this is exactly the kind of message that FTX CEO Sam Bankman-Fried gave before his crypto exchange collapsed in 2022, leading to huge losses for customers and the industry.
paras.zh: 但加密货币历史观察人士一直在网上指出，这正是 FTX 首席执行官 Sam Bankman-Fried 在其加密货币交易所于 2022 年崩溃之前发出的信息，导致客户和行业遭受巨大损失。

paras.en: Several experts have warned customers not to regard Binance's promise to cover losses as legally binding and said they may need to pursue litigation to recover them.
paras.zh: 几位专家警告客户不要将币安弥补损失的承诺视为具有法律约束力，并表示他们可能需要提起诉讼才能追回损失。

paras.en: Daniel Tunkel, of the London-based Edwin Coe law firm, said that would "come down to what [customers] have been promised in their contracts", and "where Binance can be sued for non-performance, if it comes to it".
paras.zh: 总部位于伦敦的 Edwin Coe 律师事务所的 Daniel Tunkel 表示，这“将取决于（客户）在合同中的承诺”，以及“如果涉及到币安不履约的情况，可以对币安提起诉讼”。

paras.en: Binance has been subject of regulatory scrutiny around the world.
paras.zh: 币安一直受到世界各地监管机构的审查。

paras.en: Meanwhile, AI-powered investigations company TRM Labs said that several elements of the attack resembled earlier North Korean-linked incidents, including the Bybit hack.
paras.zh: 与此同时，人工智能调查公司 TRM Labs 表示，此次攻击的几个要素与之前与朝鲜有关的事件类似，包括 Bybit 黑客攻击。

paras.en: In the last five years the crypto industry has been beset by enormous losses from hackers.
paras.zh: 在过去的五年里，加密行业一直受到黑客造成的巨大损失的困扰。

paras.en: In nearly all cases investigators have blamed hackers from North Korea, pointing to the infamous Lazarus Group - also know as TraderTraitor. The names refer to clusters of cyber criminals accused of working directly for the regime.
paras.zh: 在几乎所有案件中，调查人员都将责任归咎于来自朝鲜的黑客，并指向臭名昭著的 Lazarus Group（也称为 TraderTraitor）。这些名字指的是被指控直接为该政权工作的网络犯罪分子群体。

paras.en: Chainalysis, a crypto analytics firm, said it had "high confidence" that a North Korean is linked to the hack.
paras.zh: 加密分析公司 Chainaanalysis 表示，“高度确信”朝鲜与此次黑客攻击有关。

paras.en: North Korea is an impoverished country with very little industry and heavy international sanctions and experts say the regime uses cyber crime as a way to bring money in.
paras.zh: 朝鲜是一个贫困国家，工业很少，国际制裁也很严厉，专家表示，该政权利用网络犯罪作为赚钱的方式。

paras.en: North Korea has always denied this, but the wealth of evidence from cryptocurrency flow analysis and insider interviews from defectors is compelling.
paras.zh: 朝鲜一直否认这一点，但来自加密货币流动分析和叛逃者内部采访的大量证据令人信服。

paras.en: It makes North Korea likely to be the only nation that uses hacking as a way to raise public funds.
paras.zh: 这使得朝鲜可能成为唯一一个利用黑客行为筹集公共资金的国家。

articles.title: US tech stocks see sharp falls as AI spending nears $1tn

paras.en: Tech stocks tumbled for the second day in a row as concerns rise over the hundreds of billions of dollars they are investing in artificial intelligence (AI).
paras.zh: 由于人们对投资于人工智能（AI）的数千亿美元的担忧加剧，科技股连续第二天下跌。

paras.en: Shares in Intel plummeted by as much as 30% following Google owner Alphabet's stock price plunging by more than $500bn (Â£374bn) in the previous day's trading.
paras.zh: 谷歌母公司 Alphabet 股价在前一天交易中暴跌超过 5000 亿美元（3740 亿英镑）后，英特尔股价暴跌 30%。

paras.en: Other tech stocks including Reddit and Amazon also fell while the Nasdaq index of the largest tech firms listed in the US sank over 3.5%.
paras.zh: Reddit和亚马逊等其他科技股也下跌，而美国上市最大科技公司的纳斯达克指数下跌超过3.5%。

paras.en: While tech firms as spending big on AI, some of their earnings are not meeting analysts' expectations, spooking investors and creating fears about a potential AI bubble.
paras.zh: 尽管科技公司在人工智能方面投入巨资，但它们的一些收益并未达到分析师的预期，这让投资者感到不安，并引发了对潜在人工智能泡沫的担忧。

paras.en: Major tech companies have ramped up artificial intelligence spending, with Meta, Alphabet, Oracle, Amazon, and Microsoft committing to spending $800.6bn between them in 2026 alone.
paras.zh: 各大科技公司都加大了人工智能支出，Meta、Alphabet、甲骨文、亚马逊和微软承诺仅在 2026 年就投入 8006 亿美元。

paras.en: Alphabet's stock market value plunged on Thursday after it revealed its own AI summaries were affecting its core search advertising revenue.
paras.zh: Alphabet 透露自己的人工智能摘要正在影响其核心搜索广告收入，周四该公司股价暴跌。

paras.en: At the same time, Alphabet expects to spend up to $205bn this year on investments, almost entirely related to AI.
paras.zh: 与此同时，Alphabet 预计今年将花费高达 2050 亿美元的投资，几乎全部与人工智能相关。

paras.en: Alphabet stock continued to fall in early trading, down 1% after Thursday's massive slide.
paras.zh: Alphabet 股价早盘继续下跌，继周四大幅下跌后下跌 1%。

paras.en: The bigger losses on Friday were elsewhere, with Intel on track to lose more than $130bn in value as its shares continued to fall in Friday trading.
paras.zh: 周五损失更大的是其他地方，英特尔股价在周五交易中继续下跌，其市值有望损失超过 1300 亿美元。

paras.en: The chip maker said it planned to increase spending on AI despite weaker demand for computers.
paras.zh: 这家芯片制造商表示，尽管计算机需求疲软，但仍计划增加人工智能支出。

paras.en: On Thursday, Intel's finance chief David Zinsner said the firm did not expect to bring in more cash than it spent this year and forecast lower-than-expected revenue for its fourth quarter.
paras.zh: 周四，英特尔首席财务官戴维·辛斯纳(David Zinsner)表示，该公司预计今年的现金收入不会超过支出，并预计第四季度的收入将低于预期。

paras.en: "Looking ahead, we see the PC slowdown continuing at least through the first half of next year," he said in the chip maker's third quarter earnings report.
paras.zh: 他在芯片制造商第三季度收益报告中表示：“展望未来，我们预计个人电脑增速放缓至少会持续到明年上半年。”

paras.en: In the earnings call, he said the firm had significantly ramped up investment in equipment in the third quarter and expected that to be "even more significant" in the following three months.
paras.zh: 他在财报电话会议上表示，该公司在第三季度大幅增加了设备投资，并预计在接下来的三个月内“更加显着”。

paras.en: Amazon shares fell as far as 6% in overnight trading after the company's reported earnings fell short of investors' expectations.
paras.zh: 亚马逊公布的盈利低于投资者预期后，隔夜交易中该公司股价下跌 6%。

paras.en: Amazon on Thursday revealed it had also spent more cash that it was making, and that spending had increased six-fold over the span of three months.
paras.zh: 亚马逊周四透露，它还花费了更多的现金，而且支出在三个月内增加了六倍。

paras.en: The company has committed to spending $220bn this year alone, putting the money towards investments such as AI data centres, network equipment, and servers.
paras.zh: 该公司已承诺仅今年就支出 2200 亿美元，将资金用于人工智能数据中心、网络设备和服务器等投资。

paras.en: Shares recovered slightly from the overnight fall but were still down about 1.6% in Friday trading.
paras.zh: 该股从隔夜跌势中小幅回升，但周五交易中仍下跌约 1.6%。

paras.en: Reddit stock was down by 26%, after the social media platform revealed weaker-than-expected daily user figures and warned that Google's growing AI-driven search was hurting referral traffic.
paras.zh: Reddit 股价下跌 26%，此前该社交媒体平台公布的每日用户数据弱于预期，并警告谷歌不断增长的人工智能驱动搜索正在损害推荐流量。

paras.en: Stock in online game platform Roblox also fell, down by nearly 20%, as its daily active user numbers dropped.
paras.zh: 在线游戏平台 Roblox 的股价也因日活跃用户数量下降而下跌近 20%。

paras.en: Several major tech firms have reported earnings this week, including Microsoft, and analysts said there were questions about the payout from the huge investments in AI.
paras.zh: 包括微软在内的几家主要科技公司本周公布了财报，分析师表示，人们对人工智能巨额投资的回报存在疑问。

paras.en: Chris Low, from investment management firm FHN Financial, said the bulk of what was happening in the stock market was in reaction to some of the biggest tech players such as Amazon and Google.
paras.zh: 投资管理公司 FHN Financial 的克里斯·洛 (Chris Low) 表示，股市发生的大部分情况是对亚马逊和谷歌等一些最大科技公司的反应。

paras.en: He told Reuters the companies were "showing some pretty significant growing pains as they aggressively pursue the AI build-out".
paras.zh: 他告诉路透社，这些公司“在积极追求人工智能发展的过程中，表现出了一些相当显着的成长烦恼”。

paras.en: "The thinking is that these signs suggest that the entire sector is going to slow down."
paras.zh: “我们的想法是，这些迹象表明整个行业将会放缓。”

paras.en: Many analysts have been debating the possibility of an AI bubble in the stock market.
paras.zh: 许多分析师一直在争论股市中人工智能泡沫的可能性。

paras.en: The worry is that some tech firms do not justify their sky-high valuations because the cost of building AI data centres and developing the software will end up being greater than the money they predict they will make from it.
paras.zh: 令人担忧的是，一些科技公司并没有证明他们的天价估值是合理的，因为建设人工智能数据中心和开发软件的成本最终将高于他们预计从中赚到的钱。

paras.en: Kathleen Brookes, research director at trading firm XTB, said there have been many ups and downs in AI trade in recent months.
paras.zh: 贸易公司 XTB 研究总监凯瑟琳·布鲁克斯 (Kathleen Brookes) 表示，近几个月人工智能贸易出现了许多起伏。

paras.en: "Investors have turned ruthless, punishing any signs of disappointment in [third quarter] earnings," she said.
paras.zh: “投资者变得无情，惩罚任何[第三季度]收益令人失望的迹象，”她说。

paras.en: "The AI trade has had a good run in recent years, but now investors want payback, and companies like Alphabet and Intel are in the crosshairs."
paras.zh: “近年来，人工智能行业发展势头良好，但现在投资者希望获得回报，而 Alphabet 和英特尔等公司也成为了众矢之的。”

paras.en: However, stock market values for many of these companies remain well above where they were a year ago.
paras.zh: 然而，其中许多公司的股票市值仍远高于一年前的水平。

paras.en: While the Nasdaq is down 3.5% in Friday trading, it is up 7.6% over the last year. Similarly Amazon is up nearly 7% over the past 12 months, while Alphabet is down 1.6%.
paras.zh: 尽管纳斯达克指数在周五交易中下跌 3.5%，但去年同期却上涨了 7.6%。同样，亚马逊在过去 12 个月里上涨了近 7%，而 Alphabet 则下跌了 1.6%。

paras.en: Brookes noted that November is typically a strong month for stocks.
paras.zh: 布鲁克斯指出，十一月通常是股市强劲的月份。

paras.en: "If we see AI stocks continue to struggle in the coming days, it could suggest the AI trade is past its peak, and investors will be looking for a new theme to drive markets," she said.
paras.zh: 她表示：“如果我们看到人工智能股票在未来几天继续陷入困境，这可能表明人工智能交易已经过了顶峰，投资者将寻找新的主题来推动市场。”

articles.title: How Paper-Based Friction Materials Power Modern Machinery

paras.en: How Paper-Based Friction Materials Power Modern Machinery

Have you ever wondered what enables everything from roaring construction machinery to agricultural machinery plowing the fields to industrial equipment shuttling through factories—the precise starting, smooth operation, and reliable braking they achieve?

The answer lies in a seemingly insignificant yet crucial core component: friction material. It acts as the "safety guard" and "power link" of machinery, ensuring every brake is safe and effective, and every power transmission is smooth and flawless.

Among the vast family of friction materials, wet friction materials are becoming the new favorite in modern machinery due to their exceptional reliability, safety, and exceptionally long lifespan. Among wet materials, paper-based friction materials stand out as a leading force thanks to their excellent overall performance, cost-effectiveness, and broad application prospects.
Today, let's delve deeper into the fascinating world of this "unsung hero"—paper-based friction materials.
What is Paper-Based Friction Material? — A Sponge-Like Power Core
Imagine a "sponge" with countless tiny pores—that's the most intuitive image of paper-based friction material.

It is a material with a reticular porous structure composed of three core components: reinforcing fibers, functional fillers, and a binder resin. This unique structure gives it extraordinary capabilities:
- Oil Storage Capacity: The porous structure acts like a miniature "oil depot," capable of storing large quantities of lubricant.

- Dynamic Lubrication: When the friction plate and mating plate engage and are subjected to pressure, the lubricant within the material is instantly squeezed onto the friction surface, forming a tough lubricant film, enabling smooth, gentle "wet" friction.
- Self-Recovery: When the friction plates separate, the material rebounds like memory foam, "absorbing" the lubricant back into the pores, ready for the next operation.

It is this dynamic cycle of "oil storage-oil squeezing-oil return" that allows paper-based friction materials to perform well in an oil bath environment, achieving a perfect combination of high durability and stable friction performance.
Exploring Core Performance: How Do Three Key Factors Affect It?

The performance of paper-based friction materials is not static. Like a top athlete, its performance is influenced by the "field," "equipment," and "condition." Let's examine how these three key factors shape its performance.
Factor 1: The "Stage Effect" of Lubricants

Paper-based friction materials are highly sensitive to lubricants, and different lubricants create distinct "stages" for their performance. Even the same friction material can exhibit significantly different friction characteristics (especially the kinetic friction coefficient) when exposed to different lubricants.
Figure 1: Kinetic friction coefficient curve for a paper-based friction material in gear oil
Figure 2: Dynamic friction coefficient curve of the same material in hydraulic oil

Interpretation: The above chart clearly shows that the same material behaves very differently in gear oil and hydraulic fluid. Furthermore, various additives added to lubricating oils (such as dispersants and anti-wear agents) can interact complexly with the material surface, further affecting its friction properties. Therefore, choosing the right oil for paper-based friction materials is the first step in achieving optimal performance.
Density is a trump card for paper-based friction materials. It is directly related to the material's porosity, leading to a delicate balancing act in terms of performance.

High density (low porosity) means a denser material, resulting in better strength and thermal conductivity, lower wear rate, and longer life. However, the downside is reduced oil storage capacity, which can lead to a lower coefficient of friction and compromise power transmission.

Low density (high porosity) means the material is more porous, resulting in greater oil storage capacity and a higher coefficient of friction, which can provide greater braking force or transmit torque. However, the downside is reduced mechanical strength and wear resistance, shortening service life.
Figure 3: Comparison of the dynamic coefficient of friction for materials of varying densities (Type 2 to Type 6, increasing density)
Figure 4: Comparison of wear rates of materials with different densities

Interpretation: Figures 3 and 4 vividly illustrate this balancing act. There's no such thing as absolute good or bad, only suitability. When selecting a paper-based friction material, the optimal trade-off between friction coefficient and durability must be determined based on specific application requirements (e.g., high torque versus long life).
Factor 3: Extreme Challenges of Operating Conditions

In addition to oil type and density, actual operating conditions, such as surface pressure, sliding speed, and oil temperature, pose extreme challenges to paper-based friction materials. These factors directly affect the temperature of the friction interface, the thickness and stability of the oil film, and thus dynamically alter the coefficient of friction.

Therefore, please remember: the coefficient of friction of a particular paper-based friction material is not a fixed value, but rather a performance range determined through extensive and repeated testing under specific operating conditions.
Broad Applications: Injecting a Powerful "Heart" into Machinery

Thanks to its excellent overall performance and customizability, Carlisle Brake & Friction's paper-based friction materials have been successfully applied to the core components of various heavy-duty machinery, becoming their powerful and reliable "heart."
We understand that different machines and applications require significantly different friction materials. For example:
- Service brakes for construction machinery (such as excavators and loaders) require materials that provide a stable, powerful braking force under high loads to ensure safety.
- Powershift transmissions for agricultural machinery (such as tractors) require materials that provide smooth engagement and excellent heat resistance to handle frequent shifting.
- Clutches for industrial machinery require materials that respond quickly and have a long lifespan to ensure continuous and efficient operation of production lines.

To this end, Carlisle Brake & Friction has developed a series of special paper-based friction materials for different application scenarios, providing each customer with the most suitable and reliable solution.
Continuous Innovation, Driving the Future
Technological advancement is endless. To meet increasingly demanding application requirements and broaden market prospects, Carlisle Brake & Friction remains at the forefront of innovation.

We are not only continuously optimizing the formulation and processing of paper-based friction materials to push their performance limits, but are also actively exploring next-generation wet friction materials with even higher performance. These R&D efforts have made significant progress, aiming to provide global customers with more diverse and advanced options, driving the infinite possibilities of future machinery.

articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Removing a front bumper cover for repairs or modifications can affect advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS). Cameras, radar and other sensors require precise alignment to function properly.
