paras.en: Sanders: Early on, only the researchers could set Casey up with the system, plugging him into the Matrix, as he puts it.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：早期，只有研究人员可以设置凯西的系统，将他插入矩阵，正如他所说。

paras.en: Brandman: And so our research technologist would start coming to his house three, four, five times a week to don and doff the system to enable him to communicate so that he could go about his day. And so at a certain point, we saw, well, he really wants to use the system. Can we streamline this for him? And so we petitioned the FDA to actually allow us to change the clinical trial protocol slightly so that we could train his care partners to don and doff the system without us being there. And so since then, he’s been a near daily user of the system.
paras.zh: 布兰德曼：因此，我们的研究技术专家会开始每周去他家三、四、五次，穿上和脱下系统，使他能够进行交流，以便他可以度过自己的一天。所以在某个时候，我们看到，他真的很想使用这个系统。我们可以为他简化这个过程吗？因此，我们请求 FDA 实际上允许我们稍微改变临床试验方案，以便我们可以训练他的护理伙伴在我们不在场的情况下穿脱系统。从那时起，他几乎每天都使用该系统。

paras.en: Sanders: That’s a far cry from a few hours a week. I’m going to read you some numbers from a research paper Brandman and his colleagues published about Casey’s BCI in Nature Neuroscience in June of 2026.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：这与每周工作几个小时相差甚远。我将向您朗读布兰德曼和他的同事于 2026 年 6 月在《自然神经科学》杂志上发表的关于凯西脑机接口的研究论文中的一些数据。

paras.en: “Over nearly two years, the participant, that’s Casey, used the BCI for more than 3,800 hours at home with no researchers present to maintain rich, interpersonal communication with his family and friends, independently control his personal computer, and sustain full-time employment, despite being paralyzed. He communicated 183,060 sentences, totaling 1,960,163 words, at an average rate of 56 words per minute. He labeled 92 percent of sentences as being decoded at least mostly correctly.”
paras.zh: “近两年来，参与者凯西在没有研究人员在场的情况下在家中使用脑机接口超过 3,800 个小时，尽管瘫痪了，但仍然与家人和朋友保持丰富的人际沟通，独立控制自己的个人电脑，并维持全职工作。他传达了 183,060 个句子，总计 1,960,163 个单词，平均速度为每分钟 56 个单词。他将 92% 的句子标记为至少大部分被正确解码。”

paras.en: Those numbers in this very bare-bones science kind of way are dry, if we’re being honest. But when you stop to think about it, each sentence, each of those nearly two million words, is a tether that connects Casey to his life. They’re messages to his daughter, jokes with his partner, texts to his friends. They’re games of Wordle with his wife and kid. Here’s Casey and his family in a video shot by UC Davis Health.
paras.zh: 老实说，这些数字以这种非常简单的科学方式来说是枯燥的。但当你停下来想一想，这近两百万个单词中的每一个句子，每一个，都是连接凯西和他生活的一根绳索。它们是给他女儿的信息、与他的伴侣的笑话、给他的朋友的短信。他们是和他的妻子和孩子玩Wordle 游戏。这是加州大学戴维斯分校健康中心拍摄的视频中的凯西和他的家人。

paras.en: Okay, so no A, but we got an E. M-I. O. M-I. Good job, team. We are almost there.
paras.zh: 好吧，所以没有 A，但我们得到了 E.M-I。 O.M-I。干得好，团队。我们快到了。

paras.en: Sanders: We’ve talked a lot about words here and the fundamental ways that Casey’s BCI has restored his ability to say them. But Casey’s BCI goes a little bit farther than that. It gives him the ability to add some extras. He’s got some bells and whistles up his sleeve.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：我们在这里讨论了很多关于言语的问题，以及凯西的 BCI 恢复他说话能力的基本方法。但凯西的脑机接口比这更进一步。这让他有能力添加一些额外的东西。他有一些花里胡哨的东西。

paras.en: Casey: It is really a communication device, first and foremost, and less of a tool that I use to make funny remarks. But I do have that as well in my repertoire. For example, I have the ability to add sound effects to what I am saying.
paras.zh: 凯西：首先，它实际上是一种通信设备，而不是我用来发表有趣言论的工具。但我的保留曲目中也确实有这个。例如，我有能力为我所说的话添加声音效果。

paras.en: Sanders: For instance, Casey has a sad trombone sound.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：例如，凯西有悲伤的长号声音。

paras.en: Casey: So if I find something funny and want to say, LOL, the theme from the TV show, Seinfeld, will play.
paras.zh: 凯西：所以如果我发现一些有趣的事情并且想说，哈哈，电视节目《宋飞正传》的主题就会播放。

paras.en: Sanders: This is what he means. These jokes make me think of Jules, which made me wonder if Casey, like Jules, could also swear with his system.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：这就是他的意思。这些笑话让我想起了朱尔斯，这让我想知道凯西是否也可以像朱尔斯一样用他的系统发誓。

paras.en: Casey: To answer your question of whether I can curse with this device, I most certainly [beep] can.
paras.zh: 凯西：回答你的问题，我是否可以用这个设备咒骂，我肯定可以[嘟嘟]可以。

paras.en: Sanders: So for all your inquiring minds, there you have it. Looking ahead a bit, there’s a lot happening on the horizon. The science here is moving fast and many companies are working on similar systems. We’re going to cover that in a few episodes. But for now, Casey is alone. He is an N of 1, as the scientists say – the only person using a brain-computer interface for communication this heavily.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：对于所有好奇的人来说，这就是你想要的。展望未来，将会发生很多事情。这里的科学发展很快，许多公司正在开发类似的系统。我们将在几集中介绍这一点。但现在，凯西孤身一人。正如科学家所说，他是 N of 1——唯一一个如此频繁地使用脑机接口进行交流的人。

paras.en: Casey: I hope to have this changed very soon because I feel like everyone who wants this should have the opportunity to have it, especially those who are with my disease.
paras.zh: 凯西：我希望这种情况很快就能改变，因为我觉得每个想要这个的人都应该有机会拥有它，特别是那些患有我的疾病的人。

paras.en: Sanders: Hochberg tells me that this drive to help others is common among people who volunteer for these sorts of clinical trials.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：霍赫伯格告诉我，这种帮助他人的动力在自愿参加此类临床试验的人中很常见。

paras.en: Hochberg: Each participant in the trial has been just so generous and so clear that they recognize that it’s early days in the research, but they’ve told us that they want to help other people with paralysis. They want to be able to allow people with brainstem stroke or cervical spinal cord injury or ALS or other paralyzing illnesses or injuries to have improved function, to be able to regain control over that computer or regain the fluent speech and communication that they had previously. So it’s that generosity of spirit that has really defined the participants in our BrainGate studies.
paras.zh: 霍赫伯格：试验中的每个参与者都非常慷慨和明确，他们认识到研究还处于早期阶段，但他们告诉我们他们想帮助其他瘫痪患者。他们希望能够让患有脑干中风、颈脊髓损伤、肌萎缩侧索硬化症或其他瘫痪疾病或损伤的人改善功能，能够重新控制计算机或恢复以前流畅的言语和交流。因此，正是这种慷慨的精神真正定义了我们 BrainGate 研究的参与者。

paras.en: Sanders: Casey’s generosity, his drive to help other people, really shines through as we talk. But I want to get back to him. I ask Casey what it’s been like to have this technology in his home, in his brain. He tells me how precious our voices are, and how easy it is for many of us to forget that.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：在我们谈话的过程中，凯西的慷慨和帮助他人的动力真正体现出来。但我想回到他身边。我问凯西，在他的家里、他的大脑中拥有这项技术感觉如何。他告诉我，我们的声音是多么宝贵，而我们很多人却很容易忘记这一点。

paras.en: Casey: We take them for granted. The ability to scream when you are running and want to get out some stress. The ability to say sweet nothings into your partner’s ear. These are the things that life is all about. And when you are robbed of those times, you want them back at all costs. And this is why this is good enough for now, and we should have accelerated approval for devices like this.
paras.zh: 凯西：我们认为它们是理所当然的。当您跑步并想要释放压力时能够尖叫。在伴侣耳边说甜言蜜语的能力。这些就是生活的全部内容。当你的那些时光被剥夺时，你会不惜一切代价想要把它们夺回来。这就是为什么现在这已经足够好了，我们应该加速批准这样的设备。

paras.en: Sanders: Casey’s BCI is slow compared to the pace of a normal conversation. And it gets things wrong occasionally.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：凯西的脑机接口比正常对话的速度慢。而且偶尔也会出错。

paras.en: Casey: Sorry, I am trying to answer you. And it is changing what I want to say. And I am being stubborn instead of trying to say it another way, which I will do now.
paras.zh: 凯西：抱歉，我正在尝试回答你。它正在改变我想说的内容。我很固执，而不是试图用另一种方式表达，我现在就会这样做。

paras.en: [Sanders audio] I’m not in any rush. You take as much stubborn time as you want.
paras.zh: [桑德斯音频]我并不着急。你想花多少顽固的时间就花多少时间。

paras.en: Sanders: And it needs an internet connection and power. And let’s not forget that Casey has an adapter coming out of the top of his head. But these are solvable problems, one that scientists are actively working on. So not perfect, but as Casey puts it, good enough for now.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：它需要互联网连接和电源。我们不要忘记凯西的头顶上有一个适配器。但这些都是可以解决的问题，科学家们正在积极研究这一问题。所以并不完美，但正如凯西所说，目前已经足够好了。

paras.en: Scientific efforts to restore voices have been transformative for Jules, Casey, and others. But the ability to separate a voice from a body also raises new possibilities for our societies and for our lives.
paras.zh: 恢复声音的科学努力对朱尔斯、凯西和其他人来说是变革性的。但将声音与身体分离的能力也为我们的社会和我们的生活带来了新的可能性。

paras.en: MA: His voice will live on in whatever videos or things we’ve captured, whatever he’s left us intentionally, and that’s as far as that goes.
paras.zh: MA：他的声音将永远存在于我们捕捉到的任何视频或事物中，无论他故意留给我们什么，仅此而已。

paras.en: Sanders: On the next episode, we’re stepping out of the lab and into a strange new digital world where voices might not be what they seem.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：在下一集中，我们将走出实验室，进入一个奇怪的新数字世界，那里的声音可能并不像看上去的那样。

paras.en: Hany Farid: And so we are living in, I think, in equal parts an exciting time and a terrifying time. And somehow those are coexisting.
paras.zh: 哈尼·法里德：我认为，我们生活在一个激动人心的时代和一个可怕的时代。不知何故，这些是共存的。

paras.en: Sanders: What changes are coming in a world where voices can be so easily cloned?
paras.zh: 桑德斯：在一个声音可以轻易克隆的世界里，将会发生什么变化？

paras.en: Farid: Today, with nothing more than a keyboard and an internet connection, you can type and you can get an image, a voice, a video of anything, anybody doing or saying anything.
paras.zh: Farid：如今，只需键盘和互联网连接，您就可以打字，并且可以获得任何内容的图像、声音、视频，任何人都在做或说任何事情。

paras.en: Sanders: The Deep End is a production of Science News. It’s based on original reporting by me, Laura Sanders. This episode was produced and mixed by Ella Rowen. Our project manager is Ashley Yeager. Nancy Shute is our editor in chief. Our music is by Blue Dot Sessions. The podcast is made possible in part by the Burroughs Wellcome Fund with support from PRX.
paras.zh: 桑德斯：深渊是《科学新闻》的制作。它基于我劳拉·桑德斯的原创报道。本集由 Ella Rowen 制作和混音。我们的项目经理是阿什利·耶格尔。南希·舒特是我们的主编。我们的音乐是由 Blue Dot Sessions 制作的。该播客的部分制作是由 Burroughs Wellcome 基金在 PRX 的支持下完成的。

paras.en: This podcast was produced with support from the Burroughs Wellcome Fund and in partnership with PRX. The podcast logo was created by Neil Webb.
paras.zh: 该播客是在 Burroughs Wellcome 基金的支持下并与 PRX 合作制作的。播客徽标由尼尔·韦伯创建。

articles.title: Remember When Scientists Invented a Robot Tail to Improve Our Human Balance?
articles.author: Esra Öz

paras.en: Seven years ago, Japanese researchers developed a wearable prototype robotic tail they said could help older people stay steady on their feet and assist workers carrying heavy loads.
paras.zh: 七年前，日本研究人员开发了一种可穿戴原型机器人尾巴，他们表示可以帮助老年人保持脚步稳定，并帮助工人搬运重物。

paras.en: Called Arque, the device was designed to respond to a wearer's leaning by moving in the opposite direction.
paras.zh: 该设备名为 Arque，旨在通过向相反方向移动来响应佩戴者的倾斜。

paras.en: Walking sticks and walkers already provide support for people who need help with balance.
paras.zh: 手杖和助行器已经为需要平衡帮助的人提供了支持。

paras.en: Inspired by animal tails, the team at Japan's Keio University investigated another possibility: could a moving appendage attached to the body help people maintain their balance?
paras.zh: 受到动物尾巴的启发，日本庆应义塾大学的研究小组研究了另一种可能性：附着在身体上的移动附属物能否帮助人们保持平衡？

paras.en: Introduced in 2019, Arque was a prototype built to explore that idea. Its creators were Junichi Nabeshima, Yamen Saraiji, and Kouta Minamizawa, researchers at Keio's Graduate School of Media Design.
paras.zh: Arque 于 2019 年推出，是为了探索这一想法而构建的原型。它的创建者是庆应义塾大学媒体设计研究生院的研究人员锅岛纯一、更井地衙门和南泽康太。

paras.en: In August 2019, Reuters described a gray tail about a meter long, while New Atlas listed the prototype at 71 centimeters and 1.6 kilograms. The device was secured around the wearer's waist with a harness.
paras.zh: 2019 年 8 月，路透社描述了一条约一米长的灰色尾巴，而 New Atlas 列出的原型为 71 厘米、1.6 公斤。该设备通过安全带固定在佩戴者的腰部。

paras.en: "The tail keeps balance like a pendulum," Nabeshima said.
paras.zh: “尾巴像钟摆一样保持平衡，”锅岛说。

paras.en: The mechanism uses four pneumatic artificial muscles powered by compressed air, allowing the tail to move in eight directions.
paras.zh: 该机构使用四个由压缩空气提供动力的气动人造肌肉，允许尾巴向八个方向移动。

paras.en: The tail's length and weight can be adjusted for different wearers. Its structure consists of segments, each with four protective plates around a central component with adjustable weight.
paras.zh: 尾巴的长度和重量可以根据不同的佩戴者进行调整。其结构由多个部分组成，每个部分都有四个保护板围绕一个重量可调的中心部件。

paras.en: Elastic cords connect the plates, while springs link them to the central structure and help accommodate forces generated during movement. The artificial muscles fit into spaces inside the segments, according to the team's poster paper.
paras.zh: 弹性绳连接板，而弹簧将它们连接到中央结构并帮助容纳运动过程中产生的力。根据该团队的海报论文，人造肌肉适合各个节段内部的空间。

paras.en: In the proposed balance application, measurements from a device worn on the torso would guide the tail's response. The system would use those measurements to estimate the wearer's center of gravity, then move the tail to influence their balance.
paras.zh: 在所提出的平衡应用中，佩戴在躯干上的设备的测量结果将指导尾巴的响应。该系统将使用这些测量结果来估计佩戴者的重心，然后移动尾巴来影响他们的平衡。

paras.en: An air compressor supplied the pressure needed to operate the muscles, so the prototype still depended on additional equipment and was not yet a stand-alone device.
paras.zh: 空气压缩机提供了操作肌肉所需的压力，因此原型仍然依赖于额外的设备，并且还不是一个独立的设备。

paras.en: The Arque paper cites a 2016 pilot study in Primates examining wild bearded capuchin monkeys carrying stone tools on two legs. Its analysis indicated that the animals' tails helped balance the loads.
paras.zh: Arque 的论文引用了 2016 年在灵长类动物中进行的一项试点研究，该研究检查了两条腿携带石器的野生胡须卷尾猴。分析表明，动物的尾巴有助于平衡负载。

paras.en: The capuchin researchers examined the animals' trunk and limb positions, the movement of their center of mass, and the turning effects of forces acting on their bodies.
paras.zh: 卷尾猴研究人员检查了动物的躯干和四肢位置、重心的运动以及作用在其身体上的力的转动效果。

paras.en: They found that the monkeys carried loads with their hips and knees bent, and that body mass affected their carrying posture.
paras.zh: 他们发现，猴子在搬运重物时，臀部和膝盖是弯曲的，而体重会影响它们的搬运姿势。

paras.en: For the robotic structure, the Arque researchers drew on a separate 2015 study in Science investigating the segmented skeleton of a seahorse's tail. That work compared 3D-printed tail models with square and round segments.
paras.zh: 对于机器人结构，Arque 研究人员借鉴了《科学》杂志 2015 年的一项单独研究，该研究调查了海马尾巴的分段骨架。这项工作将 3D 打印的尾部模型与方形和圆形部分进行了比较。

paras.en: Researchers bent, twisted, and crushed the models to investigate how their shapes affected performance. The square design performed well at both gripping objects and withstanding compression. Its plates slid against one another under pressure, while the round plates could also rotate.
paras.zh: 研究人员弯曲、扭曲和压碎模型，以研究它们的形状如何影响性能。方形设计在抓握物体和承受压力方面都表现良好。它的板在压力下相互滑动，而圆板也可以旋转。

paras.en: In crushing tests, the square version could absorb more energy before its structure failed. Even as its segments failed, they kept their outline; the round segments distorted into ovals.
paras.zh: 在挤压测试中，方形版本可以在其结构失效之前吸收更多的能量。即使它的部分失败了，它们仍然保留了它们的轮廓；圆形部分扭曲成椭圆形。

paras.en: The Arque team also proposed using the tail in virtual reality. In the poster paper's example, its movement would apply forces to the wearer's body to accompany a strong virtual wind, adding a physical sensation to the simulated scene.
paras.zh: Arque团队还提议在虚拟现实中使用尾巴。在海报纸的例子中，它的运动会对佩戴者的身体施加力，伴随着强烈的虚拟风，为模拟场景增添了物理感觉。

paras.en: The researchers described this as an ungrounded system that needs no fixed external mounting point, although the prototype still required compressed air.
paras.zh: 研究人员将其描述为一个不接地的系统，不需要固定的外部安装点，尽管原型仍然需要压缩空气。

paras.en: As of its 2019 debut, the researchers were still refining the tail's flexibility in the lab, with helping older people and workers among the applications they hoped to pursue.
paras.zh: 截至 2019 年首次亮相，研究人员仍在实验室中完善尾巴的灵活性，帮助老年人和工人实现他们希望追求的应用。

paras.en: What's become of the project since then remains unclear; the researchers did not respond to requests for comment on its current status.
paras.zh: 此后该项目的进展仍不清楚。研究人员没有回应对其当前状况发表评论的请求。

paras.en: The research has been published in ACM SIGGRAPH 2019 Posters.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在 ACM SIGGRAPH 2019 Posters 上。

articles.title: Cold Triggers a Hidden Molecular Pathway That Extends Lifespan, Study Finds
articles.author: Peter Dockrill

paras.en: When it comes to health, not all temperatures are equal.
paras.zh: 就健康而言，并非所有温度都是相同的。

paras.en: Evidence suggests that cold temperatures are mysteriously beneficial for longevity, helping to boost metabolism and delivering positive effects at the cellular level.
paras.zh: 有证据表明，寒冷的气温对长寿有着神秘的好处，有助于促进新陈代谢并在细胞水平上产生积极的影响。

paras.en: On the flip side, excessive heat doesn't seem to do great things for the human body.
paras.zh: 另一方面，过多的热量似乎对人体没有什么好处。

paras.en: But what is it about coldness that's so beneficial in comparison?
paras.zh: 但相比之下，寒冷有什么好处呢？

paras.en: In a new study in Nature, researchers identified a mechanism that contributes to the effect, driven by a metabolic substance called dihydrobiopterin (BH2).
paras.zh: 在《自然》杂志上的一项新研究中，研究人员发现了一种由一种名为二氢生物蝶呤 (BH2) 的代谢物质驱动的机制。

paras.en: "We are excited to show that mildly cold temperatures trigger significant production of a specific metabolite, BH2, which is synthesized, stored, and subsequently released by muscle tissue," says molecular biologist David Vilchez from the University of Cologne in Germany.
paras.zh: 德国科隆大学的分子生物学家 David Vilchez 表示：“我们很高兴地发现，温和的低温会引发特定代谢物 BH2 的大量产生，这种代谢物由肌肉组织合成、储存并随后释放。”

paras.en: "BH2 then goes to other parts of the body, where it helps to maintain protein homeostasis and contributes to tissue health during aging."
paras.zh: “然后 BH2 进入身体的其他部位，帮助维持蛋白质稳态，并有助于衰老过程中的组织健康。”

paras.en: While scientists have known for more than a century that cold temperatures boost longevity in animals, including worms, flies, fish, and rodents, researchers weren't fully sure how coldness achieved this.
paras.zh: 虽然科学家一个多世纪以来就知道寒冷的气温可以延长蠕虫、苍蝇、鱼类和啮齿动物等动物的寿命，但研究人员并不完全确定寒冷是如何实现这一点的。

paras.en: Originally, scientists hypothesized it could be a result of passive thermodynamic effects, but in more recent times, research suggests that cold-induced longevity is an actively regulated process inside the body, triggering specific biological pathways that help organisms survive.
paras.zh: 最初，科学家们假设这可能是被动热力学效应的结果，但最近的研究表明，寒冷引起的长寿是体内的一个主动调节过程，触发了帮助生物体生存的特定生物途径。

paras.en: A few years ago, Vilchez and fellow researchers discovered that cold temperatures led to the removal of harmful protein clumps in the nematode worm Caenorhabditis elegans, activating cellular structures called proteasomes that break down protein waste.
paras.zh: 几年前，维尔切斯和其他研究人员发现，低温可以去除线虫秀丽隐杆线虫中的有害蛋白质团块，激活称为蛋白酶体的细胞结构，分解蛋白质废物。

paras.en: In the new work, the researchers investigated the systemic signals behind such responses, hypothesizing that metabolites – small molecules produced by metabolic processes – could be involved.
paras.zh: 在这项新工作中，研究人员研究了这种反应背后的系统信号，假设代谢物（代谢过程产生的小分子）可能参与其中。

paras.en: In experiments with C. elegans, the researchers found that exposure to moderately cold temperatures (15 °C, or 59 °F, which extends lifespan in worms) increases the production of an enzyme called CAT–4, largely in the worms' muscles, which in turn stimulates production of the metabolite BH2.
paras.zh: 在秀丽隐杆线虫实验中，研究人员发现，暴露在中等寒冷的温度（15°C 或 59°F，可延长线虫的寿命）下会增加线虫肌肉中一种名为 CAT-4 的酶的产生，进而刺激代谢物 BH2 的产生。

paras.en: Once produced, BH2 is then transported to other tissues, where it is converted into a bioactive molecule called tetrahydrobiopterin (BH4), which enables an enzyme called PAH–1 to produce the amino acid, tyrosine.
paras.zh: BH2 一旦产生，就会被转运到其他组织，在那里转化为一种称为四氢生物蝶呤 (BH4) 的生物活性分子，它使一种称为 PAH-1 的酶能够产生氨基酸酪氨酸。

paras.en: The team found that disrupting this pathway reduced the lifespan benefits seen in worms exposed to the cold, suggesting that the longevity effects of lower temperatures aren't simply a passive consequence of slower metabolism, but are driven in part by an actively regulated biological process that starts with muscle cells.
paras.zh: 研究小组发现，破坏这一途径会降低暴露在寒冷环境下的蠕虫的寿命益处，这表明较低温度的长寿效应不仅仅是新陈代谢减慢的被动结果，而且部分是由从肌肉细胞开始的主动调节的生物过程驱动的。

paras.en: In separate experiments, the researchers found that the pathway they'd identified also boosted healthy protein homeostasis (aka proteostasis), suppressing the aggregation of harmful proteins in a worm model of Huntington's disease.
paras.zh: 在单独的实验中，研究人员发现，他们发现的途径还可以促进健康的蛋白质稳态（又称蛋白质稳态），抑制亨廷顿病蠕虫模型中有害蛋白质的聚集。

paras.en: "These findings suggest that specifically targeting a single tissue, such as muscle, could provide organism-wide protection," Vilchez says.
paras.zh: “这些发现表明，专门针对单一组织（例如肌肉）可以提供整个生物体的保护，”维尔切斯说。

paras.en: "This opens up new avenues for therapeutic approaches."
paras.zh: “这为治疗方法开辟了新途径。”

paras.en: Perhaps most excitingly of all, the researchers found evidence suggesting that cold temperatures aren't necessary for the pathway to operate.
paras.zh: 也许最令人兴奋的是，研究人员发现的证据表明，寒冷的温度对于该途径的运作并不是必需的。

paras.en: By genetically boosting CAT–4 levels in the worms' muscles, the team was able to extend their lifespan even at normal or warmer temperatures, suggesting it's possible to reproduce some benefits of the cold without lowering body temperature.
paras.zh: 通过从基因上提高线虫肌肉中的 CAT-4 水平，研究小组即使在正常温度或较高温度下也能够延长它们的寿命，这表明有可能在不降低体温的情况下重现寒冷的一些好处。

paras.en: "We were genuinely surprised to find the supplementation significantly extended lifespan, even at standard and warmer temperatures," Vilchez says.
paras.zh: “我们真的很惊讶地发现，即使在标准温度和较温暖的温度下，补充剂也能显着延长寿命，”Vilchez 说。

paras.en: "Further experiments on human cells encourage us to look for treatments that mimic the beneficial effects of cold without requiring changes in body temperature."
paras.zh: “对人体细胞的进一步实验鼓励我们寻找能够模仿寒冷有益效果而不需要改变体温的治疗方法。”

paras.en: In separate experiments involving human cells engineered to develop proteins associated with Huntington's and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), the researchers found that supplementing the cells with BH2 reduced the accumulation of the abnormal proteins.
paras.zh: 在涉及人类细胞的单独实验中，这些细胞被设计为开发与亨廷顿舞蹈症和肌萎缩侧索硬化症 (ALS) 相关的蛋白质，研究人员发现，给细胞补充 BH2 可以减少异常蛋白质的积累。

paras.en: In addition, another experiment showed BH2 and tyrosine supplementation reduced signs of programmed cell death in human motor neurons carrying an ALS-associated mutation, suggesting the pathway could also help protect against neurodegeneration.
paras.zh: 此外，另一项实验表明，补充 BH2 和酪氨酸可减少携带 ALS 相关突变的人类运动神经元的程序性细胞死亡迹象，表明该途径还有助于预防神经退行性变。

paras.en: It's worth emphasizing that so far these results have only been shown in experiments involving nematodes and human cells, and we'll need a lot more research before we can think about how these effects could safely be transferred to living human patients.
paras.zh: 值得强调的是，到目前为止，这些结果仅在涉及线虫和人类细胞的实验中得到证实，在我们考虑如何将这些影响安全地转移到活体人类患者之前，我们需要进行更多的研究。

paras.en: But the findings show we're getting closer to understanding how cold delivers its longevity effects, and one day we might be able to do just that.
paras.zh: 但研究结果表明，我们越来越了解寒冷如何影响寿命，有一天我们也许能够做到这一点。

articles.title: Your Car's Biggest Security Weakness Could Be Somewhere Unexpected
articles.author: Esra Öz

paras.en: Could a car's entertainment system provide a route to its brakes?
paras.zh: 汽车的娱乐系统可以提供刹车路线吗？

paras.en: In 2015, security researchers demonstrated that possibility in a Jeep Cherokee. They remotely accessed its infotainment system, which runs in-car entertainment, and interfered with driving functions.
paras.zh: 2015 年，安全研究人员在吉普切诺基上证明了这种可能性。他们远程访问了运行车内娱乐系统的信息娱乐系统，并干扰了驾驶功能。

paras.en: Fiat Chrysler subsequently announced a recall covering approximately 1.4 million vehicles across the US to install a software update that fixed the flaw.
paras.zh: 菲亚特克莱斯勒随后宣布召回全美约 140 万辆汽车，以安装修复该缺陷的软件更新。

paras.en: That attack targeted a system built into the car. A recent study examines a wider network, including the apps and online services connected to vehicles.
paras.zh: 这次攻击针对的是汽车内置的系统。最近的一项研究考察了更广泛的网络，包括与车辆连接的应用程序和在线服务。

paras.en: Researchers at Sweden's University of Gothenburg and Chalmers University of Technology analyzed 413 previously reported automotive software vulnerabilities. External applications accounted for the largest share, at 36.2 percent.
paras.zh: 瑞典哥德堡大学和查尔姆斯理工大学的研究人员分析了 413 个先前报告的汽车软件漏洞。外部应用程序所占份额最大，为 36.2%。

paras.en: Their study, published in Software Quality Journal, also identified a shift toward externally connected software compared with earlier research.
paras.zh: 他们的研究发表在《软件质量杂志》上，与早期的研究相比，还发现了向外部连接软件的转变。

paras.en: "The striking point is that technologies widely used in ordinary online services are now part of the automotive security landscape," software engineering researcher Srijita Basu, who works at both institutions, told ScienceAlert.
paras.zh: “引人注目的是，广泛应用于普通在线服务的技术现在已成为汽车安全领域的一部分，”在这两个机构工作的软件工程研究员 Srijita Basu 告诉 ScienceAlert。

paras.en: The wider network includes mobile and web applications and cloud services, which store or process data on remote computers.
paras.zh: 更广泛的网络包括移动和网络应用程序以及云服务，它们在远程计算机上存储或处理数据。

paras.en: Apps and cloud services linked to a car can store data on where it travels and how it is used, and sometimes data on its owner, Basu explained. Poor security could allow outsiders to access that data.
paras.zh: 巴苏解释说，与汽车相关的应用程序和云服务可以存储有关汽车行驶地点和使用方式的数据，有时还可以存储有关车主的数据。安全性差可能会导致外部人员访问该数据。

paras.en: The consequences can also depend on connections within the vehicle. Basu noted that its entertainment and telematics systems, the software that logs and transmits data about how the car is running, can exchange data with other vehicle components.
paras.zh: 后果还可能取决于车辆内的连接。巴苏指出，其娱乐和远程信息处理系统（记录和传输有关汽车运行情况的数据的软件）可以与其他车辆部件交换数据。

paras.en: "If a vulnerability is exploited and security boundaries between these systems and safety-critical functions are insufficient, an attacker may potentially progress beyond the initial component," Basu cautioned.
paras.zh: 巴苏警告说：“如果漏洞被利用，并且这些系统和安全关键功能之间的安全边界不足，攻击者可能会超越初始组件。”

paras.en: To investigate where weaknesses were concentrated, the researchers collected automotive-related records covering January 2022 through September 2024 from the US National Vulnerability Database, cross-checking additional security sources.
paras.zh: 为了调查漏洞集中的地方，研究人员从美国国家漏洞数据库收集了 2022 年 1 月至 2024 年 9 月的汽车相关记录，交叉检查了其他安全来源。

paras.en: The flaws were categorized by the software affected, severity, and where they originated during software development.
paras.zh: 这些缺陷按照受影响的软件、严重性以及软件开发过程中的起源进行分类。

paras.en: They compared their findings with research covering 2010–2019. Applying the earlier study's method to the newer records also showed an increased share involving external software.
paras.zh: 他们将自己的发现与 2010 年至 2019 年的研究进行了比较。将早期研究的方法应用于较新的记录还表明，涉及外部软件的份额有所增加。

paras.en: The team examined another way flaws can enter automotive software, through ready-made code components called libraries. Developers use these components to perform tasks without writing every function themselves.
paras.zh: 该团队研究了缺陷进入汽车软件的另一种方式，即通过称为库的现成代码组件。开发人员使用这些组件来执行任务，而无需自己编写每个函数。

paras.en: Using five scanning tools, the researchers examined 20 open-source projects used in automotive software or its development. This separate investigation identified 827 vulnerable libraries.
paras.zh: 研究人员使用五种扫描工具检查了汽车软件或其开发中使用的 20 个开源项目。这项单独的调查确定了 827 个易受攻击的库。

paras.en: The paper also identified libraries shared across projects. A weakness in one widely used component could therefore affect multiple systems.
paras.zh: 该论文还确定了跨项目共享的库。因此，一个广泛使用的组件的弱点可能会影响多个系统。

paras.en: Basu suggested manufacturers should know which components go into their software, regularly scan libraries obtained from other developers, watch for newly reported flaws, and have a plan for applying fixes.
paras.zh: 巴苏建议制造商应该知道他们的软件中有哪些组件，定期扫描从其他开发人员那里获得的库，留意新报告的缺陷，并制定应用修复的计划。

paras.en: The analysis found the largest group of vulnerabilities was linked to the stage when code is written. The next largest group was associated with design.
paras.zh: 分析发现最大的一组漏洞与代码编写阶段有关。第二大组与设计相关。

paras.en: Security, Basu said, "should be built in from the beginning and tested throughout a vehicle's lifetime."
paras.zh: 巴苏说，安全性“应该从一开始就内置，并在车辆的整个生命周期中进行测试。”

paras.en: Her recommendations include separating driving systems from entertainment and externally connected components, so a breach in one of them does not automatically reach driving functions.
paras.zh: 她的建议包括将驾驶系统与娱乐和外部连接组件分开，因此其中之一的漏洞不会自动影响驾驶功能。

paras.en: Basu emphasized that the findings do not mean every reported flaw is remotely exploitable or provides access to driving controls. The research also can't establish what share of cars could be hacked.
paras.zh: 巴苏强调，这些发现并不意味着每个报告的缺陷都可以远程利用或提供对驾驶控制的访问。该研究还无法确定有多少汽车可能被黑客入侵。

paras.en: Only 17 automotive-relevant vulnerabilities from the study period appeared in the US cybersecurity agency's catalog of flaws known to have been exploited, and most in the dataset didn't show up in the exploitation sources the team checked.
paras.zh: 研究期间，只有 17 个与汽车相关的漏洞出现在美国网络安全机构已知已被利用的缺陷目录中，并且数据集中的大多数漏洞并未出现在团队检查的利用来源中。

paras.en: The paper also notes that the 20 scanned projects may not represent the entire industry.
paras.zh: 论文还指出，扫描的 20 个项目可能并不代表整个行业。

paras.en: For owners, Basu recommended keeping software current, choosing strong passwords used only for connected-car accounts, securing linked phone apps, and checking which services have permission to access location and personal details.
paras.zh: 对于车主来说，巴苏建议保持软件最新，选择仅用于联网汽车帐户的强密码，保护链接的手机应用程序，并检查哪些服务有权访问位置和个人详细信息。

paras.en: "However, the main responsibility for preventing and containing software vulnerabilities rests with manufacturers and their suppliers," Basu added.
paras.zh: “然而，预防和遏制软件漏洞的主要责任在于制造商及其供应商，”巴苏补充道。

paras.en: The research has been published in Software Quality Journal.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《软件质量杂志》上。

articles.title: Less than 42 minutes of bright daylight linked to higher dementia risk

paras.en: Less than 42 minutes of bright daylight linked to higher dementia risk
paras.zh: 少于 42 分钟的明亮日光与较高的痴呆风险相关

paras.en: - Getting more daylight could be linked to a surprisingly powerful benefit for brain health. In a study of more than 87,000 adults, researchers found that higher daytime light exposure was associated with a 16% lower risk of dementia, with longer exposure to bright light linked to even greater reductions. Remarkably, getting less than 42 minutes of bright daylight daily was a stronger predictor of dementia than six established risk factors.
paras.zh: - 获得更多的日照可能会对大脑健康产生令人惊讶的强大益处。在一项对 87,000 多名成年人进行的研究中，研究人员发现，白天较高的光照量与患痴呆症的风险降低 16% 相关，而暴露在强光下的时间越长，患痴呆症的风险就越低。值得注意的是，每天接受明亮日光照射的时间少于 42 分钟比六种既定风险因素更能预测痴呆症。

paras.en: Could the amount of daylight you get each day offer clues about your risk of developing dementia? A large new study suggests that exposure to brighter daytime light is associated with a lower likelihood of developing the condition.
paras.zh: 您每天接受的日照量能否提供有关您患痴呆症风险的线索？一项大型新研究表明，暴露在更明亮的白天光线与降低患这种疾病的可能性有关。

paras.en: The findings, published in General Psychiatry, point to daytime light exposure as a potentially overlooked factor in brain health.
paras.zh: 发表在《普通精神病学》上的研究结果指出，白天的光照是大脑健康中一个可能被忽视的因素。

paras.en: Brighter Daylight Linked to Lower Dementia Risk
paras.zh: 明亮的日光与降低痴呆症风险有关

paras.en: To investigate the connection, researchers analyzed data from 87,577 adults who wore wrist devices equipped with accelerometers. The devices allowed scientists to measure participants' exposure to light during both the day and night. Over a median follow-up period of 8.1 years, 741 participants developed dementia.
paras.zh: 为了调查这种联系，研究人员分析了 87,577 名佩戴配备加速计的腕部设备的成年人的数据。这些设备使科学家能够测量参与者在白天和晚上的光照情况。在 8.1 年的中位随访期内，741 名参与者患上了痴呆症。

paras.en: The results revealed a notable pattern. People exposed to average daytime light levels exceeding 1,000 lux (a moderately bright light level equivalent to an overcast day outdoors) had a 16% lower risk of developing dementia. Spending longer periods in even brighter daytime light (at least 5,000 lux) was associated with further reductions in risk.
paras.zh: 结果揭示了一个显着的模式。日间平均光照水平超过 1,000 勒克斯（相当于室外阴天的中等明亮光照水平）的人患痴呆症的风险会降低 16%。在更明亮的白天光线（至少 5,000 勒克斯）下呆更长时间与风险的进一步降低相关。

paras.en: Too Little Daylight Emerges as a Surprising Dementia Risk Indicator
paras.zh: 日光过少成为令人惊讶的痴呆症风险指标

paras.en: One of the most striking findings involved people who received very little bright light during the day. Getting less than 0.7 hours, or 42 minutes, of bright daytime light daily was a stronger predictor of dementia than 6 established dementia risk factors.
paras.zh: 最引人注目的发现之一涉及白天接受很少强光的人。每天接受明亮的日光照射时间少于 0.7 小时（即 42 分钟）比 6 个已确定的痴呆症风险因素更能预测痴呆症。

paras.en: Interestingly, researchers found no statistically significant connection between nighttime light exposure and dementia risk. This suggests that daytime brightness, rather than light exposure at night, may be particularly relevant to the relationship identified in the study.
paras.zh: 有趣的是，研究人员发现夜间光照与痴呆风险之间没有统计学上的显着联系。这表明白天的亮度，而不是夜间的光照，可能与研究中确定的关系特别相关。

paras.en: "Daytime light exposure may serve as a novel indicator of dementia risk," said corresponding author Hongliang Feng, PhD, of Guangzhou Medical University, in China.
paras.zh: “白天的光照可能是痴呆症风险的一个新指标，”通讯作者、中国广州医科大学冯宏亮博士说。

paras.en: Although the findings reveal an association, they do not establish that getting more daylight directly prevents dementia. Instead, the research highlights daytime light exposure as a potentially valuable indicator of dementia risk that deserves further investigation.
paras.zh: 尽管研究结果揭示了两者之间的关联，但他们并没有证实获得更多的日照可以直接预防痴呆症。相反，该研究强调白天光照是痴呆风险的一个潜在有价值的指标，值得进一步研究。

paras.en: Materials provided by Wiley. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由 Wiley 提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

paras.en: - Nana Zheng, Wei Wang, Biao Li, Xionge Mei, Yue Liu, Jing Du, Ngan Yin Chan, Joey W. Y. Chan, Xiaoman Xing, Xiao Tan, Christian Benedict, Yun Kwok Wing, Jihui Zhang, Hongliang Feng. articles.title: Einstein's equations may explain the universe without dark energy

paras.en: Einstein's equations may explain the universe without dark energy
paras.zh: 爱因斯坦方程可以解释没有暗能量的宇宙

paras.en: - Mathematicians have uncovered what they argue is a fundamental flaw in the standard model of the universe, potentially challenging the need for dark energy. Their calculations suggest that the mathematical framework used to describe cosmic expansion is inherently unstable and that the universe could accelerate naturally under Einstein's original theory of gravity. The findings also raise surprising questions about whether our location in the universe is as ordinary as scientists have long assumed.
paras.zh: - 数学家发现了他们认为宇宙标准模型中的一个根本缺陷，这可能会挑战对暗能量的需求。他们的计算表明，用于描述宇宙膨胀的数学框架本质上是不稳定的，并且宇宙可以在爱因斯坦最初的引力理论下自然加速。这些发现还提出了令人惊讶的问题：我们在宇宙中的位置是否像科学家长期以来假设的那样普通。

paras.en: Mathematicians are raising a major challenge to one of modern cosmology's most widely accepted explanations: the idea that dark energy is driving the accelerating expansion of the universe.
paras.zh: 数学家们对现代宇宙学最广泛接受的解释之一提出了重大挑战：暗能量正在推动宇宙加速膨胀的观点。

paras.en: A study published in Proceedings of the Royal Society A presents mathematical findings that researchers at the University of California, Davis, say reveal a fundamental instability in the standard model of the expanding universe. Their calculations suggest that cosmic acceleration could emerge naturally from Einstein's equations, potentially eliminating the need to invoke mysterious dark energy.
paras.zh: 发表在《英国皇家学会学报 A》上的一项研究提出了加州大学戴维斯分校研究人员的数学发现，称其揭示了膨胀宇宙的标准模型中的根本不稳定性。他们的计算表明，宇宙加速可以从爱因斯坦方程中自然产生，从而可能消除调用神秘暗能量的需要。

paras.en: The work challenges the Lambda-cold dark matter model, the leading framework scientists use to describe the universe's evolution since the Big Bang. The researchers reached their conclusions by studying the Einstein-Euler equations, which combine Einstein's theory of general relativity with equations describing how fluids behave. Together, these mathematical tools help scientists investigate everything from galaxies and black holes to the expansion of the cosmos.
paras.zh: 这项工作挑战了 Lambda 冷暗物质模型，这是科学家用来描述宇宙大爆炸以来宇宙演化的领先框架。研究人员通过研究爱因斯坦-欧拉方程得出了结论，该方程将爱因斯坦的广义相对论与描述流体行为的方程结合起来。这些数学工具共同帮助科学家研究从星系和黑洞到宇宙膨胀的一切事物。

paras.en: A Hidden Instability in Our Model of the Universe
paras.zh: 我们的宇宙模型中隐藏的不稳定性

paras.en: To explain the problem, Blake Temple, the study's corresponding author and a distinguished professor emeritus of mathematics at UC Davis, offered a simple comparison: a pencil balanced vertically on its tip.
paras.zh: 为了解释这个问题，该研究的通讯作者、加州大学戴维斯分校的杰出数学名誉教授布莱克·坦普尔（Blake Temple）提供了一个简单的比较：一支铅笔在笔尖上垂直保持平衡。

paras.en: "All the forces are in balance when a pencil is standing on end, so it is a 'solution of the equations,'" he said. "But it's unstable. Any breath of air and it falls away."
paras.zh: “当一支铅笔直立时，所有的力都是平衡的，所以这是一个‘方程的解’，”他说。 “但它不稳定。只要呼吸一点空气，它就会消失。”

paras.en: According to Temple, the team's mathematical analysis shows that Friedmann spacetimes, which form the foundation of conventional models of cosmic expansion, are unstable at both small and large scales in the context of the Big Bang. He described the standard solution as exceptionally unstable.
paras.zh: 坦普尔表示，该团队的数学分析表明，构成传统宇宙膨胀模型基础的弗里德曼时空在大爆炸的背景下在小尺度和大尺度上都不稳定。他将标准溶液描述为异常不稳定。

paras.en: "Unstable solutions in physics and science are considered not physical," Temple said. "You'll never observe them in nature."
paras.zh: “物理学和科学中不稳定的解决方案被认为是非物理的，”坦普尔说。 “你永远不会在自然界中观察到它们。”

paras.en: This instability could have far-reaching consequences. If the universe naturally evolves away from the behavior predicted by these conventional models, its accelerating expansion might not require a separate form of energy to explain it. Instead, Temple argues, the answer could already be contained within Einstein's original theory of gravity.
paras.zh: 这种不稳定可能会产生深远的影响。如果宇宙自然地演化远离这些传统模型预测的行为，那么它的加速膨胀可能不需要单独形式的能量来解释。相反，坦普尔认为，答案可能已经包含在爱因斯坦最初的引力理论中。

paras.en: "The instability of all Friedmann spacetimes to accelerated expansion suggests a simpler, more natural explanation for the acceleration of the universe than dark energy," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“所有弗里德曼时空对加速膨胀的不稳定性表明，对宇宙加速的解释比暗能量更简单、更自然。”

paras.en: Why Scientists Believe Dark Energy Is Expanding the Universe
paras.zh: 为什么科学家相信暗能量正在扩张宇宙

paras.en: For nearly three decades, dark energy has been the leading explanation for one of astronomy's most puzzling discoveries: the universe is not simply expanding, but its expansion is accelerating.
paras.zh: 近三十年来，暗能量一直是天文学最令人费解的发现之一的主要解释：宇宙不仅在膨胀，而且还在加速膨胀。

paras.en: The concept has roots in Einstein's groundbreaking 1915 theory of general relativity, which describes gravity as the curvature of space and time. Einstein originally believed the universe was static, neither expanding nor contracting. To make his equations compatible with that assumption, he introduced a mathematical term that counteracted gravity, calling it the "cosmological constant."
paras.zh: 这个概念源于爱因斯坦 1915 年开创性的广义相对论，该理论将引力描述为空间和时间的曲率。爱因斯坦最初认为宇宙是静态的，既不膨胀也不收缩。为了使他的方程与该假设兼容，他引入了一个抵消引力的数学术语，称之为“宇宙常数”。

paras.en: That assumption changed after Edwin Hubble discovered evidence in 1929 that the universe was expanding. Einstein famously referred to his introduction of the cosmological constant as his "biggest blunder," since his original equations without the additional term could have predicted an expanding universe.
paras.zh: 1929 年埃德温·哈勃发现宇宙正在膨胀的证据后，这一假设发生了变化。爱因斯坦曾将他引入宇宙学常数称为“最大的错误”，因为他的原始方程没有附加项就可以预测膨胀的宇宙。

paras.en: The cosmological constant returned to prominence in the 1990s, when astronomers discovered that cosmic expansion was speeding up. It became closely associated with dark energy, the name given to the unknown component thought to be responsible for this acceleration.
paras.zh: 20 世纪 90 年代，天文学家发现宇宙膨胀正在加速，宇宙学常数重新受到重视。它与暗能量密切相关，暗能量被认为是造成这种加速的未知成分的名称。

paras.en: Today's standard cosmological framework builds on the Friedmann universe, a mathematical description in which space expands while matter remains evenly distributed across the cosmos at any given moment. This assumption of large-scale uniformity plays a central role in how scientists reconstruct the universe's history.
paras.zh: 今天的标准宇宙学框架建立在弗里德曼宇宙的基础上，这是一种数学描述，其中空间在膨胀，而物质在任何给定时刻都保持均匀分布在宇宙中。这种大尺度均匀性的假设在科学家重建宇宙历史的过程中发挥着核心作用。

paras.en: But Temple and his collaborators began questioning whether the underlying mathematics could remain stable, prompting them to investigate other possible explanations for the observed acceleration.
paras.zh: 但坦普尔和他的合作者开始质疑基础数学是否可以保持稳定，促使他们研究对观察到的加速度的其他可能解释。

paras.en: Could Einstein's Equations Explain Cosmic Acceleration?
paras.zh: 爱因斯坦方程可以解释宇宙加速吗？

paras.en: The researchers initially considered whether a massive shockwave might help explain the universe's expansion and the unexpected acceleration associated with it.
paras.zh: 研究人员最初考虑了巨大的冲击波是否有助于解释宇宙的膨胀以及与之相关的意外加速。

paras.en: "Our first idea was that maybe the universe was expanding because there was a shockwave, and the anomalous acceleration was the expanding wave behind that shockwave," Temple said. "Then we realized there's a family of self-similar solutions during the radiation epoch of the Big Bang, which might model that expanding wave."
paras.zh: 坦普尔说：“我们的第一个想法是，宇宙可能正在膨胀，因为存在冲击波，而异常加速度就是冲击波背后的膨胀波。” “然后我们意识到在大爆炸的辐射时代存在一系列自相似的解决方案，这可能会模拟膨胀的波。”

paras.en: In mathematics and physics, self-similar solutions describe patterns that retain their underlying structure when viewed at different scales. A familiar example is a fractal, in which similar shapes can appear at increasingly larger or smaller sizes.
paras.zh: 在数学和物理学中，自相似解描述了在不同尺度下观察时保留其底层结构的模式。一个熟悉的例子是分形，其中相似的形状可以以越来越大或越来越小的尺寸出现。

paras.en: The researchers identified a family of these solutions associated with the radiation-dominated period of the early universe, when radiation played a major role in determining how the cosmos evolved.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现了一系列与早期宇宙以辐射为主的时期相关的解决方案，当时辐射在决定宇宙如何演化方面发挥了重要作用。

paras.en: Building on their earlier work, they used a self-similar form of Einstein's equations to represent the standard cosmological model as a rest point, a mathematical state in which the system's defining variables remain unchanged. This approach allowed them to examine whether small departures from that state would disappear or grow over time.
paras.zh: 在他们早期工作的基础上，他们使用爱因斯坦方程的自相似形式将标准宇宙学模型表示为休息点，这是一种系统定义变量保持不变的数学状态。这种方法使他们能够检查与该状态的微小偏差是否会随着时间的推移而消失或扩大。

paras.en: Their analysis provided a mathematical framework for evaluating the stability of the standard model and, more broadly, Friedmann spacetimes during the matter-dominated era of the early universe, when matter became more influential than radiation.
paras.zh: 他们的分析提供了一个数学框架，用于评估标准模型的稳定性，更广泛地说，评估早期宇宙物质主导时代的弗里德曼时空的稳定性，当时物质比辐射更具影响力。

paras.en: A Mathematical Challenge to the Standard Big Bang Model
paras.zh: 标准大爆炸模型的数学挑战

paras.en: The results suggest that the conventional mathematical descriptions of the expanding universe are vulnerable to disturbances that grow rather than fade.
paras.zh: 结果表明，对膨胀宇宙的传统数学描述很容易受到增长而不是消失的扰动的影响。

paras.en: "We prove that, like Einstein's static model, the Friedmann spacetimes are all unstable to radial perturbation at large length scales," Temple said. "This appears to rule out the Lambda-cold dark matter model as a viable stable solution of the Einstein equations of general relativity, with or without dark energy."
paras.zh: 坦普尔说：“我们证明，就像爱因斯坦的静态模型一样，弗里德曼时空对于大长度尺度的径向扰动都是不稳定的。” “这似乎排除了 Lambda 冷暗物质模型作为广义相对论爱因斯坦方程的可行稳定解，无论有或没有暗能量。”

paras.en: Radial perturbations are disturbances that change with distance from a central point. In the researchers' mathematical framework, such changes can cause the behavior of an expanding universe to depart from the predictions of the standard Friedmann model.
paras.zh: 径向扰动是随着距中心点的距离而变化的扰动。在研究人员的数学框架中，这种变化可能导致膨胀宇宙的行为偏离标准弗里德曼模型的预测。

paras.en: "This means," he added, "that the Big Bang should generically look exactly like a Friedmann spacetime near the center of symmetry, but generically one should observe accelerations away from Friedmann far from the center."
paras.zh: “这意味着，”他补充道，“大爆炸通常看起来应该与对称中心附近的弗里德曼时空一模一样，但通常人们应该观察远离中心的弗里德曼时空的加速度。”

paras.en: In other words, the universe could behave much like the standard model predicts near a central region while exhibiting different expansion behavior farther away.
paras.zh: 换句话说，宇宙的行为可能与标准模型在中心区域附近预测的非常相似，而在更远的地方却表现出不同的膨胀行为。

paras.en: The researchers argue that this instability may offer a natural route to accelerated cosmic expansion without adding a cosmological constant or invoking dark energy. Their calculations indicate that the acceleration can emerge directly from the Einstein-Euler equations themselves.
paras.zh: 研究人员认为，这种不稳定性可能提供了一种加速宇宙膨胀的自然途径，而无需增加宇宙常数或调用暗能量。他们的计算表明加速度可以直接从爱因斯坦-欧拉方程本身得出。

paras.en: The findings represent a theoretical challenge to standard cosmology rather than observational proof that dark energy is unnecessary. Establishing whether this alternative can describe the actual universe would require determining how well its predictions match astronomical observations.
paras.zh: 这些发现代表了对标准宇宙学的理论上的挑战，而不是暗能量是不必要的观测证据。确定这种替代方案是否可以描述实际宇宙需要确定其预测与天文观测的匹配程度。

paras.en: Does the Universe Have a Special Location?
paras.zh: 宇宙有一个特殊的位置吗？

paras.en: Beyond the dark energy question, the study also raises a more fundamental issue involving the Copernican principle.
paras.zh: 除了暗能量问题之外，这项研究还提出了一个涉及哥白尼原理的更基本的问题。

paras.en: Named after astronomer Nicolaus Copernicus, who helped overturn the belief that Earth sits at the center of the solar system, the principle holds that our location in the universe is not fundamentally special or privileged.
paras.zh: 该原理以天文学家尼古拉斯·哥白尼 (Nicolaus Copernicus) 的名字命名，他帮助推翻了地球位于太阳系中心的信念，该原理认为我们在宇宙中的位置从根本上来说并不特殊或享有特权。

paras.en: This assumption has become an important part of modern cosmology, supporting the view that the universe looks broadly similar when observed from different locations on sufficiently large scales.
paras.zh: 这一假设已成为现代宇宙学的重要组成部分，支持这样的观点：当从足够大的尺度上的不同位置观察时，宇宙看起来大致相似。

paras.en: The researchers' alternative mathematical framework introduces a center of spherical symmetry, raising questions about where an observer would need to be located for the model to agree with observations.
paras.zh: 研究人员的替代数学框架引入了球对称中心，提出了观察者需要位于何处才能使模型与观察结果一致的问题。

paras.en: Temple argues that the Copernican principle must be applied consistently when evaluating competing explanations of the universe.
paras.zh: 坦普尔认为，在评估对宇宙的相互竞争的解释时，必须一致地应用哥白尼原理。

paras.en: "Both the Lambda-cold dark matter model and a spherically symmetric spacetime produce a special place where we must lie for the model to be physically plausible," Temple said. "If this principle rules out one, it has to rule out the other."
paras.zh: 坦普尔说：“Lambda 冷暗物质模型和球对称时空都产生了一个特殊的位置，我们必须在这个位置上使模型在物理上合理。” “如果这个原则排除了一个，它就必须排除另一个。”

paras.en: The work opens another avenue for investigating why the universe's expansion is accelerating. Although dark energy remains a central component of the prevailing cosmological model, the researchers contend that the mathematics of general relativity may offer a different explanation for the same phenomenon.
paras.zh: 这项工作为研究宇宙加速膨胀的原因开辟了另一条途径。尽管暗能量仍然是主流宇宙学模型的核心组成部分，但研究人员认为，广义相对论的数学可能为同一现象提供不同的解释。

paras.en: If further theoretical and observational work supports their interpretation, it could lead to a significant reassessment of how scientists understand cosmic expansion and the mathematical foundations of the Big Bang.
paras.zh: 如果进一步的理论和观测工作支持他们的解释，可能会导致对科学家如何理解宇宙膨胀和大爆炸的数学基础进行重大重新评估。

paras.en: The research received funding from the United Kingdom's Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council and the American Institute of Mathematics SQuaREs Program.
paras.zh: 该研究获得了英国工程与物理科学研究委员会和美国数学研究所 SQuaREs 项目的资助。

paras.en: Materials provided by University of California - Davis. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由加州大学戴维斯分校提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

paras.en: - C. Alexander, B. Temple, Z. Vogler. The instability of critical and underdense Friedmann spacetimes at the Big Bang as an alternative to dark energy. Proceedings of the Royal Society A Mathematical Physical and Engineering Science, 2026; 482 (2338) DOI: 10.1098/rspa.2025.0912
paras.zh: - C. 亚历山大、B. 坦普尔、Z. 沃格勒。大爆炸时临界和低密度弗里德曼时空的不稳定性作为暗能量的替代品。英国皇家学会数学物理与工程科学学报，2026 年； 482 (2338) DOI: 10.1098/rspa.2025.0912

articles.title: NASA discovers Jupiter’s invisible shield is more complex than Earth’s

paras.en: NASA discovers Jupiterâs invisible shield is more complex than Earthâs
paras.zh: 美国宇航局发现木星的隐形屏障比地球的更复杂

paras.en: NASAâs Juno spacecraft has uncovered Jupiterâs surprisingly complex defense against the solar wind, revealing physics that could help explain the power of exploding stars.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局的朱诺号宇宙飞船发现了木星对太阳风的惊人复杂的防御，揭示了有助于解释恒星爆炸威力的物理学。

paras.en: - NASAâs Juno spacecraft has discovered that Jupiter uses a surprisingly complex system of powerful plasma waves and multiple shock regions to defend against the solar wind. The findings reveal major differences between Jupiter and Earth and could help scientists understand the enormous shock waves produced by exploding stars.
paras.zh: - 美国宇航局的朱诺号航天器发现木星使用一个由强大等离子体波和多个激波区域组成的极其复杂的系统来防御太阳风。这些发现揭示了木星和地球之间的主要差异，可以帮助科学家了解恒星爆炸产生的巨大冲击波。

paras.en: NASA's Juno spacecraft has uncovered remarkable new details about how Jupiter withstands the constant stream of high-energy particles flowing from the Sun. The findings reveal that the solar system's largest planet relies on a much more complex system of plasma waves and shock regions than Earth does.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局的朱诺号宇宙飞船发现了有关木星如何承受来自太阳的持续高能粒子流的非凡新细节。研究结果表明，太阳系最大的行星依赖于比地球复杂得多的等离子波系统和激波区域。

paras.en: Led by scientists at the University of Iowa, the research provides the most detailed observations yet of Jupiter's bow shock, an invisible boundary where particles from the Sun encounter the planet's magnetic environment. The discovery reveals important differences in how Jupiter and Earth respond to these incoming particles.
paras.zh: 这项研究由爱荷华大学的科学家领导，提供了迄今为止对木星弓激波最详细的观测，弓激波是来自太阳的粒子遇到木星磁环境的看不见的边界。这一发现揭示了木星和地球对这些传入粒子的反应方式的重要差异。

paras.en: Beyond Jupiter, the results could also help scientists understand some of the most powerful events in the universe, including the extreme shock waves associated with exploding stars.
paras.zh: 除了木星之外，这些结果还可以帮助科学家了解宇宙中一些最强大的事件，包括与恒星爆炸相关的极端冲击波。

paras.en: How Jupiter Protects Itself From the Solar Wind
paras.zh: 木星如何保护自己免受太阳风的影响

paras.en: The Sun continuously releases a stream of electrically charged particles called the solar wind. These particles travel through space at tremendous speeds, often faster than the speed at which sound waves move through the surrounding plasma. When the solar wind approaches a planet with a magnetic field, it encounters a boundary known as the bow shock.
paras.zh: 太阳不断释放出一股带电粒子流，称为太阳风。这些粒子以惊人的速度在太空中传播，通常比声波穿过周围等离子体的速度还要快。当太阳风接近具有磁场的行星时，它会遇到称为弓激波的边界。

paras.en: At Earth, this boundary plays an important protective role. It slows and heats the incoming particles, helping redirect much of the solar wind around the planet. Without this process, more harmful particles could reach Earth's atmosphere, potentially making conditions less favorable for life.
paras.zh: 在地球上，这个边界起着重要的保护作用。它减缓并加热传入的粒子，帮助改变地球周围大部分太阳风的方向。如果没有这个过程，更多有害颗粒可能会到达地球大气层，从而可能使环境变得不利于生命生存。

paras.en: Jupiter also has a bow shock, but its enormous size, powerful magnetic field, and gaseous composition make it a particularly interesting place to study how these boundaries behave. Scientists have long wanted to understand whether Jupiter handles the solar wind differently from Earth and what those differences might reveal about other objects throughout the universe.
paras.zh: 木星也有弓形激波，但其巨大的尺寸、强大的磁场和气体成分使其成为研究这些边界如何表现的特别有趣的地方。科学家们长期以来一直想了解木星处理太阳风的方式是否与地球不同，以及这些差异可能揭示宇宙中其他物体的哪些信息。

paras.en: Scientists Discover a More Complex Defense System
paras.zh: 科学家发现更复杂的防御系统

paras.en: Using measurements from Juno, researchers discovered that Jupiter relies on plasma waves with multiple frequencies to slow and heat incoming solar particles. These different frequencies, known as "harmonics," create a more elaborate wave pattern than the one typically observed at Earth.
paras.zh: 利用朱诺号的测量结果，研究人员发现木星依靠多种频率的等离子体波来减缓和加热入射的太阳粒子。这些不同的频率（称为“谐波”）产生了比地球上通常观察到的更复杂的波形。

paras.en: The process can be compared to music. Just as several notes played together produce a richer sound than a single note, plasma waves containing multiple frequencies can interact with incoming particles in more complex ways. This allows Jupiter's bow shock to transfer energy to more particles, heating them and reducing their speed.
paras.zh: 这个过程可以比作音乐。正如几个音符一起演奏比单个音符产生更丰富的声音一样，包含多个频率的等离子体波可以以更复杂的方式与传入的粒子相互作用。这使得木星的弓形激波能够将能量传递给更多的粒子，加热它们并降低它们的速度。

paras.en: Earth's bow shock, by comparison, primarily uses plasma waves concentrated around a single frequency. That simpler arrangement is generally sufficient for the conditions encountered near our planet.
paras.zh: 相比之下，地球的弓形激波主要使用集中在单一频率附近的等离子体波。这种更简单的安排通常足以应对我们星球附近遇到的情况。

paras.en: "Jupiter has found its own way to deal with the solar wind, through plasma waves that are stronger and exhibit richer harmonic structures," says Jayasri Joseph, a postdoctoral researcher in the Department of Physics and Astronomy at Iowa and the study's corresponding author. "That's important because if you have multiple frequencies, you can heat more particles in the solar wind and slow them down."
paras.zh: 爱荷华州物理与天文学系博士后研究员、该研究的通讯作者贾亚斯里·约瑟夫（Jayasri Joseph）表示：“木星已经找到了自己的方式来应对太阳风，通过更强、表现出更丰富谐波结构的等离子体波。” “这很重要，因为如果你有多个频率，你可以加热太阳风中更多的粒子并减慢它们的速度。”

paras.en: The researchers identified another striking difference in how the two planets interact with the solar wind.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现了这两颗行星与太阳风相互作用的另一个显着差异。

paras.en: Before incoming particles reach Jupiter's main bow shock, they can encounter smaller shock structures called shocklets. These additional regions help slow the solar wind before it arrives at the primary shock boundary.
paras.zh: 在进入的粒子到达木星的主弓激波之前，它们可能会遇到称为小激波的较小激波结构。这些额外的区域有助于在太阳风到达主激波边界之前减缓太阳风的速度。

paras.en: Earth's bow shock, in contrast, generally serves as the main region where the incoming solar wind is slowed and redirected. Jupiter's additional shock structures reveal a more complicated process for managing the energy carried by solar particles.
paras.zh: 相比之下，地球的弓形激波通常是传入太阳风减慢并改变方向的主要区域。木星额外的激波结构揭示了管理太阳粒子携带的能量的更复杂的过程。

paras.en: "Earth does not need to take these extra steps to handle the solar wind because the impact isn't as powerful," says Bill Kurth, a research scientist in Iowa's Department of Physics and Astronomy and a coauthor of the study.
paras.zh: “地球不需要采取这些额外的措施来应对太阳风，因为太阳风的影响没有那么强大，”爱荷华州物理和天文学系的研究科学家、该研究的合著者比尔·库思说。

paras.en: Kurth has participated in NASA's Juno mission since the spacecraft launched in 2011.
paras.zh: 自 2011 年 NASA 朱诺号航天器发射以来，库尔特一直参与该任务。

paras.en: What Jupiter Can Teach Us About Exploding Stars
paras.zh: 木星可以告诉我们关于爆炸恒星的什么

paras.en: Although these observations focus on Jupiter, their significance could extend far beyond our solar system.
paras.zh: 尽管这些观测集中在木星，但它们的意义可能远远超出我们的太阳系。

paras.en: Shock waves occur throughout the universe, particularly in environments where enormous amounts of energy are released. Some of the most extreme examples are found in supernova remnants, the expanding clouds of material left behind when certain dying stars explode.
paras.zh: 冲击波发生在整个宇宙中，特别是在释放大量能量的环境中。一些最极端的例子是在超新星遗迹中发现的，即某些垂死恒星爆炸时留下的不断膨胀的物质云。

paras.en: These cosmic shock waves are vastly more powerful than those encountered near Jupiter. However, the physical processes that control how energy moves through plasma share important similarities. By examining Jupiter's bow shock in unprecedented detail, scientists can investigate mechanisms that would be much harder to measure directly around distant stars.
paras.zh: 这些宇宙冲击波比木星附近遇到的冲击波要强大得多。然而，控制能量在等离子体中移动的物理过程有重要的相似之处。通过以前所未有的细节检查木星的弓激波，科学家们可以研究在遥远恒星周围直接测量更困难的机制。

paras.en: "Because even more powerful shocks occur around astrophysical objects such as supernova remnants, Jupiter's bow shock offers a nearby natural laboratory for exploring and for understanding how nature converts enormous amounts of flow energy into heat and energetic particles," Joseph says.
paras.zh: 约瑟夫说：“因为更强大的冲击发生在超新星遗迹等天体物理物体周围，木星的弓形激波为探索和了解大自然如何将大量流动能量转化为热量和高能粒子提供了一个附近的自然实验室。”

paras.en: Understanding these processes could improve scientific models of how shock waves transfer energy, heat particles, and shape environments across the universe.
paras.zh: 了解这些过程可以改进冲击波如何在宇宙中传递能量、热粒子和塑造环境的科学模型。

paras.en: NASA's Juno Makes Unprecedented Measurements
paras.zh: 美国宇航局的朱诺号进行了前所未有的测量

paras.en: The breakthrough was made possible by observations Juno collected in December 2024. The NASA spacecraft has been orbiting Jupiter since July 2016, providing researchers with an extraordinary opportunity to investigate the giant planet and its surrounding environment.
paras.zh: 这一突破是通过朱诺号在 2024 年 12 月收集的观测数据实现的。美国宇航局航天器自 2016 年 7 月以来一直绕木星运行，为研究人员提供了一个绝佳的机会来调查这颗巨大的行星及其周围环境。

paras.en: A key part of the discovery came from the Juno Waves instrument, which was designed and built by physicists at the University of Iowa. The instrument measures electric and magnetic wave activity, allowing scientists to study the behavior of plasma around Jupiter.
paras.zh: 这一发现的关键部分来自朱诺波仪器，该仪器是由爱荷华大学的物理学家设计和建造的。该仪器测量电波和磁波活动，使科学家能够研究木星周围等离子体的行为。

paras.en: Earlier spacecraft had detected the presence of bow shocks at outer planets, but they lacked the measurements needed to reveal the detailed structure of the plasma waves involved. Juno's observations have now provided a much clearer picture of how these waves behave at Jupiter.
paras.zh: 早期的航天器已经检测到外行星上存在弓形激波，但它们缺乏揭示所涉及的等离子体波的详细结构所需的测量数据。朱诺号的观测现在为这些波在木星的行为提供了更清晰的图像。

paras.en: The findings were published online on July 31 in Nature Communications in a study titled "Plasma wave observations from Juno spacecraft at the Jovian bow shock."
paras.zh: 该研究结果于 7 月 31 日在线发表在《自然通讯》杂志上，题为“朱诺号航天器对木星弓激波的等离子体波观测”。

paras.en: Additional contributors from the University of Iowa included Allison Jaynes, an associate professor in the Department of Physics and Astronomy, along with Jeremy Faden and Chris Piker, who provide research support in the same department.
paras.zh: 爱荷华大学的其他贡献者包括物理和天文学系副教授 Allison Jaynes，以及在同一系提供研究支持的 Jeremy Faden 和 Chris Piker。

paras.en: The international research team also included Lynn Wilson III of NASA Goddard Space Flight Center; John Connerney of NASA Goddard Space Flight Center and the Space Research Corporation; Frederic Allegrini of the Southwest Research Institute and the University of Texas-San Antonio; Rob Wilson of the University of Colorado-Boulder; Ali Sulaiman of the University of Minnesota; Scott Boltion and Robert Ebert of the Southwest Research Institute; and Barry Mauk of the Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory.
paras.zh: 国际研究团队还包括美国宇航局戈达德太空飞行中心的林恩·威尔逊三世（Lynn Wilson III）；美国宇航局戈达德太空飞行中心和空间研究公司的约翰·康纳尼；西南研究所和德克萨斯大学圣安东尼奥分校的 Frederic Allegrini；科罗拉多大学博尔德分校的 Rob Wilson；明尼苏达大学的 Ali Sulaiman；西南研究所的 Scott Boltion 和 Robert Ebert；和约翰·霍普金斯大学应用物理实验室的 Barry Mauk。

paras.en: Materials provided by University of Iowa. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由爱荷华大学提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

paras.en: - J. Joseph, W. S. Kurth, L. B. Wilson, J. E. P. Connerney, F. Allegrini, R. J. Wilson, A. H. Sulaiman, R. W. Ebert, J. B. Faden, C. W. Piker, A. N. Jaynes, B. H. Mauk, S. J. Bolton. Plasma wave observations from Juno spacecraft at the Jovian bow shock. Nature Communications, 2026; 17 (1) DOI: 10.1038/s41467-026-76223-x
paras.zh: - J. Joseph、W. S. Kurth、L. B. Wilson、J. E. P. Connerney、F. Allegrini、R. J. Wilson、A. H. Sulaiman、R. W. Ebert、J. B. Faden、C. W. Piker、A. N. Jaynes、B. H. Mauk、S. J. Bolton。朱诺号航天器对木星弓激波的等离子体波观测。自然通讯，2026； 17 (1) DOI：10.1038/s41467-026-76223-x

articles.title: Artemis II commander Reid Wiseman named deputy director for NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory
articles.author: Josh Dinner

paras.en: The leader of NASA's first mission around the moon in half a century is the last to announce what's next for him after retiring from active astronaut duty.
paras.zh: 这位美国宇航局半个世纪以来首次绕月任务的负责人是最后一位宣布退役后下一步计划的人。

paras.en: All four astronauts of the Artemis II mission, which flew around the moon in April, have hung up their spacesuits and moved on to greener pastures. NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL), managed by Caltech, announced yesterday that former NASA astronaut Reid Wiseman will step into the role of Caltech associate vice president and deputy director of JPL, beginning Nov. 30.
paras.zh: 今年四月，阿耳忒弥斯二号绕月飞行任务的所有四名宇航员都已经挂起了宇航服，前往更美好的地方。由加州理工学院管理的 NASA 喷气推进实验室 (JPL) 昨天宣布，前 NASA 宇航员 Reid Wiseman 将从 11 月 30 日开始担任加州理工学院副总裁兼 JPL 副主任。

paras.en: "Reid has spent his career at the edge of what is possible, and he has the technical judgment, operational experience, and leadership to help push that edge farther," NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman said in a JPL press release.
paras.zh: NASA 局长贾里德·艾萨克曼 (Jared Isaacman) 在喷气推进实验室的新闻稿中表示：“里德的职业生涯一直处于可能性的边缘，他拥有技术判断、操作经验和领导力，可以帮助进一步推动这一边缘。”

paras.en: Wiseman announced his transition to "astronaut emeritus" alongside Artemis II pilot Victor Glover in September. Glover, subsequently, accepted a full-time role as executive advisor to the president of his alma mater, California Polytechnic State University (Cal Poly).
paras.zh: 怀斯曼于 9 月宣布与阿耳忒弥斯二号飞行员维克多·格洛弗 (Victor Glover) 一起转为“名誉宇航员”。随后，格洛弗接受了母校加州理工州立大学 (Cal Poly) 校长的全职执行顾问职位。

paras.en: Artemis II mission specialists, Christina Koch and Canada's Jeremy Hansen, also made the decision to step away from their spaceflight careers. Hansen announced his career change in July, and has since entered into reservist duty with the Royal Canadian Air Force. Koch, more recently, was appointed as NASA's acting deputy chief engineer, effective Nov. 1.
paras.zh: 阿耳忒弥斯二号任务专家克里斯蒂娜·科赫和加拿大的杰里米·汉森也决定退出航天事业。汉森于七月宣布了他的职业转变，此后开始在加拿大皇家空军担任预备役军人。最近，科赫被任命为 NASA 代理副总工程师，于 11 月 1 日生效。

paras.en: The quartet launched aboard NASA's Orion capsule on April 1, and completed a 10-day flight around the far side of the moon and back. Their mission took them further from Earth than any crewed spaceflight in history, and captured the attention of millions, who were captivated by the astronauts' incredible views and their ability to demonstrate the best traits of humanity, even while being the four people farthest from it.
paras.zh: 四人组于 4 月 1 日搭乘 NASA 的猎户座太空舱发射升空，并完成了为期 10 天的绕月背面飞行。他们的任务使他们比历史上任何载人航天飞行都离地球更远，并吸引了数百万人的注意力，他们被宇航员令人难以置信的观点和他们展示人类最好品质的能力所吸引，尽管他们是距离地球最远的四个人。

paras.en: The mission served as a stepping stone in NASA's Artemis program which aims to return astronauts to the surface of the moon and eventually establish a permanent base there. NASA is targeting mid-2027 for Artemis III as a flight test with Orion and the two Artemis lunar lander spacecraft (SpaceX's Starship and Blue Origin's Blue Moon). If everything goes according to plan, that mission will pave the way for Artemis IV, and the program's first crewed lunar landing in 2028.
paras.zh: 这次任务是美国宇航局阿耳忒弥斯计划的垫脚石，该计划旨在将宇航员送回月球表面，并最终在那里建立永久基地。 NASA 计划在 2027 年中期对阿耳忒弥斯 III 进行飞行测试，与猎户座和两艘阿耳忒弥斯月球着陆器（SpaceX 的星舰和蓝色起源的蓝月亮）一起进行飞行测试。如果一切按计划进行，该任务将为阿耳忒弥斯四号以及该计划于 2028 年首次载人登月铺平道路。

paras.en: A Baltimore native, Wiseman is a retired U.S. Navy captain who served as an aviator and test pilot before joining NASA's astronaut corps in 2009. He launched to space for the first time on the on the Soyuz TMA-13M mission to the International Space Station (ISS). He spent 165 days in orbit serving as part of ISS Expeditions 40 and 41, and completed two spacewalks totaling nearly 13 hours.
paras.zh: 怀斯曼是巴尔的摩人，是一名退役美国海军上尉，在 2009 年加入 NASA 宇航员队伍之前曾担任飞行员和试飞员。他在联盟号 TMA-13M 前往国际空间站 (ISS) 的任务中首次进入太空。作为国际空间站第 40 次和第 41 次探险的一部分，他在轨道上度过了 165 天，并完成了两次太空行走，总计近 13 小时。

paras.en: Before his selection for Artemis II, Wiseman worked as NASA's chief astronaut, overseeing crew readiness, astronaut assignments and flight safety from Dec. 2020 - Nov. 2022.
paras.zh: 在入选阿尔忒弥斯二号之前，怀斯曼曾担任 NASA 首席宇航员，从 2020 年 12 月至 2022 年 11 月负责监督机组人员的准备情况、宇航员的分配和飞行安全。

paras.en: As JPL's new deputy director, Wiseman will serve under Director Dave Gallagher, helping oversee "strategic leadership, stewardship, and continuous improvement of laboratory operations," according to the JPL release.
paras.zh: 根据喷气推进实验室的新闻稿，作为喷气推进实验室的新副主任，怀斯曼将在戴夫·加拉格尔主任的领导下工作，帮助监督“实验室运营的战略领导、管理和持续改进”。

paras.en: JPL is a federally funded research and development center specializing in robotic space exploration. The lab is responsible for some of NASA's most recognizable planetary missions, including the Perseverance and Curiosity Mars rovers, Europa Clipper and the Voyager probes. JPL also operates NASA's Deep Space Network, which provides continuous communications with spacecraft throughout the solar system.
paras.zh: 喷气推进实验室是一家联邦政府资助的研发中心，专门从事机器人太空探索。该实验室负责美国宇航局一些最知名的行星任务，包括毅力号和好奇号火星探测器、欧罗巴快船和航海者号探测器。喷气推进实验室还运营着美国宇航局的深空网络，该网络为整个太阳系的航天器提供持续的通信。

paras.en: "I've explored the furthest reaches of what a human can explore at NASA — and there were truly no words in the English vocabulary to describe seeing the sun disappear behind the moon from deep space," Wiseman said.
paras.zh: 怀斯曼说：“我在美国宇航局探索了人类所能探索的最远的地方——英语词汇中确实没有任何词语可以描述从深空看到太阳消失在月球后面。”

paras.en: "But that experience was really the jumping off point to go do the impossible things that Caltech and JPL dream, dare together, and do for NASA and the nation.”
paras.zh: “但那次经历确实是实现加州理工学院和喷气推进实验室梦想、敢于共同为 NASA 和国家做不可能的事情的起点。”

paras.en: Josh Dinner is Space.com's Spaceflight Staff Writer and a photographer with a passion for science and exploration. He has worked the space beat since 2016, covering the evolution of NASA's commercial spaceflight partnerships and crewed missions, planetary science missions, the Artemis program and humanity's return to the moon. He also enjoys building 1:144-scale model rockets and spacecraft. Find some of Josh's launch photography on Instagram, and follow him on X, where he mostly posts in haiku.
paras.zh: 乔什·丁纳 (Joshdinner) 是 Space.com 的 Spaceflight 特约撰稿人，也是一位热衷于科学和探索的摄影师。自 2016 年以来，他一直致力于太空领域的研究，报道了 NASA 商业航天合作伙伴关系和载人任务、行星科学任务、阿尔忒弥斯计划和人类重返月球的演变。他还喜欢建造 1:144 比例的火箭和航天器模型。在 Instagram 上查找 Josh 的一些首发照片，并在 X 上关注他，他主要在 X 上发布俳句。

articles.title: On this day in space! Oct. 29, 1991: NASA's Galileo spacecraft flies by asteroid Gaspra and snaps amazing photos while flying at 18,000 mph
articles.author: Hanneke Weitering

paras.en: On Oct. 29, 1991, the Galileo spacecraft flew by the asteroid Gaspra on its way to Jupiter. Gaspra was the first asteroid to ever be visited by a spacecraft.
paras.zh: 1991年10月29日，伽利略号宇宙飞船在飞往木星的途中飞越小行星加斯普拉。加斯普拉 (Gaspra) 是第一颗被航天器访问过的小行星。

paras.en: Gaspra orbits near the inner edge of the asteroid belt. The Galileo spacecraft had been travelling through the asteroid belt for about two months before it reached Gaspra. Galileo was 990 miles (1,593 kilometers) away from Gaspra when it whizzed by, and it was travelling at a relative speed of about 5 miles (8 km) per second.
paras.zh: Gaspra 的轨道靠近小行星带的内边缘。伽利略号宇宙飞船在到达加斯普拉之前已经穿过小行星带大约两个月了。当伽利略号呼啸而过时，距加斯普拉 990 英里（1,593 公里），其相对速度约为每秒 5 英里（8 公里）。

paras.en: The spacecraft took several photos of the asteroid and used an instrument called the Near-Infrared Mapping Spectrometer to study its chemical composition and other physical properties. Galileo determined that Gaspra has an irregular and elongated shape measuring about 12 miles long and 7 miles wide. The images revealed that Gaspra was also covered in craters. Because Galileo was too far away for Gaspra's gravity to affect it, the spacecraft was not able to determine the asteroid's mass.
paras.zh: 该航天器拍摄了这颗小行星的几张照片，并使用一种称为近红外测绘光谱仪的仪器来研究其化学成分和其他物理特性。伽利略确定加斯普拉具有不规则且细长的形状，长约 12 英里，宽约 7 英里。图像显示加斯普拉也布满了陨石坑。由于伽利略距离太远，加斯普拉的引力无法影响它，因此航天器无法确定小行星的质量。

paras.en: The Galileo spacecraft's flyby of Gaspra was a pitstop near the midpoint of its 6-year journey to Jupiter, the largest planet in our solar system. NASA launched Galileo toward Jupiter in October 1989, with the probe swinging by Venus and Earth in 1990 before its encounter with Gaspra.
paras.zh: 伽利略号宇宙飞船飞越加斯普拉是其为期六年的太阳系最大行星木星之旅的中点附近的一个停留。美国宇航局 (NASA) 于 1989 年 10 月向木星发射伽利略号，探测器于 1990 年绕行金星和地球，然后与加斯普拉 (Gaspra) 相遇。

paras.en: The Gaspra flyby was the first asteroid flyby in history, with Galileo approaching to just under 1,000 miles (1,601 kilometers) while flying at a whopping 18,000 mph. Galileo's photos of Gaspra "revealed a cratered, complex, irregular body about 20 by 12 by 11 kilometers (12.4 by 7.4 by 6.8 miles), with a thin covering of dust and rubble," NASA wrote in an overview.
paras.zh: Gaspra 飞越是历史上首次飞越小行星，伽利略号接近 1,000 英里（1,601 公里），飞行速度高达 18,000 英里/小时。美国宇航局在一份概述中写道，伽利略拍摄的加斯普拉照片“揭示了一个布满陨石坑的、复杂的、不规则的天体，长约20×12×11公里（12.4×7.4×6.8英里），上面覆盖着一层薄薄的灰尘和瓦砾”。

paras.en: "The picture we get of Gaspra is one of something that has suffered a lot during its history," the UPI press service quoted Joseph Veverka, a Galileo imaging team member, as saying at the time. "We suspect that this is the survivor of a series of catastrophic collisions in the past."
paras.zh: 合众国际社新闻服务援引伽利略成像小组成员约瑟夫·韦韦尔卡当时的话说：“我们获得的加斯普拉照片是其历史上遭受过严重破坏的照片之一。” “我们怀疑这是过去一系列灾难性碰撞的幸存者。”

paras.en: Galileo would go on to fly by Earth a second time in 1992, then swing close by the asteroid Ida in 1993 before finally arriving at Jupiter in 1995. Along the way, the probe was in the right place at the right time to watch as the Comet Shoemaker-Levy 9 broke into pieces and crashed into Jupiter in July 1994.
paras.zh: 伽利略号于 1992 年第二次飞越地球，然后于 1993 年靠近小行星艾达，最终于 1995 年抵达木星。一路上，探测器在正确的时间到达了正确的地点，目睹了舒梅克-利维 9 号彗星于 1994 年 7 月破碎并撞向木星。

paras.en: Since Galileo's historic first asteroid flyby, NASA and other space agencies have gone on to land on asteroids (like NEAR on asteroid Eros), collect samples of asteroids and return them to Earth (like NASA's OSIRIS-REx and Japan's Hayabusa probes), and have even intentionally crashed probes into asteroids (like NASA's DART asteroid impact mission) to test planetary protection techniques.
paras.zh: 自从伽利略历史性地首次飞越小行星以来，美国宇航局和其他航天机构继续登陆小行星（例如小行星爱神星上的近邻），收集小行星样本并将其带回地球（例如美国宇航局的 OSIRIS-REx 和日本的隼鸟探测器），甚至故意将探测器撞向小行星（例如美国宇航局的 DART 小行星撞击任务）以测试行星保护技术。

paras.en: Want more space history? Check out our full On This Day In Space Story archive and watch our On This Day In Space videos on YouTube.
paras.zh: 想要更多太空历史吗？查看我们完整的“太空中的这一天”故事存档，并在 YouTube 上观看“太空中的这一天”视频。

paras.en: Hanneke Weitering is a multimedia journalist in the Pacific Northwest reporting on the future of aviation at FutureFlight.aero and Aviation International News and was previously the Editor for Spaceflight and Astronomy news here at Space.com. As an editor with over 10 years of experience in science journalism she has previously written for Scholastic Classroom Magazines, MedPage Today and The Joint Institute for Computational Sciences at Oak Ridge National Laboratory. After studying physics at the University of Tennessee in her hometown of Knoxville, she earned her graduate degree in Science, Health and Environmental Reporting (SHERP) from New York University. Hanneke joined the Space.com team in 2016 as a staff writer and producer, covering topics including spaceflight and astronomy. She currently lives in Seattle, home of the Space Needle, with her cat and two snakes. In her spare time, Hanneke enjoys exploring the Rocky Mountains, basking in nature and looking for dark skies to gaze at the cosmos.
paras.zh: Hanneke Weitering 是西北太平洋地区的一名多媒体记者，在 FutureFlight.aero 和 Aviation International News 报道航空业的未来，此前曾担任 Space.com 的航天和天文学新闻编辑。作为一名拥有 10 多年科学新闻经验的编辑，她曾为学术课堂杂志、MedPage Today 和橡树岭国家实验室计算科学研究所撰写文章。在家乡诺克斯维尔的田纳西大学学习物理学后，她在纽约大学获得了科学、健康和环境报告 (SHERP) 研究生学位。 Hanneke 于 2016 年加入 Space.com 团队，担任专职撰稿人和制作人，涵盖航天和天文学等主题。她目前与她的猫和两条蛇住在太空针塔所在地西雅图。在业余时间，汉内克喜欢探索落基山脉，沐浴在大自然中，寻找黑暗的天空凝视宇宙。

articles.title: Patrick Stewart, renowned actor and ‘Star Trek’s’ Captain Picard, dies at 86
articles.author: Jeff Spry

paras.en: Less than a week after the fates took Walter Koenig from our galaxy, another "Star Trek" legend has left us: Sir Patrick Stewart has died at the age of 86.
paras.zh: 命运将沃尔特·科尼格从我们的银河系带走后不到一周，另一位《星际迷航》传奇人物就离开了我们：帕特里克·斯图尔特爵士去世，享年 86 岁。

paras.en: According to his spokesperson Kelly Bush Novak, the beloved Shakespearean actor passed away on Wednesday (Oct. 28) at his Los Angeles home after a short struggle with Alzheimer’s disease and Lewy body dementia.
paras.zh: 据他的发言人凯莉·布什·诺瓦克称，这位深受喜爱的莎士比亚演员在与阿尔茨海默病和路易体痴呆症进行了短暂的斗争后于周三（10 月 28 日）在洛杉矶的家中去世。

paras.en: "He has been held in the warm embrace of family and friends, surrounded by live music, prayer, tears, laughter and the kind of profound emotion that only he could inspire after a lifetime of devotion to us all," Bush Novak shared. "We will forever cherish the peaceful ease and reflection on his face, an enduring reminder of his invincible grace."
paras.zh: 布什·诺瓦克分享道：“他被家人和朋友温暖的拥抱所包围，周围环绕着现场音乐、祈祷、泪水、笑声，以及只有他在一生为我们所有人奉献之后才能激发的深刻情感。” “我们将永远珍惜他脸上的平静安逸和倒影，这将永远提醒我们他无敌的恩典。”

paras.en: The first time I ever saw Patrick Stewart was in director John Boorman’s masterful 1981 King Arthur film, "Excalibur." As a young teenager, I was immediately captivated by his commanding presence and charisma portraying King Leodegrance of Cameliard — Queen Guinevere’s noble father and a cunning warrior.
paras.zh: 我第一次见到帕特里克·斯图尔特是在导演约翰·保曼 (John Boorman) 1981 年精彩的亚瑟王电影《神剑》(Excalibur) 中。作为一个年轻的青少年，我立即被他所扮演的卡梅利亚国王利奥德格朗斯（王后格尼薇儿的高贵父亲和狡猾的战士）的威严和魅力所吸引。

paras.en: In 1984, he entered the sci-fi realm in David Lynch's grand and ambitious adaptation of Frank Herbert's "Dune," in which he played Paul Atreides' good friend and mentor, War Master Gurney Halleck.
paras.zh: 1984 年，他在大卫·林奇 (David Lynch) 改编自弗兰克·赫伯特 (Frank Herbert) 的宏伟而雄心勃勃的小说《沙丘》(Dune) 中进入科幻领域，在片中他扮演保罗·阿特雷迪斯 (Paul Atreides) 的好朋友兼导师、战争大师格尼·哈莱克 (Gurney Halleck)。

paras.en: Stewart was later cast as the U.S.S. Enterprise’s Capt. Jean-Luc Picard in "Star Trek: The Next Generation. He entranced millions of viewers in this role, traveling the final frontier with his gallant crew and redefining the brave and compassionate traits of a Federation starship commander. His adventurous journey on that popular show, a spinoff of "Star Trek: The Original Series," ran from 1987 to 1994, encompassing 178 episodes across seven seasons confronting Klingons, Cardassians, Romulans and The Borg.
paras.zh: 斯图尔特后来被选为美国总统。 《星际迷航：下一代》中的企业号船长让-卢克·皮卡德 (Jean-Luc Picard) 吸引了数百万观众。他与英勇的船员们一起穿越最后的边疆，重新定义了联邦星舰指挥官的勇敢和富有同情心的特质。他在这部热门剧中的冒险之旅是《星际迷航：原始系列》的衍生剧，从 1987 年持续到 1994 年，共 7 季 178 集，与克林贡人对抗，卡达西人、罗慕兰人和博格人。

paras.en: When the series ended, Stewart continued on in the Enterprise's center seat by starring in four "Star Trek" feature films: 1994’s "Star Trek: Generations," 1996’s "Star Trek: First Contact," 1998’s "Star Trek: Insurrection," and 2002’s "Star Trek: Nemesis." Stewart also reprised the role of Jean-Luc Picard in three seasons of Paramount+’s "Star Trek: Picard," which ran from 2020 to 2023.
paras.zh: 系列结束后，斯图尔特继续在企业号的中心位置上主演了四部《星际迷航》故事片：1994 年的《星际迷航：世代》、1996 年的《星际迷航：第一次接触》、1998 年的《星际迷航：叛乱》和 2002 年的《星际迷航：复仇女神》。斯图尔特还在派拉蒙+的《星际迷航：皮卡德》三季（2020 年至 2023 年播出）中再次扮演让-吕克·皮卡德这一角色。

paras.en: Stewart's prodigious talent was on further display in the hit adaptations of Marvel’s "The X-Men." He played the powerful, wheelchair-bound telepath Professor Charles Xavier in 2000’s "X-Men," 2003’s "X2: X-Men United," 2006’s "X-Men: The Last Stand," 2014’s "X-Men: Days of Future Past," and 2017’s "Logan."
paras.zh: 斯图尔特的惊人才华在漫威电影《X战警》的热门改编作品中得到了进一步展示。他在2000年的《X战警》、2003年的《X战警：X战警联队》、2006年的《X战警：背水一战》、2014年的《X战警：逆转未来》和2017年的《洛根》中饰演强大的、坐在轮椅上的心灵感应教授查尔斯·泽维尔。

paras.en: Stewart, and Xavier, were prominently featured in those films. The actor and character also appeared in 2009’s "X-Men Origins: Wolverine" and 2013’s "The Wolverine," and will do so again in "Avengers: Doomsday," which will be released around Christmastime this year.
paras.zh: 斯图尔特和泽维尔在这些电影中扮演了重要角色。这位演员和角色还出现在 2009 年的《X 战警前传：金刚狼》和 2013 年的《金刚狼》中，并将在今年圣诞节前后上映的《复仇者联盟：世界末日》中再次出现。

paras.en: Aside from the two "Star Trek" and "The X-Men" franchise roles, Stewart had a flourishing career that spanned radio, stage and screen and was always a stellar attraction at any comic-con or other fan event around the world. Another of his many memorable projects was the compelling one-man stage show in which he played all the characters in Charles Dickens' novella "A Christmas Carol," captured on a two-disc CD set that I listen to each holiday season.
paras.zh: 除了在《星际迷航》和《X战警》系列中扮演两个角色之外，斯图尔特的职业生涯也蒸蒸日上，横跨广播、舞台和银幕，在世界各地的任何动漫展或其他粉丝活动中始终是一个引人注目的明星。他的另一个令人难忘的项目是引人入胜的单人舞台表演，他在其中扮演了查尔斯·狄更斯的中篇小说《圣诞颂歌》中的所有角色，我在每个假期都会听一张两张光盘的 CD，收录了该作品。

paras.en: Knighted by Queen Elizabeth II in 2010, Sir Patrick Stewart leaves behind a remarkable legacy that brought a rare gravitas and humanity to every performance he was ever involved in, and his passing leaves fans, friends and loved ones with heavy hearts. Here’s to a wonderful life well-lived!
paras.zh: 帕特里克·斯图尔特爵士于 2010 年被英国女王伊丽莎白二世封为爵士，留下了一份非凡的遗产，为他参与的每场表演带来了罕见的庄严和人性，他的去世让粉丝、朋友和亲人心情沉重。 Here’s to a wonderful life well-lived!

paras.en: Jeff Spry is an award-winning screenwriter and veteran freelance journalist covering TV, movies, video games, books, and comics. His work has appeared at SYFY Wire, Inverse, Collider, Bleeding Cool and elsewhere. Jeff lives in beautiful Bend, Oregon amid the ponderosa pines, classic muscle cars, a crypt of collector horror comics, and two loyal English Setters.
paras.zh: 杰夫·斯普里 (Jeff Spry) 是一位屡获殊荣的编剧和资深自由记者，报道电视、电影、视频游戏、书籍和漫画。他的作品曾出现在 SYFY Wire、Inverse、Collider、Bleeding Cool 等网站上。 Jeff lives in beautiful Bend, Oregon amid the ponderosa pines, classic muscle cars, a crypt of collector horror comics, and two loyal English Setters.
